papers.title: Validation Bias in Large Language Model Responses to Cancer Treatment Queries: A Factorial Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used by patients seeking cancer information, but their safety when users present evidence-misaligned beliefs about treatment remains uncharacterized. We hypothesized that LLMs exhibit validation bias, affirming rather than correcting such beliefs, and evaluated this with a 2x2x2 factorial design crossing conversation format (single-turn vs multi-turn), treatment type (evidence-based vs alternative), and query valence (positive vs negative). Framing was evidence-aligned (supporting evidence-based treatments or questioning alternative therapies) or evidence-misaligned (promoting alternative treatments or questioning evidence-based therapies). We analyzed 1,272 conversations (6,360 interactions) across 14 LLMs from 6 vendors, scored by an LLM judge (GPT-5-mini) validated against human annotation on a 6-dimension safety rubric. The primary outcome was the unsafe response rate, defined as a Weak classification or any critical failure. Evidence-misaligned framing increased unsafe response rates compared with evidence-aligned framing (14.4% vs 5.1%; OR 3.14, 95% CI 2.07-4.78; P < .001), and the association persisted after accounting for clustering by LLM. Among 429 conversations classified as Strong under evidence-aligned framing, 22.6% were downgraded in their paired evidence-misaligned counterpart. Multi-turn conversations had lower unsafe response rates than single-turn conversations (5.2% vs 14.7%; P < .001). Unsafe response rates varied by vendor from 1.8% to 36.8%. LLMs exhibited significant validation bias in oncology, with unsafe responses nearly tripling under evidence-misaligned framing. Evaluations limited to neutral, fact-seeking queries may overestimate real-world safety, and safety testing of medical AI systems should include evidence-misaligned user framing.

translation.title: 大语言模型对癌症治疗问题的验证偏差：一项因子交叉横断面研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人正被越来越多地用于获取癌症信息的患者，但当用户提出与证据不符的治疗信念时，其安全性尚未被刻画。我们假设LLM存在验证偏差，即肯定而非纠正此类信念，并通过2x2x2因子设计进行评估，交叉因素包括对话格式（单轮 vs 多轮）、治疗类型（循证治疗 vs 替代疗法）和查询效价（正面 vs 负面）。框架分为证据一致（支持循证治疗或质疑替代疗法）和证据不一致（推广替代疗法或质疑循证治疗）。我们分析了来自6家厂商的14个LLM的1,272段对话（6,360次交互），由经人工标注验证的LLM裁判（GPT-5-mini）依据6维安全评分标准打分。主要结局是不安全响应率，定义为Weak分类或任何关键失败。与证据一致框架相比，证据不一致框架增加了不安全响应率（14.4% vs 5.1%；OR 3.14，95% CI 2.07-4.78；P < .001），且在考虑LLM聚类效应后该关联仍然存在。在证据一致框架下被评为Strong的429段对话中，其配对的证据不一致对话中有22.6%被降级。多轮对话的不安全响应率低于单轮对话（5.2% vs 14.7%；P < .001）。各厂商的不安全响应率从1.8%到36.8%不等。LLM在肿瘤学领域表现出显著的验证偏差，证据不一致框架下不安全响应几乎增至三倍。仅限于中性、事实性查询的评估可能高估真实世界安全性，医疗AI系统的安全测试应包含证据不一致的用户框架。
translation.brief: 研究LLM面对与证据不符的癌症治疗信念时是否会迎合而非纠正，通过2x2x2因子实验量化验证偏差导致的不安全响应率。

papers.title: DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows
papers.abstract: Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. DAGGER represents a workflow as a graph, in which nodes correspond to stages and edges capture how outputs from one stage affect subsequent stages. It then decomposes workflow quality into per-node accuracy terms and per-edge dependency terms. Using a novel analytical formulation and SVD-based matrix completion, DAGGER estimates workflow quality from sparse observations without executing every candidate workflow. We evaluate DAGGER on three generative AI workflows across three datasets. DAGGER estimates workflow quality with a median error of 6.8 percentage points while reducing profiling cost by 10.2$\times$ relative to BenchPress, a state-of-the-art baseline, and selects workflow configurations competitive with state-of-the-art frameworks such as LLMSelector.

translation.title: DAGGER：面向生成式AI工作流的免部署质量估计
translation.abstract: 估计生成式AI工作流的质量具有挑战性，因为这些工作流包含多个阶段，错误会在阶段间传播，使得端到端性能不仅取决于单个模型的准确性，还取决于其输出如何影响下游阶段。每个阶段可以使用众多候选模型之一。因此，通过部署和评估每个可能的模型配置来估计端到端工作流质量的成本高得令人望而却步。现有方法因此面临估计成本与准确性之间的权衡：廉价方法往往产生不可靠的质量估计，而准确的方法需要部署和评估许多工作流配置。本文提出DAGGER，一个无需穷举部署和剖析即可估计生成式AI工作流质量的框架。DAGGER将工作流表示为图，节点对应阶段，边刻画一个阶段的输出如何影响后续阶段。它将工作流质量分解为每节点准确性项和每边依赖项。利用新颖的解析公式和基于SVD的矩阵补全，DAGGER从稀疏观测中估计工作流质量，而无需执行每个候选工作流。我们在三个数据集上的三个生成式AI工作流上评估DAGGER。DAGGER估计工作流质量的中位误差为6.8个百分点，同时相比最先进的基线BenchPress将剖析成本降低10.2倍，并选出与LLMSelector等最先进框架具有竞争力的工作流配置。
translation.brief: 解决生成式AI多阶段工作流质量估计成本过高的问题，通过图分解与SVD矩阵补全从稀疏观测中估计端到端质量。

papers.title: The Date You Didn't Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract: The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today's, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024--2026) switch a median $6.6\%$ of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to $36.5$ points of held-out accuracy. Beyond accuracy, switching to another plausible date alters LLM-judge verdicts and undoes $15$--$32\%$ of reproduced jailbreak successes on Llama-3.2-3B. Yet none of the eleven evaluation stacks we audit pins the date. With the date and the rest of the setup fixed, reruns reproduce byte-for-byte; we therefore recommend pinning, logging, and reporting the date.

translation.title: 你没设置的日期：系统提示日期作为LLM评估中的隐藏变量
translation.abstract: 许多指令微调模型的系统提示带有日期（通常是今天），会自动填充到对话和智能体请求中，因此同一评估每天可能发送不同的提示。本文探究这一隐藏输入在多大程度上改变评估结果。在六个指令微调模型和四个基准上，固定提示、解码和配置，每个模型都受影响：两个合理日期（2024-2026）会使中位数6.6%的测试项在正确与错误之间翻转。即使仅晚一天重跑评估，翻转的测试项数量也与改变批大小相当，尽管设置中没有任何改动。此外，使用语法约束的Greedy Coordinate Gradient（GCG）变体搜索任意年份的日期，我们发现某些日期会使Llama-3.x模型的留出准确率损失高达36.5分。除准确率外，切换到另一个合理日期还会改变LLM裁判的判定，并使Llama-3.2-3B上复现的越狱成功减少15-32%。然而我们审计的十一个评估栈中没有一个固定日期。在日期和其余设置固定的情况下，重跑可逐字节复现；因此我们建议固定、记录并报告日期。
translation.brief: 揭示系统提示中自动填充的日期是影响LLM评估结果和越狱复现的隐藏变量，并通过GCG搜索极端日期量化其影响，建议固定并报告该日期。

papers.title: INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract: Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language--country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge. Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. INCLUDE-2.0 is available at this https URL

translation.title: INCLUDE-2.0：解耦多语言LLM评估中的知识差距
translation.abstract: 当前的多语言基准仅覆盖现代预训练语料中语言的一小部分，且常将语言能力与回答基于特定地区和社区问题的能力混为一谈。我们提出INCLUDE-2.0，一个面向区域感知多语言事实性评估的大规模基准，覆盖来自86个国家的91种语言（共127个语言-国家对），包含从本地区域来源精选的超过22万个样本。与常将语言作为区域代理的现有基准不同，INCLUDE-2.0区分答案与上下文无关的问题、因国家而异的问题、关于某地被广泛记录的事实问题，以及主要依赖本地语言和文化来源表达的知识问题。每个条目都标注了其区域知识类型和领域，并配有英文翻译，从而能够对语言能力与区域知识掌握之间的关系进行受控分析。在INCLUDE-2.0上评估前沿和开源权重模型，我们发现总体多语言准确率掩盖了区域知识类型、语言和地区之间的巨大差异。我们发现前沿模型在本地嵌入知识上的表现差于关于地区的广泛记录事实，平均下降约14.5分。我们还表明，对于开源权重模型，规模提升准确率，但并不能可靠地使性能对问题以英语还是原语言提出保持不变。INCLUDE-2.0可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 构建覆盖91种语言、区分区域知识类型的基准INCLUDE-2.0，以解耦语言能力与区域知识掌握，揭示模型在本地嵌入知识上的短板。

papers.title: scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation
papers.abstract: Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference. Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B. Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: scOPD：基于LLM单细胞注释的路由式在策略自蒸馏
translation.abstract: 动机：大语言模型（LLM）在单细胞注释方面展现出前景，但现有训练方法主要依赖标量结果奖励，对中间生物学推理提供的监督有限。批次级注释尤其具有挑战性，因为它需要同时解决局部细胞身份和全局一对一匹配约束，一个局部错误可能影响整个分配。此外，单次推理提供的证据不足以定位不确定的预测。这些局限要求训练期间提供细粒度推理监督，推理期间进行不确定性感知的精化。结果：为应对这些挑战，我们提出scOPD，一个面向LLM单细胞注释的在策略自蒸馏框架。在推理微调之后，scOPD自适应地将合格的rollout路由到基于奖励的优化，而错误的rollout则从成功的兄弟轨迹获得特权token级监督。在推理时，rollout分歧触发对不确定分配的约束感知成对精化。在CellPuzzles和四个域外疾病数据集上，scOPD持续提升多种LLM骨干的性能，使用Qwen3-8B达到平均细胞级和批次级准确率81.71%和44.49%。可用性与实现：代码和数据可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 解决LLM单细胞注释中细粒度监督不足和批次级全局匹配约束难题，提出在策略自蒸馏框架，对错误rollout提供token级特权监督并在推理时进行不确定性感知精化。

papers.title: RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction
papers.abstract: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

translation.title: RECAP：基于上下文压缩的长时程 LLM 智能体训练
translation.abstract: 上下文压缩使大语言模型智能体能够在有限的上下文预算内处理长时程任务，方法是用压缩摘要替换交互历史。然而，将有效压缩与智能体策略进行联合学习仍然具有挑战性，因为摘要会影响后续多次交互中的任务成败。我们提出 RECAP，这是一个基于如下原则的强化学习（RL）框架：摘要应当保留由原始交互历史所诱导的行为。我们用行为失真目标来形式化这一原则，该目标度量智能体在压缩上下文与原始上下文下后续行为的散度。我们证明该失真目标的梯度可分解为两个互补的学习信号：用于摘要生成的基于失真的奖励，以及用于后续动作的自蒸馏。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上的实验表明，RECAP 在两个环境中均持续优于仅使用任务奖励的 RL 基线，在 BrowseComp-plus 和 SWE-bench Verified 上分别带来 4.6% 和 4.3% 的绝对提升。消融实验进一步凸显了联合监督摘要生成与压缩后行为对 RECAP 的价值。
translation.brief: 解决长时程任务中如何联合学习上下文压缩与智能体策略的问题，核心方法是基于行为失真目标的强化学习框架，将梯度分解为摘要生成的失真奖励与后续动作的自蒸馏两个信号。

papers.title: RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation
papers.abstract: Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users' real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. The generated dataset RecipeADQA contains natural-language questions, structured constraints, and answer sets, resulting in 128,465 instances. Experiments compare RecipeADQA with baseline datasets from two perspectives: data quality and retrieval-recommendation performance. The results show that ours outperforms existing methods on the same recipe knowledge graph in coverage, higher question quality in naturalness and constraint rationality, and better queryability. Moreover, we design a noise-augmented retrieve-and-rerank model, in which a lightweight parser first retrieves candidate recipes, and a small language model then selects and ranks relevant recipes from a noisy candidate pool. The model trained on RecipeADQA outperforms the same model trained on the baseline datasets. The relevant construction code and data have been open-sourced at a GitHub repository this https URL.

translation.title: RecipeADQA：面向多约束菜谱推荐的感知用户的问答数据集
translation.abstract: 问答式菜谱推荐任务缺乏带有真实标注（ground-truth）的数据集。现有方法往往通过食材或标签约束的简单组合来生成数据集，导致表达不自然、约束不合理，难以反映用户的真实偏好。本文提出一种面向自然语言菜谱推荐的基准式问答数据集构建方法。该方法以真实用户行为为驱动，整合外部用户查询与评论数据，利用 LLM 提取细粒度偏好信号，并将其映射到基于知识图谱的标签模式（schema）上，从而构建由偏好约束和食材约束组成的问答数据。此外，还采用贪心策略进行约束选择以控制答案规模，并应用基于标签的重排序来提升数据质量。生成的数据集 RecipeADQA 包含自然语言问题、结构化约束和答案集合，共 128,465 个实例。实验从数据质量和检索-推荐性能两个角度将 RecipeADQA 与基线数据集进行比较。结果表明，在相同的菜谱知识图谱上，我们的数据集在覆盖率上优于现有方法，在自然度和约束合理性上问题质量更高，且具有更好的可查询性。此外，我们设计了一个噪声增强的检索-重排序模型：轻量级解析器先检索候选菜谱，再由一个小语言模型从含噪候选池中选择并排序相关菜谱。在 RecipeADQA 上训练的模型优于在基线数据集上训练的同一模型。相关构建代码和数据已在 GitHub 仓库开源：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决问答式菜谱推荐缺乏高质量真实标注数据集的问题，核心方法是基于真实用户行为、用 LLM 提取偏好信号并映射到知识图谱标签模式来构建多约束问答数据集 RecipeADQA。

papers.title: Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract: The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. A differential item analysis also shows that lack of stability can be tracked to specific items shifting under translation across languages. Our findings suggest IRT-based selection in multilingual settings must be both parameter-aware and item-aware, validating model choice and screening individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.

translation.title: 项目反应理论能否跨语言泛化？来自跨语言 LLM 基准的证据
translation.abstract: 项目反应理论（IRT）在基准数据选择中的应用大多局限于单语场景。在本工作中，我们提出问题：当同一基准被翻译成多种语言时，IRT 如何泛化？我们在 Multilingual GSM 和 Global MMLU 上进行实验，涵盖 100 多个语言模型和 11 种语言。通过为每种语言拟合 1PL、2PL 和 3PL IRT 模型，我们评估了参数的跨语言一致性，以及 IRT 筛选出的子集能否在各语言间保持模型排名：题目难度是最稳定的参数，其次是猜测参数，再次是区分度参数。差异项目分析还表明，不稳定性的根源可以追溯到特定题目在跨语言翻译中发生偏移。我们的发现表明，多语言场景下基于 IRT 的选择必须同时具备参数感知和题目感知能力，即在假设跨语言泛化之前，既要验证模型选择，也要筛查单个题目。
translation.brief: 研究 IRT 参数与筛选子集在跨语言基准上是否泛化的问题，核心方法是在 Multilingual GSM 和 Global MMLU 上按语言拟合 1PL/2PL/3PL 模型并分析参数一致性与题目偏移。

papers.title: RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLMs
papers.abstract: Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. Representation, attention, calibration, and surface-feature analyses show a dissociation between marker attention and semantic grounding, overconfident forced-choice errors, and localized lexical density as a consistent difficulty predictor. Qualitative analysis finds terminology misunderstandings, sociocultural inference gaps, and cross-regional semantic divergence. RegioZH demonstrates that apparent Chinese proficiency can mask uneven understanding across regional varieties, motivating intra-language robustness evaluation alongside multilingual generalization.

translation.title: RegioZH：揭示 LLM 在各地区中文变体上的理解差异
translation.abstract: 当前的评估往往将中文变体视为一个整体，掩盖了模型对各地区用户的失败情况。我们提出 RegioZH，一个包含 2,607 道选择题的基准，用于覆盖中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡和马来西亚的地区性词汇推理。该基准由各地区标注者构建并经专家验证，聚焦于本地化的习语、俚语、语码混用、礼貌惯例以及社会文化表达。在 11 个 LLM 上的零样本结果显示出巨大差异，包括台湾与新加坡之间平均 29.4 个百分点的准确率差距。针对五个模型的人设（persona）提示和结构化思维链提示带来了选择性提升，表明部分错误源于检索或问题框架，而不仅仅是知识缺失。表征、注意力、校准和表层特征分析显示：标记注意力与语义基础之间存在脱节、强制选择题中存在过度自信的错误，且本地化词汇密度是稳定一致的难度预测因子。定性分析发现了术语误解、社会文化推理缺口以及跨地区语义分歧。RegioZH 表明，表面上的中文能力可能掩盖各地区变体上不均衡的理解水平，这促使我们在多语言泛化评估之外开展语言内部鲁棒性评估。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 评估忽视中文地区变体差异的问题，核心方法是构建覆盖五个地区的地区性词汇推理选择题基准 RegioZH 并进行多角度模型分析。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering
papers.abstract: We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5\%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. Accuracy separates into two tiers: GPT-5 (79.9\%, 95\% CI 76.6--83.1) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (78.4\%, 74.8--81.9) are statistically indistinguishable, and both outperform Grok 4 (71.7\%) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (71.3\%) by 6.7--8.7 percentage points (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$). The English--Persian accuracy difference is small for every model ($-0.2$ to $+2.5$ points; exact McNemar $p \ge 0.28$). For three models the 90\% confidence interval lies within $\pm 5$ points, so differences larger than this can be excluded. Questions with figures are much harder: the odds ratio is 0.30 (95\% CI 0.21--0.43) after adjusting for discipline. The apparent EE deficit of two models disappears once the larger share of figure-based EE items is accounted for. We describe the dataset, the protocol and its limitations, including the uncontrolled web-retrieval and decoding settings of the interface, and release item-level responses and analysis code.

translation.title: 在伊朗电气与计算机工程博士入学考试上评估大语言模型
translation.abstract: 我们在 2024 年和 2025 年伊朗全国电气工程（EE）与计算机工程（CE）博士入学考试的选择题上评估了四个大语言模型（LLM）。四本官方试卷共 440 道题，其中 7 道因题干或配图含糊而被排除，剩余 433 题（EE 186 题，CE 247 题），其中 171 题（39.5%）依赖图形。每道题均以波斯语原文和英文翻译呈现，共产生 3,464 次评分作答。GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 Grok 4 于 2025 年 10 月通过单一商业网页界面（Perplexity）以零样本、开启推理的方式由自动化脚本查询。由于每个模型回答相同的题目，所有推断均使用配对检验或按题目聚类的模型。准确率分为两个梯队：GPT-5（79.9%，95% CI 76.6–83.1）与 Gemini 2.5 Pro（78.4%，74.8–81.9）在统计上不可区分，且两者均以 6.7–8.7 个百分点（Holm 校正 p < 0.001）优于 Grok 4（71.7%）和 Claude Sonnet 4.5（71.3%）。各模型的英文与波斯语准确率差异都很小（-0.2 至 +2.5 分；精确 McNemar p ≥ 0.28）。三个模型的 90% 置信区间位于 ±5 分以内，因此可以排除大于该幅度的差异。含图题目的难度大得多：在按学科调整后，比值比为 0.30（95% CI 0.21–0.43）。一旦考虑到 EE 中含图题占比更大，两个模型表面上的 EE 劣势便消失了。我们描述了数据集、评测协议及其局限性，包括界面不受控的网页检索与解码设置，并发布了题目级作答数据与分析代码。
translation.brief: 评估 LLM 在伊朗 EE/CE 博士入学考试选择题上的表现，核心方法是以波斯语和英语双语呈现题目、通过统一网页界面零样本查询四个模型并进行配对统计分析。

papers.title: How Persona Conditioning Changes Open-Ended Task Execution: A Paired Evaluation of Behavioral Gains and Reliability Costs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often prompted with role- or persona-based instructions, yet persona conditioning has mainly been evaluated through character fidelity or aggregate benchmark accuracy. We study persona conditioning as a task-execution steering signal that changes how models interpret, structure, and sustain responses. Using paired instances derived from real user role-play logs and expanded into simulated multi-turn continuations, we compare with-persona and no-persona conditions while fixing task content, constraints, user simulation, and evaluation criteria. Across eight models, persona conditioning improves expert content depth and procedural fidelity, and these gains survive length control. At the same time, it lowers strict instruction-following accuracy by 17 to 30 points in every model evaluated, and increases unsupported real-world specificity through persona-induced elaboration. These results suggest that persona prompting is not a general-purpose performance improvement technique, but a selective task-execution policy shift with both behavioral gains and reliability risks.

translation.title: 角色设定如何改变开放式任务执行：行为收益与可靠性代价的配对评估
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常通过角色或人设类指令进行提示，但角色设定主要还是通过角色保真度或聚合基准准确率来评估。我们将角色设定视为一种任务执行引导信号，研究它如何改变模型解释、组织和维持响应的方式。基于真实用户角色扮演日志派生并扩展为模拟多轮续写的配对实例，我们在固定任务内容、约束、用户模拟和评估标准的前提下，比较有角色设定与无角色设定两种条件。在八个模型上，角色设定提升了专家内容深度和流程保真度，且这些收益在长度控制后依然存在。与此同时，它在所有被评估模型中使严格指令遵循准确率下降17至30个百分点，并通过角色诱发的细节扩展增加了无依据的现实世界具体性。这些结果表明，角色提示并非通用的性能提升技术，而是一种兼具行为收益与可靠性风险的选择性任务执行策略转变。
translation.brief: 研究角色设定提示对LLM任务执行的影响，通过固定任务内容的配对实验揭示其提升内容深度但损害指令遵循可靠性的双重作用。

papers.title: SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as persistent services that must reason over large volumes of external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds model responses in relevant documents, but the retrieved content must still be encoded and stored in the key-value (KV) cache. As this content accumulates, the cache grows linearly, increasing memory consumption and inference cost. Existing memory-compression methods address this problem either by retaining a subset of cached states or by learning context compressors that map documents to compact latent representations. Despite these advances, consolidating information under tight memory budgets while preserving its usefulness for future queries remains challenging. We investigate how the model's native KV states can be selectively consolidated into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries. To this end, we introduce SD-Cache (State-guided and Dynamically updated Cache), a query-agnostic KV-memory consolidation framework that operates alongside a frozen generator LLM. SD-Cache learns to consolidate layer-wise KV states into fixed-size memory through selective anchor-based pooling and state-guided refinement, processing new contexts in a single forward pass without context-specific optimisation. Experiments on retrieval-augmented question answering and synthetic long-context benchmarks show that SD-Cache maintains competitive downstream performance under constrained memory budgets.

translation.title: SD-Cache：基于状态引导动态缓存的可学习记忆整合
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为需要对大量外部知识进行推理的持久服务。检索增强生成（RAG）将模型响应锚定在相关文档上，但检索到的内容仍需编码并存储在键值（KV）缓存中。随着内容累积，缓存线性增长，增加内存消耗和推理成本。现有记忆压缩方法要么保留缓存状态的子集，要么学习将文档映射为紧凑潜在表示的上下文压缩器。尽管有这些进展，在严格内存预算下整合信息同时保持其对未来查询的有用性仍然具有挑战性。我们研究如何在不访问未来查询的情况下，将模型原生的KV状态选择性地整合为固定大小的工作记忆。为此，我们提出SD-Cache（状态引导动态更新缓存），一个与冻结生成器LLM并行运行的查询无关KV记忆整合框架。SD-Cache通过选择性锚点池化和状态引导精炼，学习将逐层KV状态整合为固定大小记忆，在单次前向传播中处理新上下文，无需针对特定上下文的优化。在检索增强问答和合成长上下文基准上的实验表明，SD-Cache在受限内存预算下保持了有竞争力的下游性能。
translation.brief: 提出SD-Cache框架，通过锚点池化和状态引导精炼将KV状态整合为固定大小记忆，以在内存受限下支持RAG推理。

papers.title: Agentic Systems Need Multi-Run Evaluation: A Study of Retrieval and Response Variability in a Deployed Enterprise RAG System
papers.abstract: Previous RAG systems have mostly been evaluated in a single-run setting, and with the advent of agentic RAG, systems are still often evaluated the same way. However, agentic RAG systems introduce a source of run-to-run variability, since several of their components make decisions non-deterministically. Such systems typically comprise a retrieval stage followed by a generation stage, and the retrieval stage in particular can behave differently across runs. For example, the agent might issue a different number of parallel searches from one run to the next, which alters the retrieved documents and therefore the final answer. In this paper we study this behavior in a deployed agentic RAG system for product-documentation questions, running each of 739 questions ten times and analyzing the execution traces to find where different runs first diverge. We find a substantial gap between success in any run and success in every run: the retrieval hit rate is 69.4% when the correct page is found in at least one run, but 50.9% when it must be found in all ten. Responses also stay similar in meaning while varying in wording, with an average BERTScore of 0.90 and a BLEU of 0.49. Trace-level analysis shows that retrieval is the largest source of divergence (43.9%), and the number of parallel searches at the first retrieval step alone accounts for 20.1% of divergent pairs. Taken together, these results show that single-run evaluation can hide reliability and consistency issues in agentic RAG systems, and that multi-run evaluation is necessary to reveal them.

translation.title: 智能体系统需要多次运行评估：对已部署企业RAG系统中检索与响应变异性的研究
translation.abstract: 以往RAG系统大多在单次运行设置下评估，随着智能体RAG的出现，系统仍常以同样方式评估。然而，智能体RAG系统引入了运行间变异性的来源，因为其多个组件以非确定性方式做决策。此类系统通常由检索阶段和生成阶段组成，其中检索阶段尤其可能在各次运行中表现不同。例如，智能体可能在不同运行中发出不同数量的并行搜索，从而改变检索到的文档并进而改变最终答案。本文在一个已部署的面向产品文档问答的智能体RAG系统中研究这一行为，对739个问题各运行十次，并分析执行轨迹以找出不同运行首次分歧之处。我们发现任一次运行成功与所有运行成功之间存在显著差距：当正确页面在至少一次运行中被找到时，检索命中率为69.4%，而要求在全部十次运行中都被找到时仅为50.9%。响应在措辞上变化但含义保持相似，平均BERTScore为0.90，BLEU为0.49。轨迹级分析显示检索是最大的分歧来源（43.9%），仅首次检索步骤的并行搜索数量就占分歧对的20.1%。综合来看，这些结果表明单次运行评估可能掩盖智能体RAG系统中的可靠性和一致性问题，必须进行多次运行评估才能揭示这些问题。
translation.brief: 通过对已部署智能体RAG系统每个问题多次运行并分析执行轨迹，揭示单次运行评估会掩盖检索非确定性带来的可靠性问题。

papers.title: AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning
papers.abstract: Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it. Models also detect conflicts without subsequently achieving an effective revision. Further paired interventions suggest that prior reasoning context may hinder effective revision after conflict detection, while multi-branch search highlights answer selection as a bottleneck between correct-answer discovery and successful correction.

translation.title: AhaPro：用于探测LLM推理中顿悟时刻的过程级字谜基准
translation.abstract: 现有关于大语言模型顿悟（Aha）时刻的研究大多聚焦于反思性表达或最终修正结果，对其在可见推理过程中的作用刻画不足。字谜通过字形、空间排列和谐音编码答案。重新解读关键细节可能触发顿悟时刻，并引起推理过程和候选答案的转变。我们提出AhaPro，一个使用字谜考察模型如何通过顿悟时刻重组证据和修正答案的过程级基准。该框架将思维链（CoT）表示为候选答案、证据和验证状态的序列，使用分层指标评估冲突检测、状态改进及后续采纳。在十一个模型上，我们观察到模型频繁未能采纳顿悟时刻中发现的更优状态，且被采纳的修正往往使状态质量不变或降低。模型也会检测到冲突却未能随后实现有效修正。进一步的配对干预表明，先前的推理上下文可能阻碍冲突检测后的有效修正，而多分支搜索凸显了答案选择是正确答案发现与成功修正之间的瓶颈。
translation.brief: 构建基于字谜的过程级基准AhaPro，将CoT表示为候选答案与验证状态序列，以探测LLM顿悟时刻中的证据重组与答案修正行为。

papers.title: Agentic Optimization: LLM Agents Select and Configure Algorithms for Engineering Design
papers.abstract: Engineers solving new multi-objective design problems commonly commit to a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) before seeing a result. The best MOEA differs from benchmark to benchmark. We propose agentic optimization, placing an LLM agent outside the optimization loop, where it reads a natural-language problem description to configure and launch algorithms, drawing on parametric knowledge rather than on a performance history that a novel problem lacks. We compare five LLMs in a fixed harness on four engineering benchmarks and a real-world SARS-CoV-2 molecular docking task, using hypervolume (HV) and IGD+ with multiple comparison-corrected tests. Three models (GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen) dominate every baseline on combined HV and IGD+, and each is significantly better than the best baseline on at least one benchmark, sometimes by applying the same baseline algorithm they surpass, showing the importance of both algorithm configuration and selection. Agent behavior is strongly model-dependent, but even the weakest agents dominate three of the four baselines overall.

translation.title: 智能体优化：LLM智能体为工程设计选择和配置算法
translation.abstract: 工程师在解决新的多目标设计问题时，通常在看到结果之前就选定某种多目标进化算法（MOEA）。最优MOEA因基准而异。我们提出智能体优化，将LLM智能体置于优化循环之外，由其阅读自然语言问题描述来配置和启动算法，依靠参数化知识而非新问题所缺乏的性能历史。我们在固定测试框架下比较五个LLM，在四个工程基准和一个真实世界的SARS-CoV-2分子对接任务上，使用超体积（HV）和IGD+并进行多重比较校正检验。三个模型（GPT、DeepSeek、Qwen）在HV和IGD+综合表现上超越所有基线，且每个模型在至少一个基准上显著优于最佳基线，有时是通过应用它们所超越的同一基线算法，这显示了算法配置与选择两者的重要性。智能体行为强烈依赖于具体模型，但即使最弱的智能体在总体上也优于四个基线中的三个。
translation.brief: 提出智能体优化范式，让LLM智能体根据自然语言问题描述选择并配置多目标进化算法，以解决新设计问题的算法选择难题。

papers.title: LLM Genetic Feature Engineering
papers.abstract: Feature Engineering is the (traditionally manual) process of constructing derived variables from an existing dataset by combining, transforming, or otherwise manipulating the original data fields to reduce statistical noise and extract meaningful, domain-specific quantities of interest from the raw dataset. Recent work demonstrates promising progress toward the au tomation of this process through the integration of large language models (LLMs) and various metaheuristics to guide the search for useful features. We build on this approach by introducing a novel genetic algorithm that implements selection, crossover, and mutation at the individual feature level, rather than at the level of the entire engineered feature set. In doing so, we enable in-process statistical analysis of newly-generated features, thereby enabling the genetic algorithm to simultaneously integrate individual and group-level feature metrics into its selec tion process. We demonstrate this capability using state-of-the-art feature importance metrics, and show that this approach yields superior predictive performance while driving meaningful improvements in feature relevance, algorithm robustness, and overall model interpretability.

translation.title: LLM 遗传特征工程
translation.abstract: 特征工程是（传统上由人工完成的）从现有数据集构造派生变量的过程，通过组合、变换或以其他方式操作原始数据字段，以降低统计噪声并从原始数据集中提取有意义的、领域相关的目标量。近期工作表明，通过结合大语言模型（LLM）和各类元启发式算法来引导有用特征的搜索，该过程的自动化取得了可喜进展。我们在这一思路上引入一种新颖的遗传算法，在单个特征层面而非整个工程特征集层面实现选择、交叉和变异。由此，我们能够对新生成的特征进行过程中的统计分析，使遗传算法在选择过程中同时整合个体和群体层面的特征指标。我们使用最先进的特征重要性指标展示了这一能力，并表明该方法在显著提升特征相关性、算法鲁棒性和整体模型可解释性的同时，带来了更优的预测性能。
translation.brief: 针对特征工程自动化问题，提出一种在单个特征层面执行选择、交叉和变异并结合 LLM 的遗传算法，使选择过程能同时利用个体与群体层面的特征统计指标。

papers.title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
papers.abstract: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act. In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties. We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation). Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observability, no governance architecture can collapse these dimensions without loss of correctness or stability. Allocation, in particular, acts as a first-class constraint that prevents simplification of the governance stack. We validate these results through a series of analytical constructions and empirical ablations, showing that removing or approximating any layer leads to systematic failure modes. This work reframes agent governance as a structural problem: not only how actions are executed, but how access to execution is determined, and why these decisions impose irreducible architectural requirements.

translation.title: 自主智能体系统的不可约简治理结构：公平分配、策略防操纵性与多尺度组合
translation.abstract: 自主智能体治理通常被框定为确保正确执行的问题。然而，在多智能体系统中，一个同样根本的问题先于执行出现：哪些智能体被允许行动。本文表明，分配并非次要问题，而是治理的结构性组成部分。当多个智能体在受限资源下竞争执行时，任何分配机制都会在公平性、效率和抗策略操纵之间引入不可避免的权衡。我们通过一组不可能性结果将其形式化，包括 Sybil 放大和理想分配属性之间的不相容性。随后我们证明，这些分配约束无法在单一控制层内解决；相反，它们会在系统中传播，与执行原子性、状态强制和行为漂移相互作用。由此形成一个由四个正交维度组成的多尺度治理结构：时间（原子性）、状态（强制）、行为（漂移监控）和种群（分配）。我们的主要结果是一个不可约简性定理：在有限可观测性下，任何治理架构都无法在不损失正确性或稳定性的情况下将这些维度坍缩合并。分配尤其作为一等约束，阻止治理栈的简化。我们通过一系列分析构造和实证消融验证了这些结果，表明移除或近似任何一层都会导致系统性失效模式。这项工作将智能体治理重新框定为一个结构性问题：不仅关乎行动如何被执行，还关乎执行权限如何被决定，以及为什么这些决策会带来不可约简的架构要求。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体治理中执行权限分配被忽视的问题，通过不可能性结果和不可约简性定理证明分配是治理的一等结构约束，并提出由时间、状态、行为、种群四个正交维度组成的多尺度治理结构。

papers.title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
papers.abstract: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. this https URL

translation.title: MOZAIC：用于辨别伪造内容的音视频 Deepfake 基准
translation.abstract: 音视频（AV）deepfake 可以伪造人脸、声音或两者兼有。大多数基准只询问片段是真是假，因此无法显示检测器依赖的是画面、声音还是编码痕迹。我们提出 MOZAIC，一个带四分类标签的成对基准，其中每个源片段都以真实或伪造视频与真实或伪造音频的全部四种组合发布，从而可以直接测量每种模态的贡献。伪造内容涵盖内脸替换、整帧视频扩散和语音转换。MOZAIC 包含来自 15,014 个源对的 137,745 个片段和四个任务：T1 AV 真实性、T2 操纵类型、T3 身份验证和 T4 解释。我们评估了 12 个 AV 多模态 LLM（MLLM），训练了四个检测器，并用 LoRA 微调 MLLM。总体而言，最好的 MLLM 在四分类 T1 上仅达到 35.6%，且对纯视频伪造的识别远多于纯语音伪造（43.6% 对 7.5%）。训练的检测器在 T1 上达到 98.4%，LoRA 微调提升了解释得分（OmniVinci 从 4.17 到 7.40，Qwen2.5-Omni 从 4.42 到 6.98），但当人脸替换生成器未参与训练时，最好的 T1 检测器降至 78.3%，因此泛化和解释仍是开放问题。我们发布了数据集、精简的 MOZAIC-SMALL 划分、代码和提示词。this https URL
translation.brief: 针对现有 deepfake 基准无法区分各模态贡献的问题，构建每个源片段以四种真假音视频组合发布的成对基准 MOZAIC，并评估多模态 LLM 与检测器在真实性、操纵类型、身份验证和解释四个任务上的表现。

papers.title: When Successful Collaboration Becomes an Attack Surface: Insider Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Recent Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) increasingly use shared memory to store and reuse successful collaboration records, enabling teams to improve across tasks. However, this memory introduces a new attack surface for malicious insiders. Unlike existing insider attacks that inject misleading information directly into the current collaboration, misinformation stored in shared memory can later appear as successful team experience and gain greater credibility and influence. We propose MIMPA (Multi-Agent Insider Memory Poisoning Attack), which exploits this vulnerability using only normal participation privileges, without direct memory access. During an earlier task, the malicious agent embeds a target-specific payload while helping the team answer correctly, allowing the payload to be retained in a successful collaboration record. When retrieved for a later target task, this poisoned record can steer benign agents toward a designated wrong answer, further amplified by malicious triggering. Across three benchmarks and two LLM backbones, MIMPA substantially outperforms existing insider attacks and remains effective under hierarchical memory management, while auditing only partially mitigates it. These results reveal that shared memory intended to accumulate team experience can become a persistent channel for insider attacks. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 当成功协作成为攻击面：多智能体系统中的内部人员记忆投毒
translation.abstract: 近期的多智能体系统（MAS）越来越多地使用共享记忆来存储和复用成功的协作记录，使团队能够跨任务改进。然而，这种记忆为恶意内部人员引入了新的攻击面。与现有直接向当前协作注入误导信息的内部攻击不同，存储在共享记忆中的错误信息日后会以成功团队经验的形式出现，从而获得更高的可信度和影响力。我们提出 MIMPA（Multi-Agent Insider Memory Poisoning Attack，多智能体内部记忆投毒攻击），它仅利用正常参与权限、无需直接访问记忆即可利用这一漏洞。在较早的任务中，恶意智能体在帮助团队正确作答的同时嵌入针对目标的载荷，使载荷得以保留在成功的协作记录中。当该记录在后续目标任务中被检索时，这条被投毒的记录可以引导良性智能体给出指定的错误答案，并可通过恶意触发进一步放大。在三个基准和两个 LLM 骨干上，MIMPA 大幅优于现有内部攻击，并在分层记忆管理下仍然有效，而审计只能部分缓解。这些结果表明，旨在积累团队经验的共享记忆可能成为内部人员攻击的持久通道。我们的代码见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统共享记忆可被恶意内部人员利用的问题，提出 MIMPA 攻击：恶意智能体在正常协作中向成功记录嵌入载荷，待其被后续任务检索时诱导良性智能体给出指定错误答案。

papers.title: Evolutionary AI Control: Population-Level Safety Under Reproduction, Heredity, and Selection
papers.abstract: An AI agent can satisfy every individual safety check and still give rise to a population that violates a collective safety limit. This risk arises in open multi-agent systems, where agents copy themselves, modify their successors, and change system membership during a run. Selection then shifts the population toward traits outside the developers' optimization targets. We prove conditions under which safety guarantees persist through reproduction, inheritance, and selection, and we characterize how they fail. Four counterexamples illustrate these failures. Unauthorized copies, which violate a specified reproductive restriction, can each leave fewer than one successor on average while their expected number grows without bound under continued production from an expanding authorized population. Two lineages can each decline in isolation yet grow exponentially when they interact. Alternating between reproductive rules can drive growth even when each rule, applied alone, suppresses it. Selection can raise the population's average rate of unauthorized reproduction above a certified limit even though every agent's rate remains fixed. Whereas existing verification methods assume fixed or registered membership, we prove safety certificates, under stated assumptions, for populations whose agents create successors during a run. The main result bounds the expected cumulative harm over a run, including when a scheduler adapts the reproductive rules to the observed history. Further conditions cover every population state reachable through evolution and preserve reproductive restrictions as descendants inherit modifications. Drawing on the mechanisms by which multicellular organisms control cell reproduction, the framework enables developers to specify and verify these controls before deployment.

translation.title: 演化式 AI 控制：繁殖、遗传与选择下的种群级安全
translation.abstract: 一个 AI 智能体可以通过每一项个体安全检查，却仍然产生一个违反集体安全上限的种群。这种风险出现在开放多智能体系统中：智能体在运行期间复制自身、修改其后继者并改变系统成员构成。选择随后会将种群推向开发者优化目标之外的特性。我们证明了安全保证在繁殖、遗传和选择过程中得以持续的条件，并刻画了它们如何失效。四个反例说明了这些失效。违反指定繁殖限制的未授权副本，其每个个体平均留下的后继者可少于一个，但在不断扩大的授权种群的持续繁殖下，其期望数量仍无界增长。两个谱系各自单独时可能衰减，但相互作用时却呈指数增长。在繁殖规则之间交替切换可以驱动增长，即使每条规则单独应用时都会抑制增长。选择可以将种群的平均未授权繁殖率提升到超过认证上限，即使每个智能体的繁殖率保持不变。现有验证方法假设成员固定或已注册，而我们在给定假设下，为运行期间智能体可创建后继者的种群证明了安全证书。主要结果对一次运行中的期望累积危害给出上界，包括调度器根据观测历史自适应调整繁殖规则的情形。进一步的条件覆盖演化可达的每一个种群状态，并在后继者继承修改时保持繁殖限制。借鉴多细胞生物控制细胞繁殖的机制，该框架使开发者能够在部署前指定并验证这些控制。
translation.brief: 针对开放多智能体系统中个体安全检查无法保证种群级安全的问题，证明安全保证在繁殖、遗传与选择下持续的条件，刻画其失效模式，并给出运行期期望累积危害上界的安全证书。

papers.title: Diffs Are Cheap, Show Me the Trajectory: An Empirical Study of Trajectory-Informed Code Review
papers.abstract: Code review typically starts from the final diff. However, the diff reveals little about how the code was developed. Coding-agent trajectories preserve intermediate decisions, failed attempts, and validation evidence that may assist code review. We systematically investigate whether and how these trajectories can help independent review agents identify problems in the resulting code, beyond inspecting the final diff and repository. We develop a procedure that generates review comments by comparing the initial and merged versions of pull requests, and assess it against withheld human review comments. Using held-out reference implementations as comparison targets for agent-produced code, we construct a dataset linking 339 implementations of 113 DeepSWE tasks with their trajectories and 882 synthetic reference review comments. Across three coding-agent configurations and two review harnesses, we compare diff-only review, full-trajectory access, and four alternative ways of presenting and using trajectories. Full-trajectory access raises mean reference recall from 23.03% to 25.87%, but improves recall in only four of six configurations. All four alternatives improve mean reference recall over diff-only by between 4.05 and 7.32 percentage points. The gains also extend to review comments that explain task-verifier failures. Higher recall can require more tokens and longer review time, while simpler trajectory views remain competitive. These results support development trajectories as an additional source of code-review context and show that their benefits and resource costs depend on how they are presented and used.

translation.title: Diff 很廉价，给我看轨迹：基于轨迹的代码评审实证研究
translation.abstract: 代码评审通常从最终 diff 开始，但 diff 几乎不反映代码是如何开发出来的。编码智能体轨迹保留了中间决策、失败尝试和验证证据，这些可能有助于代码评审。我们系统地研究这些轨迹能否以及如何帮助独立的评审智能体在检查最终 diff 和仓库之外识别代码中的问题。我们开发了一种通过比较 pull request 的初始版本与合并版本来生成评审意见的流程，并用保留的人工评审意见进行评估。以留出的参考实现作为智能体生成代码的对比目标，我们构建了一个数据集，将 113 个 DeepSWE 任务的 339 个实现与其轨迹及 882 条合成参考评审意见关联起来。在三种编码智能体配置和两种评审框架下，我们比较了仅看 diff 的评审、完整轨迹访问以及四种呈现和使用轨迹的替代方式。完整轨迹访问将平均参考召回率从 23.03% 提升到 25.87%，但仅在六种配置中的四种改善了召回率。四种替代方式相对仅 diff 评审将平均参考召回率提升 4.05 至 7.32 个百分点。这些收益也延伸到解释任务验证器失败的评审意见。更高的召回率可能需要更多 token 和更长的评审时间，而更简单的轨迹视图仍具竞争力。这些结果支持将开发轨迹作为代码评审上下文的额外来源，并表明其收益与资源成本取决于轨迹的呈现和使用方式。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体开发轨迹能否帮助评审智能体发现仅看 diff 难以察觉的代码问题，通过构建轨迹-实现-评审意见数据集并比较多种轨迹呈现方式来验证。

papers.title: Scoring Recovery-Time Agent Security: Proposals, Effects, and Retry Instructions
papers.abstract: A timed-out tool write may be absent, committed, or still in flight. Evaluating an agent only on whether its goal exists can hide harmful recovery actions: auditing 12 supplied traces changes apparent completion from 10/12 to 8/12. We introduce an executable evaluation that separately records tool proposals, runtime decisions, and committed effects. In 3,456 model episodes, the original task wording produces only 39/576 valid recoveries when the initial write is absent; a combined clarification produces 576/576. A further 1,584 episodes test stronger attacks and separate the effect definition from the recovery recipe with three rollouts per absent-state cell. Definition alone yields 276/288 valid recoveries; recipe alone yields 288/288. For Luna, malicious text is associated with 11.1 percentage points fewer valid recoveries under both original and definition-only wording, an availability signal limited by shared tasks and templates. The stronger attacks produce no attempted unauthorized or changed-key action and no unsafe effect. A trajectory audit finds six original-key retries after observing pending status: five denied and one deduplicated. Bounded checks distinguish atomic key enforcement from a delayed-commit race; stale negative reads also invalidate the evidence gate. A separate Claude Code program adds 720 successful episodes: 288 under the original attacks and 432 stronger-attack calibration episodes across Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku 5.5, with no observed proposal or effect deviations. The contribution is a measurement design and a diagnosis of availability, specification, and contract sensitivity, with no demonstrated general defense efficacy.

translation.title: 评分恢复期智能体安全性：提案、效果与重试指令
translation.abstract: 一次超时的工具写入可能未发生、已提交或仍在进行中。仅依据目标是否存在来评估智能体，可能掩盖有害的恢复行为：审计 12 条提供的轨迹后，表面完成数从 10/12 变为 8/12。我们引入一种可执行的评估方法，分别记录工具提案、运行时决策和已提交效果。在 3,456 个模型回合中，当初始写入缺失时，原始任务措辞仅产生 39/576 的有效恢复；而组合澄清措辞产生 576/576。另有 1,584 个回合测试更强的攻击，并将效果定义与恢复配方分离，每个缺失状态单元进行三次 rollout。仅定义措辞产生 276/288 的有效恢复；仅配方措辞产生 288/288。对于 Luna，在原始措辞和仅定义措辞下，恶意文本均与有效恢复减少 11.1 个百分点相关，这是一个受共享任务和模板限制的可用性信号。更强的攻击未产生任何未授权或换钥尝试，也未产生不安全效果。轨迹审计发现观察到 pending 状态后有六次原始密钥重试：五次被拒绝，一次被去重。有界检查区分了原子密钥强制与延迟提交竞态；过期的否定读取也会使证据门失效。一个独立的 Claude Code 程序增加了 720 个成功回合：288 个在原始攻击下，432 个在 Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku 5.5 上的更强攻击校准回合，未观察到提案或效果偏差。本文的贡献是一种测量设计以及对可用性、规范性和契约敏感性的诊断，未展示通用防御的有效性。
translation.brief: 提出一种分别记录工具提案、运行时决策与已提交效果的可执行评估方法，用于诊断智能体在超时写入恢复场景中的可用性、规范与契约敏感性问题。

papers.title: Per-Attack Blocking Hides Catalog Vulnerability: A Weakest-Link Analysis of Tool Manifests
papers.abstract: Runtime controls for tool-using agents depend on manifests that state what each tool may read and where its output may go. Evaluations of these controls, including ChainCaps, report per-attack blocking: the share of attacks a set of manifests stops. We show that this is the wrong unit. A catalog is only as safe as its weakest source policy: if $M$ independently authored policies are each wrong with probability $p$, the chance that the catalog contains an accepted exfiltration path is $1-(1-p)^M$, while per-attack blocking stays at $1-p$. Three lines of evidence agree. In synthetic catalogs run through two enforcement engines, ChainCaps and OpenAPPA, per-attack blocking holds at 92% while catalog vulnerability rises from 22% at 10 tools to 99% at 200, and composition provides no protective effect. A fifteen-model authoring pilot shows that real errors cluster by author, so a 200-tool catalog behaves like about 5 independent decisions rather than 60 (95% interval 3.4 to 9.2). On 114 real MCP tools with expert-written rules, the models' own manifests block 89% of attacks yet leave 9 of 15 catalogs open, as the author-effect model predicts and independence does not. Evaluations should report catalog vulnerability, the sink coverage of their tests, and an effective number of independent decisions alongside per-attack blocking.

translation.title: 按攻击阻断掩盖了目录脆弱性：工具清单的最弱环节分析
translation.abstract: 面向工具使用智能体的运行时控制依赖于声明每个工具可读取什么、输出可流向何处的清单。对这些控制的评估（包括 ChainCaps）报告按攻击阻断率：一组清单阻止的攻击比例。我们证明这是错误的度量单位。目录的安全性取决于其最弱的来源策略：如果 $M$ 个独立编写的策略各自以概率 $p$ 出错，则目录包含一条被接受的外泄路径的概率为 $1-(1-p)^M$，而按攻击阻断率仍停留在 $1-p$。三条证据线相互印证。在通过 ChainCaps 和 OpenAPPA 两个执行引擎运行的合成目录中，按攻击阻断率保持在 92%，而目录脆弱性从 10 个工具时的 22% 上升到 200 个工具时的 99%，且组合不提供保护效应。一项十五个模型的编写试点表明，真实错误按作者聚集，因此一个 200 工具目录的行为更像约 5 个独立决策而非 60 个（95% 区间 3.4 至 9.2）。在 114 个真实 MCP 工具及专家编写的规则上，模型自己编写的清单阻断了 89% 的攻击，却使 15 个目录中的 9 个仍然开放，这与作者效应模型的预测一致而与独立性假设不符。评估应报告目录脆弱性、测试的 sink 覆盖率以及有效独立决策数，同时报告按攻击阻断率。
translation.brief: 指出按攻击阻断率会掩盖工具清单目录的整体脆弱性，通过合成目录、模型编写试点和真实 MCP 工具三条证据线论证应改用基于最弱环节的目录脆弱性度量。

papers.title: Query Obfuscation with Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON): A Representational Blindspot in Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract: In modern agentic and semantic retrieval systems, dense embedding models increasingly determine which intent, tool, document, memory, or image to retrieve for a query. We identify a representational failure mode in this pipeline: a meaningful query can be replaced by visibly nonsemantic content while preserving much of its retrieval outcome, even when the candidate bank is hidden from the optimizer. We introduce Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), constructed using only the natural query representation, without access to candidate embeddings, relevance labels, rankings, retrieval feedback, or guardrail decisions. Despite this corpus-blind objective, EONs frequently preserve intent and tool routing, benchmark document search, episodic agent-memory retrieval, and cross-modal search across multiple dense embedding families. Crucially, this disconnect carries serious security implications: for malicious queries, an EON can reliably evade input guardrails that block the natural query, executing the intended safety-sensitive retrieval undetected. Through the geometry of the embedding space, we then characterize how query-level representation matching can reliably maintain subsequent retrieval outcomes over candidates unseen during optimization. Together, these findings expose a fundamental phenomenon across dual encoders that we call BLINDSPOT, where systems remain operationally blind to nonsemantic artifacts while reliably retrieving real, consequential content.

translation.title: 基于嵌入优化噪声（EON）的查询混淆：智能体检索中的表征盲点
translation.abstract: 在现代智能体和语义检索系统中，稠密嵌入模型日益决定为查询检索哪种意图、工具、文档、记忆或图像。我们识别出该流程中的一种表征失效模式：一个有意义的查询可以被明显非语义的内容替换，同时保留其大部分检索结果，即使候选库对优化器不可见。我们提出 Embedding-Optimized Noise（EON），其构造仅使用自然查询的表征，不访问候选嵌入、相关性标签、排序、检索反馈或护栏决策。尽管目标对语料库不可见，EON 仍能在多个稠密嵌入家族中频繁保留意图与工具路由、基准文档搜索、情景智能体记忆检索和跨模态搜索。关键在于，这种脱节带来严重的安全影响：对于恶意查询，EON 可以可靠地绕过会阻断自然查询的输入护栏，不被察觉地执行预期的安全敏感检索。随后，我们通过嵌入空间的几何结构刻画了查询级表征匹配如何在优化期间未见过的候选上可靠地维持后续检索结果。这些发现共同揭示了双编码器中的一种根本现象，我们称之为 BLINDSPOT：系统对非语义伪迹在操作上视而不见，同时仍可靠地检索真实且具有后果的内容。
translation.brief: 提出仅用查询自身表征构造的嵌入优化噪声 EON，可在不访问候选库的情况下保留检索结果并绕过输入护栏，揭示稠密检索系统的表征盲点。

papers.title: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
papers.abstract: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

translation.title: 人们选择不说什么：对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展提升了社会理解能力，使模型能够识别情绪并区分真实与欺骗行为。然而，现有基准主要关注粗粒度情绪识别或二元的真话-欺骗检测，忽视了人们在对话中操纵信息的多样方式，如隐瞒、泄露、捏造、回避和防御性反诉。理解这些行为需要对潜在事实、参与者知识和对话上下文进行推理，使其难以可靠评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出 InfoCon，一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准。InfoCon 识别六种细粒度策略，并从其事实与交互关系中导出粗粒度一致性标签。我们开发了基于证据的多智能体标注框架，从丰富的上下文证据中构建并验证可靠标签。我们对代表性多模态模型进行基准测试，并系统分析其对细粒度信息操纵的理解，提供了一个超越二元真话-欺骗判断的测试平台。
translation.brief: 构建多模态基准 InfoCon，通过基于证据的多智能体标注框架对对话中隐瞒、泄露、捏造等六种细粒度信息操纵策略进行可靠标注与模型评测。

papers.title: Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations
papers.abstract: Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for fine-tune v1 (trained on 109 written injections). An injection works through the option name: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%), while an imperative naming no option does not (5%). Option descriptions barely matter (2%). Character edits alone cost v1 up to 72% of right answers. A sanitiser frozen before any held-out result cuts the attacks it was built from by 72% but held-out sentence attacks by 27%, and an attacker who picks the best of 34 held-out strings per item restores success to 84% (mean string 18%). The same oracle takes the model fine-tuned on the four build families of injected sentences from 5% (mean string) to 58%. Fine-tuning on build families only (against an unchanged-rows control) cuts held-out sentence attacks (three held-out families) from 33% to 3% but character edits only from 25% to 20%. A label-free check that deletes the option names and measures the shift flags held-out sentence attacks (AUROC 0.95) but not character edits (0.46), and thresholds set on dev schemas for 5% false alarms gave 8% to 18% on an unseen schema and other languages. All data are synthetic with LLM labels, on one backbone. Several planned runs (other checkpoints, a second seed, some fine-tunes) were not run.

translation.title: Antares-Smaug：对抗性名称、Token与攻击改写：清洗器无法应对未见过的泛化
translation.abstract: Laya是一个开放决策模型：给定文本、问题和K个带描述的命名选项，它在单次前向传播中为每个选项返回一个概率，软件可能在未见过的答案上直接行动。我们用81种程序化编辑（注入句子、标签泄露、修改描述、诱饵选项、不可见和相似字符、洪泛）攻击566个合成条目上的六个Laya模型，并报告正确回答的条目被劫持或丢失的比例，附带bootstrap置信区间。任何防御都未曾基于其构建的攻击措辞在已发布Laya上使59%的条目转向攻击者选项，在微调v1（用109条手写注入训练）上为36%。注入通过选项名称起作用：一句提及某选项的句子即使是否定形式也能引导已发布模型（32%），而未提及任何选项的祈使句则不能（5%）。选项描述几乎不起作用（2%）。仅字符编辑就使v1损失高达72%的正确答案。一个在所有保留结果之前冻结的清洗器将其构建所用的攻击削减72%，但对保留句子攻击仅削减27%，而攻击者若从每条目34个保留字符串中挑选最佳者，可将成功率恢复至84%（平均字符串18%）。同样的oracle将用四个注入句子构建族微调的模型从5%（平均字符串）提升到58%。仅在构建族上微调（对照未变行控制组）将保留句子攻击（三个保留族）从33%降至3%，但字符编辑仅从25%降至20%。一种删除选项名称并测量偏移的无标签检查能标记保留句子攻击（AUROC 0.95），但无法标记字符编辑（0.46），且在开发schema上为5%误报设定的阈值在未见schema和其他语言上给出8%到18%的误报。所有数据均为合成数据并使用LLM标注，仅基于一个骨干模型。若干计划中的运行（其他检查点、第二个种子、部分微调）未被执行。
translation.brief: 研究开放决策模型对程序化注入和字符编辑攻击的脆弱性，并通过构建族微调与无标签偏移检测来缓解攻击。

papers.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
papers.abstract: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

translation.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation：像素即代码的智能体视觉创作
translation.abstract: 视觉创作既需要富有表现力的图像，也需要对文本、布局和结构的精确控制。我们提出Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation，一个通过Pixel as Code连接这些能力的智能体框架。光栅图像用学习到的离散视觉token表示，而结构化产物使用显式程序。一个共享的生成与渲染接口将这些表示与跨图像、矢量图形、网页和文档的视觉反馈连接起来。一个Nemotron原生的harness协调规划与光栅候选选择，并对可编辑的结构化和混合产物进行针对性修复。为支持该接口，我们开发了Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归光栅生成器Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B以及结构化代码模型族Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode。在覆盖六个视觉领域的约17.8万张图像上，我们的tokenizer将重建PSNR从Emu3.5 IBQ的26.08提升到29.57 dB，并在A100上batch size为1时提供7.13倍更快的编码和10.93倍更快的解码。在独立评估中，一个Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode变体在Chart2Code、MMSVG、Design2Code和Image2Struct的聚合上超过Kimi K3.1 Pro。在系统层面，Nemotron原生配置使用相同的光栅生成器将GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM从31.71提升到52.56。采用最佳设置，Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation在大多数有可比数据的基准上达到与GPT Image 2和Nano Banana Pro相当的性能。
translation.brief: 提出将光栅图像表示为离散视觉token、结构化产物表示为显式程序的智能体视觉创作框架，并配套开发tokenizer、光栅生成器和结构化代码模型。

papers.title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
papers.abstract: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. To efficiently exploit (a) the effect of evidence on attack success, our framework selects evidence across 2 dimensions: User/System Preferences with 3 selection policies. And to enhance (b) the process of turning the selected information into the malicious request, we introduce an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies. Across the evaluated conditions, we reach 67.4% ASR on AgentDojo and 87.3% on InjecAgent. These results show that attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

translation.title: ContextLure：利用良性对话历史进行间接提示注入
translation.abstract: 随着LLM能力增强，智能体可以使用工具执行更复杂的任务并与用户保持更长的交互。这些良性对话包含关于任务结果、用户关注点和操作约束的证据。风险在于，能够观察良性对话（证据）的攻击者可以构建更强的间接提示注入，而无需增加对先前轮次或后续注入的控制。然而，我们仍缺乏对攻击者选择和利用这些证据的有效性的清晰研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出ContextLure，一个红队框架，攻击者静默观察现有的良性对话、提取证据并构造注入。挑战有二：(a)选择有用的证据，(b)将其呈现为未授权操作的理由，同时不改变先前的良性对话。为高效利用(a)证据对攻击成功率的影响，我们的框架沿2个维度选择证据：User/System Preferences，配3种选择策略。为增强(b)将所选信息转化为恶意请求的过程，我们引入Urgency/Priority矩阵，配4种改写策略。在评估条件下，我们在AgentDojo上达到67.4%的ASR，在InjecAgent上达到87.3%。这些结果表明攻击者可以在后续攻击中利用良性交互证据，而无需先污染良性对话。
translation.brief: 提出红队框架ContextLure，通过从良性对话中提取证据并按偏好维度选择、按紧迫性矩阵改写来构造更强的间接提示注入。

papers.title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
papers.abstract: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

translation.title: 学习什么与学习如何：智能体训练中任务能力与界面能力的分解
translation.abstract: LLM智能体通过定义系统提示、动作格式、反馈循环和资源约束的harness运行。模型可能具备解决任务所需的知识，却无法通过特定harness表达这些知识。这引出一个基本问题：当策略在给定harness下失败时，是缺少任务知识还是缺少操作界面的能力？我们区分智能体能力的两个组成部分：任务能力，即解决任务所需的知识和推理；界面能力，即通过给定harness将知识付诸行动的能力。在四个推理和智能体基准上，我们表明harness条件化训练的结果因两者的交互方式而大不相同。多harness蒸馏将来自不同harness收集的轨迹中的任务知识聚合到共享策略中，但这些知识只有在训练保持或提升推理时界面上的能力时才能实现。否则，单harness训练可能对界面能力造成干扰，有时尽管底层任务知识有所提升，却在保留harness上灾难性地崩溃性能。为解耦任务和界面监督，我们提出harness rehearsal：在携带最少任务知识同时练习目标界面的轨迹上进行蒸馏。跨harness任务监督或rehearsal单独使用收益甚微，但两者结合的收益远大于任一单独使用：在Qwen3-4B的BFCL V3多轮上，它们分别达到8.5%和32.5%，而结合使用达到58.8%。最后，on-policy强化学习（RL）比蒸馏对单harness训练更鲁棒：它不会显著降低其他harness上的性能，且通过多harness蒸馏获得的界面能力在后续RL中得以保持。
translation.brief: 将智能体能力分解为任务能力与界面能力，提出harness rehearsal蒸馏与跨harness任务监督结合来解耦并提升两者。

papers.title: Leaks by Installments: Cross-Session Answer Disclosure in LLM Tutors and a Ledger-Based Defense
papers.abstract: Tutors built on large language models (LLMs) are told not to give away answers, but a learner does not have to ask for the answer all at once. Existing safeguards judge each reply within the current conversation, so a learner can open a new session, reword the problem, or request a worked solution to the same problem with different numbers. We call this cross-session disclosure and propose a defense: a persistent, per-learner disclosure ledger. For every problem a learner brings, the system builds a typed solution graph. Before a reply is released, a gate matches the reply's own content, not the learner's wording, against the ledger by result values and by type-labeled solution structure, then computes which steps the learner could now derive. The reply is withheld if that set reaches the final answer or exceeds a budget. In a simulation of 3,000 problems, the ledger reduced leakage through renumbered practice variants from 100% to 10.6% while honest learners completed 94-99.5% of problems. With two real LLM tutors (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-3.5-mini-instruct) on 60 problems, leakage through renumbered variants fell from 0.58 to 0.08 and from 1.00 to 0.18, with 98% honest completion. The ledger did not reduce split requests beyond a per-session gate in the live runs. All acceptance criteria were fixed before each run.

translation.title: 分期泄露：LLM导师中的跨会话答案泄露与基于账本的防御
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的导师被要求不得泄露答案，但学习者不必一次性索要答案。现有防护措施仅在当前对话内判断每条回复，因此学习者可以开启新会话、改述问题，或请求同一问题不同数字的完整解答。我们将此称为跨会话泄露，并提出一种防御：持久的、按学习者维护的泄露账本。对学习者提出的每个问题，系统构建一个带类型的解答图。在回复发布之前，一个门控将回复自身的内容（而非学习者的措辞）按结果值和带类型标注的解答结构与账本匹配，然后计算学习者此时可以推导出哪些步骤。如果该集合达到最终答案或超出预算，则扣留回复。在3000个问题的模拟中，账本将通过改数字练习变体的泄露从100%降至10.6%，同时诚实学习者完成了94-99.5%的问题。在60个问题上使用两个真实LLM导师（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Phi-3.5-mini-instruct），改数字变体的泄露分别从0.58降至0.08和从1.00降至0.18，诚实完成率为98%。在真实运行中，账本在拆分请求方面并未比每会话门控有额外降低。所有验收标准均在每次运行前固定。
translation.brief: 针对学习者跨会话分次套取答案的泄露问题，提出按学习者维护的持久泄露账本，通过类型化解答图匹配扣留过度泄露的回复。

papers.title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
papers.abstract: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

translation.title: Taxi：大规模分析智能体
translation.abstract: 在本技术报告中，我们提出 Taxi——一个用于大规模调试、聚类和监控智能体的系统。Taxi 能高效扩展到数百万步。这得益于多种可扩展分析方法的结合。Taxi 主要依靠聚类为步骤生成分类体系，以提供数据的结构化概览，并为工程师和自动化智能体提供完整的 SQL 访问能力以提出复杂问题。聚类与查询最好在由编码智能体引导的混合流水线中结合使用。Taxi 还包含 Jev 风格决策模型的实验性集成：这类模型将状态和有界问题直接映射为带类型的概率决策。在嵌入或字面查询不够用时，它们提供了低成本的语义路由和评估。此外，Taxi 提供可扩展的生态系统，包括内置评估器和每日报告。为适应增长，Taxi 被设计为模块化、可修改、易于个人和团队即插即用。
translation.brief: 解决大规模智能体步骤的调试、聚类与监控问题，核心方法是结合聚类分类体系、SQL 查询和 Jev 风格决策模型的混合分析流水线。

papers.title: Below the Stopwatch: Checking the Performance Claims of Coding Agents in the Kernel
papers.abstract: Coding agents open many pull requests (PRs) that claim to make software faster. Most such claims also give a reason, such as "cache the result" or "read the file once". A stopwatch can show that code got faster, but not that it got faster for the stated reason. We present Below, a pipeline that checks these reasons at the kernel level. From 1,343 runtime-performance PRs in the AIDev dataset, Below extracts the mechanism each PR claims and maps it to the kernel and hardware signals that must change if the claim is true. A build agent that never sees the claim rebuilds the code before and after each PR. Below then measures both versions with plain timing runs, hardware counters and LTTng kernel traces. Most claims are not measured: 57.3% of the PRs offer only reasoning or no evidence, and only 31.4% state an effect size. Of 82 analyzed PRs, 32 ran faster, 28 showed no clear change and 22 ran slower. The expected signal of the claimed mechanism appeared in 34 PRs (20 in kernel-trace signals alone), and 42 PRs also changed their output. Kernel signals move about 1.7 times as often for a faster PR's claimed mechanism as for mechanisms it did not claim; the instruction count barely separates them (1.15 times).

translation.title: 秒表之下：在内核层面检验编码智能体的性能声明
translation.abstract: 编码智能体提交许多声称能让软件更快的 pull request（PR）。大多数此类声明还会给出理由，例如"缓存结果"或"只读一次文件"。秒表可以显示代码变快了，但无法证明它是因为所述原因而变快。我们提出 Below，一个在内核层面检验这些理由的流水线。从 AIDev 数据集中 1,343 个运行时性能 PR 出发，Below 提取每个 PR 声称的机制，并将其映射到若声明为真则必须改变的内核和硬件信号。一个从不接触该声明的构建智能体在每个 PR 前后重新构建代码。随后 Below 用普通计时运行、硬件计数器和 LTTng 内核追踪测量两个版本。大多数声明并未被测量：57.3% 的 PR 只提供推理或没有证据，仅 31.4% 给出了效应量。在 82 个被分析的 PR 中，32 个变快，28 个无明显变化，22 个变慢。声称机制的预期信号出现在 34 个 PR 中（其中 20 个仅体现在内核追踪信号上），42 个 PR 还改变了输出。对于变快的 PR，其声称机制的内核信号变化频率约为未声称机制的 1.7 倍；而指令数几乎无法区分两者（1.15 倍）。
translation.brief: 解决编码智能体性能 PR 声称的优化机制缺乏验证的问题，核心方法是将声明机制映射到内核与硬件信号并用计时、硬件计数器和 LTTng 追踪进行检验。

papers.title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

translation.title: AdProducer：迈向智能体化广告视频生成
translation.abstract: 视频生成的最新进展使自动化广告制作日益可行。然而，有效的广告必须忠实呈现产品并通过引人入胜的视觉叙事传达卖点，这不仅是视觉合成：还需要更深入的产品理解以及关于如何呈现产品价值的策略性决策。关键在于，产品调研与创意设计紧密交织，因为收集到的产品信息决定了哪些特性可以被忠实展示以及如何展示。本文提出 AdProducer，首个端到端的广告视频创作智能体框架，将简短的创意简报转化为成品广告。我们的多模态智能体通过网络和图像搜索自主调研产品，并将调研结果转化为以卖点驱动的故事板，用于引导冻结的视频生成器。为此，我们开发了专门的数据构建流水线，产出两个训练数据集 AdProducer-SFT 和 AdProducer-RL，并通过监督微调及随后以故事板级和视频级奖励联合优化的强化学习来训练智能体。我们进一步提出 AdCreation-Bench，包含八个领域的 305 份广告简报，配有两种互补指标：衡量产品正确性与创意执行的 PG-Score，以及由独立评审评估整体广告效果的 Ad-Score。实验表明，AdProducer 将 MiniMax H3 的 PG-Score 从 17.3 提升至 51.3，并在无需额外训练的情况下泛化到 Veo 3.1，将其分数从 28.0 提升至 35.9，在 Ad-Score、VideoScore2 和人类评估中也取得一致提升。代码、模型和数据已发布。
translation.brief: 解决从创意简报自动生成忠实呈现产品卖点的广告视频的问题，核心方法是端到端多模态智能体自主调研产品并生成故事板，经 SFT 与故事板级和视频级奖励联合优化的 RL 训练。

papers.title: PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation
papers.abstract: This paper is concerned with prompt-image alignment at inference time through exploration of generative trajectories and dynamical prompt rejuvenation. We leverage sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), to offer a gradient-free and principled framework for this purpose through reward-guided trajectory selection. More specifically, we introduce LLM-based prompt rejuvenation, allowing for efficient particle exploration in SMC samplers along the diffusion time in flow matching models. The proposed method, PromptSMC, retains the selected latent states and uses a pretrained LLM to dynamically revise the prompts of duplicated particles under semantic-preservation constraints. These revised prompts induce alternative conditional velocity fields, allowing particles to explore different continuations from a shared intermediate state. The method further uses a reward model to evaluate each particle's alignment with the original prompt, and the resulting scores guide particles through resampling. PromptSMC thus integrates prompt-based exploration with reward-guided sampling, achieving faithful prompt-image alignment without additional noise injection, model training, or reward gradients. Our experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the method for text-to-image flow matching. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: PromptSMC：通过基于 LLM 的提示 rejuvenation 在流匹配中实现粒子探索
translation.abstract: 本文关注推理时通过探索生成轨迹和动态提示 rejuvenation 实现提示-图像对齐。我们利用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC），通过奖励引导的轨迹选择为此提供一个免梯度且有原则的框架。更具体地，我们引入基于 LLM 的提示 rejuvenation，使 SCM 采样器能在流匹配模型的扩散时间轴上高效进行粒子探索。所提方法 PromptSMC 保留被选中的潜状态，并使用预训练 LLM 在语义保持约束下动态修改复制粒子的提示。这些修改后的提示诱导出替代的条件速度场，使粒子能从共享的中间状态探索不同的后续路径。该方法进一步使用奖励模型评估每个粒子与原始提示的对齐程度，所得分数通过重采样引导粒子。PromptSMC 由此将基于提示的探索与奖励引导的采样相结合，在无需额外噪声注入、模型训练或奖励梯度的情况下实现忠实的提示-图像对齐。我们在多个基准和骨干上的实验与消融研究证明了该方法在文本到图像流匹配中的有效性。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决推理时提示-图像对齐问题，核心方法是在 SMC 采样中用预训练 LLM 在语义保持约束下动态改写提示以实现粒子探索，并用奖励模型引导重采样。

papers.title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. Three designs couple the two streams. Experiences can be anchored to a Skill, appearing only while it is active rather than once per task. A Contrastive Utility Score estimates each Experience's effect by randomly withholding it across rollouts of the same task, separating its contribution from task difficulty, and Experiences with consistently positive utility are consolidated into the Skills they support. Across five spatial benchmarks and four backbones, SpatialCraft achieves the best accuracy in all 20 settings, showing that a frozen agent can learn to orchestrate spatial tools from its own experience.

translation.title: SpatialCraft：从经验与技能演化出空间推理智能体的程序性智能
translation.abstract: 空间推理智能体日益依赖外部工具，如 3D 重建、分割和几何计算，来回答多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无法仅凭像素解决的问题。然而，工具访问将瓶颈转移到编排上：智能体必须决定调用哪些工具、以何种顺序调用以及如何解读其输出，而无状态的智能体会在不同任务中重复同样的错误。我们探究一个冻结的工具使用智能体能否在不更新参数的情况下从自身交互历史中改进其编排。我们提出 SpatialCraft，一个自演化框架，维护两种外部知识：Experiences——通过对比同一任务的多次 rollout 提炼出的条件-行动策略；Skills——具有显式激活和终止条件的多步流程。三项设计将两条流耦合起来。Experiences 可以锚定到某个 Skill，仅在其激活期间出现，而非每个任务出现一次。对比效用分数（Contrastive Utility Score）通过在同一任务的 rollout 中随机移除某条 Experience 来估计其效果，将其贡献与任务难度分离，效用持续为正的 Experiences 会被整合进它们所支持的 Skills。在五个空间基准和四个骨干上，SpatialCraft 在全部 20 个设置中取得最佳准确率，表明冻结的智能体可以从自身经验中学会编排空间工具。
translation.brief: 解决冻结的工具使用智能体无法从交互历史中改进工具编排的问题，核心方法是维护 Experiences 与 Skills 两类外部知识，并用对比效用分数将有效经验整合为技能。

papers.title: Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway
papers.abstract: Scientific analyses that span many jobs and computing sites depend on workflow management systems to run reliably, but writing a production workflow requires expertise in such a system, which many domain scientists do not have. Coding agents can supply this expertise when they are guided by skills and packaged procedures for recurring tasks. We wrote skills and specialist agents for the Pegasus workflow management system with a frontier model, and the PegasusAI Studio science gateway offers them to scientists through a chat interface. New users without frontier-model credits need an open-weight model, served at no cost on research cyberinfrastructure, but skills written for a frontier model may not work with an open-weight solution. This paper presents a method for adapting such skills. An evaluation harness drives the real gateway as a user would, scores the workflows the agent builds, and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier model that maintains the skills. We evaluated 21 open-weight models on 17 tasks. The five highest-scoring models are close in quality after one trial per task, and their median response times differ twelvefold. In repeated trials with the best of the three open-weight models, we repeated scores of 0.76 on workflow building against 0.82 for Claude. The harness led to five changes to the initial skills. We also identify challenges in evaluating agents within operational systems: evaluation failures can be mistaken for model failures, and agents can circumvent experimental controls within their privilege domain. In a controlled ablation, an initially significant effect disappeared when the restrictions were properly enforced.

translation.title: 在科学网关中用开放权重模型评估前沿模型的智能体技能
