translation.abstract: 跨多个作业和计算站点的科学分析依赖工作流管理系统来可靠运行，但编写生产级工作流需要此类系统的专业知识，而许多领域科学家并不具备。编码智能体在由技能（skills）和针对重复任务的打包流程引导时可以提供这种专业知识。我们使用前沿模型为 Pegasus 工作流管理系统编写了技能和专家智能体，并通过 PegasusAI Studio 科学网关以聊天界面的形式向科学家提供这些能力。没有前沿模型额度的新用户需要开放权重模型，且该模型可在研究网络基础设施上免费提供服务，但为前沿模型编写的技能可能不适用于开放权重方案。本文提出了一种适配此类技能的方法。一个评估框架（evaluation harness）像真实用户一样驱动网关，对智能体构建的工作流进行评分，并将反复出现的失败反馈给维护技能的前沿模型。我们在 17 个任务上评估了 21 个开放权重模型。得分最高的五个模型在每任务一次试验后的质量接近，但其中位响应时间相差十二倍。在使用三个开放权重模型中最佳模型的重复试验中，我们在工作流构建上重复得到 0.76 的分数，而 Claude 为 0.82。该评估框架促成了对初始技能的五处修改。我们还识别了在运行系统中评估智能体的挑战：评估失败可能被误认为模型失败，且智能体可能在其权限域内规避实验控制。在一项受控消融实验中，当限制被正确执行时，一个原本显著的效果消失了。
translation.brief: 解决领域科学家缺乏工作流系统专业知识的问题，方法是为 Pegasus 编写可由开放权重模型适配的智能体技能，并用评估框架驱动真实网关进行评分与技能迭代。

papers.title: Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark
papers.abstract: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team's return. Yet predicting a team's return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent's suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. In a comparison over eight seeds with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO), simulator credit reduces the interquartile mean burn score (each cell's burning time, capped and averaged over the map; lower is better) from 26.6% with shared reward to 20.9%. Learned credit from a centralized COMA-style critic does no better than the shared reward. Four trained critics predict the team's return well, yet the credit they assign is 9 to 42 times larger than the credit measured by replay. The critics also give heterogeneous agents nearly identical action rankings. These results show that a good fit to the team's return is a weak test of a critic's credit.

translation.title: 在可回放的野火扑救基准中度量反事实信用分配
translation.abstract: 在合作式多智能体强化学习中，学习到的 critic 通常以其预测团队回报的准确度来评估。然而预测团队回报与为个体动作分配信用是不同的任务。为了直接测试信用分配，我们提出 FLARE（Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment），一个随机野火扑救基准，其中火的任意时刻都可以在相同随机事件下以不同动作回放。回放一步可度量每个智能体扑救动作的即时效果，我们称之为模拟器信用（simulator credit）并用于训练。回放到回合结束可度量每个动作的效果，我们用它来给 critic 评分。在与多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的跨八个种子的比较中，模拟器信用将四分位均值燃烧分数（每个格元的燃烧时间，封顶后在地图上取平均；越低越好）从共享奖励的 26.6% 降至 20.9%。来自集中式 COMA 风格 critic 的学习信用并不优于共享奖励。四个训练好的 critic 都能很好地预测团队回报，但它们分配的信用比回放测得的信用大 9 到 42 倍。这些 critic 还给异构智能体几乎完全相同的动作排序。这些结果表明，对团队回报的良好拟合是检验 critic 信用的一个弱测试。
translation.brief: 解决 critic 信用分配无法被回报预测准确度有效检验的问题，方法是在可回放的野火扑救基准 FLARE 中通过回放直接度量每个动作的真实效果并据此评估 critic。

papers.title: TokenJoule: Energy Modeling for Distributed Training and Inference of LLMs
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) scale, energy dictates operating cost, cooling, and cluster capacity across training and inference. Early hardware design-space exploration (DSE) requires predicting energy before silicon exists, yet performance models miss hidden component work while prior energy predictors calibrate to deployed GPUs. We present TokenJoule, an open-source analytical tool that derives device kernel sequences, tiled compute, shared-memory staging, cache residency, and collective traffic, pricing activity directly with component energies. With zero workload fitting, TokenJoule achieves 3.3-6.6% activity error (151 A100/H100 runs) and 3.0-6.8% A100 energy error, guiding parallelism, memory packaging, and 3D-DRAM chip co-design.

translation.title: TokenJoule：面向 LLM 分布式训练与推理的能耗建模
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）规模的扩大，能耗决定了训练和推理的运行成本、散热和集群容量。早期的硬件设计空间探索（DSE）需要在芯片流片之前预测能耗，然而性能模型会遗漏隐藏的组件工作，而先前的能耗预测器则依赖已部署 GPU 进行校准。我们提出 TokenJoule，一个开源分析工具，它推导设备内核序列、分块计算、共享内存搬运、缓存驻留和集合通信流量，并直接用组件能耗为这些活动定价。在零工作负载拟合的情况下，TokenJoule 实现了 3.3-6.6% 的活动误差（151 次 A100/H100 运行）和 3.0-6.8% 的 A100 能耗误差，可指导并行策略、内存封装和 3D-DRAM 芯片协同设计。
translation.brief: 解决芯片流片前无法准确预测 LLM 训练与推理能耗的问题，方法是用零拟合的分析模型直接推导内核序列、内存与通信活动并以组件能耗定价。

papers.title: PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts
papers.abstract: Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.

translation.title: PatientFlowSynth：用匹配的患者病历评估 FHIR 智能体
translation.abstract: 搜索患者病历的智能体必须根据检索到的记录对声明进行分类，包括证据缺失或冲突的情况。在 Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources（FHIR）中，状态字段可能改变这些记录应如何被解读。PatientFlowSynth 提供 18,000 个任务，来自 225 个合成患者和 18 个模板，这些模板在代表四种证据状态的病历变体之间保持患者、问题和检索程序不变。重新执行该程序可验证每个变体的参考答案、证据集和检索要求。严格成功要求完成的回复具有正确的标签和引用，且与回合中检索到的某个被接受证据集完全匹配。在需要时，工具响应还必须显示在指定范围内完成了完整搜索。在使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 225 个合成患者（3,600 个匹配对）的研究中，显式的 Encounter 状态指导将严格成功率从 40.7% 提高到 51.3%（+10.6 个百分点；95% 患者自助法置信区间为 8.4 到 12.8）。在主要参考标签为证据不足的案例中，标签一致率从 49.2% 降至 29.3%。一项预先设定的双模型复现重现了这两项变化。检索失败可能掩盖解读错误：未检查相关记录却产出正确的证据不足标签。额外的模型比较表明，指导的收益依赖于具体模型。检索、引用和分类应分别评估。
translation.brief: 解决如何严格评估病历检索智能体在证据缺失或冲突下分类能力的问题，方法是用保持患者、问题和检索程序不变的匹配病历变体基准 PatientFlowSynth 进行受控评估。

papers.title: One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step
papers.abstract: GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail as interfaces change during deliberation. Latency alone cannot explain these failures because actions may become invalid at different interaction stages. We model four events: environment change, observation availability, decision commitment, and action receipt (EODA). We introduce ChronotopeGym to study these failures under Paused, Replay, and Live execution. Across five tasks, agents can fail in Live despite succeeding when responses remain valid, even when actions meet deadlines. On Moving Balloon, updating a pending click raises success from 0% to 100% without changing response time. Our accelerator-resident GUI controller, Chronotope, maintains compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions. Compared with Agent S3, Chronotope reduces median end-to-end latency by 85.5% for a 27B model, expanding its performance envelope to 100% Live success at an 8-second deadline versus 0%. Chronotope enables real-time GUI control through compact interaction history, knowing when to preserve, revise, or replace actions, and an overall efficient architectural design that obviates verbose reflection, reasoning, and grounding calls.

translation.title: 一步，四个时钟：GUI 智能体如何失步
translation.abstract: GUI 智能体可以选择正确的动作，却会在界面在决策期间发生变化时失败。仅凭延迟无法解释这些失败，因为动作可能在不同的交互阶段失效。我们建模了四个事件：环境变化、观测可用、决策提交和动作送达（EODA）。我们提出 ChronotopeGym，在 Paused、Replay 和 Live 三种执行模式下研究这些失败。在五个任务中，即使动作满足截止时间，智能体也可能在 Live 模式下失败，而在响应保持有效时成功。在 Moving Balloon 任务中，更新一个待执行的点击可将成功率从 0% 提升到 100%，而不改变响应时间。我们的加速器驻留 GUI 控制器 Chronotope 维护紧凑的交互历史，并有选择地保留、更新或重新决策待执行动作。与 Agent S3 相比，Chronotope 将 27B 模型的中位端到端延迟降低了 85.5%，将其性能包络扩展到在 8 秒截止时间下 100% 的 Live 成功率（对比 0%）。Chronotope 通过紧凑的交互历史、知道何时保留、修改或替换动作，以及避免冗长反思、推理和定位调用的整体高效架构设计，实现了实时 GUI 控制。
translation.brief: 解决 GUI 智能体在界面于决策期间变化时动作失效的问题，方法是用 EODA 事件模型与 ChronotopeGym 分析失步，并构建维护紧凑交互历史、可保留/更新/重决策待执行动作的 Chronotope 控制器。

papers.title: Can LLM-Simulated Respondents Pre-Test Survey Questions? Evidence From Preregistered Prospective Validation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be conditioned to simulate behavioral responses, including survey responses, but it remains unclear whether and how these simulations can support downstream research tasks. Here, we evaluate whether simulated respondents can support pre-testing new candidate survey questions before fielding them, operationalized as prioritizing candidate survey items. Specifically, we rank candidate questions by their mean responses, which can reveal ceiling or floor effects; their variance, which indicates whether responses contain meaningful variation; and differences between subpopulations, which indicate whether questions capture distinctions between relevant groups within a population. We introduce a preregistered, prospective evaluation that commits model predictions before target human responses exist, ruling out memorization of those responses by design. Using two waves of a local survey (2025: N = 1,271; 2026: N = 1,161), we built simulated respondents from 2025 participants and preregistered GPT-4.1 predictions for 22 questions introduced in 2026. Simulations accurately ranked questions by mean responses (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.71) and anticipated which questions distinguished city from county residents (\r{ho} = 0.88), Black from White residents (\r{ho} = 0.68), and employed from unemployed residents (\r{ho} = 0.57), suggesting simulations can help prioritize questions before fielding. More broadly, our prospective, preregistered design provides a general framework for evaluating AI simulations without contamination from memorized target outcomes.

translation.title: LLM 模拟受访者能否预测试调查问题？来自预注册前瞻性验证的证据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以被条件化以模拟行为反应，包括调查回答，但这些模拟是否以及如何支持下游研究任务仍不清楚。我们评估模拟受访者能否在正式投放前支持预测试新的候选调查问题，具体操作化为对候选调查条目进行优先级排序。具体而言，我们按候选问题的平均回答（可揭示天花板或地板效应）、方差（表明回答是否包含有意义的变化）以及子群体之间的差异（表明问题是否捕捉到人群中相关群体之间的区别）对候选问题进行排序。我们引入一项预注册的前瞻性评估，在目标人类回答存在之前就提交模型预测，从设计上排除了对这些回答的记忆。利用两轮本地调查（2025 年：N = 1,271；2026 年：N = 1,161），我们基于 2025 年参与者构建了模拟受访者，并预注册了 GPT-4.1 对 2026 年引入的 22 个问题的预测。模拟准确地按平均回答对问题进行了排序（Spearman ρ = 0.71），并预测出哪些问题能区分城市与县居民（ρ = 0.88）、黑人与白人居民（ρ = 0.68）以及就业与失业居民（ρ = 0.57），表明模拟可以在投放前帮助对问题进行优先级排序。更广泛地说，我们的前瞻性预注册设计为评估 AI 模拟提供了一个通用框架，避免了记忆目标结果带来的污染。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 模拟受访者能否在调查投放前对候选问题进行优先级排序，采用预注册前瞻性验证设计，在人类数据存在前提交模型预测以排除记忆污染。

papers.title: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
papers.abstract: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator class. We demonstrate our methods with a case study comparing the success of Claude Opus and Claude Haiku in improving the runtime of an open-source Python package.

translation.title: 无真值标签的智能体评估：零比例视角
translation.abstract: 智能体所采取行动的正确性通常依据已知的外部验证真值标签来评估，例如证明是否正确、代码是否编译并通过单元测试。然而，随着编码与科学智能体被赋予更多端到端自主权——提出干预、运行实验、决定下一步部署和研究什么——智能体的行动是否真正改善了结果，必须从嘈杂且往往不确定的实验中推断。为在此设定下评估智能体，我们将智能体质量定义为其轨迹中正确决策的加权和，使用 e-value 序列作为关于正确性的统计证据来替代真值标签。我们的框架允许任意相关的决策、依赖数据的轨迹终止、动态生成的假设，以及在轨迹结束后才定义的质量度量。我们构建了智能体质量的上界和下界估计器及置信集，其统计保证在所有智能体轨迹分布上一致成立，并证明了我们估计器类在实例层面的尖锐性。我们通过一个案例研究展示了这些方法，比较 Claude Opus 与 Claude Haiku 在改进一个开源 Python 包运行时间方面的成功程度。
translation.brief: 提出在缺乏真值标签时评估智能体质量的框架，将质量定义为正确决策的加权和，用 e-value 序列作为统计证据并构建带一致性保证的置信集。

papers.title: Where Agent Defenses Fail: A Case Study of Policy Compositions and Measurement Limits
papers.abstract: A coding agent may need to upload a report while its sandbox blocks network access. A host mediator can restore delivery, but an injected instruction may add a secret to the approved request. We study this interaction using files and HTTP receipts to measure effects independently of control logs. Two prospective frozen-input cohorts comprise 110 and 300 runs on previously explored authored tasks. Restrictive sandboxing produces no observed attack harm but reduces benign utility to 6/8 and 12/24. Mediation restores uploads and admits disclosure; complete-line matching retains full benign utility but misses two value-only disclosures in the expanded cohort. A separate 72-run boundary study identifies encoded disclosure, observer misses, and formatting checks that obscure benign refusals. An 80-run SafeAgents/OpenShell follow-up shows that containment stops the tested guard misses among valid observations, while mediation restores benign uploads and delivers both encoded-attestation attacks. Twelve judge-error rows remain unscored. A separate response-capture diagnostic reproduces their failures at the native token budget. A 12-run exact-publication-contract experiment blocks both attacks but also rejects both benign formatting variants; a 4-run normalized follow-up restores both benign uploads while still rejecting both attacks. These small, single-model studies identify delivery-path and measurement limits; they do not establish general attack resistance.

translation.title: 智能体防御失效之处：策略组合与测量极限的案例研究
translation.abstract: 一个编码智能体可能需要上传报告，而其沙箱阻止网络访问。主机中介可以恢复传输，但注入的指令可能在获批请求中添加机密。我们使用文件和 HTTP 回执来研究这种交互，独立于控制日志测量效果。两个前瞻性冻结输入队列在先前探索过的自创任务上分别包含 110 次和 300 次运行。限制性沙箱未观察到攻击危害，但将良性效用降至 6/8 和 12/24。中介恢复了上传并允许泄露；完整行匹配保留了全部良性效用，但在扩展队列中漏掉了两次仅值的泄露。一项独立的 72 次运行边界研究识别出编码泄露、观察者遗漏以及掩盖良性拒绝的格式检查。一项 80 次运行的 SafeAgents/OpenShell 后续实验表明，遏制在有效观察中阻止了被测试的防护遗漏，而中介恢复了良性上传并传递了两种编码证明攻击。十二行裁判错误仍未评分。一项独立的响应捕获诊断在原生 token 预算下复现了它们的失败。一项 12 次运行的精确发布契约实验阻止了两种攻击，但也拒绝了两种良性格式变体；一项 4 次运行的归一化后续实验恢复了两种良性上传，同时仍拒绝两种攻击。这些小规模、单模型研究识别了传输路径和测量方面的极限；它们并未确立普遍的攻击抵抗力。
translation.brief: 通过多组受控实验研究编码智能体在沙箱与中介策略组合下的攻击与良性效用权衡，识别传输路径和测量方法的极限。

papers.title: Reproducible Social Structure Emerges From Free-Form Interaction Among LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM simulations are increasingly used as models of social systems, but most published findings are anecdotal, i.e., drawn from a single run. It is therefore unclear which observed phenomena are robust findings of the simulated system itself, and which were random events in one particular run. Here, we introduce a repeatable, goal-free, proactive multi-agent framework in which fifty persona-conditioned agents with persistent memory choose whether, with whom, and how to communicate across three social platforms. The framework supports non-perturbative measurements across temporal snapshots and repetitions. Running the same world ten times from identical initial conditions for a total of 700 hours, we find that most measured network- and agent-level parameters are stable across repetitions. Throughout a run, initially broad communication contracts into sparse sustained dyads in all ten worlds. Importantly, we find that many identical dyads re-form across worlds significantly more often than expected by chance or from agent-specific sociability alone. Static personality similarity largely fails to predict these dyads. Instead, alignment and extremity in the emotions and traits expressed during first contact predict whether a pair later forms a sustained dyad. Additionally, individual agents' emotion and trait expression in their chain-of-thought predicts their future behavior. Finally, swapping either persona prompts or accumulated memories between agents causes recipients to exhibit behavior more similar to donors. Both kinds of transplant move the recipients about 60% of the way toward its donor personality, and state-transplanted agents start behaving similar to their donor agent from their next turn on. Overall, we show that repeated worlds enable robust, statistically-grounded conclusions about emergent within-configuration behavior in agent societies.

translation.title: 可复现的社会结构从 LLM 智能体的自由交互中涌现
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 模拟日益被用作社会系统的模型，但大多数已发表的结果都是轶事性的，即来自单次运行。因此不清楚哪些观察到的现象是模拟系统本身的稳健发现，哪些只是某次特定运行中的随机事件。我们引入一个可重复、无目标、主动的多智能体框架，其中五十个具有持久记忆、由人设条件化的智能体在三个社交平台上自主选择是否、与谁以及如何交流。该框架支持跨时间快照和重复运行的非扰动测量。在相同初始条件下将同一世界运行十次，共 700 小时，我们发现大多数测量的网络级和智能体级参数在各次重复中保持稳定。在整个运行过程中，最初广泛的交流在所有十个世界中收缩为稀疏的持续二元关系。重要的是，我们发现许多相同的二元关系在各世界间重新形成的频率显著高于偶然或智能体特定社交性所能解释的水平。静态人格相似性基本无法预测这些二元关系；相反，首次接触时表达的情绪和特质的对齐度与极端性预测了一对智能体之后是否会形成持续的二元关系。此外，个体智能体在其思维链中表达的情绪和特质可预测其未来行为。最后，在智能体之间交换人设提示或积累的记忆会使接受者表现出更接近捐赠者的行为。两种移植都使接受者向其捐赠者人格移动约 60%，且状态移植的智能体从下一轮开始就表现得与其捐赠者相似。总之，我们表明重复运行的世界能够对智能体社会中涌现的配置内行为得出稳健且有统计依据的结论。
translation.brief: 构建可重复运行的多智能体 LLM 社会模拟框架，通过十次相同初始条件的重复运行验证涌现社会结构的稳健性并探究二元关系形成的预测因素。

papers.title: Aftershock: Yesterday's Linux Kernel Bugs, Tomorrow's Android Exploits
papers.abstract: Android kernels have long suffered from slow patch propagation from Linux upstream, with fixes often reaching devices far later than conventional Linux distributions. Until recently, this lag was largely a patch-management problem. With rapidly improving LLM agents, it is becoming an exploitation problem: public upstream patches can now serve as blueprints for building working n-day exploits before downstream devices are fixed. We test this threat end to end by building an automated pipeline that screens upstream Linux patches, reproduces memory-safety vulnerabilities on Android targets, and drives an LLM agent to construct local privilege escalation exploits from an untrusted application. Across 152 candidate CVEs reported over 33 months, we reproduce 38 vulnerabilities and generate 17 independently verified exploits under production defenses. Exploitation takes a median of 14.3 agent-hours and $321 in API cost, with 90% median reliability; 12 of 14 trials succeed on Pixel 9 and Pixel 10 devices. Notably, the pipeline relies only on publicly available, off-the-shelf models. Surprisingly, only 3 of the 17 exploited CVEs appear in Android Security Bulletins, suggesting limited visibility into which upstream fixes address vulnerabilities that affect Android kernels. For these 17 CVEs, the corresponding upstream patches reach Pixel devices with a median delay of 181 days. Together, these results reveal a stark asymmetry: attackers can increasingly automate exploitation in hours, while defenders still identify and deploy fixes on the timescale of months.

translation.title: Aftershock：昨天的 Linux 内核漏洞，明天的 Android 利用
translation.abstract: Android 内核长期受制于 Linux 上游补丁传播缓慢的问题，修复往往比传统 Linux 发行版晚很久才到达设备。直到最近，这种滞后主要还是补丁管理问题。随着 LLM 智能体的快速进步，它正在变成利用问题：公开的上游补丁现在可以作为蓝图，在下游设备修复之前构建可用的 n-day 利用。我们通过构建自动化流水线端到端地测试这一威胁：筛选上游 Linux 补丁、在 Android 目标上复现内存安全漏洞，并驱动 LLM 智能体从不可信应用构建本地提权利用。在 33 个月内报告的 152 个候选 CVE 中，我们复现了 38 个漏洞，并在生产级防御下生成了 17 个经独立验证的利用。利用过程的中位耗时为 14.3 个智能体小时、321 美元 API 成本，中位可靠性为 90%；在 Pixel 9 和 Pixel 10 设备上的 14 次试验中有 12 次成功。值得注意的是，该流水线仅依赖公开可用的现成模型。令人惊讶的是，17 个被利用的 CVE 中只有 3 个出现在 Android 安全公告中，这表明对于哪些上游修复涉及影响 Android 内核的漏洞，可见性有限。对于这 17 个 CVE，相应的上游补丁到达 Pixel 设备的中位延迟为 181 天。这些结果共同揭示了一种鲜明的不对称性：攻击者越来越能在数小时内自动化利用，而防御者识别和部署修复仍需数月时间。
translation.brief: 构建自动化流水线，利用 LLM 智能体根据公开上游补丁自动生成 Android 内核 n-day 本地提权利用，以评估补丁滞后带来的攻击威胁。

papers.title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
papers.abstract: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. A rule that searches for repeated calls finds 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm. We also examine two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract. In a small pilot (17 episodes, one local model), identifiers supplied by the model do not detectably reduce harm, because the model issues a new identifier for the same operation. Identity derived from the call content, evaluated counterfactually on the sample, would have matched every harmful write in 14 to 18 of the 30 harmful recoveries, but in none of those with a wrong first-time write, and it would also have matched writes required by the task in 30 episodes. Based on these results, we outline design requirements for safer agent recovery.

translation.title: Agent 恢复出错：衡量重复调用之外的危害
translation.abstract: 执行代码的 LLM agent 会提交包含多个 API 写操作的代码块。如果某个代码块在部分写操作已生效后失败，agent 会重写该代码块并继续执行。当失败自然发生在 agent 编写的代码中时，这种恢复在多大程度上会损害外部状态尚不清楚。本文在 AppWorld agent 的记录轨迹上对此进行测量。在跨十个模型的 200 个候选 episode 的分层随机样本中，145 个经数据库状态确认属于部分执行。样本中，143 个结果可确定的已确认部分执行里有 30 个随后发生了有害恢复，且其违规在运行结束时仍然存在，由此得到分层加权估计值 24.6%。三分之二的有害恢复重复了某个效果，其余的则删除用户数据或进行错误的首写，例如订购了错误的产品。一条搜索重复调用的规则能发现 75% 的重复，但只能发现 41% 的全部危害。我们还考察了幂等性契约的两种操作身份来源。在一个小型试点（17 个 episode，一个本地模型）中，模型提供的标识符未能可检测地减少危害，因为模型会为同一操作发出新的标识符。基于调用内容派生的身份在样本上以反事实方式评估，在 30 个有害恢复中的 14 到 18 个里本可匹配所有有害写操作，但对错误首写的情况均无效，且在 30 个 episode 中它还会匹配任务所需的写操作。基于这些结果，我们概述了更安全 agent 恢复的设计要求。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM agent 代码块失败后重写恢复对外部状态造成的危害，通过在 AppWorld 轨迹上测量有害恢复比例并评估基于调用内容的幂等性身份方案来改进恢复安全性。

papers.title: COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation
papers.abstract: LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. We evaluate COGENT's behavioral and attributional fidelity across three benchmarks -- AgentNetBench, A11y-CUA, and SENSE-42 -- finding that it achieves statistically significant fidelity gains over computer-use baselines in reproducing recorded human behavior and recovers the relational structure among human self-reported psychological states. Together, these demos and evaluations demonstrate COGENT's utility toward more faithful, explainable, intervenable, and modular LLM-based cognitive simulations.

translation.title: COGENT：面向智能体用户模拟的模块化认知架构
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的用户模拟可以支持界面设计、无障碍研究和交互式智能体评估，但标准的 computer-use agent 是为任务完成而优化的，而非再现人们感知、推理和行动的方式。我们提出 COGENT（COGnitive agENT），一个用于模拟用户与桌面界面交互的模块化认知架构。COGENT 借鉴成熟认知理论，如 Norman 的行动循环和 ACT-R，通过将模拟过程分解为具有感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和行动选择显式表示的认知模块，实现可解释、可干预和模块化的用户模拟。我们首先展示六个可干预性演示，每个演示追踪对记忆、用户属性或处理模块的单次编辑如何通过认知管线传播并产生行为变化。我们在三个基准——AgentNetBench、A11y-CUA 和 SENSE-42——上评估 COGENT 的行为与归因保真度，发现它在再现记录的人类行为方面相对 computer-use 基线取得了统计显著的保真度提升，并恢复了人类自我报告心理状态之间的关系结构。这些演示和评估共同证明了 COGENT 在实现更忠实、可解释、可干预和模块化的基于 LLM 的认知模拟方面的效用。
translation.brief: 提出模块化认知架构 COGENT，通过分解为感知、记忆、意图等显式认知模块来更忠实、可解释且可干预地模拟用户与桌面界面的交互。

papers.title: Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract: Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a $\underline{D}\text{istributed}$ $\underline{S}\text{ampling-based}$ $\underline{T}\text{rajectory}$ $\underline{O}\text{ptimization} \ \text{(DS-TO)}$ architecture built on a splitting mechanism tailored to sampling. Under this splitting, each agent samples only in its own control space, independent of neighborhood size, while still remaining exposed to both the constraint-induced non-convexity and the decisions of other agents. The resulting algorithm is fully decentralized, requiring only neighborhood communication, with all local updates executed in parallel across agents. Efficient variations, including parallel Jacobi updates within each agent's subproblem and single-step constraint linearization, further reduce computation. Experiments on 2D and 3D tasks with up to 1024 agents demonstrate improved exploration and constraint satisfaction over state-of-the-art derivative-based distributed optimization, and superior scalability to existing distributed sampling methods.

translation.title: 大规模采样：分布式多智能体轨迹优化
translation.abstract: 多智能体轨迹优化面临两个耦合挑战：有效探索非凸地形，以及随智能体规模扩大而良好扩展。基于采样的方法是探索挑战的天然候选，但其扩展性随问题维度增长而变差。此外，将其直接集成到分布式优化中会引入一个根本性权衡：采样要么无法解决约束导致的非凸性，要么其搜索空间随邻域规模增长。我们通过提出基于采样的分布式轨迹优化（DS-TO）架构来填补这一空白，该架构建立在专为采样设计的分裂机制之上。在这种分裂下，每个智能体仅在自己的控制空间内采样，与邻域规模无关，同时仍然暴露于约束导致的非凸性和其他智能体的决策。所得算法完全去中心化，仅需邻域通信，所有局部更新在智能体间并行执行。高效的变体，包括每个智能体子问题内的并行 Jacobi 更新和单步约束线性化，进一步降低了计算量。在多达 1024 个智能体的 2D 和 3D 任务上的实验表明，相比最先进的基于导数的分布式优化，该方法在探索和约束满足方面有所改进，并且比现有分布式采样方法具有更优的可扩展性。
translation.brief: 提出 DS-TO 分布式采样轨迹优化架构，通过让每个智能体仅在自身控制空间采样的分裂机制，同时解决非凸探索与大规模智能体扩展问题。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Risk-Sensitive Evolutionary Learning in Coordination Games: Polarization, Welfare Loss, and Intervention for Efficiency
papers.abstract: We study evolutionary learning in coordination games in a finite population of agents with heterogeneous risk attitudes, modeled using the entropic risk measure (ERM). The population consists of two subpopulations, each with a fixed risk attitude. Under risk-sensitive best response with mutations (BRM), we characterize the long-run outcomes of the learning process. In particular, we characterize when a polarized state, in which the two subpopulations choose different actions, is uniquely stochastically stable in terms of agents' risk attitudes and the subpopulation sizes. Notably, this polarized state is strictly Pareto dominated by the payoff-dominant equilibrium under both expected payoffs and agents' own ERM-adjusted payoffs. Moreover, its welfare, measured by average expected payoff, is always lower than that of the payoff-dominant equilibrium and can also be lower than that of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, heterogeneity of risk attitudes in learning alone can lead to an inefficient long-run outcome. To mitigate such inefficiency, we propose intervention mechanisms to modify agents' risk attitudes in learning. We show that a sufficiently large intervention share (the fraction of agents modified) and sufficiently high intervention intensity (the increase in their risk parameter) ensure that the payoff-dominant equilibrium is uniquely stochastically stable. However, greater intervention intensity cannot compensate for an insufficient intervention share, and a larger intervention share cannot compensate for insufficient intervention intensity.

translation.title: 协调博弈中的异质风险敏感演化学习：极化、福利损失与效率干预
translation.abstract: 我们研究有限数量智能体（具有异质风险态度，用熵风险度量 ERM 建模）在协调博弈中的演化学习。总体由两个子总体组成，各自具有固定的风险态度。在带突变的风险敏感最优响应（BRM）下，我们刻画了学习过程的长期结果。特别地，我们刻画了在何种条件下，两个子总体选择不同行动的极化状态，依据智能体的风险态度和子总体规模，是唯一随机稳定的。值得注意的是，无论在期望收益还是智能体自身经 ERM 调整的收益下，该极化状态都严格被收益占优均衡 Pareto 支配。此外，以平均期望收益衡量的福利，它总是低于收益占优均衡，也可能低于风险占优均衡。因此，仅学习中的风险态度异质性就可能导致无效的长期结果。为缓解这种低效，我们提出干预机制来修改智能体学习中的风险态度。我们证明，足够大的干预比例（被修改智能体的比例）和足够高的干预强度（其风险参数的增加）能确保收益占优均衡是唯一随机稳定的。然而，更大的干预强度无法弥补干预比例的不足，更大的干预比例也无法弥补干预强度的不足。
translation.brief: 研究异质风险态度下协调博弈演化学习导致极化低效长期结果的条件，并提出通过修改智能体风险态度的干预机制使收益占优均衡成为唯一随机稳定状态。

papers.title: Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting
papers.abstract: In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses can be easily swapped out as capabilities improve over time.

translation.title: 用于游戏测试的现成自主智能体
translation.abstract: 在游戏测试中，通常需要人工操作员来测试大多数游戏玩法元素。在这项工作中，我们提出 Buddy，一个自主游戏求解智能体，它可以使用现成的语言模型系统在未见过的 3D 角色扮演游戏中求解长时间跨度的目标。Buddy 会采取行动、接收这些行动的反馈，并在多个回合中追求一个目标。不需要任何书面攻略或任何形式的模型训练，我们证明该范式在一个新颖环境中成立，智能体必须通过探索发现解决方案，而不是从预训练中回忆。我们展示了三种下游能力：在没有提供攻略的情况下求解游戏、为遇到的困难记录 bug 工单，以及将成功的智能体轨迹转换为用于回归测试的脚本化分层任务网络。与现有的游戏测试解决方案不同，我们的框架是完全模块化的：随着能力的提升，语言模型和 harness 可以轻松替换。
translation.brief: 提出自主游戏测试智能体 Buddy，利用现成语言模型通过探索在未见 3D 游戏中求解长时程目标，并支持 bug 记录与轨迹转 HTN 回归测试。

papers.title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
papers.abstract: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying nor as violating it; the statement is ambiguous precisely when the residue is satisfiable. For natural-language statements and contexts, an LLM entailment oracle decides the checks; it is sound if it accepts only checks that hold, and complete if it accepts every check that holds. We prove that a sound oracle makes the search safe regardless of pool quality, and that a complete one makes the frontiers tight. On security-critical AWS properties, EGs are safe in all 20 cases of an expert-adjudicated study, where majority vote over equivalence clusters and Universal Self-Consistency are unsafe in 25% and 10%. An ablation with the same oracle but no graph is unsafe in 25% and rejects every candidate in another 30%. We machine-checked our proofs in Lean.

translation.title: 安全的自动形式化：基于蕴含图的充分性与必要性
translation.abstract: 自动形式化将自然语言陈述翻译为能捕捉其意图的公式，这依赖于陈述的上下文：即用于消歧的背景。LLM 使自动形式化变得实用，但其概率性输出不提供任何形式化保证。我们提出安全自动形式化的技术，用于认证单侧逻辑充分性：对意图而言充分的公式可以安全地强制执行，而对意图而言必要的公式可以安全地依赖。我们使用 LLM 生成候选公式，并在蕴含图（Entailment Graph, EG）中按逻辑强度排序，该排序由求解器判定。每条边携带一个残差和一个共残差，即蕴含序的两个伴随，它们仅由候选池确定。在给定上下文中，两次搜索返回充分前沿（蕴含该陈述的最弱候选）和必要前沿（该陈述蕴含的最强候选）；每一步只需针对某条边的残差或共残差做一次局部检查。前沿将陈述夹在中间并产生歧义残差，该残差恰好成立于那些候选既不能认证为满足也不能认证为违反陈述的情形；当残差可满足时，陈述恰好是歧义的。对于自然语言陈述和上下文，由 LLM 蕴含预言机来判定检查；若它只接受成立的检查则是可靠的，若它接受所有成立的检查则是完备的。我们证明：可靠的预言机使搜索在任何候选池质量下都安全，而完备的预言机使前沿达到紧致。在安全关键的 AWS 属性上，在一项由专家裁决的研究的 20 个案例中，EG 全部安全，而对等价簇的多数投票和 Universal Self-Consistency 分别在 25% 和 10% 的案例中不安全。使用相同预言机但没有图的消融实验在 25% 的案例中不安全，并在另外 30% 的案例中拒绝所有候选。我们在 Lean 中机器验证了我们的证明。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 自动形式化输出缺乏形式化保证的问题，核心方法是用蕴含图对候选公式按逻辑强度排序，通过可靠/完备的蕴含预言机搜索充分与必要前沿来认证单侧逻辑充分性。

papers.title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. Internally, latent representations retain some domain information, but incompatible realignment can substantially degrade performance, and repeated latent steps can amplify representation-level failures. Thus, while latent representations may preserve information, they do not necessarily ensure effective communication, which also requires compatible realignment, information accessibility, and stable propagation.

translation.title: LatentLens：重新审视多智能体系统中的潜在接口
translation.abstract: 潜在接口让多智能体系统中的智能体通过连续表示而非解码后的文本进行通信。已有工作报告了性能和效率的提升，但既没有将潜在通信与智能体框架分离开来，也没有考察其内部组件，导致其实际贡献不明确。我们提出 LatentLens，一个在两个层面解耦潜在接口的框架：在外部将其与智能体框架解耦，以衡量其对整体性能的贡献（RQ1）；在内部将其分解为重对齐兼容性、信息可及性和传播动态，以识别各自的收益与局限（RQ2）。在使用 Qwen3 模型的七个基准上，在相同框架中加入潜在接口并不能提升、甚至可能大幅降低准确率。在内部，潜在表示保留了一定的领域信息，但不兼容的重对齐会大幅降低性能，且重复的潜在步骤会放大表示层面的失败。因此，尽管潜在表示可能保留了信息，但并不必然保证有效通信；有效通信还需要兼容的重对齐、信息可及性和稳定的传播。
translation.brief: 解决潜在接口在多智能体系统中实际贡献不明的问题，核心方法是将潜在接口从智能体框架外部解耦并分解为重对齐、信息可及性和传播动态三个内部组件进行系统分析。

papers.title: SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $\tau^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of $\tau^2$ errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

translation.title: SecondChance：面向 AI 智能体可靠错误恢复的基准测试
translation.abstract: AI 智能体在行动过程中会犯错，其可靠性取决于之后的应对。现有的恢复基准大多通过注入故障、不涉及用户、且只按任务是否最终完成来评分，因此无法体现智能体是否撤销了自己的隐性错误、是否告知了用户，或是否面对了无法修复的错误。我们提出 SecondChance，一个错误检查点数据集和评估框架，用于刻画和衡量 AI 智能体的错误恢复行为。这些错误是自然产生的：来自智能体在 τ²-bench、BFCL 和 AppWorld 中自身的任务尝试。然后，不同的智能体从相同的检查点出发，在四种条件之一（无辅助、错误通知、错误位置或修复指导）下继续执行。我们衡量错误纠正、任务成功、策略合规、环境状态保持、修复持久性和成本。我们在全部四种条件下评估了 12 个模型，共 5,760 次续写。恢复很少见：在其各环境中，最好的模型在无辅助时仅完成 16% 的恢复，在修复指导下为 27%。纠正不等于恢复：在修复指导下，Llama-3.3-70B 纠正了 26% 的 τ² 错误但无一完成任务，且 84 次成功的 AppWorld 续写中有 40 次仍将错误留在原处。SecondChance 揭示了仅凭任务成功无法捕捉的这些差异。
translation.brief: 解决现有错误恢复基准无法刻画智能体真实恢复行为的问题，核心方法是构建基于智能体自身自然错误的检查点数据集，并在四种辅助条件下系统评估恢复行为。

papers.title: GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing
papers.abstract: Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

translation.title: GoldiBench：工具对了，用量错了——面向专业编辑中效果判断的智能体基准
translation.abstract: 真实的编辑请求描述的是一种效果，而非达到该效果的步骤，因此服务这类请求的智能体必须判断每种工具需要使用多少。现有基准无法衡量这一点：它们的任务要么直接给出工具和参数值，要么用量开放却由 VLM 评审打分，而这些评审会让超过一半的半强度和三倍强度结果通过。我们提出 GoldiBench，一个包含五个专业应用（darktable、RawTherapee、GIMP、Inkscape、Blender）中 500 个编辑任务的基准，可通过编写程序或操作 GUI 求解。每个任务将一张 START 图像与由隐藏程序渲染出的 TARGET 配对，因此用量由已知目标固定；智能体的编辑结果被重新渲染并与 TARGET 比较，同一任务以三种形式提出：给出工具和参数值、只给工具、或只给目标，从而将操作与效果判断分离。在 25 个开源、GUI 和闭源模型中，智能体的操作能力良好（当被告知参数值时，从 4B 起的模型用程序可达 99-100%），但在必须判断用量时急剧下滑：只给工具时，最好的模型用程序仅通过 19% 的任务，通过 GUI 为 33%，且扩大规模无法弥合差距。手册几乎无帮助；实测的 TARGET-START 差异使通过率翻倍以上，但以图像形式呈现相同差异对开源模型无效。允许四次渲染时，智能体几乎总在第一次后停止；强制比较时，强模型的通过率翻倍。智能体知道工具，但既不读取也不检查用量。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法衡量智能体在专业编辑中判断工具用量的问题，核心方法是构建由隐藏程序渲染的固定 TARGET 图像基准，并以三种任务形式分离操作能力与效果判断能力。

papers.title: LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
papers.abstract: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL's out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.

translation.title: LUCID：面向 LLM 推理评估的统计校准自纠正方法
translation.abstract: 廉价的语言模型评分器被用于大规模评估思维链推理，但系统性的步骤评分偏差会扭曲推理审计和解法排名。我们提出 LUCID（Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis），将提示自纠正与基于设计的监督学习（Design-based Supervised Learning, DSL）相结合。无需再训练或权重访问，LUCID 通过对齐预测与专家的合理率来校准二值步骤评分。LUCID 从一个小型专家标注集合出发，以纯文本总结评分器偏差，并提示评分器对未见步骤重新评分。例如，在 PRM800K 上，GPT-5-mini 评分过严，对计算、验证和后段轨迹步骤的低估最为严重。仅需一轮，LUCID 就将 GPT-5-mini 的校准差距从 7.8 个百分点缩小到 0.9 个百分点（预测-专家率的绝对差）。LUCID 还将误报（合理步骤被评为不合理）减半，并将不合理步骤的错误检测 F1 提升 32%。仅用 1,000 个诊断步骤或仅用整体差距反馈，LUCID 也能保持这些收益。该循环还可跨模型和领域迁移：它将 GPT-5-mini 的偏差画像应用于 GLM-5.2 以提升其 PRM800K 准确率，并在数学、科学、网络和逻辑基准上为过严但能力强的评分器缩小校准差距。由于提示反馈只是移动阈值而不改善类平衡的合理/不合理判别能力，LUCID 用前置/后置检查过滤重新评分，跳过已校准的评分器并回滚无效轮次。最后，我们将该专家集合与原始语料评分一起用于 DSL 进行校准和回归去偏，并将 DSL 应用于成对标注的步骤以获得合理步骤转移。DSL 的折外合理概率将 best-of-K 选择提升到与专家标签相当的水平，其双重稳健估计器在小预算下优于仅用专家的回归拟合，并将合理步骤转移误差削减近三分之二。
translation.brief: 解决语言模型评分器系统性偏差导致推理评估失准的问题，核心方法是将提示自纠正与基于设计的监督学习（DSL）结合，通过专家标注集校准评分器偏差并去偏。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Security Review Agents with Operationally Sourced Ground Truth
papers.abstract: LLM-based security review agents can reason about vulnerabilities that deterministic tools miss, but deploying them responsibly requires knowing whether they actually work. Existing benchmarks construct ground truth synthetically or from public CVE databases and are blind to the vulnerability patterns specific to a given production codebase. We present an evaluation framework grounded in an organisation's own vulnerabilities, with three contributions. First, a dataset construction methodology that derives ground truth from operational security data (bug bounty reports, penetration test findings and internally reported vulnerabilities), exploiting the property that a confirmed vulnerability must exist immediately before its fix is merged and be absent immediately after. Second, two complementary evaluation strategies: one reviewing the pull request that introduced a vulnerability and one searching a repository where it already exists. Both run through a two-agent pipeline pairing a Security Engineer agent, which reviews code without knowledge of the vulnerability, with a Judge agent that decides whether its findings would have mitigated the known issue. Third, a trace-level behavioural characterisation of how frontier models reason about these vulnerabilities. Across GPT-5.5, Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5 shows higher discovery rates on the pull-request strategy (57%, 95% CI [42%, 72%]) after a round of OPRO-style improvements, and Sonnet 4.6 on the repository strategy (69%, 95% CI [56%, 81%]). Trace analysis shows the models have complementary strengths that explain these differences, and that outcome-only scoring can mischaracterise their production behaviour. The methodology relies only on artefacts that vulnerability management workflows commonly produce, though all results come from a single organisation's codebase and we have not tested how well they generalise.

translation.title: 基于运营来源真值评估LLM安全审查智能体
translation.abstract: 基于LLM的安全审查智能体能够推理出确定性工具遗漏的漏洞，但要负责任地部署它们，需要知道它们是否真正有效。现有基准通过合成方式或公开CVE数据库构建真值，无法看到特定生产代码库所特有的漏洞模式。我们提出一个以组织自身漏洞为基础的评估框架，包含三项贡献。第一，一种数据集构建方法，从运营安全数据（漏洞赏金报告、渗透测试发现和内部上报的漏洞）中提取真值，利用“已确认漏洞必然在其修复合并前存在、合并后消失”这一特性。第二，两种互补的评估策略：一种审查引入漏洞的pull request，另一种在漏洞已存在的仓库中进行搜索。两者都通过一个双智能体流水线运行：一个Security Engineer智能体在不知道漏洞的情况下审查代码，一个Judge智能体判断其发现是否本可缓解已知问题。第三，对前沿模型如何推理这些漏洞进行trace级别的行为刻画。在GPT-5.5、Sonnet 4.6和Opus 4.7上，经过一轮OPRO式改进后，GPT-5.5在pull-request策略上表现出更高的发现率（57%，95% CI [42%, 72%]），Sonnet 4.6在仓库策略上更高（69%，95% CI [56%, 81%]）。Trace分析显示各模型具有互补的优势，可以解释这些差异，且仅基于结果的评分可能错误刻画其生产行为。该方法仅依赖漏洞管理工作流通常产生的数据，但所有结果均来自单一组织的代码库，我们尚未测试其泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对现有安全审查基准无法反映特定代码库漏洞模式的问题，提出从运营安全数据构建真值并用双智能体流水线评估LLM安全审查智能体的框架。

papers.title: Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach
papers.abstract: Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

translation.title: 后Astra时代的可监控性设计架构：一种基于隔离的方法
translation.abstract: 像GPT-6 Astra这样的前沿模型越来越能够在没有可监控思维链的情况下进行大量推理，思维链的可读性正在下降，且为降低成本常常被异步监控。在思维链监控前景不明的情况下，可能有必要在设计LLM时就考虑可监控性。我们基于GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS及类似方法，对现有LLM架构提出一种修改，将危险能力隔离（compartmentalize），使其使用——尤其是与可能表明策略性对抗使用的危险推理类型结合使用时——能够以比思维链监控更廉价的方式被监控，且这种方式可能在可监控思维链失效后仍然有效。我们提出该架构的若干变体以平衡各种权衡，并讨论其他好处，例如能力移除。
translation.brief: 针对思维链监控可能失效的问题，提出通过隔离危险能力来设计可监控的LLM架构。

papers.title: Multi-agent System for Automatic Discovery of Pareto-optimal Meta-solvers for PDEs
papers.abstract: Designing linear solvers for discretized partial differential equations requires problem-specific expertise. We present a multi-agent framework, in which language-model agents propose, critique, implement, and evaluate solver configurations assembled from Krylov methods, preconditioners, block factorizations, and neural operators. Inside the proposing agent, a non-dominated sorting genetic evolutionary algorithm evolves the population of meta-solvers toward the Pareto front of six measured quantities, so that one run returns a front of trade-offs rather than a single tuned solver. The system runs on small open-weight language models served on a single laptop, and we compare it with a single agent on four problems. For three-dimensional acoustic scattering and elasticity, it delivers 47 and 48 convergent hybrid solvers out of 60 candidates. Relative to the Jacobi-preconditioned Krylov baselines, the best of the discovered solvers reduce the iteration counts by factors of 4.7 and 60 and the online solve time by factors of 2.3 and 3.0, whereas the single agent produces no executable plan. For coupled dynamic thermoelasticity in two and three dimensions, where the baselines fail, it completes 98 of 100 transient candidates and, compared with the single agent, reaches a given accuracy 15 times faster in two dimensions and a displacement error 20 times lower in three dimensions.

translation.title: 用于自动发现PDE帕累托最优元求解器的多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 为离散化偏微分方程设计线性求解器需要针对具体问题的专业知识。我们提出一个多智能体框架，其中语言模型智能体提出、批评、实现并评估由Krylov方法、预条件子、块分解和神经算子组装而成的求解器配置。在提出智能体内部，非支配排序遗传进化算法使元求解器种群向六个测量量的帕累托前沿演化，从而一次运行返回一组权衡前沿而非单个调优求解器。该系统运行于单台笔记本电脑上的小型开源权重语言模型，我们在四个问题上将其与单智能体进行比较。对于三维声散射和弹性问题，它在60个候选中分别给出47和48个可收敛的混合求解器。相对于Jacobi预条件Krylov基线，发现的最佳求解器将迭代次数分别降低4.7倍和60倍，在线求解时间分别降低2.3倍和3.0倍，而单智能体未能产生可执行方案。对于基线失效的二维和三维耦合动态热弹性问题，它在100个瞬态候选中完成98个，与单智能体相比，在二维中达到给定精度快15倍，在三维中位移误差低20倍。
translation.brief: 针对PDE线性求解器设计依赖专业知识的问题，提出结合语言模型多智能体与遗传进化算法自动搜索帕累托最优元求解器的框架。

papers.title: Training decision models for simulating human respondents
papers.abstract: Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic respondents in market research, conjoint analysis, and randomized experiments. However, synthetic choice data from off-the-shelf generative LLMs bias downstream econometric inference. Neither proprietary models nor higher reasoning effort reliably reduces this bias. We investigate decision models (System One architectures) for silicon sampling. Using choice training, we update KEV model weights on historical respondent-level choice microdata by conditional maximum likelihood, before inference and without target-study data. Across three model scales, training on two discrete choice experiments lowers treatment-effect error by 22% to 89% on four held-out studies from new domains (vaccines, nutrition labels, consumer rights, and AI) and new response formats. A small choice-trained model outperforms a much larger off-the-shelf model on three of the four studies. Although training on single studies lowers cross-entropy, it can exacerbate treatment-effect error. Choice training thus complements post-inference calibration by providing a stronger starting point for estimating human preferences.

translation.title: 训练用于模拟人类受访者的决策模型
translation.abstract: 研究人员越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）作为市场研究、联合分析和随机实验中的合成受访者。然而，现成生成式LLM产生的合成选择数据会使下游计量经济学推断产生偏差。专有模型或更高的推理投入都不能可靠地减少这种偏差。我们研究用于硅基采样的决策模型（System One架构）。通过选择训练（choice training），我们在推断之前、不使用目标研究数据的情况下，用条件最大似然法在历史受访者级选择微观数据上更新KEV模型权重。在三个模型规模上，在两个离散选择实验上的训练使四个来自新领域（疫苗、营养标签、消费者权利和AI）和新响应格式的留出研究的处理效应误差降低22%至89%。一个小型选择训练模型在四个研究中的三个上优于大得多的现成模型。尽管在单一研究上训练能降低交叉熵，但可能加剧处理效应误差。因此，选择训练通过为估计人类偏好提供更强的起点，补充了推断后校准。
translation.brief: 针对现成LLM合成受访者导致下游推断偏差的问题，提出用历史选择微观数据对决策模型进行选择训练的方法。

papers.title: Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks
papers.abstract: Reliably evaluating the capabilities of advanced AI systems is critical for safe development and deployment, yet such evaluations may be undermined by sandbagging, a situation in which a model strategically suppresses capabilities it possesses. Existing work has developed controlled sandbagging settings and methods for detecting or eliciting hidden capabilities, but comparatively little is known about how a model's internal neural computation changes when its capabilities are suppressed. In this work, we study sandbagging through the lens of internal functional organization. Inspired by network neuroscience, we construct functional graphs from attention-head activations and compare their organization under honest and sandbagging conditions while holding the model architecture and weights fixed. Surprisingly, across model architectures and community detection methods, we find a consistent structural signature in which sandbagging is associated with reduced functional connectivity within detected communities. We further demonstrate that this reorganization can guide capability elicitation. Ablating attention heads that exhibit the largest connectivity changes substantially recovers suppressed performance while largely preserving performance under honest behavior. Moreover, incorporating these structural signals further improves existing inference-level and weight-level elicitation methods. Together, our results show that sandbagging is accompanied by systematic reorganization of internal computation and demonstrate that functional network structure can provide both a mechanistic lens for understanding capability suppression and a practical signal for recovering hidden capabilities.

translation.title: 通过对注意力头功能网络的结构干预引出被隐藏（sandbagged）的LLM能力
translation.abstract: 可靠地评估先进AI系统的能力对安全开发和部署至关重要，然而此类评估可能被sandbagging破坏，即模型策略性地抑制其拥有的能力。现有工作已开发了受控的sandbagging设置以及检测或引出隐藏能力的方法，但对模型能力被抑制时其内部神经计算如何变化知之甚少。在本工作中，我们从内部功能组织的视角研究sandbagging。受网络神经科学启发，我们从注意力头激活构建功能图，并在保持模型架构和权重不变的情况下比较诚实与sandbagging条件下的组织方式。令人惊讶的是，跨模型架构和社区发现方法，我们发现一致的结构特征：sandbagging与检测到的社区内功能连接减少相关。我们进一步证明这种重组可以指导能力引出。消融表现出最大连接变化的注意力头能大幅恢复被抑制的性能，同时在诚实行为下基本保持性能。此外，将这些结构信号融入现有的推断级和权重级引出方法可进一步提升效果。总之，我们的结果表明sandbagging伴随着内部计算的系统重组，并证明功能网络结构既能提供理解能力抑制的机制视角，也能提供恢复隐藏能力的实用信号。
translation.brief: 针对模型sandbagging隐藏能力难以评估的问题，通过注意力头功能网络分析发现连接减少的结构特征并据此消融注意力头以恢复被抑制能力。

papers.title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agentic benchmarks, and by 9.6%, 14.3% and 28.9% on SPEED-Bench long-context prompts. On Qwen3.8-27B it leads DFlash2, DSpark and xPress by 7.6%, 10.6% and 5.0%, and by 7.4%, 5.8% and 6.0% on the same long-context prompts. The gains persist as serving load grows to concurrency 32.

translation.title: Wavefront：面向投机解码的低秩草稿与并行因果精炼
translation.abstract: 投机解码通过让廉价的草稿模型提出 token、再由目标模型并行验证来加速 LLM 推理。DFlash 和 P-EAGLE 等并行块草稿模型在一次前向传播中提出整个块，但丢失了块内 token 之间的依赖关系；DSpark 通过一个顺序运行的轻量级修正头恢复了部分依赖。我们在测量 DSpark 时发现，该修正头在大多数位置上会覆盖基础预测，因此经过目标模型完整 lm_head 的昂贵基础读取大多只是提供一个种子。因此我们提出 Wavefront，遵循一个简单原则：缩小基础部分、强化修正头。Wavefront 用学习到的低秩基础替代完整 lm_head，让修正头以同一块内整个草稿前缀为条件，并通过少量并行 Jacobi 迭代来求解。固定的迭代预算使草稿步骤不含数据依赖的控制流，因此我们将其捕获为 vLLM 中带融合内核的单个 CUDA graph。在 Qwen3-8B 上，Wavefront 在数学、代码、聊天和 agentic 基准上平均比 xPress、DSpark 和 DFlash 分别提升吞吐 2.6%、10.7% 和 23.6%，在 SPEED-Bench 长上下文提示上分别提升 9.6%、14.3% 和 28.9%。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，它领先 DFlash2、DSpark 和 xPress 分别 7.6%、10.6% 和 5.0%，在相同长上下文提示上分别领先 7.4%、5.8% 和 6.0%。随着服务负载增长至并发 32，增益依然保持。
translation.brief: 针对并行块草稿丢失块内 token 依赖的问题，提出用低秩基础加条件化修正头并以少量并行 Jacobi 迭代求解的草稿方法 Wavefront。

papers.title: E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States
papers.abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. We further propose a suite of longitudinal trajectory diagnostics, measuring dynamic consistency, coherent event progression and collaboration, and non-degenerate trajectory development rather than static consistency alone. In one 60-day simulation, E2SIM produced more extracted event threads judged meaningful by our evaluator and fewer near-duplicate actions than four direct-generation baselines. The framework and evaluation methods provide a basis for studying longitudinal user simulation, with potential applications in training and evaluating AI agents that assist users over extended periods.

translation.title: E2SIM：具有演化状态的日常人类行为长程模拟
translation.abstract: AI 智能体越来越被期望在长期内、跨越工作和日常生活为用户提供支持。这不仅需要建模用户是谁，还需要建模他们的目标、兴趣、活动和交互如何随时间演化。纵向用户模拟的一个挑战是在共享环境中保持这些演化状态与行动后果之间的一致性。我们提出 E2SIM，一个联合建模演化中的行动者状态与动态共享环境的纵向用户模拟框架。E2SIM 通过一个反馈循环将行动者状态更新与共享世界的变化连接起来，该循环关联即时行动、延迟结果以及跨工作与生活的行动者特定观察。这使得早期行动的后果能够塑造后续行为，同时保留各行动者所知信息的差异。我们进一步提出一套纵向轨迹诊断方法，衡量动态一致性、连贯的事件推进与协作，以及非退化的轨迹发展，而不仅仅是静态一致性。在一次 60 天模拟中，与四个直接生成基线相比，E2SIM 产生了更多被我们的评估器判定为有意义的事件线索，且近重复行动更少。该框架与评估方法为研究纵向用户模拟提供了基础，在训练和评估长期辅助用户的 AI 智能体方面具有潜在应用。
translation.brief: 针对长程用户模拟中演化状态与行动后果一致性的问题，提出通过反馈循环联合建模行动者状态与动态共享环境的框架 E2SIM。

papers.title: BRAG: Bayesian Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key per past query. On two public long-term memory benchmarks, BRAG matches these methods on queries asked before, as expected, because when nothing changes over time the assumptions behind these special cases hold. On harder problems, where a new chunk makes an old one obsolete, BRAG outscores them. They all stay at plain-search level (Recall@5 0.67-0.71), while BRAG retrieves the new chunk 0.80-0.86 of the time. We also ran BRAG on three of NUDGE's seven text benchmarks, and it matches or beats NUDGE on all three. On nine months of a personal agent's memory (20,640 chunks), BRAG raises Recall@5 on held-out queries from 0.75 to 0.98 and Recall@1 from 0.44 to 0.97, with little change on chunks never queried.

translation.title: BRAG：贝叶斯检索增强生成
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）按与查询的语义相似度对记忆块排序。许多方法通过从检索反馈中学习来改进这一点，但每种方法都是独立的启发式，没有说明何时才是正确选择。我们提出 BRAG，一个带使用机制的检索生成模型。每个记忆块从锚定在其原始嵌入上的 von Mises-Fisher 混合成分生成它能回答的查询，且每个块具有随时间漂移的潜在效用。该模型给出最优推断——一个闭式滤波器，为每个块存储少量键和两个标量，并根据策展者的标签在线更新——同时将检索形式化为一个控制问题。它还表明了现有方法何时是最优的：查询平均、Rocchio 式反馈和频率重排是参数固定的特例，NUDGE 是每块一个键且无动力学的情形，LADER 是每个历史查询一个键的极限。在两个公开的长期记忆基准上，BRAG 在重复提问的查询上与这些方法持平，这符合预期，因为当时间上没有变化时这些特例背后的假设成立。在更难的问题上，即新块使旧块过时的情形，BRAG 得分更高：它们都停留在普通搜索水平（Recall@5 0.67-0.71），而 BRAG 有 0.80-0.86 的概率检索到新块。我们还在 NUDGE 的七个文本基准中的三个上运行了 BRAG，它在全部三个上持平或超越 NUDGE。在一个个人智能体九个月的记忆（20,640 个块）上，BRAG 将留出查询的 Recall@5 从 0.75 提升到 0.98，Recall@1 从 0.44 提升到 0.97，而对从未被查询的块几乎没有变化。
translation.brief: 针对 RAG 检索缺乏统一概率模型的问题，提出用 von Mises-Fisher 混合建模查询生成、带时间漂移潜在效用并给出闭式在线滤波器的贝叶斯检索框架 BRAG。

papers.title: Provenance Loss and Repair in Multilingual Compaction
papers.abstract: Conversational assistants compact older messages into short notes and evict the originals. When the note's language requires a distinction that English leaves open, such as Spanish adjective gender (agotado vs. agotada), messages that omit or explicitly state that attribute can yield the same note. After eviction, later turns cannot tell them apart: taking the inflected form literally asserts an attribute the user never gave, whereas discounting it as routine grammar discards one the user did give. We propose a training-free repair across writing, pre-eviction verification and reading. The writer marks unstated attributes with paired forms (e.g., agotado/a), a likelihood check before eviction rewrites unsupported single forms into paired ones, and the reader trusts remaining single forms as stated facts. On five Qwen3.5 and Gemma-4 models, eviction cuts recall of stated attributes from 90% to 34% in question answering (QA); our repair raises F1 (which penalizes both errors) on every model, by 9-53 points in QA and 12-40 points in agent handovers.

translation.title: 多语言压缩中的来源信息丢失与修复
translation.abstract: 对话助手将较早的消息压缩为简短笔记并丢弃原文。当笔记的语言需要英语中不作区分的区分时，例如西班牙语形容词的性别（agotado vs. agotada），省略或明确陈述该属性的消息可能产生相同的笔记。丢弃原文后，后续轮次无法区分二者：将屈折形式照字面理解会断言用户从未给出的属性，而将其视为常规语法而忽略则会丢弃用户确实给出的属性。我们提出一种无需训练的修复方法，覆盖写作、丢弃前验证和阅读三个环节。写作者用成对形式（如 agotado/a）标记未陈述的属性，丢弃前的似然检查将无依据的单一形式改写为成对形式，阅读者则将剩余的单一形式视为已陈述的事实。在五个 Qwen3.5 和 Gemma-4 模型上，丢弃使问答（QA）中已陈述属性的召回率从 90% 降至 34%；我们的修复在所有模型上都提升了 F1（同时惩罚两类错误），在 QA 中提升 9-53 分，在智能体交接中提升 12-40 分。
translation.brief: 针对对话压缩在语法性别等语言区分上丢失属性来源信息的问题，提出写作标记成对形式、丢弃前似然改写、阅读信任单一形式的免训练修复方法。

papers.title: AeroPoint: Agentic AI for Intent-Driven Point Cloud Inspection in UAV-Edge Systems
papers.abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-based Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) inspection generates dense point clouds that strain onboard computing and wireless bandwidth. Intent-based inspection allows operators to request objects, attributes, and spatial relationships through natural language. Answering these requests requires trans- lating intent into spatial queries and retrieving relevant evidence under UAV processing and communication constraints. This article presents AeroPoint, an agentic AI system combining onboard point cloud processing and knowledge graph construction with Large Language Model (LLM)-based retrieval planning at a ground edge server. The LLM translates inspection questions into structured requests, which the UAV executes to return selected graph evidence for answer generation. We evaluate the prototype in a power line inspection case study using 150 TS40K UAV LiDAR scenes and profile processing costs on NVIDIA Jetson Nano hardware. Retrieval experiments use graphs constructed from dataset-provided ground-truth semantic labels. Experimental results show that transmitted payload decreases from 3700 KB for complete point clouds to 3.1 KB for retrieval responses, while evaluated LLM routers achieve the highest graph retrieval completeness for relational queries.

translation.title: AeroPoint：面向无人机边缘系统中意图驱动点云巡检的智能体 AI
translation.abstract: 基于无人机的激光雷达（LiDAR）巡检会产生密集点云，给机载计算和无线带宽带来压力。基于意图的巡检允许操作员通过自然语言请求对象、属性和空间关系。回答这些请求需要将意图转化为空间查询，并在无人机处理与通信约束下检索相关证据。本文提出 AeroPoint，一个结合机载点云处理与知识图谱构建、并在地面边缘服务器上进行基于大语言模型（LLM）检索规划的智能体 AI 系统。LLM 将巡检问题翻译为结构化请求，由无人机执行并返回选定的图谱证据用于答案生成。我们在一个使用 150 个 TS40K 无人机 LiDAR 场景的电力线巡检案例中评估原型，并在 NVIDIA Jetson Nano 硬件上剖析处理成本。检索实验使用由数据集提供的真值语义标签构建的图谱。实验结果表明，传输负载从完整点云的 3700 KB 降至检索响应的 3.1 KB，且所评估的 LLM 路由器在关系型查询上取得了最高的图谱检索完整性。
translation.brief: 针对无人机 LiDAR 巡检中机载算力与带宽受限下按自然语言意图检索点云证据的问题，提出机载点云处理与知识图谱结合地面 LLM 检索规划的智能体系统 AeroPoint。

papers.title: Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task
papers.abstract: For decades, every new medical image segmentation task has needed an expert, a dedicated architecture, and a framework such as nnU-Net. This is no longer the case: medical image segmentation is now just another coding task. Given only a task description, labeled data, and a CPU (with no segmentation framework, no pretrained weights, and no human in the loop), four off-the-shelf coding agents built segmenters for 13 tasks across four imaging modalities within hours, an ability that has emerged rather than been built. On the nine 2D tasks, their best programs reach 99% of the Dice of a GPU-trained nnU-Net. Like any code, a segmenter improves by being revised and checked, so we ask how far the same agents can improve their own segmentations and what unlocks further gains. On unseen cases there is no reference, so the agents inspect renderings of their own predictions: this alone lifts the worst tenth of cases by 0.09 Dice and cuts boundary error (HD95) by almost a quarter. Far more is within reach. Told the true Dice of each attempt, the same agents improve in all 14 matched pairs, rescue 85% of failed masks instead of 30%, and surpass the GPU-trained nnU-Net on average, by producing better masks rather than by choosing among them. What unlocks these gains is a quality signal, which neither visual inspection, nor more rounds, nor a quality estimator trained by the agents themselves yet supplies: we call this the quality blind spot. The ability to build and to repair is already present; the next advance will come not from another segmentation model, but from reference-free quality estimation that coding agents can call.

translation.title: 医学图像分割如今只是又一项编码任务
translation.abstract: 几十年来，每一项新的医学图像分割任务都需要专家、专用架构以及 nnU-Net 之类的框架。如今情况已不再如此：医学图像分割只是又一项编码任务。仅给定任务描述、标注数据和一台 CPU（无需分割框架、无需预训练权重、无需人工介入），四个现成的 coding agent 在数小时内为四种成像模态下的 13 个任务构建了分割器——这种能力是涌现出来的，而非被专门构建的。在九个 2D 任务上，它们生成的最佳程序达到了 GPU 训练的 nnU-Net Dice 的 99%。与任何代码一样，分割器可以通过修改和检查来改进，因此我们探究同样的 agent 能在多大程度上改进自己的分割结果，以及什么能解锁进一步的提升。在未见过的病例上没有参考标准，agent 只能检查自己预测结果的渲染图：仅此一项就将最差的十分之一病例的 Dice 提升了 0.09，并将边界误差（HD95）降低了近四分之一。更大的提升空间尚待挖掘。当被告知每次尝试的真实 Dice 时，同样的 agent 在全部 14 组配对实验中都有改进，将失败掩码的挽救率从 30% 提升到 85%，并在平均意义上超越了 GPU 训练的 nnU-Net——其方式是生成更好的掩码，而非在已有掩码中挑选。解锁这些提升的是质量信号，而无论是视觉检查、更多轮次，还是 agent 自行训练的质量估计器，目前都无法提供这种信号：我们称之为质量盲区。构建与修复的能力已然存在；下一步的进展将不是来自另一个分割模型，而是来自 coding agent 可以调用的无参考质量估计。
translation.brief: 研究如何让 coding agent 无需专用框架即可构建并自我改进医学图像分割器，核心方法是利用质量信号（如真实 Dice 或预测渲染检查）驱动 agent 迭代修复分割结果。

papers.title: Rethinking Document Indexing for LLM-based Analysis
papers.abstract: Documents such as clinical records, legal contracts, and scientific papers are increasingly analyzed with large language models (LLMs). The naïve approach of prompting the model with the full text for every question is slow, expensive, prone to hallucination on long inputs, and reuses no work across questions. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems build reusable state to address this, but they store it as embedded chunks: slicing text into fragments can lose the meaning that spans them, and the resulting index is tied to one embedding model, so it must be rebuilt whenever that model changes. Answering many questions over a large body of data without a full rescan, however, is not a new problem: it is the problem database indexes have been solving for decades, and we argue that this accumulated index design knowledge is waiting to be revisited for LLM access. As a concrete starting point, we propose Periplus, a hierarchical plain-text index inspired by the classic B+ tree. It arranges a document into pages running from general summaries at the root to specific ones at the leaves, so that each level guides the search into the next. But it departs from the B+ tree in three ways suited to LLM access: content lives at every level, the pages are plain text rather than attribute values, and navigation follows the relevance of a page summary to the question rather than a key comparison. The structure itself is discovered per document by the LLM rather than hand-designed in advance. In a preliminary evaluation on narrative and contract corpora, Periplus comes within 0.1--0.9 percentage points of the strongest baseline's accuracy while consuming 70--72\% fewer total tokens. These early results are encouraging, and they offer only a glimpse of what index design can bring to LLM-based analysis.

translation.title: 重新思考面向 LLM 分析的文档索引
translation.abstract: 临床记录、法律合同和科学论文等文档越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）进行分析。针对每个问题都把全文输入模型的做法速度慢、成本高、在长输入上容易产生幻觉，且无法在不同问题之间复用工作。检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过构建可复用的状态来解决这一问题，但它们将其存储为嵌入块：把文本切成片段可能丢失跨越片段的含义，且所得索引绑定于某一个 embedding 模型，一旦更换模型就必须重建。然而，在不进行全量扫描的情况下对大量数据回答众多问题并非新问题——这正是数据库索引几十年来一直在解决的问题，我们认为这些积累下来的索引设计知识值得为 LLM 访问重新审视。作为一个具体的起点，我们提出 Periplus，一种受经典 B+ 树启发的层次化纯文本索引。它将文档组织成从根部的概括性摘要到叶子的具体摘要的页面层级，每一层引导搜索进入下一层。但它有三处不同于 B+ 树、适合 LLM 访问的设计：每一层都存有内容、页面是纯文本而非属性值、导航依据页面摘要与问题的相关性而非键比较。该结构本身由 LLM 逐文档发现，而非预先手工设计。在叙事语料和合同语料上的初步评估中，Periplus 的准确率与最强基线相差仅 0.1–0.9 个百分点，而总 token 消耗减少 70–72%。这些早期结果令人鼓舞，且仅展示了索引设计能为基于 LLM 的分析带来什么的一角。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 分析中全文输入低效、RAG 嵌入块有损且绑定模型的问题，提出受 B+ 树启发的层次化纯文本索引 Periplus，由 LLM 自动构建并按摘要相关性导航。

papers.title: LimoBench: How Street Smart Are Large Language Models?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans interact with information, enabling natural-language interfaces across various domains. They are increasingly deployed for geospatial applications including map-based question answering, location-based services, and natural-language interfaces to spatial databases. But are LLMs truly location-aware, able to reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries involving real-world coordinates, points of interest (POIs), and geospatial distances? To answer this concretely, we present LimoBench, a street-level benchmark of 82 natural-language location queries over seven canonical spatial operations: geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, directionality, range search, $k$-nearest-neighbor search, and spatial join. The queries are grounded in real map data of West Lafayette, Indiana, and are graded by location and semantic complexity. They are designed to probe LLMs' street-level spatial awareness, from simple lookups to multi-step spatial reasoning. We also present Limo, an approach based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enhances the location awareness of LLMs. Limo grounds LLMs in PostGIS-backed spatial data through a compact set of tools. We find that ungrounded models mostly achieve single-digit accuracy (3.1% for GPT-6 Luna) across different spatial operations. In contrast, the same models achieve near-perfect accuracy (99.3% for GPT-6 Luna) when given access to Limo's spatial tools through MCP. Current LLMs thus have limited and unreliable street-level spatial knowledge, while grounding provides accurate answers at modest overhead (+0.2 s latency, 7.7$\times$ tokens, and 2.2$\times$ cost for GPT-6 Luna). We release the benchmark, Limo toolset, and evaluation code to encourage the community to evaluate their own location-aware LLM approaches.

translation.title: LimoBench：大语言模型有多强的街头智慧？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已经改变了人类与信息交互的方式，在各个领域实现了自然语言界面。它们越来越多地被部署于地理空间应用，包括基于地图的问答、基于位置的服务以及空间数据库的自然语言接口。但 LLM 真正具备位置感知能力吗——能否可靠地解读并精确回答涉及真实世界坐标、兴趣点（POI）和地理空间距离的位置查询？为具体回答这一问题，我们提出 LimoBench，一个街道级基准，包含 82 个自然语言位置查询，覆盖七种经典空间操作：地理编码、逆地理编码、路径规划、方向判断、范围搜索、$k$ 近邻搜索和空间连接。这些查询基于印第安纳州西拉法叶的真实地图数据，并按位置和语义复杂度分级，旨在探测 LLM 从简单查找到多步空间推理的街道级空间感知能力。我们还提出 Limo，一种基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的方法，用于增强 LLM 的位置感知能力。Limo 通过一组精简的工具将 LLM 锚定于 PostGIS 支撑的空间数据。我们发现，未锚定的模型在各类空间操作上大多只有个位数准确率（GPT-6 Luna 为 3.1%）；而同样的模型在通过 MCP 使用 Limo 的空间工具后达到近乎完美的准确率（GPT-6 Luna 为 99.3%）。因此，当前 LLM 的街道级空间知识有限且不可靠，而锚定能以适度开销（GPT-6 Luna：+0.2 秒延迟、7.7 倍 token、2.2 倍成本）提供准确答案。我们发布该基准、Limo 工具集和评估代码，以鼓励社区评估各自的位置感知 LLM 方法。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 街道级空间推理能力不足的问题，提出街道级基准 LimoBench，并通过基于 MCP 的 PostGIS 空间工具集 Limo 对 LLM 进行锚定。

papers.title: Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics
papers.abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.

translation.title: 目的地对了，旅程错了：合成心理咨询对话缺失人类交互动态
translation.abstract: LLM 生成的心理咨询对话越来越多地被用于训练和评估心理健康系统，但现有评估主要关注回复质量和最终结果，而非支持如何随时间展开。我们对十个人工、重建和合成的心理咨询数据集进行了以轨迹为中心的过程保真度评估。结果表明，合成对话往往能到达看似合理的终点，但在恢复动态和逐轮响应性上与人类支持不同。虽然生成设计可以改变恢复时机和轨迹结构等全局属性，但患者—咨询师之间的条件化响应性在所有模型和生成范式中的保真度始终较低。我们在受控合成数据集上的实验表明，有针对性的生成干预可以在若干轨迹层面指标上缩小与真实数据的差距，但无法完全恢复交互保真度，逐轮响应性仍然受限。我们发布了三个受控合成数据集（共 2,050 段对话），以及标注和评估框架。
translation.brief: 研究合成心理咨询对话与真实对话在过程动态上的差距，核心方法是以轨迹为中心评估逐轮响应性等过程保真度指标。

papers.title: E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware
papers.abstract: Retired data-center hardware can often be refurbished or resold, but triage demands more than object categories. A model must tell visually similar parts apart, judge condition under damage and occlusion, and read the printed part number. We audit nine public e-waste collections. They cover mostly consumer devices (only 10% of images are labeled as a data-center part), label neither condition nor printed text, and contain 42% exact or augmented duplicates. We introduce E-Waste-Bench, 328K photographs drawn from 762K deduplicated images and labeled for class (24 classes), granularity, condition and printed text. Images come from those collections and the web, where a recipe-based crawler works beside an agent built on an open-weight vision-language model. The agent vets new sources and reads sites the crawler cannot parse, and both are steered toward under-represented classes. Training labels are model-made, splits follow near-duplicate groups, and human annotators label a test set of nearly 10,000 images. We benchmark classification, condition, detection, text perception and cross-dataset transfer. On this test set, a ConvNeXt-T trained on E-Waste-Bench reaches 64.3% top-1, against 31.5% with the public collections alone. Near-duplicate leakage inflates top-1 by 3.0 points under model-made test labels but by less than 0.1 under human labels, so model-labeled benchmarks need group splits. Accuracy falls to 42.1% on marketplace and auction photographs, the closest proxy for hardware leaving service. Data and code will be released.

translation.title: E-Waste-Bench：面向数据中心硬件视觉分拣的大规模基准
translation.abstract: 退役的数据中心硬件通常可以翻新或转售，但分拣所需的能力远不止物体类别识别：模型必须区分外观相似的部件、在损坏和遮挡下判断成色，并读取印刷的部件编号。我们审计了九个公开电子垃圾数据集：它们大多覆盖消费类设备（仅 10% 的图像被标注为数据中心部件），既未标注成色也未标注印刷文本，且含有 42% 的完全或增强重复图像。我们提出 E-Waste-Bench，从 762K 去重图像中抽取 328K 张照片，标注了类别（24 类）、粒度、成色和印刷文本。图像来自这些数据集和网络，其中基于配方的爬虫与一个基于开放权重视觉语言模型的 agent 并行工作：agent 负责审核新来源并读取爬虫无法解析的网站，两者都被引导至代表性不足的类别。训练标签由模型生成，数据划分遵循近重复组，并由人工标注员标注了近 10,000 张图像的测试集。我们对分类、成色、检测、文本感知和跨数据集迁移进行了基准测试。在该测试集上，用 E-Waste-Bench 训练的 ConvNeXt-T 达到 64.3% 的 top-1，而仅用公开数据集训练只有 31.5%。近重复泄漏在模型标注的测试标签下使 top-1 虚高 3.0 个百分点，但在人工标签下虚高不足 0.1，因此模型标注的基准需要按组划分。在市场与拍卖照片（最接近退役硬件的代理数据）上，准确率降至 42.1%。数据和代码将发布。
translation.brief: 针对现有电子垃圾数据集缺乏数据中心硬件、成色与印刷文本标注且重复严重的问题，构建大规模基准 E-Waste-Bench，核心方法是用爬虫加视觉语言模型 agent 采集并标注图像、按近重复组划分数据。

papers.title: RTLDetective: Agentic RTL Debugging through Dataflow Analysis and Simulation-Guided Fault Localization
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promise in RTL debugging, yet accurately localizing functional errors and generating reliable repairs remain challenging. We propose RTLDetective, a multi-agent framework that integrates signal dependency analysis, simulation-guided fault localization, and knowledge-based reasoning for automated RTL debugging and repair. RTLDetective constructs signal dependency graphs from RTL code and extracts failure information from waveform traces. A lightweight localizer agent predicts expected intermediate signal values and evaluates them through targeted simulation interventions, iteratively probing signal dependencies to isolate suspicious logic and identify potential fault locations. A debug agent combines this evidence with static analysis, a curated knowledge base of hardware design principles and RTL bug patterns, and reasoning to generate corrected RTL. To reduce inference overhead, the framework reuses cached context across debugging iterations. We evaluate RTLDetective on the MEIC benchmark, achieving an 86.1% fix rate, 13.9 percentage points above the best baseline, while making fewer LLM calls.

translation.title: RTLDetective：基于数据流分析与仿真引导故障定位的智能体式RTL调试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在RTL调试中已展现出潜力，但准确定位功能错误并生成可靠的修复仍然具有挑战性。我们提出RTLDetective，一个集成信号依赖分析、仿真引导故障定位和基于知识推理的多智能体框架，用于自动化RTL调试与修复。RTLDetective从RTL代码构建信号依赖图，并从波形轨迹中提取失败信息。一个轻量级的定位器智能体预测预期的中间信号值，并通过针对性的仿真干预进行评估，迭代探测信号依赖以隔离可疑逻辑并识别潜在故障位置。调试智能体将这些证据与静态分析、一个精心整理的硬件设计原则和RTL缺陷模式知识库以及推理相结合，生成修正后的RTL。为降低推理开销，该框架在调试迭代间复用缓存上下文。我们在MEIC基准上评估RTLDetective，达到86.1%的修复率，比最佳基线高13.9个百分点，同时LLM调用次数更少。
translation.brief: 解决RTL功能错误定位与修复难题，采用多智能体框架结合信号依赖图、仿真引导故障定位和知识库推理来自动调试修复RTL。

papers.title: fork() for Agents: Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents typically execute tool calls synchronously and discard completed work upon failure. Subgraph-selective recovery, re-executing only a failed node's transitive descendants, is a well-established pattern in distributed systems (Spark, Erlang/OTP, Dryad), and recent agent runtimes (Sherlock, AgentGit, Atomix) preserve completed work through verifiers, version control, or transactional tool boundaries. We present \textbf{Agent-Kernel}, a non-blocking runtime that ports this pattern to the LLM \emph{content plane}: its primitive, \textbf{Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR)}, fires on a raw exception with no trained verifier or planner, resets a failed node's descendants while preserving completed siblings, and composes each parent's text into its children's prompts (context inheritance), all on a durable substrate with a formal state-preservation guarantee. Across 14{,}434 runs on synthetic and standard benchmarks (tau-bench, Gaia2, AutomationBench, InterruptBench), SGR reaches full recovery within budget=3 where whole-trajectory replay exhausts (100\% vs.\ 55\%), and is roughly 10$\times$ faster than an adapted Sherlock rollback that also recovers. It matches ReAct-serial accuracy within noise on linear workloads while adding recovery and parallelism (up to 12.7$\times$ speedup) where structure permits. Ablation isolates SGR: removing it collapses success to 39.4\%.

translation.title: 面向智能体的fork()：用于非阻塞LLM编排的Agent Kernel
