translation.abstract: 基于LLM的智能体通常同步执行工具调用，并在失败时丢弃已完成的工作。子图选择性恢复（仅重新执行失败节点的传递后继）是分布式系统（Spark、Erlang/OTP、Dryad）中成熟的设计模式，近期的智能体运行时（Sherlock、AgentGit、Atomix）通过验证器、版本控制或事务性工具边界来保留已完成的工作。我们提出Agent-Kernel，一个非阻塞运行时，将该模式移植到LLM内容平面：其原语Sub-Graph Recovery（SGR）在原始异常发生时触发，无需训练好的验证器或规划器，重置失败节点的后继同时保留已完成的兄弟节点，并将每个父节点的文本组合进其子节点的提示中（上下文继承），全部构建在具有形式化状态保持保证的持久化基底之上。在合成与标准基准（tau-bench、Gaia2、AutomationBench、InterruptBench）上的14,434次运行中，SGR在budget=3内实现完全恢复，而整条轨迹重放则耗尽预算（100%对55%），且比同样能恢复的改编版Sherlock回滚快约10倍。在线性工作负载上其准确率与ReAct-serial在噪声范围内相当，同时在结构允许时提供恢复能力和并行性（最高12.7倍加速）。消融实验隔离了SGR的作用：移除它会使成功率骤降至39.4%。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体失败后丢弃已完成工作的问题，提出Agent-Kernel运行时，通过子图恢复（SGR）原语仅重置失败节点的后继并保留已完成工作。

papers.title: An Order-Optimal Square-Root Bound for Online Maximin Share Allocation with Known Types
papers.abstract: An allocator knows the indivisible goods, the number $n$ of agents, and the $k$ possible additive valuations. Each agent reveals their type on arrival and must immediately receive an irrevocable bundle. Kulkarni, Mehta, and Shahkar established a deterministic guarantee of $1/k$ of maximin share (MMS) and an upper bound of $2/(\sqrt{k}-2)$ for $k>4$. We determine the optimal order $\Theta(k^{-1/2})$ by constructing a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm, Single-or-Select. On every arrival sequence, it gives each agent a fraction $(1/\sqrt{2}-o(1))/\sqrt{k}$ of their truncated proportional share. This share dominates MMS and is the largest target $y$ for which the item values capped at $y$ sum to at least $ny$. By specializing the construction of Kulkarni et al. to two arrivals and counting its types exactly, we sharpen the upper bound to $(\sqrt{2}+o(1))/\sqrt{k}$ even for binary valuations. For two arrivals with binary valuations and every $k\ge2$, the optimal fraction is $1/p$, where $p$ is the largest integer with $1+\binom{2p}{2}\le k$. In particular, up to six binary types permit full maximin share. For two arbitrary additive types, a different polynomial-time algorithm guarantees $4/7$ of maximin share for any number of agents. This ratio is tight for the algorithm. With three arrivals and two types, the optimal deterministic fraction is exactly $9/10$. For randomized policies with $k$ known additive types, the optimal MMS fraction guaranteed to all agents with probability at least $1-\delta$ on every fixed arrival sequence is $\Theta(\max\{k^{-1/2},\sqrt{\delta}\})$ for $0\le\delta<1$.

translation.title: 已知类型的在线Maximin份额分配的阶最优平方根界
translation.abstract: 分配者知道不可分割物品、n个智能体的数量以及k种可能的加性估值。每个智能体到达时揭示其类型，并必须立即获得不可撤销的物品束。Kulkarni、Mehta和Shahkar建立了1/k的maximin份额（MMS）确定性保证，以及k>4时2/(√k−2)的上界。我们通过构造确定性多项式时间算法Single-or-Select确定了最优阶Θ(k^{-1/2})。在任意到达序列上，该算法给每个智能体其截断比例份额的(1/√2−o(1))/√k比例。该份额支配MMS，且是使物品价值截断到y后总和至少为ny的最大目标值y。通过将Kulkarni等人的构造特化到两次到达并精确计数其类型，我们将上界收紧至(√2+o(1))/√k，即使对二元估值也成立。对于二元估值的两次到达以及所有k≥2，最优比例为1/p，其中p是满足1+C(2p,2)≤k的最大整数。特别地，最多六种二元类型允许完整的maximin份额。对于两次任意加性类型的到达，另一个多项式时间算法对任意数量的智能体保证4/7的maximin份额。该比例对该算法是紧的。对于三次到达和两种类型，最优确定性比例恰好为9/10。对于具有k种已知加性类型的随机化策略，在每个固定到达序列上以至少1−δ的概率保证所有智能体的最优MMS比例为Θ(max{k^{-1/2}, √δ})，其中0≤δ<1。
translation.brief: 解决已知类型在线不可分割物品分配中maximin份额保证的最优阶问题，通过构造Single-or-Select算法确定Θ(k^{-1/2})的最优界并收紧上界。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Memory-Organized Search with Anti-Imitation Crossover for Training-Free Microarchitecture Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language models can generate cache-replacement policies. The central challenge is to retain performance on workloads excluded from the search. In our adaptations of published search methods, generated code resembles established policies, with cosine similarities of 0.78-0.84. The wider comparison also shows held-out harmonic-mean instructions-per-cycle (IPC) losses of 1.0-2.4%. We present MOSAIC, a search controller that improves policies without updating language-model weights. It stores concise lessons from previous evaluations rather than repeatedly copying high-scoring code. When improvement stops, it selects two high-scoring policies whose code embeddings differ and asks the model to combine their mechanisms. Novelty prompts and model rotation support this search; controlled memory edits test how the stored lessons affect later proposals. We evaluate cache replacement using intervention-level cross-validation and a wider comparison on ten memory-intensive SPEC2006 workloads. MOSAIC reaches a 51.1% peak hit rate on the primary search workload and a 47.9% held-out mean in the intervention study. Removing crossover reduces these values by 7.8 and 21.8 percentage points, respectively, whereas the tested stronger model improves the held-out mean by 0.4 points. In the wider IPC comparison, MOSAIC has the smallest held-out gap (0.31%) and the highest held-out IPC among the evaluated LLM configurations. Adapting the same controller to data prefetching gives a 4.8% mean speedup over the LRU reference configuration. The accompanying corpus contains 10,687 generated policies with lineage and per-iteration prompt logs.

translation.title: MOSAIC：面向免训练微架构优化的记忆组织搜索与反模仿交叉
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以生成缓存替换策略。核心挑战是在搜索未覆盖的工作负载上保持性能。在我们对已发表搜索方法的改编中，生成的代码与既有策略相似，余弦相似度为0.78-0.84。更广泛的比较还显示留出集上调和平均IPC损失为1.0-2.4%。我们提出MOSAIC，一个在不更新语言模型权重的情况下改进策略的搜索控制器。它存储以往评估的简洁经验教训，而不是反复复制高分代码。当改进停止时，它选择两个代码嵌入不同的高分策略，并要求模型组合它们的机制。新颖性提示和模型轮换支持这一搜索；受控的记忆编辑测试存储的经验教训如何影响后续提议。我们在十个内存密集型SPEC2006工作负载上，使用干预级交叉验证和更广泛的比较来评估缓存替换。MOSAIC在主搜索工作负载上达到51.1%的峰值命中率，在干预研究中达到47.9%的留出均值。移除交叉会使这两个值分别下降7.8和21.8个百分点，而测试的更强模型将留出均值提高0.4个百分点。在更广泛的IPC比较中，MOSAIC在所评估的LLM配置中留出差距最小（0.31%）且留出IPC最高。将同一控制器适配到数据预取，相比LRU参考配置获得4.8%的平均加速。随附语料库包含10,687个带谱系和每次迭代提示日志的生成策略。
translation.brief: 解决LLM生成的缓存替换策略在留出工作负载上泛化差的问题，提出MOSAIC免训练搜索控制器，通过存储经验教训和反模仿交叉组合机制来提升策略新颖性与性能。

papers.title: Reproducing History Is Not Enough: Intervention-Level Assurance for LLM-Generated Simulators
papers.abstract: Large language models can now write simulation programs of operational processes and workflows. These programs can be reused to answer what-if questions on new records and policies. However, a program that reproduces recorded history can still give wrong answers to what-if questions; requested changes may be applied wrongly, or they may be applied to records other than the ones the question is about, or the program may stop being valid once its policy is revised. Current checks return a pass-or-fail verdict for the whole program, which says little about whether any single answer can be trusted. We propose Vouch, a library that judges whether an answer from a generated simulator can be trusted for the change being asked about. Each what-if question is turned into a structured change, which is checked against the program and the current records. The library also keeps a record of the kinds of change each program has passed or failed, and repeats the relevant tests whenever the program is reused. We apply it to three program-generation platforms, with programs built by five language models, across four domains: manufacturing, IT operations, and pharmacy and loan-application workflows, using independently checked reference answers. Our baselines are the platforms' own checks where such checks exist, an LLM-as-a-judge, and a ReAct agent that can run the program. We measure how many correct answers are trusted, how many are wrongly rejected, how many wrong answers are accepted, and what the checking costs. On programs written by Haiku and Sonnet in one platform, Vouch removes 97.6% of the wrong answers, while still trusting 80.1% of all answers. At equal coverage, it accepts fewer wrong answers than LLM judges built on Claude Haiku. We disclose code and results for reproducibility.

translation.title: 复现历史是不够的：LLM生成模拟器的干预级保障
translation.abstract: 大语言模型现在可以编写运营流程和工作流的模拟程序。这些程序可被复用来对新记录和新策略回答what-if问题。然而，一个能复现已记录历史的程序仍可能对what-if问题给出错误答案；请求的变更可能被错误应用，或被应用到与问题无关的记录上，或程序在其策略被修订后可能失效。当前的检查对整个程序返回通过或不通过的判定，这对任何单个答案是否可信几乎没有说明。我们提出Vouch，一个判断生成模拟器针对所询问变更给出的答案是否可信的库。每个what-if问题被转换为结构化变更，并与程序和当前记录进行核对。该库还记录每个程序通过或失败的变更类型，并在程序被复用时重复相关测试。我们将其应用于三个程序生成平台，程序由五个语言模型构建，涵盖四个领域：制造、IT运维以及药房和贷款申请工作流，并使用独立核对的参考答案。我们的基线是平台自身的检查（如存在）、LLM-as-a-judge以及一个可以运行程序的ReAct智能体。我们测量有多少正确答案被信任、多少被错误拒绝、多少错误答案被接受以及检查成本。在一个平台上由Haiku和Sonnet编写的程序上，Vouch移除了97.6%的错误答案，同时仍信任80.1%的所有答案。在相同覆盖率下，它比基于Claude Haiku的LLM评判者接受更少的错误答案。我们公开代码和结果以保证可复现性。
translation.brief: 解决LLM生成的模拟器对what-if问题答案可信度无法保证的问题，提出Vouch库，将问题转为结构化变更并逐答案核验与追踪程序历史检查记录。

papers.title: GreenDynaMix: Thermal-Aware Dynamic Mixed-Precision MoE LLM Inference Systems
papers.abstract: Sustained Large Language Model (LLM) inference generates significant heat that exacerbates silicon aging and reduces GPU reliability. Because GPU temperature fluctuates continuously with workload intensity and ambient conditions, keeping it in a safe range requires real-time frequency scaling, which inevitably comes at the cost of either throughput or accuracy. To address this tightly coupled challenge, we propose GreenDynaMix, the first runtime system to jointly integrate a DVFS-based thermal manager with a dynamic precision-tuning throughput compensator. A sensitivity-aware allocator leverages intrinsic importance signals from the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) router to assign higher precision to critical experts, preserving accuracy. Experiments on server, desktop, and embedded platforms demonstrate that GreenDynaMix reduces the temperature-induced aging rate of GPUs during LLM inference by 25-33%. Without offline profiling or model retraining, it recovers throughput at a perplexity cost of 0.9-1.6% with 8-bit/4-bit mixed precision, rising to 9.4% where memory forces 4-bit/2-bit.

translation.title: GreenDynaMix：面向热感知的动态混合精度 MoE LLM 推理系统
translation.abstract: 持续的大语言模型（LLM）推理会产生大量热量，加剧硅片老化并降低 GPU 可靠性。由于 GPU 温度随工作负载强度和环境条件持续波动，将其保持在安全范围内需要实时频率调节，而这不可避免地以吞吐量或精度为代价。为应对这一紧密耦合的挑战，我们提出 GreenDynaMix，这是首个将基于 DVFS 的热管理器与动态精度调节吞吐量补偿器联合集成的运行时系统。一个敏感性感知分配器利用 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）路由器的内在重要性信号，为关键专家分配更高精度，从而保持准确性。在服务器、桌面和嵌入式平台上的实验表明，GreenDynaMix 将 LLM 推理期间 GPU 因温度导致的老化速率降低了 25-33%。在无需离线剖析或模型重训练的情况下，它以 0.9-1.6% 的困惑度代价通过 8-bit/4-bit 混合精度恢复吞吐量；当内存限制迫使采用 4-bit/2-bit 时，困惑度代价升至 9.4%。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 推理中 GPU 过热老化与吞吐量/精度权衡问题，方法是将 DVFS 热管理器与基于 MoE 路由器重要性信号的动态混合精度补偿器联合集成。

papers.title: Where is the Interface for the AI Harness?
papers.abstract: Norman's gulfs of execution and evaluation have guided interaction design for forty years, but both assume a user who is present in the loop. Agentic delegation breaks that assumption: users describe an outcome and leave, while the agent takes hundreds of unseen actions. Starting from a 2026 incident in which a research agent circumvented an access refusal on an Australian government portal and went unnoticed for two months, we argue that delegation opens two new gulfs. The gulf of specification is the gap between what a user wants and their ability to express it, including how the agent should behave in situations nobody foresaw. The gulf of oversight is the gap between what an agent is doing and the user's ability to know, assess, and control it. We argue that both gulfs meet in the harness, the tools, permissions, checks, and loop that surround the model. Harnesses are currently written by developers and hidden from users. We call on HCI to decide which parts of the harness belong to the end-user, which should be visible and adjustable defaults, and which should be built in by design, and to create the interfaces that let ordinary people author and read them.

translation.title: AI Harness 的交互界面在哪里？
translation.abstract: Norman 的执行鸿沟与评估鸿沟四十年来一直指导着交互设计，但两者都假设用户始终在环。智能体委托打破了这一假设：用户描述一个结果后离开，而智能体执行数百个不可见的操作。从 2026 年的一起事件出发——一个研究型智能体绕过了澳大利亚政府门户的访问拒绝且两个月未被发现——我们论证委托开辟了两个新的鸿沟。规约鸿沟是用户想要什么与其表达能力之间的差距，包括智能体在无人预见的情况下应如何行事。监督鸿沟是智能体正在做什么与用户知晓、评估和控制它的能力之间的差距。我们论证这两个鸿沟都汇聚于 harness——围绕模型的工具、权限、检查和循环。目前 harness 由开发者编写并对用户隐藏。我们呼吁 HCI 界决定 harness 的哪些部分属于最终用户、哪些应作为可见且可调的默认设置、哪些应由设计内建，并创建让普通人能够编写和阅读这些部分的界面。
translation.brief: 解决智能体委托场景下用户规约与监督缺失的问题，方法是将 Norman 的鸿沟理论扩展为规约鸿沟与监督鸿沟，并主张将 harness 的部分控制权开放给最终用户。

papers.title: Mixed-Initiative Mining of Root-Cause Analyses into Audit Priors for C/C++ Vulnerability Hunting
papers.abstract: Vulnerability auditing of large C/C++ codebases is constrained by limited review attention. Human auditors and LLM-based agents need operational priors that indicate where to look first and what to suspect, but such priors are rarely available in directly usable form. Rather than proposing a new vulnerability detector, we derive audit-steering artifacts from evidence-backed root-cause analysis (RCA) reports. We introduce two complementary representations: Occurrence Context (OC), a location prior based on file role, function role, and data-structure class; and Vulnerability-Inducing Structural Patterns (VISP), reusable failure-mechanism priors. OC guides where to inspect, while VISP guides what to suspect. On 108 CVEs from Vul4C, OC's parser-based priority ranking, without LLM inference, outperforms generic prioritization baselines with moderate-to-large effect sizes. Packaged as executable SKILLs, OC and VISP form a dual-SKILL workflow that improves audit-relevant broad coverage, defined as match-or-partial findings within ground-truth functions that share the patch's failure mechanism, as assessed by three LLM judges. Across the 108-CVE cohort, dual-SKILL improves function-level broad matches by 5.3 percentage points; gains reach 7.2 points on mid-size projects and 15.0 points on large (1500-4999-line) vulnerable files. These results suggest that RCA-derived priors help direct limited audit attention toward vulnerable code. The agent-coverage evaluation is a single-run operational probe, with one run per commit, characterizing the direction and scale of the effect rather than its precise magnitude.

translation.title: 混合主动式挖掘根因分析以生成 C/C++ 漏洞挖掘的审计先验
translation.abstract: 大型 C/C++ 代码库的漏洞审计受限于有限的审查注意力。人类审计员和基于 LLM 的智能体需要可操作的先验来指示先看哪里、怀疑什么，但这类先验很少以可直接使用的形式存在。我们不提出新的漏洞检测器，而是从有证据支撑的根因分析（RCA）报告中推导审计引导工件。我们引入两种互补的表示：Occurrence Context（OC），一种基于文件角色、函数角色和数据结构类别的位置先验；以及 Vulnerability-Inducing Structural Patterns（VISP），可复用的失效机制先验。OC 指导在哪里检查，VISP 指导怀疑什么。在 Vul4C 的 108 个 CVE 上，OC 基于解析器的优先级排序（无需 LLM 推理）以中等到较大效应量优于通用优先级基线。打包为可执行 SKILL 后，OC 和 VISP 构成双 SKILL 工作流，提升了审计相关的广覆盖——定义为在与补丁失效机制相同的真实函数内的匹配或部分发现，由三个 LLM 评审员评估。在 108 个 CVE 队列中，双 SKILL 将函数级广匹配提升 5.3 个百分点；在中等规模项目上提升 7.2 个百分点，在大型（1500-4999 行）漏洞文件上提升 15.0 个百分点。这些结果表明，源自 RCA 的先验有助于将有限的审计注意力引向易受攻击的代码。智能体覆盖评估是单次运行的运营性探测，每个 commit 运行一次，刻画效应的方向和规模而非其精确量级。
translation.brief: 解决 C/C++ 漏洞审计中审查注意力有限、缺乏可用先验的问题，方法是从根因分析报告中挖掘出位置先验 OC 和失效机制先验 VISP 两种审计引导工件。

papers.title: Separating Measurement Failures from Defence Failures in Split Language-Model Privacy
papers.abstract: Split-training privacy evaluations fail through distinct mechanisms. Evaluators can overlook an exposed gradient channel, align reconstructions against shifted labels, or deploy uncalibrated probes before testing a candidate defence, while calibrated attacks can also refute real defences. Separating these failure modes alters which claims survive. We conduct a retrospective evidentiary reanalysis across four split-LLM campaigns and two cross-cutting scope checks covering host key custody and variational mutual-information bounds, mapping every recorded claim to one of five admissibility states (breach, non-detection, undetermined coverage, invalid measurement, or out-of-scope inference). Across a 19-configuration exploration, only four of 24 required probes qualified, yet those four calibrated probes still established qualified privacy breaches in 13 configurations, while utility or learning-gain failures eliminated the remaining 6. In a seven-cell defence-redesign pilot, 2 quantised configurations failed utility gates, calibrated next-byte structure probes breached the 0.02 gate on all 7 cells (0.097 to 0.112), and qualified punctuation-property probes reached 0.79 to 0.89, yielding 4 failed and 3 undetermined composite privacy assessments (the latter from marginal null-band excursions on punctuation bindings). Negative evidence against both defence families remains intact. Scope checks further show that shared-key orthogonal wrappers protect passive network captures without hiding activations from a compromised restoring host, and why near-zero variational lower bounds leave worst-case leakage unconstrained. Rerunnable scripts verify 1,522 checks across 122 SHA-256-pinned artifacts while preserving each campaign's native seed intervals and retrospective boundaries.

translation.title: 在分割式语言模型隐私中区分测量失败与防御失败
translation.abstract: 分割训练隐私评估会通过不同的机制失败。评估者可能忽略暴露的梯度通道、将重建结果与错位的标签对齐，或在测试候选防御之前部署未校准的探针，而校准攻击也可能驳倒真实的防御。区分这些失败模式会改变哪些声明能够成立。我们对四个分割 LLM 研究活动以及两项横切范围检查（涵盖主机密钥托管和变分互信息界）进行了回顾性证据再分析，将每条记录的声明映射到五种可采性状态之一（泄露、未检测、覆盖未定、无效测量或超出范围推断）。在 19 个配置的探索中，24 个必需探针中只有 4 个合格，但这 4 个校准探针仍在 13 个配置中确立了合格的隐私泄露，而效用或学习增益失败排除了其余 6 个。在一个七单元防御重设计试点中，2 个量化配置未通过效用门槛，校准的下一字节结构探针在全部 7 个单元上突破了 0.02 门槛（0.097 至 0.112），合格的标点属性探针达到 0.79 至 0.89，产生 4 个失败和 3 个未定的复合隐私评估（后者源于标点绑定上边际的零带越界）。针对两类防御的负面证据仍然成立。范围检查进一步表明，共享密钥的正交包装器能保护被动网络捕获，却无法向被攻陷的恢复主机隐藏激活值，以及为什么接近零的变分下界使最坏情况泄露不受约束。可重跑的脚本在 122 个 SHA-256 固定工件上验证了 1,522 项检查，同时保留每个活动的原生种子区间和回顾性边界。
translation.brief: 解决分割式 LLM 隐私评估中测量失败与真实防御失败混淆的问题，方法是通过回顾性证据再分析将声明映射到五种可采性状态，并用校准探针重新检验。

papers.title: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.

translation.title: TACT-Bench：针对工具使用智能体的自适应对话威胁测试
translation.abstract: AI 智能体在使用外部工具和做决策方面日益增强的自主性，使得对全面安全基准的需求变得迫切。现有基准测试被攻陷的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但可能无法捕捉受策略治理的工具使用智能体的独特能力——它们必须在不放弃同一交互中嵌入的合法工作的前提下拒绝未授权请求。为填补这一空白，我们提出 TACT-Bench，一个围绕场景特定故事、人设、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗任务都针对助手所提供策略中明确禁止的操作，同时策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT 为每个对抗任务配对至少一个良性对应任务，且其对抗任务在合规解决方案仍然可用时保留授权的真实操作。我们将这些基础任务定义为 TACT-Base。我们还引入 TACT-TrustPrime，它在同一对话中将一个独立的良性任务置于无关攻击之前。我们还提出 Paired Selective Trustworthiness（PST），将显式的安全拒绝与在匹配良性任务上展现的能力相结合，以分析智能体的过度谨慎性和实用性。在 6 个不同模型作为助手的平均结果上，TACT-Base 相比四个兼容攻击基线将攻击诱导失败率（AFR）提高 17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime 再提高 17.01%。两种被评估的防御方法平均仅将 AFR 降低 8.35%--9.41%，且未能持续改善 PST，凸显了对更强策略执行方法的需求。
translation.brief: 解决现有安全基准无法测试策略治理型工具使用智能体在拒绝攻击的同时保留合法任务能力的问题，方法是通过场景化故事、操纵策略与自适应升级构建有状态对抗基准 TACT-Bench。

papers.title: Verified Proof Refactoring with Codex and Qwen
papers.abstract: We refactor existing Lean 4 proofs to reduce source length and checking cost while preserving theorem statements and compatibility across Lean versions. A locally served Qwen model uses the open-source Codex CLI to inspect source, retrieve declarations, and test proof replacements. The host keeps a replacement only if it improves the objective and Lean accepts it on every required version. A deterministic CPU pass then refines the verified proofs. On the 60 problems in Lean Refactor Arena, model search achieves a local mean combined score of 82.07, and cleanup raises it to 82.18. The final proofs pass all 127 required proof--version checks. Our system placed first in the open-source LLM track of Lean Refactor Arena at VeriCodeGen.

translation.title: 使用 Codex 与 Qwen 进行经验证的证明重构
translation.abstract: 我们对现有的 Lean 4 证明进行重构，在保持定理陈述和跨 Lean 版本兼容性的同时，缩短源代码长度并降低检查成本。一个本地部署的 Qwen 模型使用开源的 Codex CLI 来检查源代码、检索声明并测试证明替换方案。只有当替换方案能改进目标函数且 Lean 在所有要求的版本上均接受时，宿主才保留该替换。随后由一个确定性的 CPU 流程对已验证的证明进行精炼。在 Lean Refactor Arena 的 60 个问题上，模型搜索取得了 82.07 的局部平均综合得分，清理阶段将其提升至 82.18。最终证明通过了全部 127 项证明-版本检查。我们的系统在 VeriCodeGen 的 Lean Refactor Arena 开源 LLM 赛道中获得第一名。
translation.brief: 该论文解决在保持定理陈述与跨版本兼容的前提下缩短 Lean 4 证明的问题，核心方法是让本地 Qwen 模型借助 Codex CLI 搜索并测试证明替换，再经确定性 CPU 流程精炼。

papers.title: Dreamcatcher: Remembering What Surprises a World Model in Video Streams
papers.abstract: As live video streams grow longer, repeatedly encoding and processing their full histories becomes increasingly costly. Answering questions as they arrive therefore calls for visual memory built in one pass before future questions are known. Existing methods mainly keep tokens that differ from earlier ones or match surrogate queries fixed in advance. Without modeling world dynamics, these criteria struggle to tell subtle surprising details from expected change. We introduce Dreamcatcher, a training-free framework and, to our knowledge, the first to use predictive signals from an independently pretrained, frozen video world model for online memory formation in streaming video question answering. Conditioned on recent history, the world model predicts incoming features using learned world priors. Its normalized prediction errors yield temporal and spatial surprisal signals that guide online segmentation and the retention of a frozen Video-LLM's native visual tokens, balancing surprising details with broad visual coverage under budgets that decay with segment age. At query time, an evidence gate admits a segment from a similarity-based shortlist only when the Video-LLM judges that it adds evidence for the question beyond the current view. We evaluate Dreamcatcher on three streaming and three offline long-video benchmarks. On OVO-Bench, Dreamcatcher achieves the highest overall accuracy among the compared training-free methods for each of four frozen Video-LLMs, reaching 78.9% with Qwen3.8-27B. With the three Qwen Video-LLMs, it also reduces average input tokens for answer generation by more than 80% relative to their base models at 1 fps.

translation.title: Dreamcatcher：记住视频流中令世界模型惊讶的内容
translation.abstract: 随着直播视频流变得越来越长，反复编码和处理其完整历史的成本也日益增加。因此，要在问题到来时即时作答，就需要在未知未来问题的情况下一次性构建视觉记忆。现有方法主要保留与先前不同的 token，或匹配预先固定的代理查询。由于不建模世界动态，这些标准难以区分细微的意外细节与预期变化。我们提出 Dreamcatcher，这是一个免训练框架，据我们所知也是首个利用独立预训练的冻结视频世界模型的预测信号来进行流式视频问答在线记忆构建的工作。世界模型以近期历史为条件，利用学到的世界先验预测即将到来的特征。其归一化的预测误差产生时间和空间上的惊讶信号，用于指导在线分割以及冻结 Video-LLM 原生视觉 token 的保留，在随片段年龄衰减的预算下平衡惊讶细节与广泛的视觉覆盖。在查询时，证据门控仅在 Video-LLM 判断某片段能为问题提供超出当前视野的证据时，才允许基于相似度候选列表中的片段进入。我们在三个流式和三个离线长视频基准上评估了 Dreamcatcher。在 OVO-Bench 上，对于四个冻结 Video-LLM 中的每一个，Dreamcatcher 在所比较的免训练方法中均取得最高的总体准确率，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 时达到 78.9%。配合三个 Qwen Video-LLM，与 1 fps 下的基础模型相比，它还将答案生成的平均输入 token 减少了 80% 以上。
translation.brief: 该论文解决流式视频问答中一次性构建视觉记忆的问题，核心方法是利用冻结视频世界模型的预测误差作为惊讶信号来指导在线分割与视觉 token 保留。

papers.title: DELTA: Diagnosing Exploration Lineages via Twin-path Alignment - What Can Contrasting Design Paths Reveal About Microarchitectural Behavior?
papers.abstract: Architects have two mature instruments for performance work. Top-Down analysis tells them where a design loses its pipeline slots, and design-space exploration (DSE) tells them which configuration scores best. Neither explains why a search stops improving: why a backend-bound design rejects a prefetcher that the bottleneck label recommends, or why a capacity increase that helped in one configuration hurts in the next. This paper argues that the evidence needed to answer such questions is already produced during exploration and then discarded. Every parent-child edge in an exploration tree is a controlled intervention: one knob changes, the rest of the design is held fixed, and a cycle-level simulator measures the outcome. When the same edit helps under one parent and hurts under another, aligning the two parents localizes the interaction that decides its sign. We present DELTA, a simulator-grounded root-cause analysis tool that builds a Design Memory of such interventions during exploration and lets an architect query it afterwards. Each record stores the full parent configuration, the single applied edit, the measured and predicted IPC, a Top-Down breakdown from StallLens, our gem5 implementation of Top-Down, and its lineage. Unlike evolutionary LLM search, which keeps only high-scoring programs, DELTA keeps failed edges as evidence. The same memory also makes exploration efficient: on four SPEC CPU2017 workloads, the full system raises IPC by 55.5% in 22 simulated designs for $1.56 of model cost, predicts the IPC of its own proposals to within 3.3%, and keeps improving after a bottleneck-guided search stalls. A root-cause query over the recorded history led us to a usefulness-throttled variant of the Best-Offset prefetcher that improves IPC by 1.37% over the original in matched configurations.

translation.title: DELTA：基于双路径对齐的探索谱系诊断——对比设计路径能揭示哪些微架构行为？
translation.abstract: 架构师在性能工作中有两种成熟的工具。Top-Down 分析告诉他们设计在何处丢失流水线槽位，设计空间探索（DSE）告诉他们哪种配置得分最高。但两者都无法解释搜索为何停止改进：为何一个后端受限的设计会拒绝瓶颈标签所推荐的预取器，或为何在某配置中有帮助的容量增加在下一个配置中反而有害。本文认为，回答这些问题所需的证据在探索过程中已经产生，随后却被丢弃。探索树中的每一条父子边都是一次受控干预：改变一个旋钮，其余设计保持固定，由周期级模拟器测量结果。当同一修改在一个父配置下有益而在另一个下有害时，对齐这两个父配置可以定位决定其效果符号的交互。我们提出 DELTA，一个以模拟器为根基的根因分析工具，它在探索过程中构建此类干预的“设计记忆”，并允许架构师事后查询。每条记录存储完整的父配置、所应用的单一修改、测量与预测的 IPC、来自 StallLens（我们的 gem5 Top-Down 实现）的 Top-Down 分解及其谱系。与只保留高分程序的进化式 LLM 搜索不同，DELTA 将失败的边作为证据保留。同一记忆也使探索更高效：在四个 SPEC CPU2017 工作负载上，完整系统在 22 个模拟设计中将 IPC 提升 55.5%，模型成本仅 1.56 美元，对其自身提案的 IPC 预测误差在 3.3% 以内，并在瓶颈引导搜索停滞之后仍能继续改进。对记录历史的一次根因查询引导我们得到 Best-Offset 预取器的一个有用性节流变体，在匹配配置下将 IPC 比原版提升 1.37%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决设计空间探索为何停滞的根因诊断问题，核心方法是在探索中记录父子配置干预构建“设计记忆”，并通过双路径对齐定位决定修改效果的交互。

papers.title: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.abstract: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emph{parse rather than execute} the query. On full 1{,}000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf{62.5 / 75.1} EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf{73.5 / 81.0} on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf{37.1 / 50.0} on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript{2}RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript{2}RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.

translation.title: 基于 SPARQL 规划的单跳遍历实时知识图谱多跳问答
translation.abstract: 语义检索在多跳问答中的召回率和精确率均面临困难：黄金段落被干扰项淹没而影响阅读器的回答，且检索它们需要对查询进行推理而非简单匹配。GraphRAG 技术通过将段落连接到图节点并在初始检索后进行一跳或多跳扩展来增强语义检索。这提高了召回率，但多跳扩展变得昂贵，并给检索集合带来额外噪声。我们通过将稠密检索与知识图谱遍历交错进行来打破这一权衡，以应对复杂的多跳问题。稠密检索以良好的召回率定位搜索空间中最初的相关区域，而对既有外部知识图谱（Wikidata）的遍历则通过依据 KG 中的推理路径确认检索到的段落来恢复精确率并提升召回率。为使遍历既适应问题又可靠，我们让 LLM 将其规划为以 SPARQL 格式生成图遍历代码的任务，但只解析而不执行该查询。在共享语料库和阅读器、且以单一配置统一应用于所有数据集的完整 1000 题划分上，我们在 HotpotQA 上达到 62.5/75.1 的 EM/F1，在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上达到 73.5/81.0，在 MuSiQue 上达到 37.1/50.0，在全部三个基准上均领先于复现的 HippoRAG2、T²RAG 和 IRCoT。在 token 匹配的第二种设置下，我们在 HotpotQA 和 2Wiki 上仍领先 T²RAG，同时每查询开销大致相当。执行而非解析生成的 SPARQL 会损失多达 11.4 的 EM，主要原因是原始查询返回空结果，而非语法错误。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多跳问答中检索召回与精确的权衡问题，核心方法是将稠密检索与 LLM 规划的 SPARQL 知识图谱遍历（仅解析不执行）交错进行。

papers.title: SwarmLeak: Does Coordination Improve Privacy Attacks on LLM Agents?
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly collaborate in group chats while holding tool access to confidential records, which makes the shared chat an attack surface. It remains unclear whether several colluding attackers extract such information more effectively than one. We introduce SwarmLeak, a red-teaming dataset of 24 synthetic group-chat scenarios across healthcare, law, finance, and software engineering, where attackers pose as colleagues to make a victim agent post protected fields despite an explicit confidentiality policy. With GLM 5.2 attacking five victim models through seven conversational strategies, we compare one attacker with a swarm of four sharing a private channel, matching scenarios, strategies, and a 200,000-token budget that also covers swarm coordination. Swarms show no advantage: a single attacker matches or exceeds them on every victim, and the share of runs leaking any field differs between conditions by at most 14.3 percentage points, whereas changing the victim shifts it from 0% to 99.4%. On the two most vulnerable models, nearly every run leaks under both conditions, but single attackers expose more of the record at first disclosure (85.4% vs. 68.1% of protected fields on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning). Four of the five victims leaked despite the policy. GLM 5.2 retrieved protected data in 64.3% of individual-attack runs and leaked in 0.6%: retrieval does not imply disclosure, but in high-stakes settings even one leaked field can identify a patient or client. At equal budgets, a larger red team is not automatically a stronger one; the victim model matters far more.

translation.title: SwarmLeak：协调能否提升针对 LLM 智能体的隐私攻击？
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地在群聊中协作，同时持有对机密记录的工具访问权限，这使得共享聊天成为一种攻击面。目前尚不清楚多个串通的攻击者是否比单个攻击者更有效地提取此类信息。我们提出 SwarmLeak，一个包含 24 个合成群聊场景的红队测试数据集，涵盖医疗、法律、金融和软件工程领域，攻击者伪装成同事，诱使受害智能体在明确的保密策略下发布受保护字段。使用 GLM 5.2 通过七种对话策略攻击五个受害模型，我们比较了单个攻击者与共享私密通道的四攻击者群体，匹配场景、策略以及同样覆盖群体协调开销的 20 万 token 预算。群体没有优势：单个攻击者在每个受害模型上都持平或超过群体，两种条件下泄露任一字段的运行比例差异最多 14.3 个百分点，而更换受害模型则使其从 0% 变动到 99.4%。在两个最脆弱的模型上，两种条件下几乎每次运行都发生泄露，但单个攻击者在首次泄露时暴露更多记录内容（在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 上为 85.4% 对 68.1% 的受保护字段）。五个受害模型中有四个在策略约束下仍然泄露。GLM 5.2 在 64.3% 的单攻击运行中检索到受保护数据，但仅在 0.6% 中泄露：检索不等于披露，但在高风险场景中，哪怕泄露一个字段也可能识别出患者或客户。在相同预算下，更大的红队并不自动更强；受害模型的影响要大得多。
translation.brief: 该论文研究多个串通攻击者是否比单个攻击者更有效地从 LLM 智能体群聊中提取机密信息，核心方法是构建 SwarmLeak 红队数据集并在匹配预算下对比单攻击者与四攻击者群体。

papers.title: AGL-SKILL: Coding Harnesses as Agentic Optimizers
papers.abstract: Frontier models are increasingly used through harnesses as agents, with growing autonomy to do useful work. Agent performance can often be enhanced by the use of skills: reusable workflows, code, and prompts that provide task-related information or guide the behaviour of the model. Skills, being textual in nature, present themselves as another editable surface to be optimized; current methods have improved on handcrafting and one-shot generation by treating skill development as an iterative process, using score-driven search to tweak and improve performance. In this paper, we demonstrate the efficacy of the agents themselves as optimizers: across five benchmarks, a coding agent without guidance substantially improves every target and outperforms published skill-optimization methods. More broadly, this shows the capability of agents to do such work and to refine their own behaviour to provide task-specific context, as long as they are given a metric to measure against.

translation.title: AGL-SKILL：将编码工具框架作为智能体优化器
translation.abstract: 前沿模型越来越多地通过工具框架以智能体形式使用，其自主完成有用工作的能力不断增强。智能体性能常可通过技能加以提升：技能是可复用的工作流、代码和提示，能够提供任务相关信息或引导模型行为。技能本质上是文本，因此构成了另一个可被优化的可编辑对象；现有方法已超越手工制作和一次性生成，将技能开发视为迭代过程，利用分数驱动的搜索来调整和改进性能。本文展示了智能体自身作为优化器的有效性：在五个基准上，一个没有引导的编码智能体显著改进了所有目标，并优于已发表的技能优化方法。更广泛地说，这表明只要给智能体一个可衡量的指标，它们就有能力完成此类工作，并改进自身行为以提供任务特定的上下文。
translation.brief: 研究如何优化智能体技能，提出让编码智能体自身作为优化器迭代改进技能，在五个基准上超越现有技能优化方法。

papers.title: A Generative AI Agent to Emulate Interactive Human-driven Vehicles for Automated Driving Testing in Urban Areas
papers.abstract: Realistic modeling of human-driven vehicle (HDV) interactions is essential for automated driving safety testing in urban areas. Existing methods struggle to reproduce realistic safety-critical interactions involving high collision risk for the following reasons: they often assume full observability, overlooking interactions arising from occlusion. Driving styles are mainly characterized by vehicle maneuvers, limiting the diversity of safety-critical interaction behaviors. Moreover, learning signals from safety-critical interactions can be diluted by non-critical driving behaviors. To address these issues, we propose a generative AI agent to emulate interactive HDVs. The agent incorporates field-of-view modeling to account for driver visibility under occlusion and characterizes the interaction process using five metrics spanning its initial, intermediate, and final stages. It automatically learns diverse interaction styles through a dynamic mixture-of-experts network. Through residual reinforcement learning, the agent further refines generated trajectories to match the real-world distributions of safety-critical interaction characteristics. Experiments on the INTERACTION dataset show that our method reduces Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) by 39.9\%--87.1\% across five interaction characteristics compared with a state-of-the-art baseline. Our method achieves greater improvements of up to 87.1\% in final-stage interaction metrics, suggesting that it can reduce error accumulation in long-horizon trajectory generation. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each proposed component, particularly highlighting the importance of residual refinement. Generalization experiments show that our method approaches the performance of full training on unseen intersections with only one epoch of fine-tuning.

translation.title: 用于城市自动驾驶测试的生成式AI智能体：模拟交互式人类驾驶车辆
translation.abstract: 对人类驾驶车辆（HDV）交互的真实建模对于城市地区的自动驾驶安全测试至关重要。现有方法难以再现涉及高碰撞风险的真实安全关键交互，原因如下：它们通常假设完全可观测，忽略了由遮挡引起的交互；驾驶风格主要通过车辆机动来刻画，限制了安全关键交互行为的多样性；此外，来自安全关键交互的学习信号可能被非关键驾驶行为稀释。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个生成式AI智能体来模拟交互式HDV。该智能体引入视场建模以考虑遮挡下的驾驶员可见性，并使用覆盖交互初始、中间和最终阶段的五个指标来刻画交互过程。它通过动态混合专家网络自动学习多样的交互风格。通过残差强化学习，智能体进一步细化生成的轨迹，以匹配安全关键交互特征的真实世界分布。在INTERACTION数据集上的实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，我们的方法在五项交互特征上将Jensen--Shannon散度（JSD）降低了39.9%–87.1%。我们的方法在最终阶段交互指标上取得了高达87.1%的更大改进，表明它可以减少长时程轨迹生成中的误差累积。消融研究证实了每个所提组件的有效性，尤其突出了残差细化的重要性。泛化实验表明，我们的方法仅需一个epoch的微调即可在未见过的交叉口上接近全量训练的性能。
translation.brief: 解决自动驾驶测试中人类驾驶车辆安全关键交互难以真实模拟的问题，提出结合视场建模、动态混合专家网络与残差强化学习的生成式AI智能体。

papers.title: Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents commonly use the full interaction history as a proxy for state, retaining all past observations and actions regardless of whether they remain relevant. We instead ask what information an agent actually needs to carry forward. We define agent state as a compact abstraction of interaction history that preserves the competence of a fixed reference agent, with the minimal such abstraction as the ideal. Because matching the reference agent's behavior is unnecessarily restrictive and difficult for black-box policies, we define sufficiency through task performance rather than behavior matching. We represent state abstractions as deterministic recursive programs and search over them using an LLM-guided genetic algorithm. Across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, the learned abstractions preserve near-reference task success while reducing mean policy input by up to 71% and 57%, respectively. The resulting programs are directly inspectable, providing an explicit account of what information is retained, updated, and discarded during interaction.

translation.title: 为LLM智能体学习紧凑的状态抽象
translation.abstract: LLM智能体通常使用完整交互历史作为状态的代理，保留所有过去的观察和动作，而不论它们是否仍然相关。我们转而追问：智能体实际需要携带哪些信息。我们将智能体状态定义为交互历史的一种紧凑抽象，它保持固定参考智能体的能力，理想情况是最小的此类抽象。由于匹配参考智能体的行为是不必要的限制，且对黑盒策略而言很困难，我们通过任务表现而非行为匹配来定义充分性。我们将状态抽象表示为确定性递归程序，并使用LLM引导的遗传算法对其进行搜索。在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上，学习到的抽象在保持接近参考智能体任务成功率的同时，分别将策略平均输入减少了71%和57%。所得程序可直接检查，明确说明了交互过程中哪些信息被保留、更新和丢弃。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体携带冗余交互历史的问题，将状态抽象表示为确定性递归程序并用LLM引导的遗传算法搜索最小充分抽象。

papers.title: Federated Policy Gradient for Dynamic Consensus: Gradient Dominance and Topological Bounds
papers.abstract: This paper presents a federated optimization framework for dynamic consensus in homogeneous multi-agent systems. The underlying problem is challenged by the communication graph's spectral properties, which induce spatial heterogeneity and complicate decentralized control even when the dynamics of the agents are completely known. The problem is addressed in this paper by bridging distributed control theory with federated policy gradients. Accordingly, a comprehensive optimization landscape for dynamic consensus is established through a modal decomposition formulation. Specifically, a parameterized suboptimality bound is characterized that explicitly decouples the true aggregate policy gradient from the network covariance mismatch. Building on this formulation, sufficient conditions based on the graph's Laplacian spectrum are derived to recover exact gradient dominance, which guarantees convergence to the global consensus policy and establishes a lower bound on the achievable dominance coefficient. Furthermore, a Federated model-free consensus algorithm is proposed that utilizes zeroth-order exploration alongside a bisection-based discount factor annealing mechanism, successfully eliminating the need for an initial stabilizing policy. This approach achieves linear global convergence for policy optimization subroutines while maintaining strictly bounded outer iterations until dynamic consensus is achieved. Through extensive simulation studies and comparative feasibility analyses across diverse network topologies, it is demonstrated that the proposed federated approach consistently outperforms existing model-based and data-driven separation-based techniques.

translation.title: 面向动态一致性的联邦策略梯度：梯度占优与拓扑界
translation.abstract: 本文提出一个用于同质多智能体系统动态一致性的联邦优化框架。该问题受通信图谱性质的挑战，谱性质引起空间异质性，即使智能体动力学完全已知，也使分散控制变得复杂。本文通过将分布式控制理论与联邦策略梯度相结合来解决该问题。为此，通过模态分解形式为动态一致性建立了完整的优化景观。具体而言，刻画了一个参数化的次优界，显式地将真实的聚合策略梯度与网络协方差失配解耦。基于该形式，推导了基于图拉普拉斯谱的充分条件以恢复精确的梯度占优，从而保证收敛到全局一致性策略，并给出可实现的占优系数下界。此外，提出了一种联邦无模型一致性算法，利用零阶探索和基于二分的折扣因子退火机制，成功消除了对初始稳定策略的需求。该方法在策略优化子程序上实现线性全局收敛，同时保持严格有界的外层迭代直至达成动态一致性。通过大量仿真研究以及跨多种网络拓扑的可行性对比分析，表明所提联邦方法始终优于现有的基于模型和基于数据驱动的分离式技术。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统动态一致性中通信图谱导致空间异质性的难题，将分布式控制理论与联邦策略梯度结合，提出基于拉普拉斯谱条件和无模型零阶探索的联邦一致性算法。

papers.title: Where Did My Tokens Go? Verifiable Token Billing for LLM Services
papers.abstract: Users of large language model (LLM) services receive token bills with limited evidence of which calls incurred their charges. In broker-mediated agent workflows, calls arise after authorization and billing evidence spans service domains. A bill can count one genuine receipt twice and omit another. Valid metering evidence can also be attributed to the wrong execution. We present \textsc{TokenProv}, which uses authenticated provider acceptances to establish settlement coverage and verify token charges. An authenticated causal history links runtime attempts to the signed policy, and jointly signed handoffs bind intent, dispatch, and acceptance to the same call. Handoffs submitted independently of the bill can reveal omitted calls. The auditor requires a one-to-one match between observable acceptances and settled receipts. For each acceptance, a common provider relation binds metered usage to the cache-dependent execution of the accepted input using the registered model and serving rules, and checks the charge under the pricing rule. To limit serving-path overhead, providers can use attested state transitions in trusted execution environments or defer proof generation until audit by committing to witnesses in receipts before settlement. The auditor recomputes the bill from the verified charges. We prove audit soundness relative to authenticated evidence. Across five models, \textsc{TokenProv} with signed provider receipts achieves 94.4--107.4\% of baseline throughput with 54--66\,ms of online non-LLM processing per request. In a separate eight-call replay, deferring scoped proofs reduces foreground protocol time from 1.20\,s to 8.65\,ms (99.28\%). The auditor rejects all 1,600 validly signed attack queries across 100 adaptive episodes.

translation.title: 我的Token去哪了？面向LLM服务的可验证Token计费
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务的用户收到的token账单缺乏证据表明哪些调用产生了费用。在由中介代理的智能体工作流中，调用发生在授权之后，计费证据跨越多个服务域。一份账单可能将一张真实凭证重复计数，同时遗漏另一张。有效的计量证据也可能被归因于错误的执行。我们提出TokenProv，它使用经过认证的提供商接受记录来建立结算覆盖范围并验证token费用。经过认证的因果历史将运行时尝试与签名的策略关联，联合签名的交接将意图、分发和接受绑定到同一调用。独立于账单提交的交接可以揭示被遗漏的调用。审计者要求可观察的接受记录与已结算凭证之间一一对应。对于每条接受记录，一个共同的提供商关系使用注册的模型和服务规则将计量的使用量绑定到被接受输入的依赖缓存的执行，并根据定价规则检查费用。为限制服务路径开销，提供商可以在可信执行环境中使用经证明的状态转换，或在结算前通过在凭证中提交见证来将证明生成推迟到审计时。审计者从验证过的费用中重新计算账单。我们相对于经过认证的证据证明了审计的可靠性。在五个模型上，使用签名提供商凭证的TokenProv达到基线吞吐量的94.4–107.4%，每请求仅有54–66毫秒的在线非LLM处理。在另一次八调用重放中，推迟范围化证明将前台协议时间从1.20秒降至8.65毫秒（99.28%）。审计者在100个自适应回合中拒绝了全部1,600条有效签名的攻击查询。
translation.brief: 解决LLM服务token账单缺乏可验证证据、可能重复计数或遗漏调用的问题，提出TokenProv，通过认证的提供商接受记录、签名交接与因果历史实现可审计的token计费。

papers.title: How Far Apart Are Two Proofs? Measuring Proof Dissimilarity in a Proof Kernel and in Lean/Mathlib
papers.abstract: We now live in the age of machine-generated mathematics: AI systems produce research-level proofs faster than the human mathematical community can read them. Verification is only part of the challenge. We also need to know whether a "new proof" is indeed new, whether a thousand generated proofs contain one idea or many, and where each sits relative to human mathematics. All of these require measuring distances between proofs. Following Hilbert's 24th problem and the identity-of-proofs problem, we ask how far apart two proofs of one theorem are, and what shape the proof space they inhabit has. We define 19 dissimilarity measures in 6 families (syntactic, structural, dependency & resource, semantic, information-theoretic, higher-categorical) and 10 desirable properties, which we argue are the conditions for safely optimising a measure. In a Curry-Howard kernel, 5 machine-checked proofs that the primes are infinite show that raw syntax cannot tell a rewrite from a new argument, that dependency-based and structural measures reproduce the intuitive ordering (Euclid rewritten < Goldbach < Furstenberg), and that semantic measures invert it: Furstenberg's topological proof produces exactly Euclid's witness. A replication in Lean 4/Mathlib (3 theorems, 19 proofs, 18 measures) confirms that dependency-closure measures track intuition best, and shows that equality of normal forms never holds between differently written versions of the same argument, that proofs by citation look unlike the arguments they cite, and that proof irrelevance cannot distinguish any two proofs. We argue for reporting dissimilarity as a multi-level profile, extend the measures to proofs of different theorems, and discuss uses, from detecting duplicated AI proofs and orchestrating prover agents to interpreting AI proofs via their nearest human-understandable counterparts. Code, Lean sources and data are released.

translation.title: 两个证明相距多远？在证明内核与 Lean/Mathlib 中度量证明相异性
translation.abstract: 我们如今生活在机器生成数学的时代：AI 系统产出研究级证明的速度超过了人类数学共同体阅读它们的速度。验证只是挑战的一部分。我们还需要知道一个“新证明”是否确实新颖，一千个生成的证明是包含一个想法还是多个想法，以及每个证明相对于人类数学所处的位置。所有这些都需要度量证明之间的距离。沿着 Hilbert 第 24 问题与证明同一性问题的思路，我们追问：同一个定理的两个证明相距多远，以及它们所处的证明空间具有什么形状。我们定义了 6 大家族（句法、结构、依赖与资源、语义、信息论、高阶范畴）共 19 种相异性度量，以及 10 条期望性质，我们论证这些性质是安全优化某种度量的前提条件。在一个 Curry-Howard 内核中，5 个机器验证的“素数无穷多”证明表明：原始句法无法区分重写与新论证；基于依赖和结构的度量能复现直觉排序（Euclid 重写版 < Goldbach < Furstenberg）；而语义度量则将其反转：Furstenberg 的拓扑证明恰好产生 Euclid 的见证对象。在 Lean 4/Mathlib 中的复现实验（3 个定理、19 个证明、18 种度量）证实依赖闭包度量最贴合直觉，并表明：同一论证的不同写法之间正规形式相等从不成立；引用式证明与其所引用的论证看起来不同；证明无关性无法区分任何两个证明。我们主张以多层次剖面报告相异性，将度量扩展到不同定理的证明，并讨论其用途：从检测重复的 AI 证明、编排证明器智能体，到通过最接近的人类可理解对应物来解读 AI 证明。代码、Lean 源码与数据均已发布。
translation.brief: 研究如何度量同一定理两个证明之间的相异性，提出 6 大家族 19 种度量并在 Curry-Howard 内核与 Lean 4/Mathlib 中实证评估。

papers.title: Agentic Discovery of Soundness Bugs in Safe Rust Bindings
papers.abstract: Rust crates confine unsafe code, such as calls into C or C++ libraries or system calls, behind safe interfaces that must uphold Rust's invariants. If an interface encodes one rule of the code beneath it too weakly, a program written in purely safe Rust can cause undefined behavior. Static analyzers and fuzzers are bound to fixed patterns or to the paths they execute. We propose LLM agents as auditors of these interfaces, and study how well they do it. We first define a taxonomy of the defects of such interfaces, including undefined behavior, divergences from the wrapped library, and incomplete unsafe contracts. We then measure, in repeated audits of a real-world crate by a closed and an open model, Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, which defect classes agents find, how well they triage them, and what makes them find more. Agents find the first two classes unprompted, but find few incomplete contracts even when asked. Their findings are almost always real, even without an independent reviewer, yet they lack triage discipline: they seldom confirm with a sanitizer, and they stop early. With the same guidance, the open model finds as many defects as the closed one at a quarter of the cost. We integrate these insights in Crustify, an agentic system for automating C-to-Rust tasks, and run it at scale. In 16 widely used crates, including the bindings to the C libraries OpenSSL, SQLite, libgit2, and libcurl and to the C++ engine V8, Crustify found 225 undefined-behavior bugs, 23 behavioral divergences, and 36 incomplete unsafe contracts, between 3 and 61 per crate at a median cost under $50 per audit. In the Linux kernel's Rust abstractions, it found 11 more undefined-behavior bugs and 4 incomplete contracts. Maintainers have fixed 26 of the 83 findings that we reported.

translation.title: 智能体化发现安全 Rust 绑定中的健全性缺陷
translation.abstract: Rust crate 将不安全代码（如对 C 或 C++ 库的调用、系统调用）封装在必须维护 Rust 不变量的安全接口之后。如果接口对其底层代码的某条规则编码得过于宽松，纯安全 Rust 编写的程序就可能引发未定义行为。静态分析器和模糊测试工具受限于固定模式或其执行的路径。我们提出将 LLM 智能体作为这些接口的审计者，并研究其表现。我们首先为此类接口的缺陷定义了一个分类体系，包括未定义行为、与被封装库的行为偏差，以及不完整的 unsafe 契约。随后我们通过闭源与开源模型（Claude Opus 5.5 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）对真实 crate 的重复审计，测量智能体能发现哪些缺陷类别、其分诊能力如何，以及什么因素能让它们发现更多缺陷。智能体无需提示即可发现前两类缺陷，但即使被要求也几乎发现不了不完整契约。即使没有独立审查者，其发现几乎总是真实的，但它们缺乏分诊纪律：很少用 sanitizer 加以确认，且过早停止。在相同指导下，开源模型以四分之一的成本发现与闭源模型同样多的缺陷。我们将这些洞见集成到 Crustify——一个自动化 C 到 Rust 任务的智能体系统——并大规模运行。在 16 个广泛使用的 crate 中，包括 C 库 OpenSSL、SQLite、libgit2、libcurl 的绑定以及 C++ 引擎 V8 的绑定，Crustify 发现了 225 个未定义行为缺陷、23 个行为偏差和 36 个不完整 unsafe 契约，每个 crate 3 到 61 个不等，每次审计的中位成本低于 50 美元。在 Linux 内核的 Rust 抽象层中，它又发现了 11 个未定义行为缺陷和 4 个不完整契约。在我们报告的 83 项发现中，维护者已修复 26 项。
translation.brief: 用 LLM 智能体审计安全 Rust 绑定接口以发现未定义行为等健全性缺陷，并构建大规模自动化审计系统 Crustify。

papers.title: Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.

translation.title: 探索多人社交博弈作为大语言模型的可验证训练场
translation.abstract: 训练具备社交智能的语言模型通常依赖大语言模型（LLM）裁判，其成本高、噪声大且易受奖励劫持。多人社交博弈提供了一种天然的替代方案：它们需要开放式沟通来与队友协作并推断隐藏角色，而其规则提供了可作为训练用可验证奖励的客观结果。我们使用三个社交博弈，探究 Qwen3 模型通过监督微调（SFT）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）能获得多少社交智能。结果显示，面对强得多的 Gemma-3-27B 模型，SFT 和 RLVR 将 Qwen3-4B 在三个受训博弈上的胜率从 33% 提升到 81%，在三个额外保留博弈上从 39% 提升到 54%。相比之下，提示等上下文内策略在相同的训练与评估博弈上仅将 Qwen3-4B 的胜率提高约 6 个百分点。此外，我们表明 SFT 和 RLVR 的收益在 1.7B、4B 和 32B 模型规模上均成立。对智能体行为的定性分析显示出更强的社交智能迹象：例如受训智能体倾向于更开放地分享信息、用公开证据核查彼此的主张，并协调投票。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，在社交博弈的可验证结果上训练 LLM 能够培养可泛化的社交行为，为构建社交智能体提供了一条可扩展的路径。
translation.brief: 以多人社交博弈的客观胜负作为可验证奖励，通过 SFT 与 RLVR 训练 LLM 获得可泛化的社交智能行为。

papers.title: GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures
papers.abstract: Generating Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problems requires controlling not only the included skills, but also the underlying mathematical kernel and solution path. Existing LLM-based methods mainly rely on surface-level specifications, while the realized difficulty of generated problems cannot be determined directly from prompted targets. Therefore, we propose GaokaoMathGen, a framework for Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problem generation controlled by latent reasoning structures. It extracts standardized latent reasoning structures from seed problems and performs constrained synthesis using skills, methods, a core identity, and a pivot step as structural controls. We further estimate realized difficulty through logical-quality filtering, fixed-solver decoding effort, structural features, and solver-output search signals. Experiments show that semantic normalization improves cross-annotator comparability and that 78.0% of 609 scored candidates pass the logical-quality filter. In a teacher audit of the 60 highest-effort candidates, all were judged to reach finale or penultimate problem difficulty, and only one exhibited a severe logical issue. These results support latent reasoning structures as effective control signals for generating high-difficulty mathematical problems.

translation.title: GaokaoMathGen：由潜在推理结构控制的中国高考数学压轴题生成
translation.abstract: 生成中国高考数学压轴题不仅需要控制所涉及的技能，还需要控制底层数学内核与解题路径。现有基于 LLM 的方法主要依赖表层规格说明，而生成题目的实际难度无法直接从提示目标中确定。因此，我们提出 GaokaoMathGen，一个由潜在推理结构控制的中国高考数学压轴题生成框架。它从种子题目中提取标准化的潜在推理结构，并以技能、方法、核心恒等式和关键步骤作为结构控制进行受限合成。我们进一步通过逻辑质量过滤、固定求解器解码工作量、结构特征和求解器输出搜索信号来估计实际难度。实验表明，语义规范化提升了跨标注者的可比性，609 个已评分候选题中有 78.0% 通过逻辑质量过滤。在对 60 个最高工作量候选题的教师审计中，全部被判定达到压轴题或倒数第二题难度，且仅有一个存在严重逻辑问题。这些结果支持将潜在推理结构作为生成高难度数学问题的有效控制信号。
translation.brief: 提出 GaokaoMathGen，用从种子题提取的潜在推理结构作为控制信号来生成可控难度的高考数学压轴题。

papers.title: Not All Interpretation Methods Are Created Equal: Tiered Evaluation of AI Interpretability
papers.abstract: As AI transitions to sociotechnical deployments, uninterpretable models pose serious threats to reliability, public trust and contestability. However, not all interpretation methods are created equal: for interpretability to enhance deployment safety and effectiveness, interpretation methods must be evaluated in a tiered system to differentiate evidence levels of trustworthiness, rather than validated through isolated interpretation instances. Our core vision is that elevating the evaluation of interpretation methods to a core AI assessment metric will drive robust knowledge discovery from data (KDD) and ensure safe, contestable sociotechnical deployments of AI. To this end, we propose TRUST, a tiered evaluation framework that builds upon the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) principles for Veridical Data Science (VDS) and the Predictive, Descriptive and Relevant (PDR) foundations. To differentiate interpretation methods effectively and systematically, TRUST grades interpretation across five tiers: Task-Aligned PDR Foundations, Rigorous Epistemic Grounding, Unifying Semantic Understanding, Scope Transferability, and Targeted Prospective Validation. We present a start-to-finish case study of the iterative Random Forest (iRF) family under TRUST and contrast it with other LLM interpretation methods that struggle to clear specific tiers. Finally, we conclude with brief initial thoughts on how TRUST principles can extend in autonomous agentic frameworks. Ultimately, the TRUST framework fosters contestability and epistemic grounding as foundational evaluation principles for human-machine workflows and, eventually, autonomous agentic workflows.

translation.title: 并非所有解释方法生而平等：AI 可解释性的分层评估
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 过渡到社会技术部署，不可解释的模型对可靠性、公众信任和可争议性构成严重威胁。然而，并非所有解释方法生而平等：要使可解释性提升部署的安全性与有效性，必须在分层体系中评估解释方法以区分可信度的证据层级，而不是通过孤立的解释实例来验证。我们的核心愿景是：将解释方法的评估提升为核心 AI 评估指标，将推动从数据中稳健的知识发现（KDD），并确保 AI 在社会技术部署中的安全性与可争议性。为此，我们提出 TRUST，一个建立在真实数据科学（VDS）的可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）原则以及预测性、描述性与相关性（PDR）基础之上的分层评估框架。为有效且系统地区分解释方法，TRUST 将解释划分为五个层级：任务对齐的 PDR 基础、严谨的认识论根基、统一的语义理解、范围可迁移性，以及针对性的前瞻验证。我们展示了在 TRUST 框架下对迭代随机森林（iRF）家族的端到端案例研究，并将其与其他难以通过特定层级的 LLM 解释方法进行对比。最后，我们简要探讨 TRUST 原则如何扩展到自主智能体框架。归根结底，TRUST 框架将可争议性与认识论根基确立为人机工作流乃至最终自主智能体工作流的基础评估原则。
translation.brief: 提出 TRUST 分层评估框架，将 AI 解释方法的可信度按五个层级系统分级以支撑安全可争议的部署。

papers.title: Spec-Test Coverage Gap: Detecting Overspecified Tests in SWE-Bench-Style Benchmarks
papers.abstract: SWE-bench-style benchmarks, such as SWE-bench Verified (Verified) and SWE-bench Pro (Pro), evaluate coding agents with tests taken from the change that originally fixed each issue. However, these tests can enforce details the task never states, causing correct alternative fixes to fail. Such overspecified tests have so far been found mainly through expensive expert review. To address this, we define the Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG), a 1-4 scale measuring overspecification, and score it with two LLM judges, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, which are given the specification and the test patch. A task is flagged as overspecified when both judges score it 3 or higher. Our study has three parts. First, we validate the judges on 206 tasks that earlier human audits and agent results label as overspecified or fine. Second, we apply STCG to all 500 Verified and 731 public Pro tasks and compare the flags with the results of the top 30 Verified submissions. Third, we verify the flags by asking Claude Opus 5.5 to loosen the overspecified requirements of flagged tasks, and regrade 2,186 failed patches from those submissions. Our main findings are: (1) Overspecified tests are detectable: on the validation tasks, the judges correctly flag 89% of the tasks that human audits identify as overspecified and wrongly flag only 4% of the tasks known to be fine. (2) Overspecified tests are common: applied to whole benchmarks, the judges flag 23% of Verified and 35% of Pro tasks. (3) Flagged tasks are much harder for agents: the top 30 Verified submissions resolve only 31% of the flagged tasks on average, against 88% of the other tasks. (4) Overspecified tests change the leaderboard: relaxing the tests lets 61% of the 2,186 failed patches on flagged tasks pass. Counting these patches as resolved would add 33 to 60 tasks to each top-30 submission, raising resolve rates by up to 12 percentage points.

translation.title: Spec-Test 覆盖缺口：检测 SWE-Bench 风格基准中的过度指定测试
translation.abstract: SWE-bench 风格的基准，如 SWE-bench Verified（Verified）和 SWE-bench Pro（Pro），使用来自最初修复每个 issue 的变更中的测试来评估编码智能体。然而，这些测试可能强制执行任务从未说明的细节，导致正确的替代修复方案失败。此类过度指定测试迄今主要通过昂贵的专家审查来发现。为解决这一问题，我们定义了 Spec-Test 覆盖缺口（STCG），一个衡量过度指定程度的 1-4 分量表，并使用两个 LLM 评审——Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol——对其进行打分，评审会获得任务规格说明和测试补丁。当两个评审都给出 3 分或更高时，该任务被标记为过度指定。我们的研究包含三个部分。首先，我们在 206 个任务上验证评审，这些任务被早期的人工审计和智能体结果标注为过度指定或正常。其次，我们将 STCG 应用于全部 500 个 Verified 任务和 731 个公开的 Pro 任务，并将标记结果与 Verified 排名前 30 的提交结果进行比较。第三，我们通过让 Claude Opus 5.5 放宽被标记任务的过度指定要求来验证标记结果，并对这些提交中的 2,186 个失败补丁重新评分。我们的主要发现是：(1) 过度指定测试是可检测的：在验证任务上，评审正确标记了 89% 被人工审计认定为过度指定的任务，且仅错误标记了 4% 已知正常的任务。(2) 过度指定测试很常见：应用于整个基准时，评审标记了 23% 的 Verified 任务和 35% 的 Pro 任务。(3) 被标记的任务对智能体来说难得多：Verified 排名前 30 的提交平均只解决了 31% 的被标记任务，而其他任务的解决率为 88%。(4) 过度指定测试会改变排行榜：放宽测试后，被标记任务上 2,186 个失败补丁中的 61% 得以通过。将这些补丁计为已解决，将为每个前 30 名提交增加 33 到 60 个任务，使解决率最多提升 12 个百分点。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 SWE-bench 风格基准中测试过度指定导致正确修复被误判失败的问题，核心方法是定义 STCG 量表并用双 LLM 评审自动检测过度指定测试。

papers.title: Faithful Persona Steering under Incongruity via Dual-Stream Refinement
papers.abstract: Standard LLM personalization typically frames identity as a static retrieval task, overlooking the inherent incongruity of human personas, where stable traits coexist with atypical, context-specific stances. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these dimensions: prompting succumbs to context drift over long sequences, while fine-tuning often suppresses idiosyncratic "quirks" in favor of generic distributional patterns. To bridge this gap, we present QuirkyMind, a framework that disentangles identity definition from its expression. First, Traits Anchoring constructs a dual-stream latent state, fusing a sentence-level summary for semantic stability with a token-level sequence for generative control. This state is stabilized via In-Context Narrative Refinement using an alternating objective: a discriminative InfoNCE loss anchors the persona in representation space to prevent drift, while a generative cross-entropy loss ensures faithful verbalization. Finally, Persona Steered Generalization transfers the refined state to downstream tasks via parameter-efficient adapters. Empirical evaluations on Persona-Steered QA and Narrative Inference demonstrate that QuirkyMind mitigates drift, consolidating persona knowledge without erasing authentic incongruities.

translation.title: 不一致情境下基于双流精炼的忠实人格引导
translation.abstract: 标准的 LLM 个性化通常将身份视为静态检索任务，忽视了人类人格固有的不一致性，即稳定特质与不典型的、情境特定的立场并存。现有方法难以调和这两个维度：提示方法在长序列中容易发生上下文漂移，而微调往往压制独特的"怪癖"，偏向通用的分布模式。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 QuirkyMind，一个将身份定义与其表达解耦的框架。首先，Traits Anchoring 构建双流潜在状态，融合用于语义稳定性的句子级摘要与用于生成控制的 token 级序列。该状态通过采用交替目标的 In-Context Narrative Refinement 得到稳定：判别式 InfoNCE 损失将人格锚定在表示空间中以防止漂移，而生成式交叉熵损失确保忠实的语言化。最后，Persona Steered Generalization 通过参数高效的适配器将精炼后的状态迁移到下游任务。在 Persona-Steered QA 和 Narrative Inference 上的实证评估表明，QuirkyMind 减轻了漂移，在巩固人格知识的同时不抹除真实的不一致性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 个性化中人格漂移与特质被抹平的问题，核心方法是 QuirkyMind 框架，通过双流潜在状态与判别-生成交替损失将身份定义与表达解耦。

papers.title: Modeling Event-Conditioned Emotional Expression Response with LLM Agents in a Synthetic Social Simulation
papers.abstract: Emotions are central drivers of human behavior, yet most behavioral models fail to capture their role in shaping perception, decision-making, and collective action. Application areas such as emergency response and public health are especially constrained by the lack of emotion-aware modeling. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into agent-based models (ABMs), little work has examined how to endow LLM agents with emotional reasoning or validated their ability to reproduce empirically observed emotional patterns. This study addresses this gap by introducing a hierarchical prompting framework that conditions LLM agents with demographic, psychological, and contextual cues to generate event-conditioned emotional responses to real-world events. We validate the resulting event-conditioned emotional responses against large-scale social media reaction data derived from the Social Science One Facebook URL Shares Dataset, complemented by demographic and personality benchmarks. Our simulation results reproduce both polarized and consensus-driven emotional patterns with significant fidelity, supporting the application of LLM agents for emotion-aware modeling in behavioral simulations. We also find, however, that systematic gaps in emotional expression of LLM agents and human populations exist, such as the underexpression of anger relative to human baselines. As such, these findings highlight the need for continued calibration if LLM agents are to serve as proxies for human populations in behavioral modeling. By quantifying their divergence from human populations in terms of emotional expression, we hope that our methods can aid in this effort.

translation.title: 在合成社会模拟中用 LLM 智能体建模事件条件下的情绪表达响应
translation.abstract: 情绪是人类行为的核心驱动力，但大多数行为模型未能捕捉情绪在塑造感知、决策和集体行动中的作用。应急响应和公共卫生等应用领域尤其受限于缺乏情绪感知的建模。尽管大语言模型（LLM）日益被整合到基于智能体的模型（ABM）中，但很少有工作研究如何赋予 LLM 智能体情绪推理能力，或验证其重现经验观察到的情绪模式的能力。本研究通过引入一个分层提示框架来填补这一空白，该框架以人口统计、心理和情境线索为条件来配置 LLM 智能体，从而生成对现实世界事件的事件条件情绪响应。我们将所得的事件条件情绪响应与来自 Social Science One Facebook URL Shares Dataset 的大规模社交媒体反应数据进行验证，并辅以人口统计和人格基准。我们的模拟结果以显著的保真度重现了极化和共识驱动的情绪模式，支持将 LLM 智能体应用于行为模拟中的情绪感知建模。然而，我们也发现 LLM 智能体与人类群体在情绪表达上存在系统性差距，例如相对于人类基线，愤怒表达不足。因此，这些发现凸显了持续校准的必要性，如果 LLM 智能体要在行为建模中作为人类群体的代理。通过量化它们在情绪表达方面与人类群体的差异，我们希望我们的方法能够助力这一努力。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 智能体缺乏情绪推理能力的问题，核心方法是分层提示框架，以人口、心理和情境线索生成事件条件情绪响应，并用社交媒体数据验证。

papers.title: No Fixed Configuration Is Best: Context- and Cost-Aware Tuning of LLM Pipelines, with an Application to Schema Matching and Mapping
papers.abstract: The numeric settings of a multi-stage LLM pipeline (a compound AI system) are the usual target of tuning. We tuned all of them for an LLM pipeline for schema matching and mapping, with accuracy and cost as joint objectives, and we show what this buys, what it cannot buy, and where the remaining accuracy is. First, tuning buys cost and a little accuracy. On 35 tasks, with whole groups of tasks held out from tuning, one tuned configuration gains 2.9 points of top-1 accuracy (HR@1) over the default at 18% more cost, and another keeps the accuracy of the default at 32% lower cost. Second, the accuracy depends on a choice that numeric tuning cannot reach. Restricting the search for each source column to one assigned target table changes HR@1 by +30 points on a MIMIC-III to OMOP task and by -52 points on a task built from database views, more than numeric tuning gains on nine of ten test tasks. Neither setting is right for all tasks: on the larger set of 41 tasks used for the remaining results, mean HR@1 is 75.7% with the restriction (the default) and 83.1% without it. Third, choosing the setting per task is not enough either: even an oracle that picks the better setting for each task reaches only 87.8% on the 41 tasks, because the better setting differs between the columns of one task. The pipeline therefore runs both settings, and an LLM judge chooses among their candidate answers on the 26% of columns on which they disagree. This reaches 91.5% HR@1 on the 41 tasks, at 5.9 times the cost of the default, about one cent per column.

translation.title: 没有最优的固定配置：LLM 流水线的上下文与成本感知调优，及其在模式匹配与映射中的应用
translation.abstract: 多阶段 LLM 流水线（复合 AI 系统）的数值设置通常是调优的目标。我们针对一个用于模式匹配与映射的 LLM 流水线，以准确率和成本为联合目标，对所有数值设置进行了调优，并展示了调优能带来什么、不能带来什么，以及剩余的准确率在哪里。首先，调优带来成本收益和少量准确率提升。在 35 个任务上（整组任务从调优中留出），一个调优后的配置在成本增加 18% 的情况下，比默认配置的 top-1 准确率（HR@1）提升 2.9 个百分点；另一个配置在成本降低 32% 的情况下保持默认配置的准确率。其次，准确率取决于一个数值调优无法触及的选择。将每个源列的搜索限制在一个指定的目标表中，在 MIMIC-III 到 OMOP 的任务上使 HR@1 变化 +30 个百分点，而在由数据库视图构建的任务上变化 -52 个百分点，这比数值调优在十个测试任务中九个上的收益更大。没有一种设置适合所有任务：在用于其余结果的 41 个任务的更大集合上，使用该限制（默认）时平均 HR@1 为 75.7%，不使用时为 83.1%。第三，按任务选择设置也不够：即使是每个任务都选择更优设置的预言机，在 41 个任务上也只能达到 87.8%，因为更优的设置在同一任务的不同列之间有所不同。因此，流水线同时运行两种设置，并在它们不一致的 26% 的列上由 LLM 评审在候选答案中进行选择。这在 41 个任务上达到 91.5% 的 HR@1，成本为默认配置的 5.9 倍，约每列一美分。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 流水线中数值调优无法覆盖结构性配置选择的问题，核心方法是同时运行多种配置并由 LLM 评审在候选答案间进行上下文与成本感知的选择。

papers.title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
papers.abstract: Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&A synthesis. Based on this framework, we construct RepoEviQA, a benchmark for Repository-Level Evidence-Grounded Question Answering, comprising 334 tasks across five programming languages and diverse SWE categories, with rigorous rubric-based evaluation. We evaluate five frontier coding models on RepoEviQA, revealing substantial performance differences across task categories and programming languages.

translation.title: RepoEviAgent：可扩展的证据支撑型仓库级问答任务合成
translation.abstract: 真实世界的软件工程（SWE）任务要求智能体理解仓库结构、跨模块依赖和运行时行为，这给构建高质量的训练和评估数据带来了重大挑战。为此，我们提出 RepoEviAgent，一个可扩展的 SWE 数据构建框架，它集成了质量感知的数据筛选和角色专门化的多智能体任务合成。从 8,477 个开源仓库和约 248 万条 pull request 记录出发，我们采用语义对齐、复杂度约束和多维质量评估来识别有价值的 SWE 数据。我们进一步开发了基于沙箱的多智能体框架，集成自动化环境构建、执行验证、仓库探索和证据支撑的问答合成。基于该框架，我们构建了 RepoEviQA，一个仓库级证据支撑问答基准，包含跨五种编程语言和多样 SWE 类别的 334 个任务，并采用严格的基于评分标准的评估。我们在 RepoEviQA 上评估了五个前沿编码模型，揭示了不同任务类别和编程语言之间的显著性能差异。
translation.brief: 该论文解决高质量仓库级 SWE 训练与评估数据难以构建的问题，核心方法是 RepoEviAgent 框架，结合质量感知数据筛选与基于沙箱的多智能体任务合成。

papers.title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
papers.abstract: Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

translation.title: AgentDRC：面向空间感知的自动化DRC修复多智能体算法
translation.abstract: 设计规则检查（DRC）错误的修复仍然是物理设计中的耗时瓶颈，尽管有先进的EDA优化，往往仍需人工干预。现有的LLM智能体方法由于冗余的上下文图形、对原始坐标的空间推理能力有限以及低效的扁平版图表示而表现不佳。我们提出AgentDRC，将迭代式DRC修复形式化为多智能体算法，并引入一种空间感知的验证与修复算法，该算法重构关键图形之间的结构化空间关系，并通过几何和语义约束检查来验证修复效果。该系统协调四个专用智能体，以感知多层次、多模态的几何特征，过滤无关图形，并迭代式地修复违规。实验表明，AgentDRC在具有挑战性的违规问题上实现了最高30.4%的pass@1和55.7%的pass@5，相比最佳基线在pass@5上提升13.8%。我们将在论文被接收后开源所有代码和基准任务。
translation.brief: 针对DRC错误修复中现有LLM智能体空间推理不足的问题，提出将DRC修复形式化为多智能体算法，通过重构结构化空间关系并进行几何与语义约束验证来迭代修复违规。

papers.title: Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning enhanced Federated Learning for Predicting Remaining Useful Lifetime
papers.abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is central to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). The growth of industrial IoT has unlocked large multivariate sensor streams and enabled deep models - especially Transformers - for long-horizon sequence learning. However, transformers are parameter-heavy and data-hungry, while operational datasets are often siloed and privacy-sensitive. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by training across clients without raw data sharing, but in practice many clients connect over lossy wireless links where UDP is preferred for low latency, making model exchange vulnerable to packet drops. We present a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that adapts FL to lossy channels by selecting per-client layer subsets to transmit and capping retransmissions. This framework is trained with QMIX value-function factorization for scalability. We instantiate the approach with a Graph Convolution Position-Aware Transformer (GCPATr) for RUL forecasting. On the CMAPSS dataset, our MARL-enhanced FL (RL-FL) consistently improves mean square error over standard FL, with the largest gains at high packet loss (e.g., up to 18% improvement on FD003 at 50% loss). These results show that MARL is an effective countermeasure to wireless degradation in FL-based RUL prediction.

translation.title: 多智能体强化学习增强的联邦学习用于剩余使用寿命预测
translation.abstract: 剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测是故障预测与健康管理（PHM）的核心。工业物联网的发展催生了大量多变量传感器数据流，并使深度模型——尤其是Transformer——能够进行长时序序列学习。然而，Transformer参数量大且依赖大量数据，而运营数据往往分散存储且涉及隐私。联邦学习（FL）通过在不共享原始数据的情况下跨客户端训练来解决这一问题，但实践中许多客户端通过有损无线链路连接，且为低延迟更倾向使用UDP，使模型交换容易受到丢包影响。我们提出一个协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，通过为每个客户端选择要传输的层子集并限制重传次数，使联邦学习适应有损信道。该框架使用QMIX值函数分解进行训练以保证可扩展性。我们以图卷积位置感知Transformer（GCPATr）进行RUL预测来实例化该方法。在CMAPSS数据集上，我们的MARL增强联邦学习（RL-FL）持续优于标准联邦学习的均方误差，在高丢包率下收益最大（例如在FD003上50%丢包率时提升高达18%）。这些结果表明，MARL是应对基于联邦学习的RUL预测中无线信道退化的有效手段。
translation.brief: 针对联邦学习在无线丢包环境下模型交换不可靠的问题，提出用QMIX多智能体强化学习自适应选择各客户端传输的层子集并限制重传，以提升RUL预测性能。

papers.title: Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work
papers.abstract: Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to Video-MME-v2. Even under the same observation interface, gains differ substantially across models; interaction traces reveal corresponding differences in evidence seeking and the reliability of answer revision. The benefits also vary across tasks for the same model, ranging from substantial improvements to limited gains and regressions. Together, these findings support an account in which harness effectiveness depends on the alignment between opportunities for informative observation and the model's ability to turn interaction into reliable revisions. They motivate video harnesses that coordinate perception and reasoning, matching observational autonomy to task demands and model capabilities.

translation.title: 重新思考视频智能体：视频Harness何时以及为何有效
translation.abstract: 视频理解不仅取决于模型如何推理视觉证据，还取决于模型观察到哪些证据。固定观察策略预先确定这些证据；而智能体式harness允许模型随着理解的深入主动获取更多观察。这一转变为释放固定输入无法挖掘的能力创造了机会，但能够请求观察并不意味着能有效利用它们。我们研究了视频harness何时以及为何能提升理解能力，考察任务需求和模型的交互能力如何共同决定其收益。我们以Video-Relook作为实验框架，让模型从统一的默认配置出发自适应调整其时间和空间观察，并分析不同模型和任务上的性能与交互轨迹。自适应观察在细粒度动作理解上带来显著收益，并扩展到Video-MME-v2。即使在相同的观察接口下，不同模型的收益差异巨大；交互轨迹揭示了模型在证据获取和答案修正可靠性上的相应差异。同一模型的收益也因任务而异，从显著提升到收益有限甚至出现退化。综合来看，这些发现支持如下解释：harness的有效性取决于获取有信息量观察的机会与模型将交互转化为可靠修正的能力之间的对齐程度。这启发我们设计协调感知与推理的视频harness，使观察自主性与任务需求和模型能力相匹配。
translation.brief: 研究视频智能体harness在何种条件下有效，通过Video-Relook框架让模型自适应调整时空观察，分析任务需求与模型交互能力如何共同决定收益。

papers.title: Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents
papers.abstract: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

translation.title: Open-OmniCoach：面向全模态视频智能体的证据增强轨迹学习
translation.abstract: 训练强大的全模态视频智能体不仅需要多样化的问答对：智能体还必须学会在全模态场景下可靠地查找、关联和修正与任务相关的证据。然而，我们认为现有数据流水线对任务相关证据的控制有限，且对这些能力的监督较弱。在本工作中，我们提出Open OmniCoach，一个面向证据查找型全模态视频智能体的新框架。它包含一个高质量数据集OmniCoach-240K和一种新的智能体强化学习（RL）方法——步级证据引导策略优化（SEPO）。前者OmniCoach-240K包含248.2K条交互轨迹，其中230.7K条多片段轨迹和17.4K条反思轨迹。我们通过利用细粒度全模态证据和智能体自身的错误，设计了三阶段数据流水线。同时，与其他RL基线相比，SEPO基于证据覆盖度和时间定位的改进提供回合级信用分配。结合轨迹数据和SEPO方法，我们得到Open OmniAgent模型。所得模型在多个视频和视听理解任务上显著超越基线，证明了Open OmniCoach框架的有效性。特别是，Open OmniAgent-30B在九个基准上将平均准确率相比Qwen3-Omni提升6.3个百分点，在LVOmniBench和LVBench上分别提升12.2和13.3个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对全模态视频智能体缺乏对任务相关证据的有效监督问题，构建OmniCoach-240K轨迹数据集并提出步级证据引导的强化学习方法SEPO来训练智能体。

papers.title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
papers.abstract: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Loupe：强化知识密集型视频生成智能体
translation.abstract: 知识密集型视频生成仍然具有挑战性，因为提示词往往遗漏准确生成所需的事实、外观和时间关系。基于搜索的工作流可以检索缺失的证据，但人工设计的策略限制了自适应规划，且传统训练受制于高昂的视频级反馈和粗糙的轨迹级信用分配。本文提出Loupe，一个检索并验证文本和视觉证据、以构建基于证据且带参考图像的时间性视频提示词的视频生成智能体。我们进一步提出基于评分准则的信用分配（RBC），利用提示词特定的事实、视觉和时间要求，在视频渲染之前评估中间搜索和规划决策。基于RBC，RBC-SFT按步骤质量对assistant token的学习进行重加权，而RBC-GRPO在强化学习过程中结合步级信用和最终规划奖励，且无需渲染视频。为解决缺乏专门的搜索导向评估的问题，我们构建了Search-VBench，包含七个类别的150个保留提示词。实验表明，Loupe在三个视频生成器上提升了全部四个评估维度，将MiniMax-H3的总分从32.80提升至70.67，并优于未经训练的搜索工作流。消融实验表明，完整的RBC训练比标准SFT加轨迹级GRPO高出5.27分。人类评估以及Sci-VBench和KIVI-Bench上的结果进一步证明了生成质量、科学依据、事实精确性和有用性的提升。项目页面见此https链接。
translation.brief: 针对知识密集型视频生成中提示词信息缺失和训练信用分配粗糙的问题，提出检索验证证据的Loupe智能体及基于评分准则的步级信用方法RBC用于SFT和强化学习训练。

papers.title: Decompose, Verify, Evolve: Physically Grounded Shape Decomposition
papers.abstract: Shape decomposition represents 3D objects as a compact set of geometric primitives for interpretable modeling and simulation. However, existing decomposition methods are trained primarily for geometric fidelity, without explicit constraints on physical plausibility, and can therefore produce disconnected parts or physically unstable reconstructions. We present PhysDec, an agentic framework that draws on a pretrained vision-language model's semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning to predict material-aware primitive decompositions from a few images. Within this framework, PhysDec-Loop is an agentic pipeline that reasons about part structure and materials, using a reference 3D point cloud for geometric feedback and physical verifiers to guide iterative refinement. Through self-evolution, we further develop another agentic pipeline, PhysDec-Evolved, which learns from prior corrections to predict primitive decompositions from images without point-cloud feedback or a correction loop at inference. Experiments show that PhysDec-Loop improves geometric fidelity, physical plausibility and visual quality over geometry-focused baselines, while PhysDec-Evolved approaches its performance at substantially lower inference cost.

translation.title: 分解、验证、演化：物理合理的形状分解
translation.abstract: 形状分解将3D物体表示为一组紧凑的几何基元，以支持可解释的建模与仿真。然而，现有分解方法主要以几何保真度为目标进行训练，缺乏对物理合理性的显式约束，因此可能产生不连通的部分或物理上不稳定的重建。我们提出PhysDec，一个智能体框架，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的语义理解与常识推理，从少量图像预测材料感知的基元分解。在该框架内，PhysDec-Loop是一个智能体流水线，对部件结构与材料进行推理，利用参考3D点云提供几何反馈，并借助物理验证器引导迭代精化。通过自我演化，我们进一步发展出另一个智能体流水线PhysDec-Evolved，它从先前的修正中学习，在推理时无需点云反馈或修正循环即可从图像预测基元分解。实验表明，PhysDec-Loop在几何保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量上优于以几何为中心的基线方法，而PhysDec-Evolved以显著更低的推理成本接近其性能。
translation.brief: 针对形状分解缺乏物理合理性约束的问题，提出利用视觉-语言模型结合几何反馈与物理验证器进行迭代精化及自我演化的智能体分解框架PhysDec。

papers.title: (No) Separation of Concerns: Philosophical Concerns about Agent Ethics and Implications for SE Practitioners
papers.abstract: The use of AI agents in software engineering (SE) are commonplace, with differing levels of autonomy, a myriad of capabilities, and ability to perform a variety of tasks. Philosophers have begun to examine the ethics of such agents, and SE researchers or practitioners could benefit from them; on the other hand, SE practitioners currently explore most of these concerns through the lens of principlism.
