We bridge this gap by reviewing the philosophical literature on AI agents indexed in PhilPapers, and translating its ethical concerns into a research agenda for SE researchers and into implications for teams that use coding agents. A systematic mapping study of PhilPapers -- a major philosophy index and open access archive -- yielded 33 peer-reviewed papers by professional philosophers published since 2023. We coded these papers thematically, with cross-disciplinary review of the emerging themes, resulting in eight themes and 85 codes. From these, we derive seven research questions for SE, covering developers' reliance on agents, responsibility for agent-written code, ethical constraints in agent configurations, and benchmark design. For practitioners, we derive five implications: decide which choices an agent must refer to a human, keep agent-written pull requests small enough to review, pair configuration-file instructions with checks, watch for changes to tests, and record who approved what. We argue that ethical concerns cannot be separated from SE concerns into a module of their own: they arise inside code review, configuration, evaluation, and requirements work, and addressing them requires cross-disciplinary work.

translation.title: （无法）关注点分离：对智能体伦理的哲学关切及其对软件工程从业者的启示
translation.abstract: AI智能体在软件工程（SE）中的应用已十分普遍，它们具有不同程度的自主性、多种能力，并能执行各类任务。哲学家已开始审视此类智能体的伦理问题，SE研究者或从业者可从中受益；另一方面，SE从业者目前主要通过原则主义（principlism）的视角来探讨这些关切。我们通过梳理PhilPapers中关于AI智能体的哲学文献，将其伦理关切转化为SE研究者的研究议程以及使用编码智能体的团队的实践启示，以弥合这一差距。对PhilPapers——一个主要的哲学索引与开放获取档案——的系统性映射研究共获得2023年以来专业哲学家发表的33篇同行评审论文。我们对这些论文进行主题编码，并对涌现的主题进行跨学科评审，最终得到八个主题和85个编码。由此，我们为SE提炼出七个研究问题，涵盖开发者对智能体的依赖、智能体所写代码的责任归属、智能体配置中的伦理约束以及基准设计。对从业者，我们提出五点启示：决定哪些选择必须由智能体交由人类裁决、保持智能体所写pull request足够小以便审查、将配置文件指令与检查配对、留意测试的变更、记录谁批准了什么。我们主张，伦理关切无法从SE关切中分离为独立模块：它们产生于代码审查、配置、评估和需求工作之中，应对它们需要跨学科协作。
translation.brief: 针对SE从业者缺乏对AI智能体伦理的系统性认识的问题，通过对PhilPapers哲学文献的系统性映射研究提炼出研究问题与从业者实践启示。

papers.title: Shuttle: Dependency-Attributed Workflow Evolution for Smart Contract Auditing
papers.abstract: In LLM-based smart contract auditing, detection quality depends on both model capability and workflow design. While coding agents can revise workflows from execution feedback, unconstrained rewrites rarely yield stable gains. Cross-function vulnerabilities require multi-step state tracking and boundary reasoning that coarse pipelines miss. End-to-end outcomes hide which step lost a clue, so direct rewrites regress existing hits or discard valid edits under coarse aggregate scoring. Repeatedly iterating on a small project set also adds case-specific heuristics that bloat prompts and hurt generalization. We present Shuttle, a constrained workflow-evolution system, and LucidScan, the auditing framework it evolves. Shuttle centers on provenance-graph attribution: it expands each run into an instance-level dependency graph, locates the node where a clue was lost via forward search, and traces existing hits backward into a protected set. After evaluating a merged batch, Shuttle drops dragging edits via a node-level provenance ledger, falling back to cache-reusing local re-runs only when early-round edits overlap on the same node. For localized bottlenecks, Shuttle generates edits under task decomposition, progressive refinement, and generality blind review. On 10 training projects, Shuttle evolves LucidScan from $G_0$ (28.7% per-project average C/H/M recall) to $G_8$ (82.1%). On 13 held-out validation projects under the same model, average recall rises from 28.6% ($G_0$) to 70.3% ($G_8$), above Pashov and Codex Security. In an anonymized live public audit contest with 896 researchers (Nov. 2026), the evolved scanner tied for #1 in High-severity recall (6/8, 75.0%), ranked #2 in scored H/M clusters (34/72, 47.2%) with 92.9% validity (78/84), and finished #3 overall.

translation.title: Shuttle：面向智能合约审计的依赖归因工作流演化
translation.abstract: 在基于LLM的智能合约审计中，检测质量取决于模型能力与工作流设计两方面。虽然编码智能体可以根据执行反馈修订工作流，但不受约束的重写很少带来稳定收益。跨函数漏洞需要多步状态跟踪与边界推理，而粗粒度流水线往往遗漏这些。端到端结果掩盖了哪一步丢失了线索，因此在粗粒度聚合评分下，直接重写会使已有命中退化或丢弃有效修改。在小型项目集上反复迭代还会引入针对特定案例的启发式规则，使提示词膨胀并损害泛化能力。我们提出Shuttle，一个受约束的工作流演化系统，以及由其演化的审计框架LucidScan。Shuttle以溯源图归因为核心：它将每次运行展开为实例级依赖图，通过前向搜索定位丢失线索的节点，并将已有命中向后追溯到一个受保护集合。在评估合并批次后，Shuttle通过节点级溯源账本丢弃拖累性修改，仅当早期轮次的修改在同一节点上重叠时才回退到复用缓存的本地重跑。对于局部化瓶颈，Shuttle在任务分解、渐进精化和通用性盲审下生成修改。在10个训练项目上，Shuttle将LucidScan从$G_0$（每项目平均C/H/M召回率28.7%）演化到$G_8$（82.1%）。在相同模型下的13个留出验证项目上，平均召回率从28.6%（$G_0$）升至70.3%（$G_8$），高于Pashov和Codex Security。在2026年11月一场有896名研究者参与的匿名化公开审计竞赛中，演化后的扫描器在高危召回率上并列第一（6/8，75.0%），在计分的H/M簇上排名第二（34/72，47.2%），有效率92.9%（78/84），总排名第三。
translation.brief: 针对LLM审计工作流盲目重写难以稳定提升的问题，提出基于溯源图归因定位线索丢失节点并受约束演化工作流的系统Shuttle。

papers.title: Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract: Large language model unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving unrelated model capabilities. Existing likelihood-based methods commonly optimize against fixed forget sequences, providing only negative supervision on what the model should not generate and overlooking the states visited by the evolving unlearned policy. We introduce Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation (CPSD), a new unlearning framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories. Given a student rollout, a frozen reference model evaluates each token under a plain context and a privileged context containing the forget information. CPSD treats the resulting distributional shift as a knowledge-associated direction and reverses it to obtain a counterfactual unlearning target. The student is then trained to match this target at every rollout position while retaining its utility on unrelated data. We further introduce a privacy-enhanced variant that combines distributional unlearning with lightweight sequence-level suppression. Experiments under OpenUnlearning show that CPSD improves the forgetting-utility trade-off over NPO across TOFU forget-set sizes and Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. On MUSE-News, the privacy-enhanced variant improves all reported knowledge, memorization, privacy, and utility metrics over NPO.

translation.title: 面向LLM遗忘的对比式在策略自蒸馏
translation.abstract: 大语言模型遗忘旨在移除指定训练数据的影响，同时保留无关的模型能力。现有基于似然的方法通常针对固定的遗忘序列进行优化，仅提供模型不应生成什么内容的负向监督，忽视了不断演化的遗忘策略所访问的状态。我们提出对比式在策略自蒸馏（CPSD），一种新的遗忘框架，它构建一个显式的知识削减目标分布，并沿模型自身的轨迹对其进行蒸馏。给定学生模型的rollout，一个冻结的参考模型分别在普通上下文和包含遗忘信息的特权上下文下评估每个token。CPSD将由此产生的分布偏移视为知识相关方向，并将其反转以获得反事实遗忘目标。然后训练学生模型在每个rollout位置匹配该目标，同时保持在无关数据上的效用。我们进一步引入一个隐私增强变体，将分布遗忘与轻量级的序列级抑制相结合。在OpenUnlearning下的实验表明，CPSD在TOFU不同遗忘集规模和1B至8B参数的Llama模型上，均改善了相比NPO的遗忘-效用权衡。在MUSE-News上，隐私增强变体在所有已报告的知识、记忆、隐私和效用指标上均优于NPO。
translation.brief: 针对现有遗忘方法仅提供负向监督、忽视策略自身状态的问题，提出通过参考模型构造反事实目标分布并沿模型自身轨迹蒸馏的CPSD框架。

papers.title: Native Block-Quantized Matrix Multiplication and Explicit K/V Residency with Dual-View Access for LLM Inference on RISC-V Vector Processors
papers.abstract: Some key execution states in large language model inference persist across multiple instructions and are difficult to express and exploit within RVV semantics centered on individual operations. We define specialization boundaries according to data-state lifetimes and propose Quantized Block Streams (QBS) and Attention/KV Context (AKV) while preserving RVV programmability. QBS organizes native-block format processing, block traversal, integer computation, and ordered FP32 accumulation into a unified execution process, whereas AKV maintains local K/V residency and supplies operand views aligned with the computation direction while leaving Attention arithmetic on RVV. Cycle-accurate RTL evaluation shows that QBS achieves geometric-mean speedups of 35.68x and 51.34x for projection Compute and Matmul, respectively, while AKV achieves a 1.45x geometric-mean speedup over Tiled RVV for Decode Attention. Compared with the baseline, the complete design increases total area by 12.65%; on the evaluated projection workloads, throughput per area and energy efficiency improve by 46.63x and 19.78x, respectively. Further evaluation demonstrates applicability across multiple block-quantization formats and across models with different Attention organizations.

translation.title: 面向RISC-V向量处理器LLM推理的原生块量化矩阵乘法与双视图访问的显式K/V驻留
translation.abstract: 大语言模型推理中的一些关键执行状态会跨越多条指令持续存在，难以在以单个操作为中心的RVV语义中表达和利用。我们根据数据状态生命周期定义特化边界，在保持RVV可编程性的前提下提出量化块流（QBS）和Attention/KV上下文（AKV）。QBS将原生块格式处理、块遍历、整数计算和有序FP32累加组织为统一的执行过程；而AKV维护本地K/V驻留，并提供与计算方向对齐的操作数视图，同时将Attention算术保留在RVV上。周期精确的RTL评估显示，QBS在投影Compute和Matmul上分别取得35.68倍和51.34倍的几何平均加速，AKV在Decode Attention上相比Tiled RVV取得1.45倍的几何平均加速。与基线相比，完整设计使总面积增加12.65%；在所评估的投影工作负载上，单位面积吞吐量和能效分别提升46.63倍和19.78倍。进一步评估证明了该设计在多种块量化格式和不同Attention组织的模型上的适用性。
translation.brief: 针对RVV语义难以表达跨指令持久执行状态的问题，提出按数据生命周期特化的QBS与AKV硬件扩展以加速LLM推理。

papers.title: CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies
papers.abstract: A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy completes, and CAPE certifies optimality when its executable and optimistic values meet. On CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests, CAPE reaches the independently computed optimum in 502 of 504 compilations while taking 22.0% less compilation time than eager exact search. On larger CSV families it returns policies with higher completion at similar compilation time, and it raises completion by 15.38 to 34.66 percentage points over an LLM that revises its serialization from error feedback.

translation.title: CAPE：协调校准与搜索的工具使用策略编译
translation.abstract: 即使工具调用背后的操作是正确的，调用本身也可能失败，因为接收工具会在代理无法查看的配置下解析分隔符、日期或记录格式。为这样的工具编译工具使用策略需要两方面工作：校准（在候选配置上评估候选调用）和对已评估调用的搜索。两者共享同一个编译预算：先校准一切会把任何改进的策略推迟到最后，而每一步都重新求解部分已知的模型又会延迟下一个有用的查询。一旦某个调用在会到达它的配置上的效果已知，它就变得可用。基于这一观察，我们提出了无需训练的编译器 CAPE。它始终维护一个可执行策略，将校准引导到能改进该策略的调用上，并且只在能提前结束校准的地方收紧界限。返回的策略保留了初始策略能完成的每一个配置，并且当可执行值与乐观值相遇时，CAPE 能证明最优性。在由 64 个请求构建的 CSV 和 JSON 工作流上，CAPE 在 504 次编译中的 502 次达到独立计算的最优解，同时比急切的精确搜索节省 22.0% 的编译时间。在更大的 CSV 家族上，它在相近编译时间内返回完成率更高的策略，并且相比通过错误反馈修正序列化的 LLM，它将完成率提升了 15.38 至 34.66 个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决工具调用在未知配置下可能失败的工具使用策略编译问题，核心方法是在编译过程中动态协调校准与搜索，始终维护可执行策略并将校准聚焦于能改进策略的调用。

papers.title: Beyond "AI Can Make Mistakes": How Risk Communication Shapes Trust and Decision Confidence for LLMs in Health Information Seeking
papers.abstract: Adoption of LLMs for health information has outpaced public understanding, but whether risk communication can work as a corrective remains unknown. In a preregistered experiment (N=500), we compared a standard disclaimer against structured risk communication varying in contextual relevance and mechanistic explanation. Without intervention, users understanding LLMs less reported higher trust and confidence in deciding when to rely. Structured risk communication significantly reduced trust, more so with health-specific framing, but did not improve confidence in reliance decision. Risk disclosure was associated with higher decision confidence among those with stronger AI knowledge, but lower confidence among those less preferring analytical thinking. Effects were also task-dependent: disclosure shifted preferences for medical queries and impairment assistance, while LLMs remained preferred for emotional companionship regardless of exposure. These findings demonstrate that risk communication can narrow trust gaps across AI-literacy levels, but turning disclosure into judgment requires adapting to usage context and users' prior knowledge.

translation.title: 超越“AI 会犯错”：风险传播如何塑造 LLM 在健康信息获取中的信任与决策信心
translation.abstract: LLM 在健康信息领域的应用已超出公众的理解速度，但风险传播能否作为一种纠偏手段仍不得而知。在一项预注册实验（N=500）中，我们比较了标准免责声明与在情境相关性和机制解释上有所不同的结构化风险传播。在没有干预的情况下，对 LLM 理解较少的用户报告了更高的信任度和在决定何时依赖时的信心。结构化风险传播显著降低了信任度，在健康特定表述下降低得更多，但并未提高依赖决策的信心。对于 AI 知识较强的用户，风险披露与更高的决策信心相关，而对于不太偏好分析性思维的用户则与更低的信心相关。效果还依赖于任务：披露改变了用户对医疗查询和功能障碍辅助的偏好，但无论是否接触披露信息，用户在情感陪伴场景中仍然更偏好 LLM。这些发现表明，风险传播可以缩小不同 AI 素养水平之间的信任差距，但要让披露转化为判断力，需要适应使用情境和用户的先验知识。
translation.brief: 研究风险传播能否纠正用户对 LLM 健康信息的过度信任，核心方法是通过预注册实验比较标准免责声明与不同情境相关性和机制解释的结构化风险传播的效果。

papers.title: Typical-query energy figures mislead institutional AI electricity demand
papers.abstract: Institutions increasingly buy large language model services, yet we still often estimate electricity use as single Wh-per-query value. We present the Surrogate Large Language Energy Emulator (SULLEE), an open bottom-up model linking token geometry, serving hardware, and workflow structure to annual institutional electricity, with uncertainty propagated by Monte Carlo simulation. When an institution multiplies a single reported "typical" per-query energy figure by its count of visible user prompts our modelling implies that this compounds two separable shortfalls: a right-skewed task-energy distribution not represented by any single scalar, and workflow amplification of each visible prompt into additional agent and tool calls. Together these imply an underestimate of total inference electricity by a factor of approximately 3.4 under present-day observed use, rising to approximately 15 under a 2030 high-integration scenario. Using Australian public universities as a case study, we show how the top 10% of highest-energy requests contributes over half of modelled institution-level energy use. We quantify how institution-level electricity demand may increase across three AI integration scenarios of: 1) a continuation of estimated present-day 2026 usage; 2) a high-uptake present-day 2026 institution, and 3) a potential 2030 uptake scenario - based on present trends of generative AI tools and their uptake. For a representative Australian university, mean annual electricity demand for AI inference purposes is projected to increase from 17.3 MWh (with a 3.1-47.1 MWh uncertainty, within P05-P95 scenario quartile ranges) under the 2026 observed-use scenario to up to 287.4 MWh (41.5-830.7 MWh) by 2030.

translation.title: 典型查询能耗数据误导机构级 AI 电力需求估算
translation.abstract: 机构越来越多地购买大语言模型服务，但我们通常仍以单一的每查询瓦时值来估算电力使用。我们提出了代理大语言能耗模拟器（SULLEE），这是一个开放的自底向上模型，将 token 几何结构、服务硬件和工作流结构与机构年度电力消耗联系起来，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟传播不确定性。当机构将单一报告的“典型”每查询能耗值乘以其可见用户提示的数量时，我们的建模表明这叠加了两个可分离的缺口：一是任何单一标量都无法代表的右偏任务能耗分布，二是工作流将每个可见提示放大为额外的代理和工具调用。在当前观测使用情况下，这两者共同意味着总推理电力被低估约 3.4 倍，在 2030 年高集成场景下升至约 15 倍。以澳大利亚公立大学为案例研究，我们展示了能耗最高的前 10% 请求贡献了超过一半的机构级建模能耗。我们量化了在三种 AI 集成场景下机构级电力需求可能如何增长：1）延续估计的 2026 年当前使用量；2）2026 年高使用率的机构；3）基于生成式 AI 工具及其采用趋势的潜在 2030 年采用场景。对于一所代表性的澳大利亚大学，AI 推理用途的年均电力需求预计将从 2026 年观测使用场景下的 17.3 MWh（不确定性为 3.1-47.1 MWh，处于 P05-P95 场景四分位区间）增长到 2030 年的最多 287.4 MWh（41.5-830.7 MWh）。
translation.brief: 解决用单一每查询能耗值估算机构级 LLM 电力需求导致严重低估的问题，核心方法是构建自底向上的开放模型 SULLEE，结合 token 几何、服务硬件与工作流结构并用蒙特卡洛模拟传播不确定性。

papers.title: Are Web Agents Still Detectable? Stress-Testing Bot Defenses with Coordinated Evasion
papers.abstract: AI web agents can autonomously navigate websites and complete various tasks. As their capabilities and adoption expand, evaluating bot defenses requires adversarial stress tests. Although prior work demonstrates that existing agents can remain detectable, it remains unclear how effective bot defenses are against adversaries that coordinate evasion across browser fingerprints, automation controls, and interaction behavior. To investigate this threat, we introduce DarkAgent, an autonomous web agent that combines a forked Chromium browser that conceals automation artifacts and generative models that produce human-like mouse and keyboard traces. To address the limitations of existing keyboard mimickers, our keyboard model jointly generates realistic key events and their timings while reliably reproducing the target text. Released agent detectors accept our generated behavior as human, and trained classifiers find it substantially harder to distinguish from human traces than existing mimickers. DarkAgent achieves an 89% page-access bypass rate across a third-party stealth benchmark, exceeding the strongest published baseline by 12 percentage points. To further enhance the measurement of agents, we introduce a benchmark that measures browser fingerprints, interaction behavior, and network activity to assess each channel's contribution to detecting adversarial agents such as DarkAgent. On this benchmark, browser and behavioral modifications are complementary: either alone remains detectable, and only their combination evades all tested checks. Together, our findings expose the gap between passing existing bot defenses and reproducing human behavior, and point to timing between actions as a remaining signal for defenders.

translation.title: 网页代理还能被检测到吗？用协同规避压力测试机器人防御
translation.abstract: AI 网页代理可以自主浏览网站并完成各种任务。随着其能力和采用范围的扩大，评估机器人防御需要对抗性压力测试。尽管先前的工作表明现有代理仍可被检测到，但机器人防御对在浏览器指纹、自动化控制和交互行为之间协同规避的对手究竟有多有效仍不清楚。为研究这一威胁，我们引入 DarkAgent，一个自主网页代理，它结合了一个隐藏自动化痕迹的 fork 版 Chromium 浏览器和生成类人鼠标与键盘轨迹的生成模型。为解决现有键盘模拟器的局限，我们的键盘模型联合生成逼真的按键事件及其时序，同时可靠地复现目标文本。已发布的代理检测器将我们生成的行为判定为人类，且训练出的分类器发现它比现有模拟器更难与人类轨迹区分。DarkAgent 在第三方隐身基准上实现了 89% 的页面访问绕过率，超过最强已发表基线 12 个百分点。为进一步增强对代理的测量，我们引入了一个基准，测量浏览器指纹、交互行为和网络活动，以评估各通道对检测 DarkAgent 这类对抗性代理的贡献。在该基准上，浏览器和行为修改是互补的：单独使用任一手段仍可被检测，只有二者结合才能绕过所有测试的检查。总之，我们的发现揭示了通过现有机器人防御与复现人类行为之间的差距，并指出动作之间的时序是防御者可利用的剩余信号。
translation.brief: 研究现有机器人防御对跨浏览器指纹、自动化控制和交互行为协同规避的对抗性网页代理的有效性，核心方法是构建结合隐身浏览器与类人键鼠轨迹生成模型的自主代理 DarkAgent 及多通道检测基准。

papers.title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
papers.abstract: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.

translation.title: Coding4Games：现代编程代理能玩现代电子游戏吗？
translation.abstract: 游戏，尤其是现代 AAA 游戏，对语言模型在感知复杂场景、控制动作和长时程决策方面提出了挑战。现有游戏基准主要将语言模型作为计算机使用代理来测试，在游玩过程中反复查询语言模型，导致重复的推理成本，并且在实时游戏中需要在环境持续演化的同时进行决策。我们探究编程代理能否从游戏交互中学习，开发无需语言模型推理即可运行的独立游戏程序。为此我们引入 Coding4Games，一个评估编程代理能否开发通过视觉观察和标准游戏输入来玩现代游戏的独立程序的基准。Coding4Games 有三个显著特点：1）多样的现代游戏，涵盖 15 款在视觉、策略和控制需求上各不相同的游戏；2）开发-测试分离，编程代理使用沙箱和标准玩家接口迭代开发程序，之后所选程序被冻结并在无语言模型推理的情况下独立测试；3）结果与过程评估，不仅衡量游戏表现和可靠性，还衡量代理在开发过程中如何使用反馈、修改程序和解决问题。在 15 款游戏中，每款游戏的最佳程序在 13 款上超过最强 GUI 基线，在 1 款上与之持平。人类玩家在 10 款游戏中超过所有代理。我们还考察了开发预算的影响。Coding4Games 评估编程代理能否将其对复杂交互环境的理解转化为能独立可靠运行的程序。
translation.brief: 解决现有游戏基准依赖反复调用语言模型、成本高且不适合实时游戏的问题，核心方法是提出 Coding4Games 基准，评估编程代理能否开发出无需语言模型推理即可独立玩现代游戏的程序。

papers.title: CodeHOI: Code with Agents for Physically Plausible 4D Hand-Object Interaction
papers.abstract: Modeling 4D hand-object interaction (HOI) is fundamental to understanding manipulation. This requires physics, since hands move objects only by touch and each material responds differently. Yet existing methods ignore this physics or simulate only a narrow range of matter. Programs can instead describe any matter with its physics, but coding agents omit the hand that drives the interaction. We close this gap with CodeHOI, to our knowledge the first agentic framework that writes physically plausible 4D HOI as programs. To write one, an Object Agent first builds each object with the physics of its matter. An HOI Agent then specifies the hands by their contacts and simulates each kind of matter with an established physics solver. Finally, an Evaluator Agent checks each result against physical laws. We also introduce CodeHOI-Bench with 100 reconstruction and generation tasks across four kinds of matter. With off-the-shelf frontier models, CodeHOI writes interactions that are plausible for every kind of matter and remain so when transferred to an independent physics engine. It thereby enables coding agents to write physically plausible HOI across diverse matter.

translation.title: CodeHOI：用智能体编写物理合理的4D手-物体交互
translation.abstract: 建模4D手-物体交互（HOI）是理解操作行为的基础。这需要物理，因为手只能通过接触来移动物体，且每种材料的响应各不相同。然而现有方法忽略了这种物理，或只能模拟范围很窄的物质。程序则可以用其物理属性描述任何物质，但编程智能体却遗漏了驱动交互的手。我们用CodeHOI来弥补这一空白，据我们所知，这是首个以程序形式编写物理合理4D HOI的智能体框架。为编写一个交互，Object Agent首先根据物体材料的物理属性构建每个物体；HOI Agent随后通过接触点指定手，并用成熟的物理求解器模拟每种材料；最后，Evaluator Agent依据物理定律检查每个结果。我们还引入了CodeHOI-Bench，包含跨四种材料的100个重建与生成任务。借助现成的前沿模型，CodeHOI编写的交互对每种材料都物理合理，且迁移到独立物理引擎后依然如此。由此，它使编程智能体能够跨多种物质编写物理合理的HOI。
translation.brief: 解决编程智能体无法编写物理合理的4D手-物体交互的问题，核心方法是构建多智能体框架，分别负责按材料物理构建物体、通过接触指定手并用物理求解器模拟、以及依据物理定律评估结果。

papers.title: Reading, Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space
papers.abstract: Can a language model work in the weight space of a policy network for a repeated game? We put four questions to a mid-size open model, on recurrent networks of 1{,}218 weights with exactly checkable answers. Given a population of opponents described in English, write a policy that is optimal: its value is a finite computation over the agent's information state, so a submitted network has an exact gap from the optimum. Given a network's weights, report its action after each of fifteen opponent histories; recover the state machine it implements, judged on every opponent sequence to depth ten; or repair a network whose output was altered in one place and say which round first goes wrong. The model recovers the program in 62 of 66 replies, reports all fifteen behavioral entries correctly in 34 of 36, and attains the optimum in 20 of 20 when it states a policy the evaluator compiles. Repair is the exception: 4 of 18 repaired, 5 of 18 diagnosed, with a median patch covering one of the two entries needed.

translation.title: 在权重空间中阅读、编写与修复博弈论策略
translation.abstract: 语言模型能否在重复博弈策略网络的权重空间中工作？我们向一个中等规模的开源模型提出四个问题，对象是具有1218个权重、答案可精确验证的循环网络。给定一个用英文描述的对手群体，编写一个最优策略：其价值是对智能体信息状态的有限计算，因此提交的网络与最优值之间存在可精确计算的差距。给定一个网络的权重，报告它在十五个对手历史中每个历史之后的动作；恢复它实现的状态机，并在深度为十的所有对手序列上评判；或修复一个输出在一处被篡改的网络，并指出哪一轮首次出错。该模型在66次回答中有62次成功恢复程序，在36次中有34次正确报告全部十五个行为条目，并在20次中有20次在其陈述策略（由评估器编译）时达到最优。修复是例外：18次中仅4次修复成功、5次诊断正确，中位补丁只覆盖所需两个条目中的一个。
translation.brief: 研究语言模型能否直接在策略网络权重空间中阅读、编写和修复重复博弈策略，核心方法是在权重可精确验证的小型循环网络上设计四类可精确评分的任务来测试模型能力。

papers.title: Discovering Bandwidth-Efficient Prefetchers to Shrink the Cache Hierarchy
papers.abstract: Shared last-level caches (LLCs) increasingly dominate server processor die area, forcing architects to trade core counts for cache capacity. While intelligent data prefetching offers a pathway to reclaim this silicon, designing coordinated, multi-level prefetching policies for multi-core systems is bottlenecked by day-long, cycle-level simulations. This simulation wall limits even LLM-based microarchitecture discovery; the state-of-the-art ArchAgent system evolves one cache level at a time on single-core benchmarks, adds multi-core configurations only at the end, and trails the human champion under multi-core shared cache contention. We introduce DuoArchitect, an autonomous agentic framework for multi-fidelity, multi-core co-discovery of prefetchers. Agents jointly evolve evaluation proxies and coordinated prefetching policies across the L1D, L2, and LLC hierarchies, constructing simulation proxies 3-26x faster than cluster evaluation and hardware diagnostic oracles to guide the search. To study how much cache silicon a smarter prefetcher can replace, we evaluate and evolve prefetchers under reduced cache budgets, and find that evolving under our tightest cache constraint (with both the L2 and LLC halved) produced our strongest prefetcher overall at every cache size we tested: DuoArch-Nano. On the Fourth Data Prefetching Championship (DPC4) benchmarks with full-size caches, DuoArch-Nano delivers a 9.2% geomean IPC speedup (+10.5% on four-core mixes) while reducing four-core DRAM traffic by 11.4%, more than doubling the gains of the human champion BertiGO and the agentic ArchAgent v2. When the LLC is halved, DuoArch-Nano erases the baseline's 8.6% overall slowdown and edges out the full-LLC baseline overall (+0.88%), showing that agentic frameworks can generate prefetchers that reclaim megabytes of LLC SRAM per core with zero overall IPC penalty.

translation.title: 发现带宽高效预取器以缩小缓存层次
translation.abstract: 共享末级缓存（LLC）日益占据服务器处理器芯片面积的主导地位，迫使架构师以核心数量换取缓存容量。智能数据预取为回收这部分硅面积提供了途径，但为多核系统设计协调的多级预取策略受制于耗时一整天的周期级仿真。这道仿真之墙甚至限制了基于LLM的微架构发现；最先进的ArchAgent系统在单核基准上一次只演化一级缓存，直到最后才加入多核配置，且在多核共享缓存竞争下落后于人类冠军。我们提出DuoArchitect，一个用于多保真度、多核协同发现预取器的自主智能体框架。智能体联合演化评估代理和跨L1D、L2与LLC层次的协调预取策略，构建比集群评估快3-26倍的仿真代理，以及引导搜索的硬件诊断oracle。为研究更聪明的预取器能替代多少缓存硅面积，我们在缩减的缓存预算下评估和演化预取器，发现在最紧缓存约束下（L2和LLC均减半）演化出的预取器在我们测试的每种缓存规模下都是整体最强的：DuoArch-Nano。在配备全尺寸缓存的第四届数据预取锦标赛（DPC4）基准上，DuoArch-Nano带来9.2%的几何平均IPC加速（四核混合负载上+10.5%），同时将四核DRAM流量降低11.4%，超过人类冠军BertiGO和智能体系统ArchAgent v2收益的两倍。当LLC减半时，DuoArch-Nano消除了基线8.6%的整体性能下降，并整体略胜全尺寸LLC基线（+0.88%），表明智能体框架能够生成在零整体IPC损失下回收每核数MB LLC SRAM的预取器。
translation.brief: 解决多核多级预取器设计受周期级仿真耗时限制的问题，核心方法是构建自主智能体框架DuoArchitect，联合演化快速仿真代理与跨L1D/L2/LLC的协调预取策略。

papers.title: InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time
papers.abstract: Even when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer incorrectly, their internal cues often point to the relevant region. A widely used remedy re-presents the cue-selected region as an enlarged crop to supply finer detail. However, we find that much of its gain requires no new detail: it largely survives when the crop comes from the already-seen low-resolution input, and partly even when the region's cached tokens are merely copied. Part of re-presentation's gain thus comes from drawing attention to evidence the model already holds. We propose InCue, a test-time framework that makes better use of this evidence without additional visual input. InCue treats visual attention and predictive-entropy gradients as Internal Cues, couples them into a spatial target, and optimizes only an offset on the existing visual tokens to steer attention toward it. Under matched visual-token budgets, InCue achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming recent test-time methods and improving four MLLMs by up to 8.9% on V$^*$ and 23.4% on its hard samples. Its gains carry over to eight general benchmarks. Code will be available at this https URL.

translation.title: InCue：在测试时更好地利用多模态LLM已经看到的信息
translation.abstract: 即使多模态大语言模型（MLLM）回答错误，其内部线索往往已指向相关区域。一种广泛使用的补救方法是将线索选中的区域重新呈现为放大的裁剪图以提供更精细的细节。然而我们发现，其收益的很大部分并不需要新细节：当裁剪图来自已经看过的低分辨率输入时，收益基本保留；甚至当仅仅复制该区域已缓存的token时，收益也部分存在。因此，重新呈现的收益部分来自引导模型关注其已掌握的证据。我们提出InCue，一个在测试时无需额外视觉输入就能更好利用这些证据的框架。InCue将视觉注意力和预测熵梯度视为内部线索（Internal Cues），将其耦合为空间目标，并仅对现有视觉token优化一个偏移量，以将注意力引向该目标。在匹配的视觉token预算下，InCue取得最先进性能，持续超越近期的测试时方法，在V$^*$上将四个MLLM提升最多8.9%，在其困难样本上提升23.4%。其收益还扩展到八个通用基准。代码将发布于该网址。
translation.brief: 解决MLLM在测试时未能充分利用已掌握视觉证据的问题，核心方法是将视觉注意力与预测熵梯度耦合为空间目标，仅优化现有视觉token的偏移量来引导注意力。

papers.title: Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at this https URL.

translation.title: 描述而非决策：纠正多模态LLM的答案偏差
translation.abstract: 在比较图像中的两个实体时，多模态LLM（MLLM）常常答错。我们发现，答案偏差并非在模型观看时引入，而是在模型看着图像做决策时引入：模型自己对两个实体的描述往往已包含正确答案。因此我们提出D$^3$（Describe, Don't Decide）：模型先单独描述每个实体，再仅依据这些描述（不看图像）进行决策，最后将该决策与其直接答案合并。无需任何训练，D$^3$在十个基准、八个7-9B MLLM的全部79个模型-基准组合上均有提升。在留出的GQA比较问题上，这些模型的平均准确率从72.4%升至83.2%（单模型最高+21.5%），高于Qwen2.5-VL-32B直接回答的准确率（82.8%）。代码将发布于该网址。
translation.brief: 解决MLLM在图像比较任务中因看着图像做决策而产生的答案偏差，核心方法是让模型先分别描述各实体、仅凭描述决策，再将该决策与直接答案合并，无需训练。

papers.title: Not Just Any Example: Security Requirements and Fix Patterns for Guiding LLM Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract: Software vulnerabilities leave systems open to attack, and their remediation is often delayed. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced automated patch generation, yet passing functionality tests does not ensure that a patch enforces the security requirement the vulnerability violated. Existing vulnerability repair techniques rely on curated patterns or templates with limited coverage, leaving unclear which repair strategies carry over across vulnerabilities and how they can steer LLMs. We present a large-scale empirical study that relates recurring fix patterns to the security impacts of vulnerabilities and examines how this knowledge can guide LLM-based repair. Building on a manual study of security patches, we cluster 3,816 security patches from 348 open-source repositories and analyze the edits and their context to derive concrete fix patterns, ranging from local safeguards to coordinated changes across multiple locations. We define 12 security impact classes by the security requirements that vulnerabilities violate and map them to repair categories and fix patterns, revealing characteristic repairs, alternative strategies within a class, and patterns shared across classes. We then use these patterns and impact-pattern associations to select repair examples for four LLMs on repair tasks of varying complexity. Guided example selection raises the four-model mean pass@3 from 37.9% under zero-shot prompting to up to 49.2%, whereas randomly selected examples reach only 36.9%. Our findings connect vulnerability characterization with patch generation and support organizing repair knowledge around security requirements.

translation.title: 并非任意示例：用于指导 LLM 漏洞修复的安全需求与修复模式
translation.abstract: 软件漏洞使系统暴露于攻击之下，而漏洞修复常常被延迟。大语言模型（LLM）推动了自动化补丁生成的发展，但仅通过功能测试并不能保证补丁真正落实了漏洞所违反的安全需求。现有漏洞修复技术依赖覆盖范围有限的人工整理模式或模板，尚不清楚哪些修复策略可以跨漏洞迁移，以及如何用它们引导 LLM。我们提出一项大规模实证研究，将反复出现的修复模式与漏洞的安全影响相关联，并考察这些知识如何指导基于 LLM 的修复。基于对安全补丁的人工研究，我们对来自 348 个开源仓库的 3,816 个安全补丁进行聚类，分析代码编辑及其上下文，推导出具体的修复模式，涵盖从局部防护到跨多个位置的协同修改。我们依据漏洞违反的安全需求定义了 12 个安全影响类别，并将其映射到修复类别和修复模式，揭示了各类别的典型修复方式、类别内的替代策略以及跨类别共享的模式。随后，我们利用这些模式及影响-模式关联，为四个 LLM 在不同复杂度的修复任务中选择修复示例。引导式示例选择将四个模型的平均 pass@3 从零样本提示下的 37.9% 提升至最高 49.2%，而随机选择的示例仅达到 36.9%。我们的发现将漏洞刻画与补丁生成联系起来，并支持围绕安全需求组织修复知识。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 修复漏洞时未必满足安全需求的问题，核心方法是通过大规模实证研究从安全补丁中归纳修复模式并映射到安全影响类别，据此为 LLM 选择引导性修复示例。

papers.title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
papers.abstract: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

translation.title: TableRouter：面向长表格问答的查询感知证据构建
translation.abstract: LLM 可以对表格进行推理，但当表格超出上下文预算时，检索相关行只是解决方案的一部分。检索到的子集可能遗漏精确聚合所需的信息；即使证据完整，LLM 也可能难以使用。我们提出 TableRouter，一个免训练框架，它分析每个查询后在两条路线中选择：计算路线，从完整表格中推导以问题为条件的统计量；覆盖路线，检索相关行和列摘要。所选上下文通过一次调用传给冻结的 LLM。在三个 LLM 和三个大表格基准上，TableRouter 在全部九个设置中以 1.2-18.3 个准确率点超越六个单次调用基线中最强者，相比截断表格提示节省 77-95% 的估计 FLOPs，且索引开销可在多个问题间摊销。收益还扩展到此前实验未使用的数据库长表格，TableRouter 使用 Qwen2.5-7B 达到 35.8%，而最强的外部基线仅为 16.4%。一项受控实验表明，即使所有决定答案的行都可用，显式提供计算出的统计量也能将准确率提升最多 40.0 个点。这些结果区分了证据获取与证据使用：长表格推理取决于信息的表示方式，而不仅仅是检索到哪些行。
translation.brief: 该论文解决长表格超出 LLM 上下文时的问答问题，核心方法是免训练地按查询在计算统计量与检索行列两条路线间路由，构建更易用的证据上下文。

papers.title: LIBRA: Runtime Co-Tuning of Batch Size and Parallelism for Time-Efficient LLM Training
papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) requires choosing both a batch size and a parallel configuration. Existing systems make these decisions in isolation, tuning parallelism for throughput and batch size for convergence, but neither objective alone determines training efficiency. We present LIBRA, a lightweight runtime framework that co-tunes batch size and parallel configuration to minimize end-to-end time. LIBRA treats throughput and convergence as two noisy objectives and searches their joint space using parallel noisy expected hypervolume improvement (qNEHVI). To make this runtime search efficient, we propose hierarchical pruning, which removes infeasible and low-throughput parallel configurations through system-level performance estimation and then narrows batch-size candidates through critical-batch-size-aware convergence monitoring. We further design acquisition-guided parallel evaluation (AGPE), which evaluates surviving candidates concurrently across GPU groups in order of their acquisition values. On clusters of up to 256 GPUs, LIBRA reduces time-to-convergence by 31.1% on average over state-of-the-art methods, while runtime tuning accounts for only 0.3-3.5% of overall time.

translation.title: LIBRA：面向时间高效 LLM 训练的批大小与并行度运行时协同调优
translation.abstract: 训练大语言模型（LLM）需要同时选择批大小和并行配置。现有系统孤立地做这两项决策——为吞吐量调并行度、为收敛调批大小——但任一目标单独都无法决定训练效率。我们提出 LIBRA，一个轻量级运行时框架，协同调优批大小与并行配置以最小化端到端时间。LIBRA 将吞吐量和收敛视为两个带噪声的目标，使用并行噪声期望超体积改进（qNEHVI）搜索它们的联合空间。为使运行时搜索高效，我们提出分层剪枝：先通过系统级性能估计剔除不可行和低吞吐量的并行配置，再通过临界批大小感知的收敛监测缩小批大小候选范围。我们进一步设计了采集引导的并行评估（AGPE），按采集值顺序在 GPU 组间并发评估幸存候选。在多达 256 个 GPU 的集群上，LIBRA 相比最先进方法平均将收敛时间缩短 31.1%，而运行时调优仅占总时间的 0.3-3.5%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 训练中批大小与并行配置孤立调优导致效率不佳的问题，核心方法是用 qNEHVI 贝叶斯优化在运行时协同搜索两者并结合分层剪枝与并发评估加速搜索。

papers.title: Calm Agent: Reframing Agent Interaction around Intermittent Human Attention
papers.abstract: AI agents can carry out auxiliary tasks while users focus on other work. Yet users still need to understand task state, make changes, and respond when help is required. We argue that agents for ongoing auxiliary tasks should be designed around intermittent human attention: tasks should continue between interactions, and users should be able to return with little effort to understand and control them. We develop this position as Calm Agent. It connects three on-demand interaction modes: Delegate, Adjust, and Check, through a persistent task representation. Generative interaction provides controls and feedback suited to open-ended goals, while existing controls support routine actions. We illustrate these principles with Orvlet, a desktop prototype for background execution and compact task interfaces. We identify challenges in adapting interfaces while preserving continuity, coordinating attention across tasks, providing responsive interaction, and learning user habits over time. The aim is to support continuing task control while protecting attention for primary work.

translation.title: Calm Agent：围绕间歇性人类注意力重构智能体交互
translation.abstract: AI 智能体可以在用户专注于其他工作时执行辅助任务。但用户仍需了解任务状态、做出修改，并在需要帮助时予以响应。我们主张，面向持续性辅助任务的智能体应围绕间歇性人类注意力来设计：任务应在交互间隙继续进行，用户应能以很小的代价返回以理解和控制任务。我们将这一立场发展为 Calm Agent。它通过持久的任务表示连接三种按需交互模式：委托（Delegate）、调整（Adjust）和查看（Check）。生成式交互为开放式目标提供合适的控制与反馈，而现有控件支持常规操作。我们以 Orvlet——一个支持后台执行和紧凑任务界面的桌面原型——来阐释这些原则。我们识别了在保持连续性的同时适配界面、跨任务协调注意力、提供响应式交互以及随时间学习用户习惯等方面的挑战。其目标是在保护用户专注于主要工作的注意力的同时，支持对持续任务的控制。
translation.brief: 该论文解决用户注意力有限时如何持续控制后台辅助智能体任务的问题，核心方法是提出围绕间歇性注意力设计的 Delegate/Adjust/Check 三种交互模式与持久任务表示。

papers.title: Marketing-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Models and Agents on Real-World Marketing Capabilities
papers.abstract: As frontier AI models and agents are deployed more broadly in the real world, marketing is emerging as one of their largest applications. Marketing teams use AI models to produce brand assets like website copy and social media posts, while consumers' agents autonomously discover products, research purchases, and navigate websites. However, evaluating marketing capability is difficult because unlike areas like software development, customer support, or legal review where ground truth is more objectively defined, marketing is subjective, and output quality is judged based on taste and brand. We introduce Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, which pairs discriminative tasks (detecting brand anomalies) with generative tasks (remediation), while keeping answers verifiable. Marketing-Bench tests five key pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice, all crucial elements for good brand content on the web. We find that frontier models are far from solving the benchmark: the average model corrects only about half of the introduced issues (53.1%), whereas a marketing expert corrects nearly all of them. Even the strongest, GPT-6 Astra, reaches only 74.8%, with Claude Opus and Fable, Gemini Argon, and GPT-6 Sol falling well short. These findings suggest that marketing capabilities are less mature than adoption implies, and that principled evaluation should precede further scaling of usage. Marketing-Bench is a first step toward "frontier marketing models" with superhuman marketing performance.

translation.title: Marketing-Bench：在真实世界营销能力上评估前沿模型与智能体
translation.abstract: 随着前沿 AI 模型和智能体在现实世界中被更广泛地部署，营销正成为其最大的应用领域之一。营销团队使用 AI 模型生成品牌资产，如网站文案和社交媒体帖子，而消费者的智能体则自主发现产品、研究购买并浏览网站。然而，评估营销能力很困难，因为与软件开发、客户支持或法律审查等真值更客观定义的领域不同，营销是主观的，输出质量取决于品味和品牌。我们提出 Marketing-Bench，首个开源营销基准，它将判别式任务（检测品牌异常）与生成式任务（修复）配对，同时保持答案可验证。Marketing-Bench 测试五个关键支柱：事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构和品牌语调，这些都是优质网络品牌内容的关键要素。我们发现前沿模型远未解决该基准：模型平均只修复了约一半引入的问题（53.1%），而营销专家几乎能修复全部。即使最强的 GPT-6 Astra 也仅达到 74.8%，Claude Opus 和 Fable、Gemini Argon 以及 GPT-6 Sol 则差距更大。这些发现表明，营销能力的成熟度低于其普及程度所暗示的水平，在进一步扩大使用规模之前应先进行有原则的评估。Marketing-Bench 是迈向具有超人营销能力的"前沿营销模型"的第一步。
translation.brief: 该论文解决营销能力因主观性而难以评估的问题，核心方法是构建首个开源营销基准 Marketing-Bench，将可验证的品牌异常检测与修复任务配对来评估模型。

papers.title: To Critic Or Not To Critic
papers.abstract: As large language models tackle longer and more complex tasks, understanding when a critic improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes increasingly important. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains a critic to reduce variance and provide fine-grained credit assignment, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drops the critic and avoids the bias of bootstrapping from the critic's value estimates. Although recent critic-based methods have reported strong performance relative to GRPO, it remains unclear when each approach is preferable. We argue that there is no universal answer; instead, the choice depends on several interacting factors, including batch size, critic reliance, and task complexity. We study the bias-variance tradeoff in terms of gradient direction, measuring how closely each method's gradient estimates align with the true policy gradient as batch size grows. Under a shared actor objective, we compare GRPO with PPO in control tasks, short-horizon math, and long-horizon terminal agents. Across more than 1,200 training runs, including 96 with LLMs, we find that PPO generally leads at small batch sizes, while GRPO often overtakes heavily bootstrapped PPO and reaches parity with lightly bootstrapped PPO at larger batches. At longer horizons and in more complex domains, GRPO needs larger batches to catch up to PPO's performance. Accounting for training compute, critics pay off at small budgets, but their returns diminish at larger budgets.

translation.title: 批评家还是不批评家
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型处理更长、更复杂的任务，理解批评家何时能提升强化学习（RL）的效率变得越来越重要。Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）训练一个批评家来降低方差并提供细粒度的信用分配，而 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）则去掉批评家，避免从批评家的价值估计进行自举所带来的偏差。尽管近期基于批评家的方法相对于 GRPO 报告了强劲性能，但仍不清楚何时应选择哪种方法。我们认为没有普适答案；相反，选择取决于多个相互作用的因素，包括批量大小、对批评家的依赖程度和任务复杂度。我们从梯度方向的角度研究偏差-方差权衡，衡量随着批量增大，每种方法的梯度估计与真实策略梯度的接近程度。在共享的 actor 目标下，我们在控制任务、短时程数学和长时程终端智能体上比较 GRPO 与 PPO。在超过 1,200 次训练运行（包括 96 次使用 LLM）中，我们发现 PPO 通常在小批量时领先，而 GRPO 在较大批量时往往超过重度自举的 PPO，并与轻度自举的 PPO 达到同等水平。在更长时程和更复杂的领域中，GRPO 需要更大的批量才能赶上 PPO 的性能。考虑训练计算量后，批评家在小预算下是划算的，但在更大预算下其收益递减。
translation.brief: 研究在何种条件下应选择带批评家的PPO或不带批评家的GRPO，通过梯度方向的偏差-方差权衡分析批量大小、批评家依赖和任务复杂度等因素的影响。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents
papers.abstract: Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. Hierarchy-level embeddings further support learning from sparse observations and patterns shared within each authorization level. We establish finite-sample risk bounds and provide sufficient conditions for consistent authorization probability estimation and algorithmic convergence. Experiments on simulated data, AI-generated user profiles, and real user authorization data demonstrate strong predictive performance with zero hierarchy violations.

translation.title: 面向个人AI智能体分层授权的结构感知Transformer
translation.abstract: 个人AI智能体可以代表用户执行复杂的多步骤任务，但这通常涉及大量的权限请求。手动审查每个请求非常耗时，而不加区分地批准则带来隐私和安全风险。预测用户的授权偏好提供了一种在保留用户控制权的同时减轻这一负担的方法。然而，授权预测具有挑战性，因为权限请求往往是分层的，且观察到的用户决策稀疏且可能相关。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了面向层级的父门控授权Transformer（PATH），用于预测用户对个人AI智能体的授权偏好。PATH 是一种新颖的神经网络架构，它将层级感知的注意力掩码与父门控概率公式相结合，以确保预测的层级一致性。层级嵌入进一步支持从稀疏观测和每个授权层级内共享的模式中学习。我们建立了有限样本风险界，并给出了一致授权概率估计和算法收敛的充分条件。在模拟数据、AI生成的用户画像和真实用户授权数据上的实验展示了强大的预测性能，且零层级违规。
translation.brief: 提出PATH架构，通过层级感知注意力掩码和父门控概率公式预测用户对个人AI智能体权限请求的授权偏好，解决层级一致性和稀疏观测问题。

papers.title: Unifying Partner and Environment Diversity to Improve Human-AI Coordination
papers.abstract: Real-world applications of modern AI systems require generalization to both unseen environments and novel human users. The field of zero-shot coordination (ZSC) has focused primarily on deploying AI to cooperate with novel partners in otherwise familiar environments. Popular population-based methods achieve this by partnering the agent with a diversity of simulated human users during training in a fixed environment, but does not consider the more realistic scenario where both the users and the environment are unseen during training. Recently, training across environments has been explored in training a single self-play agent, which shows better generalization on both novel human users and unseen environments. In this work, we ask whether jointly modeling partner diversity and environment diversity yields stronger coordination with novel partners in novel environments. We introduce Cross Environment Co-Play (CECP), a two-stage framework that first trains a population of self-play agents across a distribution of procedurally generated environments, and then trains a cooperator policy against this partner population. To further couple social and environmental reasoning, we add a next-state prediction module that encourages representations to encode both partner behavior and task structure. We evaluate CECP on both a neuroscience-inspired cooperative foraging task, and the popular ZSC benchmark Overcooked, under held-out partner and held-out environment conditions. CECP achieves the strongest performance among the compared baselines and attains state-of-the-art results under our evaluation protocol for human-AI collaboration. We analyze the model's latent representation encoded by the next-state prediction module, showing it can not only improve the performance of the cooperative AI, but also provide more interpretable latents, demonstrated by the inference of partner skill levels.

translation.title: 统一伙伴与环境多样性以改进人机协作
translation.abstract: 现代AI系统的现实应用需要对未见环境和新型人类用户的泛化能力。零样本协作（ZSC）领域主要关注在熟悉环境中部署AI与新型伙伴协作。流行的基于种群的方法通过在固定环境中让智能体与多样化的模拟人类用户配对训练来实现这一点，但未考虑用户和环境在训练时均未见的更现实场景。最近，跨环境训练已被用于训练单个自博弈智能体，在新型人类用户和未见环境上均表现出更好的泛化。在本工作中，我们探究联合建模伙伴多样性和环境多样性是否能带来与新型环境中新型伙伴更强的协作。我们提出 Cross Environment Co-Play（CECP），这是一个两阶段框架：首先在程序化生成环境的分布上训练自博弈智能体种群，然后针对该伙伴种群训练协作策略。为进一步耦合社会推理与环境推理，我们添加了一个下一状态预测模块，鼓励表征同时编码伙伴行为和任务结构。我们在受神经科学启发的合作觅食任务和流行的 ZSC 基准 Overcooked 上，在留出伙伴和留出环境条件下评估 CECP。CECP 在对比基线中取得最强性能，并在我们的人机协作评估协议下达到最先进水平。我们分析了下一状态预测模块编码的模型潜在表征，表明它不仅能提升合作AI的性能，还能提供更可解释的潜在表征，例如推断伙伴的技能水平。
translation.brief: 提出CECP两阶段框架，联合建模伙伴多样性与环境多样性，训练在未见环境和新型人类用户中均能协作的智能体，并加入下一状态预测模块耦合社会与环境推理。

papers.title: Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums: Execution-Bound Evidence Certification and Plausible-World Safety Gating in Agentic Control Planes
papers.abstract: Agreement among large language models is not physical evidence for mutating production infrastructure. Because generative models share pretraining priors and conform to peer rationales during deliberation, voting ensembles correlate errors instead of providing independent fault tolerance; yet attaching rigid deterministic checks to unconstrained agent outputs paralyzes incident remediation. We present Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums (PIEQ), an execution-bound certification layer that keeps every language model strictly outside the trusted computing base. PIEQ unifies assumption-based truth maintenance, physical provenance isolation, control-theoretic plausible-world safety shielding, and linearizable concurrency governance around three distinct obligations: certifying diagnostic preconditions from disjoint physical failure domains, gating candidate mutations across all unrefuted fault worlds while falling back to read-only diagnostic probes under ambiguity, and binding admission certificates to target execution through snapshot barriers, revision checks, authorization freshness, trusted temporal-precondition policies, and capability-tiered enforcement. Across formal guarantees, automated etcd fault suites, frozen software benchmarks, and live language-model runs, PIEQ achieves zero within-assumption unsafe admissions and zero false-precondition commits, converting occasional agent proof omissions into recoverable false blocks rather than unsafe actions. On a physical PostgreSQL/Patroni cluster, PIEQ gates supervised failovers alongside Patroni and etcd's native split-brain protection and enforces a full Tier E2 contract inside a single serializable PostgreSQL transaction for bounded capacity reservations. All benchmarks are author-labeled, live model snapshots are unpinned, and Tier E2 physical failover promotion as well as multi-host hardware fault isolation remain open work.

translation.title: 溯源隔离的认知仲裁法定人数：智能体控制平面中的执行绑定证据认证与可能世界安全门控
translation.abstract: 大语言模型之间的一致意见并非变更生产基础设施的物理证据。由于生成式模型共享预训练先验并在审议中迎合同伴的论证，投票集成会使错误相关化而非提供独立的容错；然而，将僵化的确定性检查附加到不受约束的智能体输出上又会使事故修复陷入瘫痪。我们提出 Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums（PIEQ），一个执行绑定的认证层，使每个语言模型都严格处于可信计算基之外。PIEQ 围绕三项不同的义务，统一了基于假设的真值维护、物理溯源隔离、控制论的可能世界安全屏蔽和可线性化的并发治理：从不相交的物理故障域认证诊断前置条件，在所有未被反驳的故障世界中门控候选变更并在歧义时回退到只读诊断探测，以及通过快照屏障、修订检查、授权新鲜度、可信时间前置条件策略和能力分层执行将准入证书绑定到目标执行。在形式化保证、自动化 etcd 故障套件、冻结软件基准和真实语言模型运行中，PIEQ 实现了假设内零不安全准入和零错误前置条件提交，将偶发的智能体证明遗漏转化为可恢复的错误阻止而非不安全操作。在一个物理 PostgreSQL/Patroni 集群上，PIEQ 与 Patroni 及 etcd 原生的脑裂保护协同门控受监督的故障转移，并在单个可串行化的 PostgreSQL 事务内为有界容量预留强制执行完整的 Tier E2 契约。所有基准均由作者标注，真实模型快照未固定，Tier E2 物理故障转移提升以及多主机硬件故障隔离仍是待完成的工作。
translation.brief: 提出PIEQ执行绑定认证层，将语言模型排除在可信计算基之外，通过物理溯源隔离、可能世界安全屏蔽和并发治理来安全门控智能体对生产基础设施的变更。

papers.title: Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hiding incentives and asynchronously patches exploited environments during training. Candidate repairs triggered by execution invariants or differential fuzzing are deployed only after passing three automated validation gates that block the exploit while preserving valid solutions, canceling detector false positives and enabling structural propagation across repositories without scaffold labels or reference solutions. Across 20 controlled GRPO experiments on heterogeneous software-engineering repositories, online environment repair reduces cumulative reward hacking from 36.9% to 0.06% and improves held-out Pass@8 from 21.7% to 46.7%, consistently outperforming reward-penalty, rollout-filtering, and static-hardening baselines while eliminating zero-shot exploitation on unseen loophole classes.

translation.title: 面向编程智能体的在线环境修复
translation.abstract: 程序化验证器为用强化学习训练编程智能体提供了可扩展的奖励信号，然而细微的测试框架缺陷和不完整的单元测试使得策略无需完成预期任务即可获得满分。现有的训练时防御要么惩罚可疑输出，要么过滤被标记的任务和轨迹。然而，输出惩罚使底层验证器仍然可被利用，驱使策略在推理监视器下伪装捷径，或在检测器误报时将有效解清零；而任务和轨迹过滤则丢弃或屏蔽了捷径最早出现的最难问题。预训练验证器加固直接修复环境，但会漏掉只在强化学习过程中随策略提升才暴露的漏洞类别。本文提出在线环境修复，它保持触发轨迹的奖励不变以消除隐藏动机，并在训练过程中异步修补被利用的环境。由执行不变量或差分模糊测试触发的候选修复，只有在通过三道自动化验证门后才被部署，这些验证门在阻止漏洞利用的同时保留有效解，消除检测器误报，并在无需脚手架标签或参考解的情况下实现跨仓库的结构化传播。在异构软件工程仓库上的 20 个受控 GRPO 实验中，在线环境修复将累积奖励作弊从 36.9% 降至 0.06%，并将留出集 Pass@8 从 21.7% 提升至 46.7%，持续优于奖励惩罚、轨迹过滤和静态加固基线，并消除了对未见漏洞类别的零样本利用。
translation.brief: 提出在线环境修复方法，在强化学习训练编程智能体过程中异步修补被利用的验证器环境，通过执行不变量、差分模糊测试和三道自动化验证门来消除奖励作弊。

papers.title: Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training
papers.abstract: Continued fractions have been shown to be a function class capable of constructing expressive yet parameter-efficient neural networks. These neural networks are not only effective for supervised learning, but also for training LLMs. However, the rational form of this function class introduces poles when the denominator approaches zero, which prior work has avoided by enforcing a small positive (non-smooth) lower bound. We show that performance and training stability can be highly sensitive to the choice of this lower bound. In this work, we introduce a novel transformation of the partial denominators, inspired by its connection to the Green's function in physics, that mitigates the above issue elegantly by constraining the spectra of the constructed tridiagonal Hamiltonian. Our approach further eliminates the need for incremental training used by previous works for stability, thus avoiding involved modifications to standard pre-training procedures. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our reparameterization by replacing FFNs with a previously proposed continued fraction architecture for both language and image generative modeling. Across diverse models, such as GPT-2 XL, (nano) Llama-MoE, and Granite, we show that our proposed method achieves performance comparable to the original (FFN-based) architectures while maintaining ~30%-50% parameter savings as before, and in most cases even outperforms the more complicated incremental training baseline. We further demonstrate, for the first time for continued fraction networks, that their effectiveness also carries over to image generative modeling, that utilize diffusion objectives. On a state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformer, we show that our approach again achieves performance comparable to the original FFN-based models with ~30% parameter savings and significantly outperforms the previous incremental training approach.

translation.title: Spec-CoFrGeNet：重参数化连分数网络以实现稳定且精确的训练
translation.abstract: 连分数已被证明是一类能够构建表达力强且参数高效的神经网络函数类。这些神经网络不仅适用于监督学习，也适用于训练 LLM。然而，该函数类的有理形式在分母趋近于零时会引入极点，先前的工作通过强制施加一个较小的正（非光滑）下界来规避这一问题。我们表明，性能和训练稳定性对该下界的选择高度敏感。在本工作中，受其与物理学中格林函数联系的启发，我们引入了一种对部分分母的新颖变换，通过约束所构造的三对角哈密顿量的谱，优雅地缓解了上述问题。我们的方法还消除了先前工作为保持稳定性所需的增量训练，从而避免了对标准预训练流程的复杂修改。我们通过用先前提出的连分数架构替换 FFN，在语言和图像生成建模中验证了该重参数化的有效性。在 GPT-2 XL、(nano) Llama-MoE 和 Granite 等多种模型上，我们表明所提方法在保持原有约 30%-50% 参数节省的同时，性能与原始（基于 FFN 的）架构相当，且在大多数情况下甚至优于更复杂的增量训练基线。我们进一步首次证明，连分数网络的有效性同样适用于采用扩散目标的图像生成建模。在最先进的 Diffusion Transformer 上，我们的方法再次实现了与原始基于 FFN 的模型相当的性能，节省约 30% 参数，并显著优于先前的增量训练方法。
translation.brief: 解决连分数网络因分母趋零产生极点导致训练不稳定的问题，核心方法是通过与格林函数的联系对部分分母进行重参数化，以约束三对角哈密顿量的谱。

papers.title: CHORAL: A Multi-Agent Scaffold for Longitudinal Prognostic Reasoning from Patient-Generated Health Data
papers.abstract: Longitudinal patient-generated health data can inform prognostic reasoning about how patients' conditions may evolve between follow-up visits. Existing approaches summarize trajectories or predict symptom states, but provide limited support for examining how heterogeneous evidence informs prognosis. We present CHORAL, a multi-agent scaffold that forms domain-specific appraisals before cross-domain synthesis and review, preserving evidence and revisions. Informed by a formative study with 12 psychiatrists, we evaluated CHORAL quantitatively and with 22 clinicians. CHORAL achieved balanced accuracy comparable to persistence (0.673 vs. 0.672), while detecting 40% of LOW-to-HIGH deterioration cases missed by persistence. Versus a single-agent baseline, it improved balanced accuracy from 0.639 to 0.673 and evidence coverage from 70.1% to 89.2%. Clinicians rated CHORAL significantly higher for evidence appraisal, alternative interpretations, grounds for challenge, and distinguishing what to rely on from what required verification. These findings show how multi-agent deliberation can support review by exposing alternative interpretations and grounds for verification.

translation.title: CHORAL：基于患者自报健康数据进行纵向预后推理的多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 纵向的患者自报健康数据可以为预后推理提供依据，帮助判断患者在随访就诊之间病情可能如何演变。现有方法要么总结轨迹，要么预测症状状态，但对考察异质性证据如何支撑预后的支持有限。我们提出 CHORAL，这是一个多智能体框架，先形成领域特定的评估，再进行跨领域综合与审查，并保留证据和修订记录。基于一项有 12 位精神科医生参与的形成性研究，我们对 CHORAL 进行了定量评估，并有 22 位临床医生参与评估。CHORAL 实现了与持续性基线相当的平衡准确率（0.673 vs. 0.672），同时检测出持续性基线遗漏的 40% 的 LOW-to-HIGH 恶化病例。与单智能体基线相比，它将平衡准确率从 0.639 提升至 0.673，证据覆盖率从 70.1% 提升至 89.2%。临床医生对 CHORAL 在证据评估、替代解释、质疑依据以及区分可依赖内容与需验证内容方面给予显著更高的评分。这些发现表明，多智能体协商可以通过呈现替代解释和验证依据来支持审查。
translation.brief: 解决现有方法难以利用异质性患者自报健康数据进行预后推理的问题，核心方法是构建先做领域评估再跨领域综合审查的多智能体框架 CHORAL。

papers.title: From Rule-based to Agentic: LLM Agent based Real-time Control of Urban Drainage Systems for Flooding and Sewer Overflow Mitigation
papers.abstract: Real-time control (RTC) for urban drainage systems (UDS) remains hampered by sparse in-network sensing. While heterogeneous multi-modal meteorological early warnings often contain decision-critical information for UDS RTC, none of the existing approaches can exploit such externally-sourced information within the control workflow. Here we introduce AgenticAI-Control, an agentic artificial intelligence framework able to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings in RTC. Two coupled large language model agents are integrated to generate control strategies by retrieving meteorological early-warnings and fusing them with domain engineering expertise. Validated via simulation studies of a combined sewer catchment in eastern China across 10 real-world rainfall events, the AgenticAI-Control achieved 69.1-90.6% reduction in aggregated flood and overflow volumes compared to the rule-based baseline control. Rigorously standardized prompt engineering and modular workflow constraints substantially compress performance disparities among four distinct LLMs. Our work establishes AgenticAI as a viable tool to unify multi-source meteorological monitoring and practitioner domain knowledge, surmounting longstanding monitoring limitations of UDS RTC and delivering cost-efficient, robust intelligent control solutions for sensor-sparse sewer infrastructures.

translation.title: 从基于规则到智能体化：基于 LLM 智能体的城市排水系统实时控制以缓解洪涝与污水溢流
translation.abstract: 城市排水系统（UDS）的实时控制（RTC）仍受限于管网内稀疏的传感。虽然异构多模态气象预警往往包含对 UDS RTC 至关重要的决策信息，但现有方法均无法在控制流程中利用此类外部来源的信息。我们提出 AgenticAI-Control，一个能够在 RTC 中同化多源气象预警的智能体人工智能框架。该框架集成两个耦合的大语言模型智能体，通过检索气象预警并将其与领域工程专业知识融合来生成控制策略。通过对中国东部某合流制排水汇水区在 10 场真实降雨事件中的仿真研究验证，与基于规则的基线控制相比，AgenticAI-Control 将累计洪涝和溢流水量降低了 69.1%-90.6%。严格标准化的提示工程和模块化工作流约束显著压缩了四种不同 LLM 之间的性能差异。我们的工作确立了 AgenticAI 作为统一多源气象监测与从业者领域知识的可行工具，克服了 UDS RTC 长期存在的监测局限，为传感器稀疏的污水基础设施提供了低成本、鲁棒的智能控制解决方案。
translation.brief: 解决城市排水系统实时控制无法利用外部多源气象预警信息的问题，核心方法是构建集成两个耦合 LLM 智能体以融合气象预警与工程知识的 AgenticAI-Control 框架。

papers.title: Do Clinician-Scored Examples Help LLMs Code ADOS-2 from Hour-Long Transcripts?
papers.abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example's label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model's graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.

translation.title: 临床医生评分的示例能帮助 LLM 从长达一小时的转录文本中完成 ADOS-2 编码吗？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以依据书面评分细则对转录文本进行编码，这使得自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS-2）的自动化编码看似触手可及。让此类评分器与临床医生对齐的常用方法是向其展示专家评分的示例，但正确标签是否能改善一致性却很少被检验。我们针对 48 名儿童长达一小时的 ADOS-2 模块 3 会话中的八个基于语音的条目进行了检验，使用一个本地模型和预注册的安慰剂对照设计。我们比较了少样本评分、锚定比较（模型仅判断某儿童比已评分锚点更好、相似或更差，再由固定规则给出分数）、事后校准、基于协议的证据路由以及对完整转录文本的直接评分。在 40 名留出儿童上，与临床医生的一致性较为有限，二次加权 kappa 在 0.22 到 0.30 之间。将每个示例的标签替换为错误标签会改变约三分之一的少样本预测，且偏向被污染标签的程度高于随机水平，但并未降低一致性（正确标签为 0.25，错误标签为 0.23）。一个更大的第二模型表现相同。锚定比较并未优于少样本评分，其跨儿童判断的准确性也不高于由绝对分数所隐含的判断，路由也没有帮助。在注册的未校准组中，对完整转录文本的直接评分一致性最高，为 0.30。探索性后续分析发现，模型的分级判断对儿童的排序优于其最终分数，现有的批量校准将同一批儿童上的一致性提升至 0.46，且在受控合成会话中，分别对片段评分并不优于校准后的整段转录评分。专家评分的示例本身并不能校准基于模型的临床评分器，关于校准或增加流程复杂性的主张需要错误标签对照和强基线。
translation.brief: 检验专家评分示例能否提升 LLM 对 ADOS-2 转录文本自动编码与临床医生的一致性，核心方法是采用预注册的安慰剂对照设计比较多种评分策略。

papers.title: Generalized Tensor Parallelism: Powering Trillion-Parameter LLM Training at 10+ EFLOP/s
papers.abstract: Pretraining state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) with up to trillions of parameters is memory- and compute-intensive. Existing parallelization schemes compromise on either per-GPU memory or throughput: data parallelism replicates parameters; tensor parallelism and fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP) add communication of activations and parameters, respectively, to every microbatch; and pipeline parallelism leaves GPUs idle while the pipeline fills and drains. We show that, for linear layers, five commonly used parallelisms (data, tensor, sequence, context parallelism and FSDP) are special cases of one framework, generalized tensor parallelism (GTP), in which each layer's parameters and activations are partitioned and either can be re-materialized with an all-gather before use. In GTP, a parameter all-gather is an optional preprocessing step on one input of a matrix multiplication (GEMM), whereas FSDP implementations typically treat it as a step before an entire Transformer block, which can increase memory footprint and delay GEMMs. The GTP view lets us schedule all-gathers per GEMM rather than per block, issuing each early enough to hide its communication but late enough to limit memory. Our implementation is open source at this https URL with it, an internal 2T-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model reaches \textbf{13.0 model EFLOP/s} (exaFLOP/s) on 12,288 GB300 GPUs with 98\% weak-scaling efficiency, and runs with 1M-token sequences on 512 GPUs. On 256--1,024 GPUs, our implementation achieves \textbf{1.05--1.55$\times$ the throughput of Megatron-FSDP} across three MoE models and \textbf{1.27--1.31$\times$ that of a tuned 3D-parallel recipe with pipeline parallelism} on a DeepSeek-V4-Pro proxy model.

translation.title: 广义张量并行：以 10+ EFLOP/s 算力驱动万亿参数 LLM 训练
translation.abstract: 预训练参数量高达数万亿的最先进大语言模型（LLM）对内存和算力的需求极高。现有并行化方案在单 GPU 内存或吞吐量上有所妥协：数据并行会复制参数；张量并行和全分片数据并行（FSDP）分别在每个 microbatch 中引入激活或参数的通信；流水线并行则在流水线填充和排空时使 GPU 空闲。我们证明，对于线性层，五种常用并行方式（数据并行、张量并行、序列并行、上下文并行和 FSDP）都是同一框架——广义张量并行（GTP）——的特例，其中每层的参数和激活被分区，且任一者都可在使用前通过 all-gather 重新物化。在 GTP 中，参数 all-gather 是矩阵乘法（GEMM）某一输入上的可选预处理步骤，而 FSDP 实现通常将其视为整个 Transformer 块之前的步骤，这可能增加内存占用并延迟 GEMM。GTP 视角使我们能够按 GEMM 而非按块调度 all-gather，使其发出得足够早以隐藏通信，又足够晚以限制内存。我们的实现已在 https URL 开源，借助它，一个内部 2T 参数的混合专家（MoE）模型在 12,288 块 GB300 GPU 上达到 13.0 model EFLOP/s（exaFLOP/s），弱扩展效率达 98%，并可在 512 块 GPU 上运行 1M token 序列。在 256-1,024 块 GPU 上，我们的实现在三个 MoE 模型上达到 Megatron-FSDP 吞吐量的 1.05-1.55 倍，并在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 代理模型上达到调优后的带流水线并行的 3D 并行方案的 1.27-1.31 倍。
translation.brief: 解决现有并行方案在内存与吞吐量之间难以兼顾的问题，核心方法是提出广义张量并行（GTP）框架，将五种并行方式统一为特例并按 GEMM 粒度调度 all-gather。

papers.title: Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs
papers.abstract: Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor's quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model's actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.

translation.title: 修正行为而非思维：前沿大语言模型的外科手术式微调
translation.abstract: 开源权重的大语言模型（LLM）是称职的软件工程师，但有时会在它们本有能力完成的任务上失败。这往往不是推理能力的缺陷，而是长轨迹中的几个小失误（重复执行已经失败的步骤，或在需求尚未满足时宣告任务完成）造成了差异。纠正这类问题需要一种外科手术式的权重更新，引导模型采取正确行动而不干扰其推理。这类更新通常通过 LoRA 适配器学习，但往往太小，在合并进发布检查点时难以保留。在我们的 BF16 发布版本中，权重变化的中位数仅为单个舍入步长的 1.5%，且合并会损失约三分之二的更新范数。当同一适配器合并进同一模型的混合 FP8/NVFP4 发布版本时，93% 的更新会消失。我们没有增大更新幅度，而是直接在存留部分上进行训练。我们提出了合并感知微调（merge-aware fine-tuning）。标准 LoRA 仅在导出时才将合并后的权重舍入到存储格式，因此损失函数从未见过舍入后的权重。我们则在每一步训练中都将基础权重与适配器更新之和舍入到发布格式，保留厂商的量化缩放因子，并在这些权重上计算损失。前向传播与推理引擎的数值完全一致，梯度直接穿过舍入操作，因此我们训练的模型就是我们发布的模型。损失函数只优化模型的行为，并使其推理保持接近基础模型。应用于 Nemotron-3.5，该方案在 BF16 和 NVFP4 发布版本上都提升了智能体编程能力，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最高提升 8.4 分，并且我们公开发布了这两个模型。
translation.brief: 针对 LoRA 微调更新在量化合并时大量丢失的问题，提出合并感知微调，在每步训练中直接对舍入到发布格式的权重计算损失，从而只修正模型行为而不损害推理。

papers.title: Efficient Semantic ORDER BY via Transitivity-Aware LLM Batch Sorting
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable declarative semantic sorting through LLM-ORDER BY operators that rank tuples according to natural-language criteria over unstructured data. Executing such operators efficiently is challenging because LLM comparisons are expensive, stochastic, and sometimes inconsistent. Pairwise approaches require many costly calls. Listwise approaches such as external merge sort rank several items per call, but they follow a fixed merge schedule and keep no record of earlier answers: each merge call re-asks orderings that previous calls have already revealed, directly or by transitivity. We present Transitive Batched Sort (TBS), a transitivity-aware physical operator for semantic sorting that records every revealed preference in a global acyclic preference graph and issues a listwise request only for items whose relative order is not yet implied. To scale, TBS stores only directly observed preferences and answers transitivity queries through a memory-efficient reachability index; to handle noisy LLM outputs, it validates responses and rejects cycle-inducing updates. We evaluate TBS on six benchmarks spanning structured sorting, product price ranking, passage ranking, and personalized recommendation with four LLMs. TBS reduces API calls by 12-20x relative to pairwise quicksort and, at the same batch size, uses 1.1-1.6x fewer calls and 1.3-5.3x lower cost than listwise merge sort while achieving competitive or higher ranking quality across most benchmarks; on Amazon it scales to one million products. These results show that reusing previously inferred preference relations, rather than re-querying them, is an effective foundation for scalable semantic ORDER BY operators.

translation.title: 基于传递性感知的 LLM 批量排序的高效语义 ORDER BY
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通过 LLM-ORDER BY 算子实现声明式语义排序，根据自然语言标准对非结构化数据上的元组进行排名。高效执行此类算子极具挑战性，因为 LLM 比较代价高昂、具有随机性且有时不一致。成对方法需要大量昂贵的调用。列表式方法（如外部归并排序）每次调用可对多个条目排名，但遵循固定的归并调度且不记录先前的答案：每次归并调用都会重新询问之前调用已直接或通过传递性揭示的排序关系。我们提出传递性感知批量排序（Transitive Batched Sort, TBS），一种传递性感知的语义排序物理算子，它将每条已揭示的偏好记录在全局无环偏好图中，仅对相对顺序尚未被隐含确定的条目发出列表式请求。为提升可扩展性，TBS 仅存储直接观测到的偏好，并通过内存高效的可达性索引回答传递性查询；为处理 LLM 的噪声输出，它验证响应并拒绝会导致环的更新。我们在六个基准上评估 TBS，涵盖结构化排序、商品价格排名、段落排序和个性化推荐，使用四个 LLM。与成对快速排序相比，TBS 将 API 调用减少 12-20 倍；在相同批大小下，比列表式归并排序少用 1.1-1.6 倍调用、成本低 1.3-5.3 倍，同时在大多数基准上取得相当或更高的排名质量；在 Amazon 数据集上可扩展到一百万件商品。这些结果表明，复用先前推断出的偏好关系而非重新查询，是构建可扩展语义 ORDER BY 算子的有效基础。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 语义排序中重复询问已知偏好导致调用开销过高的问题，提出 TBS 算子，用全局偏好图记录并复用已揭示的排序关系，仅对未确定顺序的条目发起批量查询。

papers.title: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
papers.abstract: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

translation.title: ExpGuard：保护长程 LLM 智能体免受受损经验的侵害
translation.abstract: 长程大语言模型（LLM）智能体会将过往轨迹提炼为可复用的经验。源轨迹中的误导性或对抗性指导可能污染这些经验，使有害指令跨任务持续存在并影响智能体未来的行动。评估潜在受损经验的风险面临三个挑战：（1）在经验复用前建模来源与执行依赖关系，（2）从轨迹结果中学习任务条件化的风险，（3）在在线推理时修复有风险的经验。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ExpGuard，一个检索触发的经验风险评估与在线修复框架。具体而言，针对挑战（1），ExpGuard 将经验语义与来源和执行依赖关系整合到任务条件化的异构图中，在经验复用前预测攻击风险和任务失败风险。为实现任务条件化的风险监督并应对挑战（2），我们对每条原始经验及其来自同一任务和环境检查点的最小中和对应版本进行匹配的反事实重放，从攻击成功与合法任务完成的差异中分别导出风险标签。为在推理时应对挑战（3），ExpGuard 在检索时修复被基于图的预测器标记为高风险的候选经验，并在其进入智能体的活跃经验上下文之前重新预测其风险。大量实验表明，ExpGuard 在识别有风险的经验和防御经验污染方面非常有效。
translation.brief: 针对长程 LLM 智能体经验库可能被误导性或对抗性轨迹污染的问题，提出 ExpGuard，用任务条件化异构图预测经验风险，并通过反事实重放生成风险标签、在检索时在线修复高风险经验。

papers.title: Automated Smoke Testing for Multi-ending Game Quests via Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Modern game quests are increasingly trending toward high freedom and multiple endings, making their design and testing more complex. Smoke testing in games aims to rapidly validate quest functionality, but existing automated testing approaches face critical limitations when handling quests with branching narratives, and multiple possible endings. These challenges result in insufficient exploration of endings, redundant action sequences, and prohibitively high interaction costs. To address these challenges, we propose EndWeaver, an automated smoke testing framework specifically designed for multi-ending game tasks. EndWeaver leverages LLMs to interpret quest descriptions and game environments, generating high-level methods to guide global exploration, complemented by the generated primitive task sequences for fine-grained planning. By combining this multi-level planning structure with the dynamic construction of state-transition graphs, EndWeaver ensures comprehensive coverage of all possible endings and enables efficient testing. We evaluated EndWeaver on four game environments---Mini RPG, Overcooked Plus, Minecraft, and PySC2 against baseline methods. In all environments, EndWeaver achieved stable quest completion with high reliability, significantly outperforming the baselines. In terms of testing cost, EndWeaver required only a few thousand steps, while baseline methods required millions of steps, all while ensuring comprehensive coverage of all possible quest endings. Ablation studies further demonstrated the critical contributions of each framework component, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our approach.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的多结局游戏任务自动化冒烟测试
translation.abstract: 现代游戏任务日益趋向高自由度和多结局，使其设计与测试更加复杂。游戏中的冒烟测试旨在快速验证任务功能，但现有自动化测试方法在处理具有分支叙事和多种可能结局的任务时面临关键局限。这些挑战导致结局探索不充分、动作序列冗余以及过高的交互成本。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EndWeaver，一个专为多结局游戏任务设计的自动化冒烟测试框架。EndWeaver 利用 LLM 解读任务描述和游戏环境，生成高层方法以引导全局探索，并辅以生成的原语任务序列进行细粒度规划。通过将这种多层次规划结构与状态转移图的动态构建相结合，EndWeaver 确保对所有可能结局的全面覆盖并实现高效测试。我们在四个游戏环境——Mini RPG、Overcooked Plus、Minecraft 和 PySC2——上针对基线方法评估了 EndWeaver。在所有环境中，EndWeaver 都以高可靠性稳定完成任务，显著优于基线。在测试成本方面，EndWeaver 仅需数千步，而基线方法需要数百万步，同时确保全面覆盖所有可能的任务结局。消融研究进一步证明了框架各组件的关键贡献，验证了我们方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 针对多结局游戏任务自动化测试中结局覆盖不足、交互成本过高的问题，提出 EndWeaver，用 LLM 生成高层探索方法与原语任务序列的多层规划，并结合动态状态转移图实现全结局覆盖。

papers.title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

translation.title: Clinical3D-Bench：评估与提升多模态大语言模型在医院环境中的空间智能
translation.abstract: 医院中的空间推理需要追踪外观相似的设备、解读相对于患者的方向以及判断通道宽度，但现有基准对这些能力的覆盖有限。我们提出 Clinical3D-Bench，一个模拟基准，包含 3,368 道八种类型的问题，基于 373 个病房布局的第一人称行走视频。布局遵循医院设计指南，答案由 3D 场景计算得出，配对的场景状态用于检验模型是否会在相关证据变化时改变答案。视频具有照片级真实感，并由十位医生对布局进行筛选。在 35 个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，最好的开源和专有模型分别达到 45.7% 和 53.6% 的宏平均准确率，而答案先验为 40.8%，医生在一个子集上为 79.0%；32 个开源模型中有 27 个在双向患者相对方向上得分低于 40%。在我们包含 44,750 道题的训练集 Clinical3D-45K 上微调后，两个 MLLM 比最好的专有模型高出 16-20 分。提供给微调后 MLLM 的 3D 地图输入基本未被利用：即使将其替换为另一段视频的地图（甚至是真值），其准确率也几乎不变。我们提出的 GeoJeV 则让 MLLM 真正用 3D 进行计算：它从每段视频重建场景记忆，根据 MLLM 的问题状态选择 3D 操作及其参数，并将其证据加到选项得分上。它取得了所有被评估模型中最高的准确率，缩小了与医生的差距。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 在医院场景空间推理能力不足且微调后仍不真正利用 3D 输入的问题，构建 Clinical3D-Bench 基准并提出 GeoJeV，通过重建场景记忆并选择 3D 操作将几何证据融入选项评分。

papers.title: GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

translation.title: GUI-PRISM：面向GUI智能体的高效动作解码
translation.abstract: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体将截图和用户指令转化为可执行动作。现有方法大多依赖视觉-语言模型以文本形式生成动作，由于自回归解码往往带来显著的推理延迟。为解决这一低效问题，我们提出GUI-PRISM，一种混合动作解码器，可直接预测动作类型和结构化参数，同时保留对开放式文本的语言生成能力。与主要关注目标定位的现有空间解码方法不同，GUI-PRISM将直接预测扩展到动作类型及其相关参数，实现完整的GUI动作预测。具体而言，GUI-PRISM采用字段特定查询从共享的多模态特征库中提取与动作相关的语义和空间信息，并通过条件查询建模动作组件之间的依赖关系，再利用门控残差交叉注意力以细粒度多模态信息精炼这些预测。GUI-PRISM在ScreenSpot-v2上达到95.1%的准确率，超过最强的基于head的空间解码方法2.0个百分点，同时相比基线实现3.8倍推理加速。在AndroidControl-v2和MM-Mind2Web-v2上，它分别将完整动作准确率提升4.8和0.7个百分点，并实现2.7倍和3.9倍的推理加速。代码已发布于项目页面。
translation.brief: 解决GUI智能体自回归文本解码推理延迟高的问题，提出混合动作解码器直接预测动作类型与结构化参数并保留语言生成。

papers.title: RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions.
