To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

translation.title: RISE：基于隐式状态嵌入的GUI智能体推理
translation.abstract: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体将用户指令和截图转化为可执行动作。为学习可执行动作，现有方法在训练中往往依赖显式推理，这导致过度依赖特定推理模式而非可泛化的动作相关信息。本文提出隐式框架RISE，将与动作相关的推理融入隐式状态表示以指导GUI动作预测。为此，通过三个互补的监督目标捕捉动作相关推理：全CoT状态对齐在推理过程中保留信息，动作分布对齐编码动作偏好，推理-动作边界对齐捕捉动作生成前的即时表示。由此，RISE有效学习到信息丰富的隐式表示，从而提升下一动作token预测的准确率。RISE在OSWorld-G上达到70.6%的准确率，在所比较的8B模型中建立最先进性能，较其骨干模型提升4.3个百分点。在两种不同骨干模型和六个多样化基准上的结果进一步证明了其在GUI定位和动作预测中的有效性。代码已发布于项目页面。
translation.brief: 解决GUI智能体显式推理导致过拟合特定推理模式的问题，提出通过三个对齐监督目标将动作相关推理融入隐式状态表示。

papers.title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
papers.abstract: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -> Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R->T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.

translation.title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA：将异构大语言模型转化为流形解耦的毫米波雷达世界模型
translation.abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到毫米波（mmWave）雷达，可实现跨黑暗、烟雾和墙壁的隐私保护、全天候物理场景理解。然而，标准指令微调将连续雷达流视为静态的类文本token，导致近乎随机的全局雷达-文本检索，以及在传感器中断下严重的物理漂移。相反，将成对对比损失（如SigLIP）直接耦合到共享骨干中虽能改善检索，但会注入O(B^2)的排斥梯度，破坏连续坐标流形（R^2 < 0）。我们提出PhysRF-WorldJEPA，一种流形解耦的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），将连续电磁状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离。无衰减的1.0x时钟锚点和并行双尺度RF编码器为仅约3% LoRA的精简LLM提供输入，该LLM通过两步状态空间EMA-JEPA（去噪->推演）和样本轴Batch-VICReg训练以预测+3.0秒的物理状态；随后一个停止梯度对齐头通过假阴性掩码将冻结的提示状态映射到文本超球面。在一个包含4,541个窗口、跨三个频段（77/60.25/60 GHz）、对比10个基线的测试套件上，冻结物理骨干仅训练解耦头，将R->T R@10从5.95%提升至15.01%，MedRank从107.0改善至60.0，同时保持完全相同的物理读出性能：3.37度（R^2=+0.961）的中断后+3.0秒躯干倾斜，1.89米（R^2=+0.679；RF前端为1.19米/+0.863）的杂波环境UAV高度，2.04米（R^2=+0.461）的墙后NLOS测距，0.9976的虚拟RIS不变性，以及100%的跌倒召回率。在五个0.5B-1.8B LLM家族（15个零开销模型）上，World-JEPA在10/10次运行中改善检索和75%丢弃补全，并在4/5（Span-Euc）、2/5（Scatter）和5/5（各家族最优）中优于SFT的中断倾斜性能。
translation.brief: 解决LLM处理毫米波雷达时物理状态预测与跨模态对齐相互干扰的问题，提出流形解耦的JEPA架构分离连续电磁状态预测与语言对齐。

papers.title: CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering
papers.abstract: Episodic-memory embodied question answering enables agents to answer questions based on previously recorded visual observations of the surrounding scenes. However, growing observation histories, varying observation quality across viewpoints, and limited computational resources make it challenging to construct and maintain compact visual memories while retrieving sufficient evidence for question answering. To address these challenges, we introduce CoverMem, which incorporates three key components: (1) a coverage-constrained memory construction method that selects a compact set of informative full frames satisfying object-quality and representative-scene coverage requirements; (2) a coverage-preserving incremental maintenance strategy that locally reselects only the affected frames to satisfy updated coverage requirements as observations arrive; and (3) a budgeted complementary frame selection method that balances question relevance, additional support for question requirements, and redundancy with selected frames within a fixed budget. Experimental results on three benchmarks covering diverse environments and question types demonstrate that CoverMem improves question-answering performance under limited visual budgets.

translation.title: CoverMem：面向预算受限具身问答的覆盖约束视觉记忆
translation.abstract: 情景记忆具身问答使智能体能够基于先前记录的周围场景视觉观察来回答问题。然而，不断增长的观察历史、不同视角下观察质量的差异以及有限的计算资源，使得在为问答检索充分证据的同时构建和维护紧凑视觉记忆变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出CoverMem，包含三个关键组件：（1）覆盖约束的记忆构建方法，选择满足对象质量和代表性场景覆盖要求的紧凑信息完整帧集合；（2）覆盖保持的增量维护策略，随着观察到来，仅对受影响的帧进行局部重选以满足更新的覆盖要求；（3）预算约束的互补帧选择方法，在固定预算内平衡问题相关性、对问题需求的额外支持以及与已选帧的冗余度。在涵盖多样环境和问题类型的三个基准上的实验结果表明，CoverMem在有限视觉预算下提升了问答性能。
translation.brief: 解决具身问答中观察历史膨胀与计算预算受限下难以构建紧凑视觉记忆的问题，提出覆盖约束的记忆构建、增量维护与预算内互补帧选择方法。

papers.title: SCOPE: Evaluating and Enhancing Permission Explanation Transparency in Mobile Apps
papers.abstract: Permission explanations, explanatory text accompanying mobile app permission requests, are crucial for user privacy transparency and informed consent. Despite their importance, current practices often fall short of regulatory expectations due to the lack of systematic evaluation mechanisms. Through an empirical study of 600 mainstream mobile apps, we reveal widespread deficiencies: 15\% of permission requests provide no explanation, others use vague language or technical jargon, and critically, many fail to disclose third-party SDK data access despite these components actively using granted permissions. To address these transparency gaps, we present SCOPE, an automated multi-agent framework that systematically evaluates permission explanation compliance and generates targeted optimization recommendations. SCOPE employs four specialized agents working collaboratively: multimodal LLM-based explanation extraction, few-shot learning-based linguistic analysis, dynamic API-based purpose inference, and adaptive report generation. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates SCOPE's effectiveness, achieving 98\% accuracy in explanation extraction, 93.5\% consistency in compliance analysis, and 92\% accuracy in purpose inference. A user study with 30 participants shows 84.6\% preference for SCOPE-optimized explanations, confirming practical utility. Our work provides the first systematic analysis of permission explanation practices and establishes a scalable solution for enhancing mobile app privacy transparency.

translation.title: SCOPE：评估与增强移动应用的权限解释透明度
translation.abstract: 权限解释是伴随移动应用权限请求的说明性文本，对用户隐私透明度和知情同意至关重要。尽管其重要性显著，由于缺乏系统性评估机制，当前实践往往达不到监管期望。通过对600款主流移动应用的实证研究，我们揭示了普遍存在的缺陷：15%的权限请求未提供任何解释，其他应用使用模糊语言或技术术语，更关键的是，许多应用在第三方SDK积极使用已授予权限的情况下却未披露其数据访问。为弥补这些透明度差距，我们提出SCOPE，一个自动化多智能体框架，系统评估权限解释合规性并生成针对性优化建议。SCOPE采用四个专业智能体协同工作：基于多模态LLM的解释提取、基于少样本学习的语言分析、基于动态API的目的推断，以及自适应报告生成。全面评估表明SCOPE的有效性：解释提取准确率达98%，合规分析一致性达93.5%，目的推断准确率达92%。一项30名参与者的用户研究显示84.6%的用户偏好SCOPE优化的解释，证实了其实用性。我们的工作首次对权限解释实践进行系统分析，并建立了提升移动应用隐私透明度的可扩展解决方案。
translation.brief: 解决移动应用权限解释缺乏系统评估且透明度不足（含第三方SDK数据访问未披露）的问题，提出多智能体自动化框架评估合规性并生成优化建议。

papers.title: LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance
papers.abstract: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. We propose a three-stage framework LARF (Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance): it first performs cold-start SFT on strategically selected samples with multi-agent guided CoT rationales, then applies discriminative GRPO with attribute-wise, list-wise, and rule-consistency rewards together with a margin loss on the terminal relevance token, and finally distills the teacher into a dual-head student whose classification heads are retained for non-autoregressive inference. On a human-annotated web search relevance benchmark with approximately 300K training and 16K test instances, LARF-8B improves six-class classification accuracy by 5.78 percentage points and NDCG by 5.05 points, while the classification-only serving path reduces inference latency by 82.9\%. These results indicate that aligning structured reasoning, terminal decision optimization, and classification-head distillation can provide an effective accuracy--efficiency trade-off for industrial search relevance modeling.

translation.title: LARF：面向搜索相关性的对齐学习推理框架
translation.abstract: 查询-文档相关性估计是AI原生搜索系统的核心组件，模型需要在复杂的多维标准下评估检索到的文档是否满足用户的信息需求。然而，直接将大语言模型（LLM）应用于该任务仍然具有挑战性，因为传统的监督微调（SFT）对领域特定的判断依据提供的监督有限，而标准的轨迹级强化学习（RL）目标无法在相邻的有序相关性标签之间显式地强制间隔分离。此外，尽管这类推理在训练期间可能有用，但思维链（CoT）推理对于延迟敏感的在线排序并不实际。这些挑战使得模糊的决策边界难以解决。我们提出了一个三阶段框架LARF（Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance）：首先在策略性选取的样本上使用多智能体引导的CoT依据进行冷启动SFT，然后应用判别式GRPO，结合逐属性、列表级和规则一致性奖励以及作用于最终相关性token的间隔损失，最后将教师模型蒸馏到双头学生模型，保留其分类头用于非自回归推理。在一个包含约30万训练样本和1.6万测试样本的人工标注网页搜索相关性基准上，LARF-8B将六分类准确率提升5.78个百分点，NDCG提升5.05点，而仅分类的服务路径将推理延迟降低82.9%。这些结果表明，将结构化推理、终端决策优化和分类头蒸馏对齐，可以为工业搜索相关性建模提供有效的精度-效率权衡。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM搜索相关性判断中监督不足、有序标签边界模糊及CoT推理延迟高的问题，提出SFT冷启动、带间隔损失的判别式GRPO和分类头蒸馏的三阶段框架LARF。

papers.title: Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract: Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Building on this analysis, we show that a single token-level KL anchor on the high tier is sufficient to learn separated tiers within one RL stage, and that natural-language effort instructions make this separation emerge from the start of training, yielding a policy competitive with multi-teacher OPD at matched thinking length. Finally, the separation built by dense targets holds only on the states seen in training: it does not carry over to unseen agentic tasks, where effort acts mainly through the number of interaction turns, whereas the compression induced by sequence-level rewards does.

translation.title: 重新思考大语言模型的推理努力训练：On-Policy蒸馏还是强化学习？
translation.abstract: 大语言模型在复杂任务上展现出强大能力，但如何控制其推理努力仍是实际部署中的一项重大挑战。本文对推理努力训练进行了系统性研究，对比了强化学习（RL）与on-policy蒸馏（OPD）。我们发现，压缩推理和划分努力层级受不同信号支配。带长度惩罚的RL能可靠地压缩单一策略，在AIME25上减少70%的思考量而不损失准确率，但在联合训练多个层级时会使层级崩溃。多教师OPD则能实现层级分离：在33个基准上，低、中层级比高层级分别少用58%和43%的思考token，而高层级比参考策略提升3.1分。我们将这一差异归因于训练信号：序列级奖励无法区分层级特定行为与共享行为，而OPD在每个访问到的状态（包括停止决策）都提供层级特定的目标。基于这一分析，我们证明仅在高层级上使用单个token级KL锚点就足以在单个RL阶段内学习到分离的层级，且自然语言的努力指令使这种分离从训练一开始就出现，在相同思考长度下产生与多教师OPD相竞争的策略。最后，由密集目标构建的层级分离仅在训练中见过的状态上成立：它无法迁移到未见过的agentic任务，在这些任务中努力主要通过交互轮数起作用，而序列级奖励诱导的压缩则可以迁移。
translation.brief: 该论文研究如何控制LLM的推理努力层级，发现序列级RL奖励无法实现层级分离而OPD可以，并提出token级KL锚点与自然语言努力指令使RL也能学到分离的层级。

papers.title: RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences
papers.abstract: Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one matching and multiplicative gating. RightDiff achieves state-of-the-art preference modeling performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench, surpassing all open-source reward models and leading proprietary LLM judges. Downstream, it provides reliable supervision for direct preference optimization on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval while effectively resisting length shortcuts.

translation.title: RightDiff：通过正确的差异进行判断的学习型生成式奖励模型
translation.abstract: 生成式奖励模型通常依赖通用的查询级评分标准或无约束的推理过程，忽视了成对偏好实际上由响应特定的差异驱动这一事实。此外，仅针对结果正确性进行优化会促使模型利用冗长和格式等表面捷径，引发推理漂移。为此，我们提出RightDiff，将成对评估结构化为在单次自回归生成中执行的基于证据的评估轨迹。RightDiff显式地发现候选之间的对比差异，将其归类为实质性或非实质性因素，并在最终裁决前归纳出针对该对的评分标准。为了在不进行事后合理化的情况下训练这一过程，我们通过响应隔离的提示合成示范数据，并以差异对齐奖励优化奖励模型，同时用预算约束的一对一匹配和乘法门控进行正则化。RightDiff在RewardBench和RM-Bench上取得了最先进的偏好建模性能，超越所有开源奖励模型并领先于专有LLM裁判。在下游任务中，它为Arena-Hard和AlpacaEval上的直接偏好优化提供可靠监督，同时有效抵御长度捷径。
translation.brief: 该论文解决生成式奖励模型忽视响应间具体差异并易受表面捷径影响的问题，提出在单次自回归生成中显式发现并分类对比差异、以差异对齐奖励训练的RightDiff。

papers.title: DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations
papers.abstract: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text this http URL also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

translation.title: DocPristine：真实世界混合退化下的内容感知文档外观增强
translation.abstract: 相机拍摄的文档常常呈现混合退化，如高光、阴影和模糊，这些退化会扭曲背景并遮蔽文本细节。文档外观增强（DAE）旨在缓解这些退化并提高可读性。现有的文档外观增强方法要么依赖在严重退化下可能变得不可靠的输入衍生视觉线索，要么依赖缺乏空间引导的基于LLM的退化诊断。值得注意的是，我们发现预训练的文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍会关注文本区域，从而提供内容感知的引导。基于这一洞察，我们提出DocPristine，它自适应地融合来自冻结文档视觉编码器的多层特征，并将其注入像素修复网络。为了将这些特征整合到像素修复网络中，DocPristine结合了自适应多层特征融合（AMFF）、分层门控条件化（HGC）和移位窗口交叉注意力（SWCA）。具体而言，SWCA利用跨窗口边界的相邻位置的结构线索来恢复精细文本。我们还引入了DocACE数据集，包含一个合成混合退化训练集（DocACE-Synthetic）和一个包含人工修复的真实图像及文档解析标注的真实世界测试集（DocACE-Real）。在三个基准上的全面实验表明，DocPristine实现了最先进的外观增强质量，并持续提升下游文档解析性能。代码、模型和数据将公开。
translation.brief: 该论文解决真实混合退化下文档外观增强中视觉线索不可靠的问题，提出利用冻结文档视觉编码器的多层特征并通过AMFF、HGC和SWCA注入像素修复网络的DocPristine。

papers.title: LLM Agent Authorization Across Context Compaction
papers.abstract: Request-derived authorizers such as Progent protect LLM agents from prompt injection by deriving what an agent may do from the user's request. Their guarantee rests on attribution: the request is taken to be what the user said. Compaction breaks it. At every automatic compaction we observed, Claude Code and Codex placed a model-written summary of earlier turns as a user message, so the compactor's quotation of the user, documents and injected text reads as the user speaking. Because a policy frozen at the first request lets the agent finish few later tasks, we let Progent derive its policy for each request, and find that what it grants then follows what the compactor wrote. Even a payee the user stated is not safe: when an attacker's notice states another account as plain data and the user asks to pay the rent, the policy derived from a frontier compactor's summary admits the notice's account in 91% of cases, and the one derived from the user's own words in none. The cause is general: we prove that an authorizer that cannot see who wrote which bytes cannot treat a forged record differently from the legitimate one it imitates by more than the two are distinguishable, and that the bound is tight. Frontier compactors bear this out: they mark injected instructions, which have no legitimate twin, but rarely injected data, which does. What a compactor keeps, and how it marks it, is a security parameter. The fix follows from attribution: the authorizer credits only what the user said, authenticated on arrival and carried verbatim across the boundary, while the agent still reads the summary. We prove that it then receives exactly that text or nothing, so an attacker can block the policy but cannot shape it, and adaptive attacks on our implementation confirm it. In 40 attacked AgentDojo episodes re-run with the fix, no attacker action completes while the agent reads the summary.

translation.title: 跨上下文压缩的LLM智能体授权
translation.abstract: 诸如Progent等基于请求派生的授权器通过从用户请求派生智能体可执行的操作来保护LLM智能体免受提示注入攻击。其保证依赖于归因：请求被视为用户所说的话。而压缩破坏了这一点。在我们观察到的每一次自动压缩中，Claude Code和Codex都会将模型生成的早期对话摘要作为用户消息插入，因此压缩器对用户话语、文档和注入文本的引用会被读作用户本人在说话。由于在首个请求时冻结的策略会让智能体无法完成后续任务，我们让Progent为每个请求派生策略，发现其授予的权限随后跟随压缩器所写的内容。即使是用户明确指明的收款人也不安全：当攻击者的通知以纯数据形式写明另一个账户，而用户要求支付房租时，由前沿压缩器摘要派生的策略在91%的情况下接受通知中的账户，而由用户原话派生的策略则从不接受。其原因是普遍性的：我们证明，一个无法分辨哪些字节由谁写入的授权器，对伪造记录与其模仿的合法记录的区分能力不会超过两者本身的可区分程度，且该界是紧的。前沿压缩器证实了这一点：它们会标记注入的指令（没有合法的对应物），但很少标记注入的数据（有合法对应物）。压缩器保留什么以及如何标记它，是一个安全参数。修复方法源于归因：授权器只认可用户所说的话，在到达时进行认证并跨边界原样传递，而智能体仍可读取摘要。我们证明此时智能体要么收到确切的原文，要么什么都收不到，因此攻击者可以阻止策略但无法塑造策略，对我们实现的适应性攻击也证实了这一点。在使用修复方案重跑的40个受攻击的AgentDojo场景中，智能体读取摘要期间没有任何攻击者操作完成。
translation.brief: 该论文解决上下文压缩破坏LLM智能体授权归因导致提示注入攻击的问题，提出仅认证并原样传递用户原话作为授权依据、同时允许智能体读取摘要的修复方案。

papers.title: When Answering Is Administering: Permission Replies That Rewrite Coding-Agent Policy
papers.abstract: Coding agents let plugins and remote services answer permission prompts, and Claude Code documents that such an answer cannot override the operator's deny rules. However, we show that this guarantee, checked one decision at a time, fails over a whole run, because an answer to one permission prompt can rewrite the policy that every later answer is checked against. For example, a remote service with no access to the operator's files approves an unrelated command and attaches an update that deletes the deny rule protecting the project's secrets. The agent then reads the secrets in that session and the next, even inside the vendor's strict sandbox. The root cause is that Claude Code checks only updates that add or replace allow rules. Relays that forward such deletions already exist, including the vendor's own Remote Control. In effect, the right to answer a prompt has become the right to administer the policy. Worse, the deletion leaves the same records as a local edit by the operator, so Claude Code cannot tell who wrote a rule. More generally, what a runtime records decides what it can safely delegate. A runtime that cannot tell who wrote a rule can accept only updates that keep every currently denied call denied, whereas, to protect every party's restrictions, a runtime that records who wrote each rule can let each party remove only the restrictions proven to be its own. We prove that these two bounds are tight. They correctly predict whether the operator's restrictions survive in all thirteen permission designs across ten agent systems, including predictions we wrote down before running Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, and Goose. Enforcing the bounds at the shared update step blocks the attack. A survey of 2,227 fetched marketplace plugins finds only two that send policy updates.

translation.title: 当回答变成管理：会改写编码智能体策略的权限回复
translation.abstract: 编码智能体允许插件和远程服务回答权限提示，且 Claude Code 文档声明此类回答不能覆盖操作者的拒绝规则。然而我们证明，这一逐次决策检查的保证在整个运行过程中会失效，因为对某个权限提示的回答可以改写后续所有回答所依据的策略。例如，一个无法访问操作者文件的远程服务批准一条无关命令，并附带一个删除保护项目机密的拒绝规则的更新。随后智能体在本次及下一次会话中读取这些机密，即使是在厂商的严格沙箱内也是如此。根本原因在于 Claude Code 只检查添加或替换允许规则的更新，而转发此类删除的中继已经存在，包括厂商自己的 Remote Control。实际上，回答提示的权利已变成管理策略的权利。更糟的是，删除操作留下的记录与操作者本地编辑相同，因此 Claude Code 无法分辨规则由谁写入。更一般地说，运行时记录了什么决定了它能安全地委托什么。无法分辨规则写入者的运行时只能接受保持所有当前被拒绝调用仍被拒绝的更新；而记录了每条规则写入者的运行时，为保护各方的限制，可以让每方只删除被证明属于自己的限制。我们证明这两个界限是紧的。它们正确预测了十个智能体系统中全部十三种权限设计下操作者限制是否存续，包括我们在运行 Codex、Gemini CLI、opencode 和 Goose 之前写下的预测。在共享更新步骤强制执行这些界限可阻止该攻击。对 2,227 个已获取的 marketplace 插件的调查发现只有两个发送策略更新。
translation.brief: 针对远程服务通过回答权限提示改写 Claude Code 策略的攻击，提出基于运行时记录能力的两条紧致委托界限并在共享更新步骤强制执行以阻止攻击。

papers.title: What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting
papers.abstract: Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

translation.title: 改什么、留什么：面向视频重铸的经验演化智能体
translation.abstract: 视频重铸旨在将现有视频的实体和环境转换到新的视觉世界，同时保留其本质动作和交互。然而，实现连贯的转换仍然具有挑战性，因为协调编辑可能破坏原始事件结构。本文提出 RecastAgent，一个在冻结模型权重下运行的经验引导智能体框架，用于源条件视频重铸。该框架采用经验引导规划器（Experience-Guided Planner），在定性视觉评判下选择编辑提示和输入视频状态，使智能体能够在部分进展上继续构建或回溯以保留源结构。跨任务地，经验积累模块将已完成的轨迹提炼为条件化、有证据关联的原则，同时记录编辑策略及其有效范围。我们还构建了一个包含 67 个源视频、跨六个创意类别的 134 个配对规格任务的基准用于评估。实验表明，RecastAgent 在 Bernini 和 Ditto 上优于单次生成和智能体重写基线。此外，积累的经验提升了在留出测试视频上的性能，并可零样本迁移到 FiVE-Bench 和 VE-Bench 等外部基准。
translation.brief: 针对视频重铸中协调编辑破坏原事件结构的问题，提出冻结权重下经验引导的智能体框架 RecastAgent，通过经验积累与回溯机制选择编辑策略。

papers.title: Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection
papers.abstract: Recent information-theoretic filters for multi-label feature selection disagree on how to distribute relevance over labels: some amplify features that inform a few labels, others balance what every label receives. We show these choices are implicit social welfare functions. Treating labels as agents whose utility is the information they receive, we propose FLIC, which greedily maximises the $\alpha$-fair welfare of per-label information coverage. A single parameter $\alpha$ moves from utilitarian ($\alpha=0$) through proportionally fair ($\alpha=1$) to max-min selection ($\alpha\to\infty$), and a dozen published relevance terms lie on this axis, most as special cases, first-order approximations or limits. The objective is monotone submodular for every $\alpha\ge0$ whenever each label's information is, so greedy selection is a $(1-1/e)$-approximation; this fails for $\alpha<0$, and the max-min limit is inapproximable. Fano's and the Hellman-Raviv inequalities tie raw coverage to the Bayes Hamming loss and normalised coverage to per-label relative error. FLIC uses bias-corrected, label-wise conditional information and has no relevance-redundancy trade-off parameter. On 22 data sets, FLIC is the best of 14 information-theoretic filters on seven of nine metrics, winning 86 of 117 pairwise comparisons significantly and losing none significantly. Among 17 methods it ranks first on ranking loss, coverage and macro-AUC with two classifiers and has the best mean rank (narrowly with ML-kNN), while three embedded methods lead on Hamming loss, one-error and micro-F1.

translation.title: 信息归谁？用于多标签特征选择的 α-公平标签覆盖框架
translation.abstract: 近期基于信息论的多标签特征选择过滤器在如何将相关性分配给各标签上存在分歧：一些方法放大只对少数标签有信息量的特征，另一些则平衡每个标签获得的信息。我们指出这些选择是隐式的社会福利函数。将标签视为以所获信息为效用的智能体，我们提出 FLIC，它贪心地最大化每标签信息覆盖的 α-公平福利。单一参数 α 从功利主义（α=0）经比例公平（α=1）过渡到 max-min 选择（α→∞），十余种已发表的相关性度量都位于这一轴上，多数作为特例、一阶近似或极限。只要每个标签的信息是单调次模的，该目标对所有 α≥0 都是单调次模的，因此贪心选择具有 (1-1/e) 近似保证；α<0 时该保证失效，max-min 极限不可近似。Fano 和 Hellman-Raviv 不等式将原始覆盖与 Bayes Hamming 损失、归一化覆盖与每标签相对误差联系起来。FLIC 使用偏差校正的逐标签条件信息，且没有相关性-冗余权衡参数。在 22 个数据集上，FLIC 是 14 个信息论过滤器中在九项指标中的七项上最优者，在 117 次两两比较中显著获胜 86 次且无显著失败。在 17 个方法中，它在两个分类器下的 ranking loss、coverage 和 macro-AUC 上排名第一，并具有最佳平均排名（与 ML-kNN 差距很小），而三个嵌入式方法在 Hamming loss、one-error 和 micro-F1 上领先。
translation.brief: 针对多标签特征选择中相关性分配方式不统一的问题，提出 FLIC 框架，用单一 α 参数统一多种相关性度量并贪心最大化 α-公平的标签信息覆盖。

papers.title: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: this https URL and this https URL.

translation.title: OmniEVIE：面向多模态检索的证据向量信息嵌入
translation.abstract: 多模态检索需要匹配密集页面、细粒度实体、有序视频以及智能体工具和记忆。单向量嵌入丢失局部证据，交叉编码器需在线重读每个召回项，而未压缩的 late interaction 过大难以服务。我们提出 OmniEVIE，一个 4.5B 的多向量嵌入模型，用单一压缩索引和三阶段检索器覆盖文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具。每条记录最多存储 128 个维度为 64 的 int8 向量（9,472 字节，即每百万条记录 8.82 GiB），提供均值向量、1-bit 符号和 int8 多向量用于粗、中、细三阶段搜索，同时将每个命中定位到页面区域或视频区间。训练、合并、索引和检索协同设计：所有任务共享一种检索格式，三级证据检查消除假负例，动态采样跟随基线-教师差距，候选在训练期间用 ST-HAC 压缩以匹配索引，分阶段和专家模型按参数块合并，带噪声底限的显著性门控细化查询打分。在公开数据集上训练的 OmniEVIE 在 MMEB-V3（190 个任务）上得 60.68（完整 d=2048 序列）和 60.06（K128 x d64 int8 索引），在 MMEB-V2（78 个任务）上得 77.96，在 ViDoRe V3（48 个任务）上得 62.96。在 100 万和 500 万条记录上，单线程查询耗时 54.2 ms 和 120.2 ms（比精确 4096 维单向量搜索快 11.1 倍和 25.3 倍；比完整 int8 MaxSim 快 236 倍和 532 倍）。视频直接从帧编码而无需解析模型：在 QVHighlights（1,083 个查询）上，78.0% 的查询峰值落在标注片段内，返回区间（视频长度的 18%）与之相交的比例为 94.3%，而随机为 44.9%。权重和代码：this https URL 和 this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多模态检索中单向量丢证据、交叉编码器开销大、late interaction 存储过大的问题，提出压缩多向量嵌入模型 OmniEVIE，通过训练-索引协同设计实现高效三阶段检索。

papers.title: When the Miner is the Generator: Rethinking the Separation Axiom in LLM-Driven Data Mining
papers.abstract: The theoretical foundation of data mining implicitly relies on an unstated premise, the Separation Axiom (SA), which assumes that mining tools and the data being analyzed are epistemologically independent. However, this premise is increasingly challenged by the emergence of LLM-driven AI agents that actively participate in data generation. We argue that this shift leads to a new epistemic failure mode, which we term ontological self-reference, where discovered patterns may reflect the inductive biases of the tools rather than the underlying structure of the data. This raises fundamental concerns about the credibility of knowledge discovery and the risk of self-reinforcing epistemic loops, where inferred patterns may reflect model-internal biases rather than the underlying structure of the data. We therefore call for a rethinking of the data mining paradigm in the era of large language models, grounded in an SA-aware theoretical foundation and extended to system-level epistemic safeguards. We argue that such a shift is necessary to conceptually rearm the discipline, preventing future knowledge discovery from collapsing into self-justifying algorithmic echo chambers.

translation.title: 当挖掘者即生成者：反思 LLM 驱动数据挖掘中的分离公理
translation.abstract: 数据挖掘的理论基础隐式依赖一个未言明的前提——分离公理（Separation Axiom, SA），即假设挖掘工具与被分析数据在认识论上相互独立。然而，随着积极参与数据生成的 LLM 驱动 AI 智能体的出现，这一前提日益受到挑战。我们认为这种转变导致一种新的认识论失败模式，我们称之为本体论自指：发现的模式可能反映工具的归纳偏置而非数据的底层结构。这引发了对知识发现可信度的根本担忧，以及自我强化的认识论循环的风险，即推断出的模式可能反映模型内部偏置而非数据的底层结构。因此，我们呼吁在大语言模型时代重新思考数据挖掘范式，建立 SA 感知的理论基础，并扩展到系统级的认识论保障。我们认为这种转变对于在概念上重新武装该学科是必要的，可防止未来的知识发现坍缩为自我辩护的算法回音室。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体参与数据生成导致挖掘工具与数据不再独立的问题，提出以分离公理感知的理论基础和系统级认识论保障重构数据挖掘范式。

papers.title: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: XMind：基于跨记忆推理的LLM自动驾驶“三思而后行”
translation.abstract: 记忆增强的大语言模型（LLM）驾驶智能体可以复用过去的经验，但当交通状况变化时，先前学到的纠正往往难以迁移。一个关键局限在于现有记忆主要记录观察到的结果，几乎不提供关于替代动作的证据。我们提出XMind，一个无需训练的框架，通过跨记忆推理使基于LLM的驾驶能够“三思而后行”。XMind将近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆相结合。智能体首先根据当前上下文做出初始决策，然后将其与检索到的历史经验进行交叉核对。如果出现冲突，则在检索到的证据指导下做出第二次决策。为构建可靠的情景记忆，XMind通过在扰动交通条件下的反事实推演评估替代动作，并将验证后的结果存储为结构化的风险胶囊。这些胶囊通过联合匹配空间风险模式和场景语义来检索。在闭环高速公路仿真中，XMind取得了83.3%至93.3%的成功率，平均超过强基线6.6个百分点。在K-Risk上的评估进一步表明，在未见过的真实世界高风险交互中决策风险更低。消融研究证实了工作记忆、风险文本检索和反事实验证的互补收益。代码见此 https URL
translation.brief: 解决LLM驾驶智能体记忆中缺乏替代动作证据、经验难以迁移的问题，通过反事实推演构建风险胶囊情景记忆并进行跨记忆二次决策。

papers.title: PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $\Delta$Pose over the same horizon. The predicted $\Delta$Pose is composed with the current trajectory-level pose to obtain the future pose state, which is recursively propagated throughout navigation, forming a continuous geometric state evolution from past memory to future motion. Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling geometric state evolution, with PoseVLN outperforming the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate, respectively, using only single RGB observations.

translation.title: PoseVLN：面向视觉语言导航的几何状态演化学习
translation.abstract: 视觉语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在遵循自然语言指令的同时，关联过去的经验、当前的空间状态和未来的运动。近期方法通过长时程记忆、状态感知推理和未来预测来提升这些能力，但这些组件往往被分别建模，导致导航状态演化在时间上的关联不足。我们认为相机位姿为桥接过去、现在和未来状态提供了一种自然的几何表示。基于这一洞察，我们提出PoseVLN，一个位姿感知的VLN框架，联合学习导航决策和几何状态演化。PoseVLN在以回合为参照的坐标系中组织视觉记忆和当前观测，并在同一时间范围内联合预测接下来的K个导航动作和局部$\Delta$Pose。预测的$\Delta$Pose与当前轨迹级位姿组合得到未来位姿状态，并在整个导航过程中递归传播，形成从过去记忆到未来运动的连续几何状态演化。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val-Unseen划分上的实验证明了显式建模几何状态演化的有效性，PoseVLN仅使用单目RGB观测，成功率分别超过最强对比基线2.6和2.9个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决VLN中过去、现在与未来状态建模割裂的问题，以相机位姿为几何纽带联合预测导航动作与位姿演化。

papers.title: Disentangling Visual Dynamics for World Model Planning
papers.abstract: Visual world models enable planning through predictive latent states. However, entangled agent and exogenous dynamics can obscure task progress. Disentangling visual dynamics for planning requires addressing two challenges: 1) suppressing cross-factor interference while retaining useful information; and 2) linking factors to task-relevant signals, since stability alone does not ensure meaningful planning distances. Therefore, we introduce FactorWorld, a disentangled visual dynamics framework for world model planning. To separate agent and exogenous dynamics, we propose a Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer (CCRF) guided by bidirectional counterfactual pairs. CCRF separates shared context from dynamic residuals, combining average and worst-partner constraints to suppress interference with state and motion supervision to retain useful information. To translate these factors into planning decisions, we introduce semantic routing to refine full-representation task predictions for state estimation, trajectory scoring, and task-adapted planning. Experiments on MiniGrid, MetaDrive, and CARLA show improved bidirectional factor stability across two backbones. On MiniGrid, factor routing raises mean SR from 78.80% to 82.40%. Across four continuous control tasks, including Push-T, FactorWorld achieves mean success rates ranging from 91.67% to 100% across tasks. These results demonstrate that combining decoupled visual dynamics with explicit tasks can significantly improve the planning capabilities of world models.

translation.title: 解耦视觉动力学以用于世界模型规划
translation.abstract: 视觉世界模型通过预测性潜在状态实现规划。然而，智能体动力学与外源性动力学的纠缠可能掩盖任务进展。为规划而解耦视觉动力学需要应对两个挑战：1）在抑制跨因子干扰的同时保留有用信息；2）将各因子与任务相关信号关联，因为稳定性本身并不能保证有意义的规划距离。因此，我们提出FactorWorld，一个面向世界模型规划的解耦视觉动力学框架。为分离智能体与外源性动力学，我们提出由双向反事实对引导的反事实共识残差因子分解器（CCRF）。CCRF将共享上下文与动态残差分离，结合平均与最差伙伴约束来抑制干扰，并通过状态与运动监督保留有用信息。为将这些因子转化为规划决策，我们引入语义路由来细化全表示的任务预测，用于状态估计、轨迹评分和任务自适应规划。在MiniGrid、MetaDrive和CARLA上的实验显示，在两个骨干网络上双向因子稳定性均得到提升。在MiniGrid上，因子路由将平均成功率从78.80%提升至82.40%。在包括Push-T在内的四个连续控制任务上，FactorWorld在各任务上取得91.67%至100%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，将解耦的视觉动力学与显式任务相结合可以显著提升世界模型的规划能力。
translation.brief: 解决世界模型中智能体与外源性动力学纠缠影响规划的问题，通过反事实共识残差因子分解和语义路由实现解耦与任务对齐。

papers.title: SkillCore: Internalizing Generalizable Skills via Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Runtime skills can improve agents' problem-solving capabilities by providing procedural guidance for tasks such as code review and debugging. However, these benefits reach only a minority of users, as most do not proactively invoke skills in practice. We argue that such generalizable procedures should become part of the model's capabilities rather than remain optional external add-ons, making them directly available without explicit skill loading. To this end, we present SkillCore, a data pipeline and supervised fine-tuning recipe for internalizing generalizable skills. We transform real agent trajectories by removing skill-loading scaffolding while preserving the task context and subsequent agent actions, thereby supervising direct execution without external skill content. To preserve access to task-specific skills that provide genuinely external information, we mix these scaffold-removed trajectories with a small proportion of skill-native trajectories that preserve supervision for skill invocation. On a held-out skill-free evaluation, SkillCore improves task completion quality over the base Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-72B models by 54.4% and 24.8%, respectively, while preserving task-specific skill invocation on a separate probe and general coding performance on SWE-bench Verified.

translation.title: SkillCore：通过去除脚手架微调内化可泛化技能
translation.abstract: 运行时技能可以通过为代码审查和调试等任务提供程序性指导来提升智能体的问题解决能力。然而，这些收益只能惠及少数用户，因为大多数用户在实践中不会主动调用技能。我们认为，这类可泛化的程序应当成为模型能力的一部分，而非可选的外部附加组件，使其无需显式加载技能即可直接使用。为此，我们提出SkillCore，一个用于内化可泛化技能的数据流水线和监督微调方案。我们通过移除技能加载脚手架、同时保留任务上下文和后续智能体动作来转换真实智能体轨迹，从而监督模型在不依赖外部技能内容的情况下直接执行。为保留对提供真正外部信息的任务特定技能的访问能力，我们将这些去除脚手架的轨迹与少量保留技能调用监督的技能原生轨迹混合。在无技能的保留评估集上，SkillCore使任务完成质量相比基础Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-72B模型分别提升54.4%和24.8%，同时在单独的探针上保留了任务特定技能调用能力，并在SWE-bench Verified上保持通用编码性能。
translation.brief: 解决运行时技能需显式加载、多数用户无法受益的问题，通过去除技能加载脚手架的监督微调将可泛化技能内化为模型自身能力。

papers.title: Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints
papers.abstract: Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional. On the LLMEval-Med subset, it outperforms direct generation and ties Top-5 RAG. Component analyses further examine semantic closure, example-guided refinement, specialty screening, and constraint-conditioned delivery.

translation.title: 基于形式化约束的临床推理精炼与健康指南对齐
translation.abstract: 从不完整或相互矛盾的患者证据中进行临床推理时，必须考虑低概率但高风险的问题，同时保持以健康指南为依据。我们提出VerClin，一个可解释框架，将指南的条件、排除项、建议和优先级提取为可执行知识，并将患者对话表示为带作用域的病例。一个确定性的四值推理器产生可追溯的指南匹配，同时保留不确定性并强制执行排除项。随后多个专科智能体筛选匹配指南对病例的适用性，一个会诊模型通过专科建议和保留句子的形式化约束通道综合被采纳的指导。我们按优先级与触发强度排名之和的升序呈现被采纳的指导，从而能够浮现触发较弱但高风险的指导。VerClin在HealthBench Hard和HealthBench Professional上优于直接生成和Top-5 RAG。在LLMEval-Med子集上，它优于直接生成并与Top-5 RAG持平。组件分析进一步考察了语义闭包、示例引导的精炼、专科筛选和约束条件化的交付。
translation.brief: 解决临床推理需兼顾高风险低概率问题并与健康指南对齐的问题，通过将指南形式化为可执行知识并用四值推理器与专科智能体进行可解释推理。

papers.title: TimeTravelContainer: A Live Forking Sandbox for Stateful Agent Exploration
papers.abstract: LLM agents that drive stateful tools (e.g., interactive shells, design environments, simulation engines) frequently need to clone, backtrack, and parallelize live sessions to support exploration. However, cloning a live session today requires serializing the tool's in-memory state to disk or relaunching from scratch, both prohibitively slow for interactive exploration. Existing agent sandboxes based on microVMs or kernel patches either serialize full guest memory to storage or require privileged deployment, limiting use on shared compute farms, personal computers, and other restricted environments. We present TimeTravelContainer (TTC), a rootless container runtime that live-forks an entire running container, including processes, memory, filesystem, and network, with copy-on-write (CoW) semantics. Because the bulk of a tool session's memory is typically read-only after the fork point, clones share it automatically and only diverged pages consume additional memory. TTC requires no kernel modifications, hardware virtualization, or root privileges, and runs on all major platforms including Linux, macOS (Apple Silicon), and Windows (WSL 2), making it deployable as a portable foundation for agent harnesses. We evaluate TTC on two agentic electronic design automation (EDA) flows as representative stateful-tool workloads: MAGE (Innovus) and EvoDRC (KLayout). TTC achieves 84.1$\times$ environment cloning speedup, 31--72% memory reduction, and 1.7--9.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup, demonstrating that live forking removes a scaling barrier for agent-driven exploration of stateful tool environments.

translation.title: TimeTravelContainer：面向有状态智能体探索的实时分叉沙箱
translation.abstract: 驱动有状态工具（如交互式 shell、设计环境、仿真引擎）的 LLM 智能体经常需要克隆、回溯和并行化运行中的会话以支持探索。然而，目前克隆一个运行中的会话需要将工具的内存状态序列化到磁盘或从头重新启动，这对交互式探索而言都过于缓慢。现有的基于 microVM 或内核补丁的智能体沙箱要么将完整的客户机内存序列化到存储，要么需要特权部署，限制了其在共享计算集群、个人电脑等受限环境中的使用。我们提出 TimeTravelContainer（TTC），一个无 root 权限的容器运行时，能够以写时复制（CoW）语义实时分叉整个运行中的容器，包括进程、内存、文件系统和网络。由于工具会话的大部分内存在分叉点之后通常是只读的，克隆体自动共享这些内存，只有发生分歧的页面才消耗额外内存。TTC 无需内核修改、硬件虚拟化或 root 权限，可运行于所有主要平台，包括 Linux、macOS（Apple Silicon）和 Windows（WSL 2），使其可作为智能体 harness 的可移植基础进行部署。我们在两个智能体电子设计自动化（EDA）流程上评估 TTC，将其作为代表性的有状态工具工作负载：MAGE（Innovus）和 EvoDRC（KLayout）。TTC 实现了 84.1 倍的环境克隆加速、31–72% 的内存节省和 1.7–9.4 倍的端到端加速，表明实时分叉消除了智能体驱动的有状态工具环境探索的扩展瓶颈。
translation.brief: 解决克隆运行中有状态工具会话过慢的问题，提出无 root 权限、基于写时复制语义的容器实时分叉运行时 TTC。

papers.title: Mayfly: Lifecycle-Aware High-Bandwidth Flash for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets an LLM improve its agent system by proposing and evaluating candidate variants across tasks. A generation's sessions grow their KV caches together and release them as they finish, creating a burst followed by a decline. At high concurrency, even the KV of sessions ready to run exceeds the GPU's HBM. Offloading that KV to host DRAM or SSDs adds capacity but leaves ready sessions waiting for HBM space before execution. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) can serve the overflow in place, but excessive reads lengthen decode steps and repeated writes consume flash endurance. Our key insight is that where ready KV is read should follow the burst and its decline: from HBF in place while the burst overflows HBM, as much as each step's bandwidth allows, and from HBM again as the decline frees it. A switch between ready and parked decides only whether a block is read, so its flash copy stays valid, and a session's end, which the orchestrator announces, decides when its private KV dies. We present Mayfly, lifecycle-guided HBF management for RSI. Mayfly bounds per-step HBF reads during overflow and returns KV to HBM as sessions finish and free space. It retains a valid backing copy of each block evicted from HBM to avoid rewrites across state transitions, and forwards session-end signals to the controller to avoid copying dead KV during garbage collection. Experimental results show that, at 128 sessions per generation on four added HBF sites, Mayfly finishes 34% sooner than parking the same KV on HBF and 23% sooner than reading it from HBF whenever HBM is full; its gain over parking grows with concurrency, to 55% at 256 sessions on eight sites. Keeping one flash copy per block and trimming at announced session ends avoid write amplification.

translation.title: Mayfly：面向递归自我改进的生命周期感知高带宽闪存
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）让 LLM 通过跨任务提出并评估候选变体来改进其智能体系统。一个世代的会话共同增长其 KV 缓存，并在完成时释放，形成先爆发后衰减的模式。在高并发下，即使是就绪会话的 KV 也超过 GPU 的 HBM 容量。将这些 KV 卸载到主机 DRAM 或 SSD 虽增加容量，但就绪会话仍需等待 HBM 空间才能执行。高带宽闪存（HBF）可以就地服务溢出的 KV，但过多的读取会延长解码步骤，重复写入会消耗闪存寿命。我们的关键洞察是：就绪 KV 的读取位置应遵循爆发及其衰减——当爆发溢出 HBM 时从 HBF 就地读取，读取量以每步带宽为限；当衰减释放 HBM 空间时再回到 HBM 读取。就绪与驻留之间的切换只决定某个块是否被读取，因此其闪存副本保持有效；而会话的结束（由编排器宣告）决定其私有 KV 何时消亡。我们提出 Mayfly，一种面向 RSI 的生命周期引导的 HBF 管理。Mayfly 在溢出期间限制每步 HBF 读取，并随着会话完成释放空间将 KV 返回 HBM。它为每个从 HBM 驱逐的块保留有效的闪存后备副本，以避免跨状态转换的重写，并将会话结束信号转发给控制器，以避免在垃圾回收期间复制已死亡的 KV。实验结果表明，在每世代 128 个会话、4 个附加 HBF 站点的情况下，Mayfly 比将相同 KV 驻留在 HBF 上快 34%，比在 HBM 满时从 HBF 读取快 23%；其相对驻留的优势随并发增长，在 8 个站点、256 个会话时达到 55%。每块保留一份闪存副本并在宣告的会话结束时裁剪，避免了写放大。
translation.brief: 解决 RSI 高并发下 KV 缓存超出 HBM 的问题，提出按会话生命周期引导的 HBF 就地读取与驻留切换管理方法 Mayfly。

papers.title: Unjamming Deferrals: Supporting Students Through JAMN Bot, a Mobile RAG-Grounded Policy Assistant
papers.abstract: In some educational institutions, workflows such as the exam deferral process can be slow, inconvenient, and inconsistent, which creates the need to implement novel digital systems. This paper presents Schedulater, a mobile app for managing university exam deferrals. JAMN Bot is a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered chatbot integrated into Schedulater that provides context-aware support to help users understand the deferral process. The system features a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using Ollama (Llama 3.2 3B) for self-hosted inference which enables policy-grounded responses without sacrificing privacy. We evaluate the system using a 43-item benchmark spanning Exam Deferral, Privacy, Scheduling, Cross-Policy, and Adversarial & Out-of-Scope questions, and report inter-rater agreement among our human evaluators alongside retrieval hit-rate metrics. Subsequently, we utilize an LLM-as-a-judge approach with GPT-5.4, revealing slight-to-moderate alignment with our raters that improves with answer quality, and check the ranking against a panel including Gemini 3.5 Flash and Qwen3.5 397B. The results of our study display trade-offs between open-weight and frontier models, as well as LLM-human evaluation alignment with answer quality. Schedulater demonstrates the feasibility of integrating lightweight LLMs into university administrative workflows with structured retrieval.

translation.title: Unjamming Deferrals：通过移动端 RAG 政策助手 JAMN Bot 支持学生
translation.abstract: 在一些教育机构中，考试缓考等流程可能缓慢、不便且不一致，因此需要实现新型数字系统。本文提出 Schedulater，一个用于管理大学考试缓考的移动应用。JAMN Bot 是集成在 Schedulater 中的由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的聊天机器人，提供上下文感知的支持，帮助用户理解缓考流程。该系统采用检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，使用 Ollama（Llama 3.2 3B）进行自托管推理，在不牺牲隐私的前提下实现基于政策的回答。我们使用一个涵盖考试缓考、隐私、排课、跨政策以及对抗性与超范围问题的 43 项基准来评估系统，并报告人工评估者之间的评分者间一致性以及检索命中率指标。随后，我们使用 GPT-5.4 的 LLM-as-a-judge 方法，发现其与人工评分者存在轻微到中等的对齐，且对齐程度随回答质量提升而提高，并与包括 Gemini 3.5 Flash 和 Qwen3.5 397B 在内的评审团进行排名对比。研究结果显示了开源权重模型与前沿模型之间的权衡，以及 LLM-人类评估对齐与回答质量的关系。Schedulater 证明了将轻量级 LLM 结合结构化检索集成到大学行政工作流中的可行性。
translation.brief: 解决大学考试缓考流程低效且需保护隐私的问题，构建集成自托管 RAG 聊天机器人 JAMN Bot 的移动应用 Schedulater。

papers.title: Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused. To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. Pando employs noise-coupled pruning, which draws the target model's sampling noise before drafting and ranks candidate branches under that noise, so the tree retains the branches the target will actually sample. Noise coupling is lossless and requires no retraining or additional model pass, yet increases acceptance length by up to $8.4\%$ on Qwen3-8B. To optimize and evaluate Pando configurations across hardware, we normalize an operator-level roofline to AR decoding, reducing every platform to its ridge point. On a representative edge device, a 16-node Pando tree attains $5.3\times$ speedup and $4.2\times$ energy reduction over AR decoding: $25\%$ faster than DSpark's released chain, and $27\%$ faster and $72\%$ more energy-efficient than an EAGLE-3 tree. The best configurations remain memory-bound on every edge device we model, so added compute capacity does not reduce their latency.

translation.title: Pando：面向高效边缘端投机解码的噪声耦合并行草稿树
translation.abstract: 自回归（AR）解码每次前向传播只输出一个 token，每次都要重新加载完整模型，因此边缘设备上的 LLM 推理受内存带宽限制，而计算单元处于闲置状态。投机解码通过在单次前向传播中验证多个草稿 token 来利用这些闲置算力。最先进的并行草稿器如 DFlash 和 DSpark 在一次前向传播中提出整块草稿 token，使草稿生成计算高效。然而，它们部署时的草稿链长度受限于训练时的块大小，导致大部分验证计算预算未被利用。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Pando，它在并行草稿器之上构建动态草稿树，从而消除这一上限。Pando 采用噪声耦合剪枝，在草稿生成前抽取目标模型的采样噪声，并在该噪声下对候选分支排序，使树保留目标模型实际会采样的分支。噪声耦合是无损的，无需重训练或额外的模型前向传播，却在 Qwen3-8B 上将接受长度提升至多 8.4%。为了跨硬件优化和评估 Pando 配置，我们将算子级 roofline 归一化到 AR 解码，将每个平台简化为其脊点。在一个代表性边缘设备上，16 节点的 Pando 树相比 AR 解码实现 5.3 倍加速和 4.2 倍能耗降低：比 DSpark 发布的链快 25%，比 EAGLE-3 树快 27% 且节能 72%。在我们建模的所有边缘设备上，最佳配置仍受内存带宽限制，因此增加算力并不能降低其延迟。
translation.brief: 解决并行草稿器草稿链长度受训练块大小限制的问题，提出在并行草稿器上构建动态草稿树并用噪声耦合剪枝的方法 Pando。

papers.title: StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

translation.title: StreamCoach：通过持续视觉推理实现主动式运动教练
translation.abstract: 在健身和运动训练中，及时的动作质量评估（AQA）对学习者在动作执行过程中识别并纠正技术错误至关重要。然而，大多数 AQA 方法评估的是已完成的动作表现，限制了其提供及时反馈的能力。流式方法缓解了这一延迟，但有限的推理能力阻碍了其对细微动作线索和运动专项知识的利用。此外，其碎片化的反馈一次只关注一个身体部位，忽略了其他部位的动作细节以及动作阶段之间的转换。为解决这些局限，我们提出 StreamCoach，一个 OnCueCoaching 范式下的流式 AQA 框架，将持续的思维链（CoT）推理与主动的、基于证据门控的教练指导相结合。技术感知推理（Technique-Aware Reasoning）依据运动专项标准追踪身体部位动作和动作阶段转换，而整体教练（Holistic Coaching）整合累积的证据，及时提供关于优点和技术错误的全面反馈。为支持训练和基准测试，我们通过对 Ego-Exo4D 中 1,213 个运动视频序列进行 LLM 辅助重标注和人工审核，构建了 EE4D-Stream 数据集，将密集的 CoT 标注与证据门控的语音内容配对。基于该数据集，我们使用时序-语义对齐强化学习训练 StreamCoach，联合优化反馈的时机和内容。我们在 EE4D-Stream 上对 11 个离线和流式基线进行基准测试，包括三个专有模型。StreamCoach 在干预时机、动作评估和教练质量方面均取得最先进的结果，超越了 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5。
translation.brief: 解决运动训练中动作质量反馈不及时且碎片化的问题，提出结合持续 CoT 推理与证据门控主动教练的流式 AQA 框架 StreamCoach。

papers.title: DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining
papers.abstract: Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency for LLM pretraining in English and multilingual scenarios, with various steering target designs. The improvements from DAiSy can consistently survive the instruction-tuning phase.

translation.title: DAiSy：基于自适应效用估计的 LLM 预训练在线数据选择
translation.abstract: 模型感知的在线数据选择会优先选取对模型当前状态贡献最大的训练文档。现有的在线选择器基于梯度数据效用分数对候选文档排序，这需要对每个候选文档执行主模型的完整前向-反向传播。因此为每个文档打分的开销与在其上训练相当，而实际用于模型更新的文档只占很小一部分。我们提出 DAiSy，一个轻量级线性辅助模型，它学习从冻结的文档嵌入预测数据效用分数，从而消除计算开销和基础设施负担。该线性估计器与主语言模型同步更新，拟合来自常规训练步骤反向传播得到的精确梯度效用分数。因此，对候选文档打分只需一次线性变换，绕过了昂贵的梯度对齐计算。我们在英文和多语言场景以及多种引导目标设计下，展示了其在 LLM 预训练中的有效性和高效性。DAiSy 带来的提升在指令微调阶段仍能持续保持。
translation.brief: 针对在线数据选择中梯度效用打分开销过大的问题，提出用与主模型同步更新的轻量线性辅助模型从冻结文档嵌入预测效用分数。

papers.title: Norn: Context-Length-Aware Optimization of Weight and KV Cache Placement for Offloaded LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Offloading model weights and the key-value (KV) cache to host memory enables large language models (LLMs) to run on a single memory-constrained GPU. As the KV cache grows during decoding, GPU memory requirements and the costs of KV cache transfers and attention computation change. However, existing offloading methods generally use static computation assignments and placements of model weights and the KV cache, preventing them from adapting to these changes and degrading inference performance. We propose Norn, a context-length-aware offloaded LLM inference method. Based on offline profiling, Norn co-optimizes computation assignments and placements at the sublayer level, precomputing multiple execution plans and their switching points. During decoding, Norn switches plans as context length increases, overlapping computation and data transfers without knowing the output length in advance. For prefill, Norn employs operator-major chunked prefill to avoid repeated weight transfers and automatically selects the chunk size. Experiments with Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B on two single-GPU systems show up to a 16.8$\times$ speedup in end-to-end latency over Pipelined Sharding and a 4.2$\times$ speedup over its oracle variant with known input and output lengths.

translation.title: Norn：面向卸载式 LLM 推理的上下文长度感知权重与 KV Cache 放置优化
translation.abstract: 将模型权重和键值（KV）缓存卸载到主机内存，使大语言模型（LLM）能够在单张内存受限的 GPU 上运行。随着解码过程中 KV 缓存的增长，GPU 内存需求以及 KV 缓存传输和注意力计算的成本也随之变化。然而，现有的卸载方法通常采用静态的计算分配以及权重和 KV 缓存的放置方式，无法适应这些变化，从而降低推理性能。我们提出 Norn，一种上下文长度感知的卸载式 LLM 推理方法。基于离线性能剖析，Norn 在子层级别协同优化计算分配与放置，预计算多个执行计划及其切换点。在解码过程中，Norn 随上下文长度增长切换计划，在无需预知输出长度的情况下实现计算与数据传输的重叠。对于 prefill，Norn 采用算子优先的分块 prefill 以避免重复的权重传输，并自动选择分块大小。在两个单 GPU 系统上使用 Qwen3-14B 和 Qwen3-32B 的实验表明，相比 Pipelined Sharding 端到端延迟最高加速 16.8 倍，相比已知输入输出长度的 oracle 变体加速 4.2 倍。
translation.brief: 针对卸载式 LLM 推理中静态放置无法适应 KV 缓存增长的问题，提出按上下文长度切换预计算执行计划的动态协同优化方法。

papers.title: Towards a Multimodal Aesthetic Agent for Photographic Reference Grading
papers.abstract: Reference-guided photographic color grading helps users realize their aesthetic intent by selectively drawing on the color and tonal characteristics of a reference photograph. Doing so requires understanding which characteristics users wish to adopt and translating these preferences into controllable edits. However, image-only reference methods align overall appearance without instruction-grounded selection, while pixel-space generative editors typically produce flattened images without editable parameters, limiting subsequent refinement. To address these challenges, we introduce JarvisAura, a multimodal aesthetic agent that formulates photographic color grading as structured decision-making in an editable parameter space. JarvisAura offers three key advantages: (1) an aesthetic agent paradigm that integrates visual attribute perception, strategy-level reasoning, and parameterized execution for interpretable and controllable photographic color grading; (2) a unified reasoning-to-execution pipeline that connects aesthetic planning with backend rendering and editable parameter refinement; and (3) a three-stage training strategy comprising Parameter-Grounded Continual Pre-Training for parameter-appearance grounding, Reference-Grounded Supervised Fine-Tuning for reference-guided reasoning and parameter decisions, and Reference-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for rendered-outcome refinement with multidimensional rewards and dynamic data derivation. On Ref-Bench, JarvisAura achieves the best scores among methods with results across reported automatic metrics and a 74% human-rated task-success rate, exceeding GPT-Image-2.5 by 9 percentage points.

translation.title: 迈向用于照片参考调色的多模态美学智能体
translation.abstract: 参考引导的照片调色通过有选择地借鉴参考照片的色彩和影调特征，帮助用户实现其审美意图。这需要理解用户希望采纳哪些特征，并将这些偏好转化为可控的编辑。然而，仅基于图像的参考方法在没有指令引导选择的情况下对齐整体外观，而像素空间的生成式编辑器通常输出无法编辑参数的扁平化图像，限制了后续的精细调整。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 JarvisAura，一个将照片调色形式化为可编辑参数空间中结构化决策的多模态美学智能体。JarvisAura 具有三大优势：(1) 美学智能体范式，融合视觉属性感知、策略级推理和参数化执行，实现可解释、可控的照片调色；(2) 统一的推理到执行流水线，将美学规划与后端渲染及可编辑参数精调相连接；(3) 三阶段训练策略，包括用于参数-外观对齐的 Parameter-Grounded Continual Pre-Training、用于参考引导推理与参数决策的 Reference-Grounded Supervised Fine-Tuning，以及通过多维奖励和动态数据生成对渲染结果进行精调的 Reference-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization。在 Ref-Bench 上，JarvisAura 在各自动指标报告的方法中取得最佳成绩，人工评定的任务成功率达 74%，超过 GPT-Image-2.5 九个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对参考引导照片调色中缺乏指令引导选择和可编辑参数的问题，提出将调色形式化为参数空间结构化决策的多模态美学智能体及三阶段训练策略。

papers.title: ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?
papers.abstract: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

translation.title: ASTERISM：多模态 LLM 真的看了所有图像吗？
translation.abstract: 多图像基准旨在测试多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是否能综合跨图像的证据，但其中许多题目仅凭一张图像即可回答。在对来自 19 个公开基准的约 3.3 万道题目的审计和两阶段单图像过滤中，我们发现 24.2% 的题目仅凭一张图像或问题本身即可解答。在这些题目上，MLLM 仅凭一张图像即可恢复全部图像相对纯文本所带来准确率的中位数 78%，说明这些题目奖励仅凭一张图像作答，我们称之为单图像捷径。即使在一图不足的题目上，MLLM 也会走这条捷径：在这类题目上，它们的大多数错误答案与其仅凭一张图像给出的答案重复，比例远高于随机水平。我们构建了 ASTERISM——据我们所知是规模最大的经审计的多图像基准——从这 19 个基准中保留需要多于一幅图像的题目。其 1.87 万道题目（其中 2000 道经过修正或重写）采用统一格式、统一评分器和七个任务类别。我们还发布了包含 4.9 万道训练题的 ASTERISM-Train，以及逐题人工核验的困难子集 ASTERISM-Lite。在 ASTERISM-Lite 上，最强的专有 MLLM 得分为 68%。目前在 MLLM 后训练中普遍使用的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）同样会奖励这种捷径，因为仅凭一张图像读出的正确答案与综合多图得出的正确答案获得同样的奖励。与此一致，现有 RLVR 目标对 ASTERISM 得分提升甚微。为了在训练中像 ASTERISM 在评测中那样不再奖励捷径，我们提出跨图像信用分配（CICA），这是 RLVR 的一个扩展，将信用向需要多于一幅图像的 token 转移。在三个开源 MLLM 上，CICA 将 ASTERISM 得分提升 2.6 至 6.0 分，是相同数据上训练的各通用及视觉专用 RL 目标收益的两倍以上。
translation.brief: 针对多图像基准中大量题目可单图作答导致 MLLM 走单图像捷径的问题，构建需多图推理的 ASTERISM 基准并提出将奖励信用转向多图 token 的 CICA 训练方法。

papers.title: FigmaEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents in Professional UI Design
papers.abstract: Recent advances in AI agents have enabled autonomous UI design using professional tools such as Figma, yet evaluating their design capabilities remains challenging due to the open-ended nature of design tasks and the absence of unique ground truths. We introduce FigmaEval, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on professional UI design tasks, comprising 84 tasks and 783 screens derived from real-world Figma design files. FigmaEval adopts a constrained-specification, open-solution paradigm, standardizing task requirements and design resources while allowing agents to independently determine layouts, visual hierarchies, component composition, and visual presentation. To assess design quality beyond reference similarity, we develop 22 expert-grounded evaluation rubrics across six dimensions and introduce a human evaluation arena where professional designers compare agent-generated designs through blinded pairwise judgments. Evaluating eleven models under a unified Figma agent setup, we find substantial agreement between rubric-based assessments and human preferences, alongside distinct differences in design practices and quality--efficiency trade-offs. FigmaEval provides a framework for systematically assessing professional UI design capabilities and understanding the strengths and limitations of current AI agents.

translation.title: FigmaEval：评估 AI 智能体专业 UI 设计能力的基准
translation.abstract: AI 智能体的最新进展使其能够使用 Figma 等专业工具进行自主 UI 设计，但由于设计任务的开放性和缺乏唯一的标准答案，评估其设计能力仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 FigmaEval，一个评估 AI 智能体专业 UI 设计能力的基准，包含源自真实 Figma 设计文件的 84 个任务和 783 个屏幕。FigmaEval 采用约束规格、开放解法的范式：标准化任务要求和设计资源，同时允许智能体自主决定布局、视觉层级、组件构成和视觉呈现。为评估超越参考相似度的设计质量，我们制定了覆盖六个维度的 22 项基于专家的评估细则，并引入人工评估竞技场，由专业设计师通过盲测两两比较对智能体生成的设计进行评判。在统一的 Figma 智能体设置下评估十一个模型，我们发现基于细则的评估与人类偏好高度一致，同时揭示了设计实践和质量-效率权衡上的显著差异。FigmaEval 为系统评估专业 UI 设计能力、理解当前 AI 智能体的优势与局限提供了框架。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 智能体 UI 设计能力难以评估的问题，构建基于真实 Figma 文件、采用约束规格开放解法范式并结合专家细则与人工盲评竞技场的基准。

papers.title: When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention
papers.abstract: Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K >= 2 explain the interaction. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma, and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 leaves at least 10% relative improvement within a fully enumerated 24-position candidate pool in 55/60, 49/60, and 60/60 cases, respectively. SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, detects 157/164 such cases and returns directly checkable improving supports. A KL-margin certificate relates support fidelity to next-token stability; larger-budget, multi-layer cached-decoding experiments measure predictive fidelity at K = 128 and 256. These results establish joint support quality as an essential object of analysis for sparse attention and motivate downstream-aware support selection under inference constraints.

translation.title: 当精确的 Token 重要性还不够时：LLM 注意力中 Top-K 选择的局限
translation.abstract: 长上下文语言模型通常只为一个注意力查询保留有限的过去 token 位置集合。一种常见策略是对各位置独立打分并保留排名最高的 K 个。然而注意力权重会在所选集合上重新归一化：两个单独重要的位置未必构成最佳组合。我们提出这样的问题：即使每个重要性分数精确度量了单独删除该位置所引起的下一 token 预测的下游变化，独立排序是否仍然足够。答案是否定的。一个四位置构造使排序选出的组合产生最优组合 133.2 倍的 KL 散度，且一个参数化族证明该乘性差距是无界的。一个精确的交换恒等式以及所有 K >= 2 时的偏好反转解释了这种交互作用。在对 SmolLM2、Gemma 和 Qwen 的穷举式冻结模型审计中，精确单点 Top-4 在完全枚举的 24 位置候选池中分别有 55/60、49/60 和 60/60 的情形至少存在 10% 的相对改进空间。SwapCert 是一种同等预算的单次交换审计，检测出 157/164 个此类情形，并返回可直接验证的改进支持集。一个 KL 边际证书将支持集保真度与下一 token 稳定性联系起来；更大预算、多层缓存解码实验在 K = 128 和 256 时度量了预测保真度。这些结果确立了联合支持集质量作为稀疏注意力分析的核心对象，并推动在推理约束下进行下游感知的支持集选择。
translation.brief: 该论文证明即使使用精确的单位置重要性分数，独立 Top-K 排序也无法选出最优注意力支持集，并通过构造性反例、交换恒等式和交换审计揭示位置间交互作用，倡导联合支持集选择。

papers.title: GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\% and 45.47\%, respectively.

translation.title: GUI-WEdit 与 GUI-SkillEvo：小型 GUI Agent 的无梯度适配
translation.abstract: 小型图形用户界面（GUI）agent 可以执行桌面工作流，但重复的局部错误和脆弱的程序性决策限制了其可靠性。我们提出 GUI-WEdit-4B 和 GUI-SkillEvo-2B，这是对 GUI-Owl-1.5 骨干模型的两种无梯度适配。对于 4B 模型，我们利用轨迹反馈对一个后期多层感知机（MLP）构建带保护的闭式更新，并将成功状态保留为保护约束。最终检查点改变了 23,739,095 个参数值，即 4,437,815,808 参数骨干模型的 0.535%，且仅限于单个权重张量内。对于 2B 模型，一个助手迭代地提出并改进程序性技能，而模型权重保持不变。在排除 Google Drive 任务的 361 个任务 OSWorld 子集上，冻结系统分别获得 48.02% 和 45.47% 的最终总分。
translation.brief: 该论文针对小型 GUI agent 可靠性差的问题，提出两种无梯度适配方法：对 4B 模型仅用轨迹反馈做带保护的闭式权重更新，对 2B 模型在权重冻结下迭代进化程序性技能。

papers.title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows
papers.abstract: An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it. In our documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost on the initial task. Lower token prices alone do not solve this control-flow tax: inexpensive general-purpose routers can trigger additional calls to the expensive generator. We evaluate a heterogeneous architecture in which Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks, 480 valid runs comprise 470 completions and ten request-limit endpoints. Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory. On the initial task, mean cost falls by 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval: 42.9% to 56.3%) and elapsed time by 33.2% (19.6% to 46.7%). Across three further tasks, cost reductions are 40.5% to 42.9% and concurrent elapsed-time reductions are 12.9% to 14.4%. Existence-only specialization saves just 1.8% on the initial task. Separately, Sol and Jev each select accepted actions on 100/100 reviewed retail states, with Jev using 97.88% less reference cost and 72.30% less mean request time. The results identify two requirements for efficient agent control: inexpensive decisions and trajectories that preserve those savings.

translation.title: 控制流税：面向 LLM Agent 工作流的专用决策路由
translation.abstract: 一个 agent 花在决定做什么上的开销几乎与实际执行相当。在我们的文档工作流中，控制流路由占初始任务基线参考成本的 42.5%。仅靠降低 token 价格无法解决这一控制流税：廉价的通用路由器可能触发对昂贵生成器的额外调用。我们评估了一种异构架构，其中专用 System 1 决策模型 Jev 控制有限动作，而 Sol 负责生成文档。在四个软件任务中，480 次有效运行包含 470 次完成和十个请求上限终止点。Jev 全路由在每个任务上都实现了最低的平均成本和耗时，所有 40 次专家控制的运行都沿最短轨迹完成。在初始任务上，平均成本下降 49.6%（95% 配对自助区间：42.9% 至 56.3%），耗时下降 33.2%（19.6% 至 46.7%）。在另外三个任务上，成本降低 40.5% 至 42.9%，并发耗时降低 12.9% 至 14.4%。仅存在性专用化在初始任务上只节省 1.8%。另外，在 100/100 个受审零售状态上，Sol 和 Jev 各自都正确选择了被接受的动作，而 Jev 使用的参考成本少 97.88%，平均请求时间少 72.30%。这些结果指出了高效 agent 控制的两个要求：廉价的决策以及能保留这些节省的轨迹。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM agent 工作流中控制流路由开销过高的问题，提出由专用轻量决策模型 Jev 负责动作路由、生成模型 Sol 专注文档生成的异构架构。

papers.title: Validating Multi-Model AI-Generated Acceptance Criteria in Requirements Engineering
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate artifacts such as requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, documentation, and code. Their use in requirements engineering raises important questions about correctness, traceability, and hallucination, especially because flawed specifications can affect later design, implementation, and verification activities. While much recent work on AI-assisted software engineering has focused on code generation and code-level validation, the validation of AI-generated specifications has received less attention. This paper addresses this gap by presenting a validation-oriented approach for AI-generated acceptance criteria. The approach combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-model generation, and an explicitly structured human-in-the-loop workflow. We describe a working prototype that allows users to prepare or enter user stories, generate acceptance criteria using several LLMs, optionally augment generation with retrieved requirements-related examples, compare outputs side by side, inspect retrieved context, and select, edit, or regenerate candidate criteria before explicitly submitting a reviewer-finalized version. The system also records model outputs, user interventions, retrieval settings, and final criteria as part of a logged decision process. Rather than claiming that generation accuracy is already improved, the contribution of this work is to operationalize validation as an explicit, inspectable, and accountable process for AI-generated requirements artifacts.

translation.title: 需求工程中多模型 AI 生成验收标准的验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在软件工程中被越来越多地用于生成需求、用户故事、验收标准、文档和代码等制品。它们在需求工程中的使用引发了关于正确性、可追溯性和幻觉的重要问题，尤其因为有缺陷的规格说明会影响后续的设计、实现和验证活动。尽管近期关于 AI 辅助软件工程的工作大多聚焦于代码生成和代码级验证，但 AI 生成规格说明的验证受到的关注较少。本文通过提出一种面向验证的 AI 生成验收标准方法来填补这一空白。该方法结合了检索增强生成（RAG）、多模型生成以及一个显式结构化的人机协同工作流。我们描述了一个可运行的原型，允许用户准备或输入用户故事，使用多个 LLM 生成验收标准，可选择用检索到的需求相关示例增强生成，并排比较输出，检查检索到的上下文，并在显式提交评审者最终确定的版本之前选择、编辑或重新生成候选标准。系统还将模型输出、用户干预、检索设置和最终标准记录为有日志的决策过程的一部分。本文并不声称生成准确性已经提升，其贡献在于将验证操作化为一个针对 AI 生成需求制品的显式、可检查且可问责的过程。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 AI 生成验收标准缺乏验证机制的问题，提出结合 RAG、多模型生成和结构化人机协同工作流的可检查、可问责验证方法及原型系统。

papers.title: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
papers.abstract: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.

translation.title: AI 能设计出更好的 nnU-Net 吗？从失败到设计规则的假设驱动架构发现循环
translation.abstract: 神经架构搜索和 LLM 驱动的进化往往将评估简化为一个标量适应度分数，丢弃了那些本可解释设计成败原因的失败案例。我们提出一个假设驱动的架构发现循环，其中 LLM agent 诊断结构化错误模式，提出可证伪的假设，在冻结的 nnU-Net 流水线下测试反事实对照，并将经过验证的机制提炼为可执行的触发-动作规则。经过八轮搜索，该循环为 3D 医学图像分割识别出两条原则。第一，将计算从高分辨率解码器重新分配到中段编码器，可在降低成本的同时保留细小解剖结构的边界。第二，支持集受限的区域对比解决了嵌套解剖腔室之间的错误，并使用依赖解剖结构的触发器来选择该规则的适用时机。这些原则产生了 LeanNeXt（相对于 nnU-Net 为 0.78 MACs 和 0.92 训练步时间；在 KiTS23 四折交叉验证上 +1.63 Dice 点）和触发路由的 LeanNeXt+。后者在全部 15 个评估的 CT/MRI 设置上均优于 nnU-Net，并在 15 个基准中的 12 个上以 0.30 的参数量超过大 3.3 倍的 ResEnc-M。相对于随机采样、单次 LLM 生成和分数选择的 agent 搜索，该循环展示了失败分析如何产生跨模态可复用的设计规则。
translation.brief: 该论文解决神经架构搜索丢弃失败信息的问题，提出让 LLM agent 诊断错误、提出可证伪假设并做反事实验证的架构发现循环，从中提炼出可复用的设计规则。

papers.title: AgentBank: Banking on Blockchain Agentic Payments
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly pay for data and computation through protocols such as x402 and AP2, but individually funded wallets idle and require asset transfers for every payment. We present AgentBank, a smart-contract banking layer that lets agents spend bank liabilities under owner-issued mandates and on-chain spending limits. Internal payments update account balances without transferring assets, while pooled backing funds are allocated between reserves and yield-bearing strategies. We bound losses from compromised agent keys and analyze how correlated demand affects reserve requirements. Experiments show that AgentBank reduces idle liquidity by 52-77% relative to per-agent wallets and lowers gas costs for batched internal payments. Using historical DeFi liquidity data, we evaluate how reserve policies balance treasury returns against payment availability during market stress. We further examine the risks of automated bank runs and evaluate mechanisms to mitigate them.

translation.title: AgentBank：基于区块链智能体支付的银行化方案
translation.abstract: AI 智能体越来越多地通过 x402 和 AP2 等协议为数据和计算付费，但各自独立注资的钱包资金闲置，且每次支付都需要资产转移。我们提出 AgentBank，一个智能合约银行层，让智能体在所有者授权和链上支出限额下使用银行负债进行消费。内部支付仅更新账户余额而无需转移资产，同时池化的支持资金在储备和收益策略之间分配。我们界定了智能体密钥被攻破时的损失上限，并分析了相关需求如何影响储备要求。实验表明，与每个智能体独立钱包相比，AgentBank 将闲置流动性降低 52-77%，并降低了批量内部支付的 gas 成本。利用历史 DeFi 流动性数据，我们评估了储备政策如何在市场压力下平衡资金库收益与支付可用性。我们还进一步考察了自动化银行挤兑的风险并评估了缓解机制。
translation.brief: 解决智能体独立钱包资金闲置和支付低效问题，提出基于智能合约的银行层，让智能体在授权与链上支出限额下使用银行负债进行内部结算。

papers.title: Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement
papers.abstract: Self-evolving language models can continuously acquire useful experience through test-time interaction, reflection, and prompt optimization, yet turning such experience into model itself to ensure self improvement remains challenging. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides a natural mechanism for internalizing test-time information into model parameters, yet it largely assumes that the gener- ated experience is worth learning. We show that this assumption does not always hold: experiences that improve test-time performance may provide limited or even harmful training signals.
