To better characterize which experience should be inter- nalized, we systematically analyze diverse mutated experiences across multiple tasks and reflection models, and find that gradient-based alignment is a more reli- able indicator of downstream distillation gains than immediate test-time improve- ment. Based on this finding, we propose E2L, a self-evolution framework that iteratively generates, evaluates, and distills experiences according to their esti- mated training utility. E2L closes the loop between experience generation and parameter learning, enabling agents to autonomously produce experience suitable for self-improvement.

translation.title: 进化以学习：面向模型自我提升的梯度对齐经验进化
translation.abstract: 自我进化的语言模型可以通过测试时交互、反思和提示优化持续获取有用经验，但如何将这类经验内化为模型本身以确保自我提升仍然具有挑战性。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）为将测试时信息内化到模型参数中提供了自然机制，但它很大程度上假设生成的经验值得学习。我们证明这一假设并不总是成立：能提升测试时表现的经验可能提供有限甚至有害的训练信号。为更好地刻画哪些经验应被内化，我们系统分析了跨多个任务和反思模型的多样化变异经验，发现基于梯度的对齐度比即时的测试时提升是更可靠的下游蒸馏收益指标。基于这一发现，我们提出 E2L，一个根据估计的训练效用迭代生成、评估和蒸馏经验的自进化框架。E2L 打通了经验生成与参数学习之间的闭环，使智能体能够自主产出适合自我提升的经验。
translation.brief: 解决测试时经验未必值得内化的问题，提出以梯度对齐度作为经验训练效用的可靠指标，并据此迭代生成、评估和蒸馏经验的自进化框架 E2L。

papers.title: Verify then Steer: Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in an unseen 3D environment. However, existing methods still struggle to recover from route deviations at test time. We investigate this limitation through the lens of instruction progress, and trace it to a phenomenon we term progress hallucination: agents misinterpret off-route observations as evidence of task progress, causing their internal instruction progress to advance beyond the actual task stage and hindering recovery based on earlier sub-instructions. To address this failure mode, we propose PHAR (Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery), a test-time recovery framework following a verify-then-steer paradigm. The verifier examines residual-stream representations of the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify mismatch of cross-modal evidence along the trajectories, and uses split conformal calibration to control false alarms. When an alarm is raised, the steering module uses a contextual bandit to adaptively select the rewind extent of instruction progress for online recovery. Through extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, our framework enhances the reliability of multiple state-of-the-art vision-language navigation methods at test time.

translation.title: 先验证再纠偏：面向连续视觉语言导航的进度幻觉感知恢复
translation.abstract: 视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体遵循语言指令在未见过的 3D 环境中到达目标。然而，现有方法在测试时仍难以从路线偏离中恢复。我们通过指令进度的视角研究这一局限，并将其归因于我们称之为进度幻觉的现象：智能体将偏离路线的观测误读为任务进展的证据，导致其内部指令进度超前于实际任务阶段，阻碍了基于较早子指令的恢复。为解决这一失败模式，我们提出 PHAR（进度幻觉感知恢复），一个遵循先验证再纠偏范式的测试时恢复框架。验证器检查视觉语言模型（VLM）残差流表示，以识别轨迹上跨模态证据的不匹配，并使用 split conformal 校准来控制误报。当发出警报时，纠偏模块使用上下文老虎机自适应地选择指令进度回退的幅度以进行在线恢复。在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 上的大量实验表明，我们的框架在测试时提升了多种最先进视觉语言导航方法的可靠性。
translation.brief: 解决 VLN 智能体因进度幻觉而无法从路线偏离中恢复的问题，提出先验证再纠偏的测试时框架 PHAR，用残差流表示验证跨模态不匹配并用上下文老虎机自适应回退指令进度。

papers.title: CPU-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models for CPU Hardware Code Generation
papers.abstract: Benchmarks such as VerilogEval have supported rapid advances in hardware description language (HDL) generation by large language models (LLMs). However, recent HDL-generation systems achieve pass rates above 90% on VerilogEval, leaving limited headroom for revealing further advances. To provide a challenging target for further progress on a practically important hardware-development task, we introduce CPU-Eval, a benchmark of 339 HDL-generation problems constructed from six CPUs. Drawn from practical CPU designs, including families fabricated in silicon, the problems span CPUs from small embedded cores to Linux-capable out-of-order cores and cover diverse CPU functions written in SystemVerilog, Chisel, and SpinalHDL. In each problem, an LLM performs the real CPU-development task of generating HDL. Across seven state-of-the-art LLMs, mean pass@1 is 45.14 percentage points lower on CPU-Eval than on VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL, exposing capability differences obscured by VerilogEval's high pass rates. CPU-Eval reveals that pass@1 is lower for submodules with more source-code lines, which motivates fine-grained modular design for LLM-aided hardware generation. We also show that pass@1 is lower for CPUs written in less widely used HDLs, motivating designers to verify that an LLM is sufficiently proficient at generating code in the HDL they use before deployment.

translation.title: CPU-Eval：评估大语言模型的 CPU 硬件代码生成能力
translation.abstract: VerilogEval 等基准推动了大型语言模型（LLM）在硬件描述语言（HDL）生成方面的快速进步。然而，近期 HDL 生成系统在 VerilogEval 上的通过率已超过 90%，留给揭示进一步进步的空间十分有限。为在这一实际重要的硬件开发任务上提供更具挑战性的进步目标，我们引入 CPU-Eval，一个由六款 CPU 构建的包含 339 个 HDL 生成问题的基准。这些问题取自实际 CPU 设计（包括已流片的系列），涵盖从小型嵌入式核到可运行 Linux 的乱序核的 CPU，覆盖以 SystemVerilog、Chisel 和 SpinalHDL 编写的多样 CPU 功能。在每个问题中，LLM 执行生成 HDL 这一真实的 CPU 开发任务。在七个最先进的 LLM 上，CPU-Eval 的平均 pass@1 比 VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL 低 45.14 个百分点，揭示了被 VerilogEval 高通过率掩盖的能力差异。CPU-Eval 表明，源代码行数更多的子模块 pass@1 更低，这促使在 LLM 辅助硬件生成中采用细粒度模块化设计。我们还发现，使用较不流行 HDL 编写的 CPU pass@1 更低，这促使设计者在部署前验证 LLM 对其所用 HDL 的代码生成能力足够熟练。
translation.brief: 解决现有 HDL 生成基准饱和、难以区分模型能力的问题，构建基于六款真实 CPU 的 339 个问题的高难度基准 CPU-Eval。

papers.title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
papers.abstract: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

translation.title: 看见答案，学会嵌入：从后见之明学习通用多模态嵌入
translation.abstract: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型将异构多模态输入映射到共享嵌入空间，其中的成对相似度可支持多种下游任务。近期的推理驱动 UME 方法使用中间推理为嵌入生成额外上下文，但常在推理时带来额外计算。本文探索将匹配候选（即配对目标）作为另一种上下文来源，探究模型能否在训练时"看见答案"而在推理时"学会嵌入"。然而，直接以这种特权上下文为条件可能引入仅凭查询无法获得的候选特定信息，或导致以候选为条件的查询表示向候选嵌入坍缩。为此，我们提出 Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings（HEME），从候选上下文中学习以查询为根基的后见之明表示。HEME 首先通过后见之明注意力掩码、错配候选条件化和查询 token 对齐来训练一个后见之明教师，以限制对候选的过度依赖；然后冻结教师，将其后见之明表示和相似度分布蒸馏到一个独立的嵌入器中。推理时，学生模型独立编码查询和候选，无需候选条件化或后见之明教师。在 MMEB-V2 以及 MMEB-V3 的智能体和文本任务上的实验证明了 HEME 的有效性，并表明它比显式推理驱动的方法推理更高效。
translation.brief: 解决推理驱动多模态嵌入推理开销大的问题，提出 HEME，训练后见之明教师并蒸馏为独立学生嵌入器，使模型训练时利用配对候选上下文而推理时无需额外条件。

papers.title: A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds
papers.abstract: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

translation.title: A Mesh to Remember：面向交互式视频世界的持久外观
translation.abstract: 视频世界模型能够根据用户动作合成逼真的观测，但在长时间交互中难以保持一致性。Coding agents 和 text-to-3D 模型则生成显式 3D 世界，其几何和状态天然持久，但外观远达不到照片级真实感。近期方法结合两者优势，将此类世界渲染为粗略代理以引导视频模型。然而，由于这些代理只指定物体的位置，渲染器必须在探索世界时自行发明物体的外观，而任何被遗忘的内容在表面重新出现时都会被重新发明。我们的关键洞察是：mesh 能跨帧、跨视角地标识每个像素显示的是哪个表面，即使物体在移动，因此可作为渲染器生成内容的地址。我们提出 M2R（Mesh to Remember），一个少步数因果视频渲染器，它将自己描绘的特征存储在对应表面上（以每个物体的坐标系存储），并在这些表面重新进入视野时通过光栅化 mesh 检索它们。这样，外观随物体移动而迁移、在重访时持久存在，并被所有观察它的 agent 共享，同时内存随所见表面而非帧数增长。M2R 仅在合成数据上训练，即可零样本迁移到真实室内扫描和由 coding agents 构建的世界。在静态、动态和多 agent 基准上，其一致性优于最先进方法，物体持久性提升超过一倍，跨 agent 一致性接近翻倍，同时以 40 FPS 实时渲染 720p 视频。
translation.brief: 解决视频世界模型长交互中外观不一致的问题，核心方法是将渲染器特征存储在 mesh 表面上并在表面重现时检索，实现持久且可共享的外观。

papers.title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
papers.abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

translation.title: MAGPIE：通过可执行场景构建实现 Agentic 多参考图像生成
translation.abstract: 多参考图像生成要求模型在按指令排布所选主体的同时保留其外观。尽管基于参考的生成和组合控制近来取得进展，但将所选主体可靠地组织到目标场景中仍然具有挑战性。现有方法虽提供各种形式的组合引导，但规划的关系在图像合成前并不总是被显式实例化以供检查和修正。为解决这一局限，我们提出 MAGPIE，将目标构图表示为由可执行 Blender 程序定义的简化 3D 场景。一个 coding agent 将每个场景实例与其参考关联，对照指令检查几何和渲染视图，并修改程序以纠正偏差。最终的代理渲染作为图像生成器的视觉规划。利用 MAGPIE-Instruct-3K，我们训练生成器遵循该规划，同时从参考中提取每个主体的外观。MAGPIE 在 DreamOmni2 和 SconeEval 上提升了 Qwen 和 FLUX 的表现。使用 FLUX 时，其在 DreamOmni2 上的整体成功率比原始骨干提升 28.21 个百分点，并在 SconeEval 上取得所评估模型中的最高总分。
translation.brief: 解决多参考图像生成中主体布局不可检查修正的问题，核心方法是用 coding agent 构建并迭代修正可执行的 Blender 3D 场景作为视觉规划来引导图像生成。

papers.title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
papers.abstract: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to this http URL, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.

translation.title: VISE：基于工具实现反馈的、不依赖验证器的技能自我进化
translation.abstract: Agent skills 为 LLM agents 使用工具提供可复用的工作流。改进这些工作流需要关于缺失或错误指令的反馈，但任务特定的验证器并不总是可用。我们提出 VISE（Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution），一种以脚本为先的方法，利用工具实现来指导技能修订。它从源代码中提取工具的能力、输入要求、使用条件和输出格式。结合任务请求和执行轨迹，它将这些信息与当前工作流指令进行比较，以识别缺失或冲突的步骤。然后针对该 http URL 推荐具体修改，并将每处更改与相关实现和使用条件关联。我们在 SkillsBench 和 SkillLearnBench 上将 VISE 作为四种进化方法的额外修订阶段进行评估。与相应的 No-verifier 条件相比，它将整体平均任务成功率提升 9.14-13.35 个百分点，三次运行全部解决的任务比例提升 12.36-18.29 个百分点。案例研究展示了修订后的指令如何将工具输出与后续步骤关联。这些结果支持将工具实现作为技能自我进化的实用反馈来源。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏任务验证器时 agent 技能难以改进的问题，核心方法是从工具源代码中提取能力与使用条件等信息，与执行轨迹对比来定位并修订工作流中的缺失或冲突步骤。

papers.title: Assessing Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract: As the use of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes more widespread in cyber-physical systems, it becomes increasingly important to design RL agents that are able to adapt to changes in their environments in order to maintain safety and reliability. This paper addresses the question of whether different classes of RL algorithm are more robust against forgetting previously learned behaviours, a critical issue in continual learning, in non-stationary environments. We evaluate the robustness of representative examples of three important classes of RL algorithm in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment. These are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is a model-free on-policy algorithm, Soft-Actor-Critic (SAC), which is a model-free off-policy algorithm, and Drama, which is a model-based algorithm. The agents must learn to successfully park in four different scenarios, which are presented successively, with parking spaces oriented at varying angles. We find off-policy algorithms appear to be more robust compared to on-policy algorithms due to their use of replay, while model-based algorithms do not appear to offer any direct advantage over model-free algorithms. These experiments also highlight the additional challenges of finding robust abstractions of the environment, and oversensitivity to hyperparameters.

translation.title: 评估信息物理系统持续深度强化学习中对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性
translation.abstract: 随着强化学习（RL）在信息物理系统中的应用日益广泛，设计能够适应环境变化以维持安全性和可靠性的 RL agent 变得越来越重要。本文研究的问题是：在非平稳环境中，不同类别的 RL 算法在抵抗遗忘已学行为（持续学习中的关键问题）方面是否更具鲁棒性。我们在一个非平稳的自主泊车环境中评估三类重要 RL 算法的代表性实例的鲁棒性：无模型 on-policy 算法 Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）、无模型 off-policy 算法 Soft-Actor-Critic（SAC），以及基于模型的算法 Drama。agent 必须学会在依次呈现的四个不同场景中成功泊车，泊车位的朝向角度各不相同。我们发现，由于使用了 replay，off-policy 算法相比 on-policy 算法似乎更鲁棒，而基于模型的算法相比无模型算法并未显示出直接优势。这些实验还凸显了寻找鲁棒环境抽象以及对超参数过度敏感等额外挑战。
translation.brief: 解决非平稳环境下不同类别 RL 算法抗灾难性遗忘能力未知的问题，核心方法是在非平稳自主泊车环境中对比评估 PPO、SAC 和 Drama 三类算法的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Analyzing Single-Bit Flips on LLMs and Their Backbone-Matched VLMs
papers.abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) enable offline weight analysis and are reused as backbones in vision-language models (VLMs), increasing the risk of bit-flip attacks that manipulate stored weight bits to induce malicious model behavior. An adversary could identify vulnerable bits on a public LLM and later flip the same locations in a deployed LLM or its backbone-matched VLMs. A single-bit flip is particularly practical in this setting because it is easier to achieve under hardware fault attacks than multi-bit flips. However, existing selectors are mostly limited to multi-bit flips, without in-depth analysis of single-bit flips. In this paper, we adapt representative data-free and data-based bit selectors to identify candidate bits. We evaluate each bit independently on source LLMs and at the same logical coordinates in backbone-matched VLMs (without re-search), considering both performance degradation and prediction patterns across multiple inputs. Results show impact of single-bit flips varies across selectors on LLMs and their backbone-matched VLMs. A single-bit flip can make the model tend to produce a repeated output string across different inputs. Our robustness analysis reveals vulnerabilities in terms of performance and prediction patterns.

translation.title: 分析 LLM 及其骨干匹配 VLM 上的单比特翻转
translation.abstract: 开放权重的大语言模型（LLM）支持离线权重分析，并被复用为视觉语言模型（VLM）的骨干，这增加了 bit-flip 攻击的风险——攻击者通过操纵存储的权重比特来诱导恶意模型行为。攻击者可以在公开的 LLM 上识别易受攻击的比特，之后在部署的 LLM 或其骨干匹配的 VLM 中翻转相同位置。在这种场景下，单比特翻转尤其可行，因为在硬件故障攻击下它比多比特翻转更容易实现。然而，现有的比特选择器大多局限于多比特翻转，缺乏对单比特翻转的深入分析。本文将代表性的无数据和基于数据的比特选择器进行适配以识别候选比特。我们在源 LLM 上独立评估每个比特，并在骨干匹配的 VLM 的相同逻辑坐标处（无需重新搜索）进行评估，同时考虑性能下降和跨多个输入的预测模式。结果表明，单比特翻转的影响在 LLM 及其骨干匹配 VLM 上因选择器而异。单比特翻转可使模型在不同输入下倾向于产生重复的输出字符串。我们的鲁棒性分析揭示了性能和预测模式方面的脆弱性。
translation.brief: 解决单比特翻转攻击在 LLM 及其骨干匹配 VLM 上的脆弱性缺乏分析的问题，核心方法是适配多种比特选择器定位候选比特，并在源模型与 VLM 相同逻辑坐标处独立评估其性能与预测模式影响。

papers.title: RecurSciBench: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement in Data-Driven Scientific Research
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are advancing the automation of data-driven scientific research. Recent advances in recursive self-improvement (RSI) offer the potential for these agents to continuously improve through experience, but evaluating transfer across scientific tasks requires executable, scientifically verifiable tasks and independent assessment of self-improvement gains. We introduce RecurSciBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating RSI in data-driven scientific research. Its RecurSciPipe framework automatically constructs scientific modeling and data analysis tasks from raw datasets, with execution-based verification and scientific validity checks. RecurSciBench spans four scientific domains, multiple data modalities, and varied scientific objectives. We evaluate four RSI systems by comparing their initial and evolved states on independent tasks after evolution on source tasks, covering within-type, cross-type, and cross-domain transfer. Experiments show that the benefits of self-improvement vary across agent systems and scientific domains. Positive overall gains can coexist with regressions on individual tasks. Experience can transfer across task types and benefit other domains even without measurable gains in the source domain.

translation.title: RecurSciBench：面向数据驱动科学研究中递归自我提升的基准测试
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正在推动数据驱动科学研究的自动化。递归自我提升（RSI）的最新进展为这些智能体通过经验持续改进提供了可能，但评估其在科学任务间的迁移需要可执行、科学上可验证的任务以及对自我提升收益的独立评估。我们提出 RecurSciBench，一个用于评估数据驱动科学研究中 RSI 的可扩展基准。其 RecurSciPipe 框架从原始数据集自动构建科学建模与数据分析任务，并带有基于执行的验证和科学有效性检查。RecurSciBench 覆盖四个科学领域、多种数据模态和多样的科学目标。我们通过比较四个 RSI 系统在源任务上演化前后于独立任务上的表现来评估它们，涵盖同类型、跨类型和跨领域迁移。实验表明，自我提升的收益因智能体系统和科学领域而异。整体正收益可能与个别任务上的退化并存。经验可以跨任务类型迁移，即使在源领域没有可测收益的情况下也能惠及其他领域。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何评估 LLM 智能体递归自我提升在科学任务间迁移效果的问题，核心方法是构建自动生成可执行、可验证科学任务的基准 RecurSciBench 并系统比较演化前后的迁移收益。

papers.title: GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

translation.title: GeoVLDrive：面向自动驾驶的几何接地视觉语言推理
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）规划器继承了预训练视觉语言模型的语义知识，但其推理很少基于 3D 场景结构及其随时间的演化。我们提出 GeoVLDrive，一个用于 3D 时空推理与规划的几何接地 VLA 框架。来自 3D 基础模型的多层特征通过门控交叉注意力增强视觉语言主干。结构化的潜在思维链（CoT）将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动和元动作组织为有序且分别监督的潜在状态。动作专家基于这些状态和多层场景特征生成轨迹候选，并使用场景接地的交互式评分 token 对其排序。我们还提出 NAVSIM 3DQA 用于训练和评估度量化的 3D 空间与运动理解。GeoVLDrive 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.8 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 90.9 EPDMS。在 NAVSIM 3DQA 上，几何接地主干总体得分 89.2%，比微调的 Qwen3-VL-2B 基线高 4.6 个百分点。在 LingoQA 上，主干达到 68.6% 的 Lingo-Judge 准确率。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 VLA 自动驾驶规划器推理缺乏 3D 场景结构接地的问题，核心方法是用 3D 基础模型特征增强视觉语言主干并引入结构化潜在思维链进行时空推理与规划。

papers.title: Reliability-aware AI Agent Execution in Collaborative Edge Computing: A World Model Approach
papers.abstract: Collaborative edge computing supports AI agent applications by distributing execution across heterogeneous user-controlled devices with limited resources. This paper studies reliability-aware AI agent execution under node failures and wireless disruptions. These disruptions can make agent execution state unavailable or inconsistent, forcing recovery or recomputation that consumes the remaining deadline budget. Maintaining recoverable execution states can therefore improve request completion before deadlines. We formulate an online AI agent execution management problem that jointly selects resource allocations, state protection actions, and recovery targets to maximize the expected task success rate subject to resource, compatibility, and deadline constraints. We develop a world model that jointly captures evolving agent workflows and recoverable execution state under candidate management actions, accounting for node reliability, network conditions, and resource availability. The model enables the controller to simulate future execution and recovery trajectories under candidate actions and estimate their effects on execution progress and task completion before deadlines. We then employ world model-based model predictive control (WorldMPC) with Monte Carlo rollouts to jointly optimize resource allocation, state protection, and recovery decisions for long-term reliable agent execution under the dynamic environment. We evaluate the proposed approach on the simulation and real-world testbed using real-world and synthetic datasets. Experimental results show that WorldMPC improves task success rate over baselines in both simulation and real-world testbed.

translation.title: 协同边缘计算中可靠性感知的 AI 智能体执行：一种世界模型方法
translation.abstract: 协同边缘计算通过将执行分布到资源受限的异构用户控制设备上来支持 AI 智能体应用。本文研究节点故障和无线中断下可靠性感知的 AI 智能体执行。这些中断可能使智能体执行状态不可用或不一致，迫使恢复或重计算消耗剩余的截止时间预算。因此，维护可恢复的执行状态可以改善在截止时间前完成请求。我们形式化了一个在线 AI 智能体执行管理问题，在资源、兼容性和截止时间约束下联合选择资源分配、状态保护动作和恢复目标，以最大化期望任务成功率。我们开发了一个世界模型，联合刻画候选管理动作下不断演化的智能体工作流和可恢复执行状态，并考虑节点可靠性、网络状况和资源可用性。该模型使控制器能够在候选动作下模拟未来的执行与恢复轨迹，并在截止时间前估计其对执行进度和任务完成的影响。随后我们采用基于世界模型的模型预测控制（WorldMPC）结合蒙特卡洛 rollout，在动态环境下联合优化资源分配、状态保护和恢复决策，实现长期可靠的智能体执行。我们在仿真和真实测试床上使用真实与合成数据集评估所提方法。实验结果表明，WorldMPC 在仿真和真实测试床上的任务成功率均优于基线。
translation.brief: 该论文解决边缘节点故障与无线中断下 AI 智能体执行的可靠性问题，核心方法是构建联合刻画工作流与可恢复执行状态的世界模型，并用基于世界模型的模型预测控制联合优化资源分配、状态保护和恢复决策。

papers.title: Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards
papers.abstract: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.

translation.title: Avalon-M1：基于集体奖励的强化学习
translation.abstract: 我们提出基于集体奖励的强化学习（RLCR），一种在延迟约束下联合训练语言模型作为智能体组织的方法。一个 CEO 和最多八名专家共享一个策略，通过消息板和工作区协同，并使用共同的基于结果的优势进行训练。截止时间使得当并行工作能增加在时限内获得的回报时变得有价值。我们在 147 个环境中训练了 Avalon-M1-Mini（120B）。对于训练后的模型，八人组织的执行将 IMO-ProofBench-Advanced 分数从单智能体执行的 23.8% 提升至 39.0%。在 12 个基准上，组织在约三分之一于 token 匹配的单智能体执行延迟、略高于八次独立尝试后择优的延迟的情况下，取得了相近的平均分数。在比较各模型最佳测试配置时，训练后的模型在所有评估中均优于从同一基座模型后训练的 Nemotron 3 Super。在 EdgeBench 上，组织在约 0.4 派生小时后超越单智能体。在训练过程中，组织发展出层级结构以管理通信成本，加大对同行评审的投入，并改变工作的划分方式。安全评估发现对有害行为几乎普遍拒绝，但在三个监督场景中有两个出现外部报告的持续下降。这些结果为研究组织学习、性能-延迟权衡和集体监督建立了共享优势基线。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何在延迟约束下训练语言模型作为多智能体组织协同工作的问题，核心方法是提出基于集体奖励的强化学习（RLCR），让共享策略的 CEO 与专家团队以共同结果优势联合训练。

papers.title: RePrism: Joint Request and Representation Scheduling for LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows often invoke large language models multiple times. When the dependencies are visible to the serving system, it can use them to schedule requests and cache reusable content, improving workflow execution efficiency. Prior work has largely focused on ordering requests or managing shared resources under a fixed caching scheme. A reusable prompt that specifies model behavior, however, can have multiple representations. We present RePrism, a serving system that jointly selects which ready request to serve and which eligible representation of its prompt to use. Its goal is to improve throughput and shorten session completion time (SCT). The scheduler ranks pairs of requests and representations by combining each pair's immediate value with an estimate of its future value based on the visible workflow. The resource manager allocates GPU memory to both LoRA adapters and cached key-value states. It also coordinates their admission and eviction as memory pressure changes. We compare RePrism with S-LoRA on a dynamic workload with an arrival rate of 1.8 sessions per second, and it achieves 1.37 times the request throughput and reduces P95 SCT by a factor of 4.10. Under controlled load, RePrism reduces mean time to first token by a factor of 5.26 relative to S-LoRA. On a controlled workload, RePrism's joint scoring achieves 2.7% higher request throughput and 12.3% lower mean SCT than a policy that ranks requests before selecting their representations.

translation.title: RePrism：面向 LLM 智能体服务的请求与表示联合调度
translation.abstract: 智能体工作流通常多次调用大语言模型。当依赖关系对服务系统可见时，系统可以利用它们来调度请求并缓存可复用内容，从而提高工作流执行效率。已有工作大多聚焦于在固定缓存方案下对请求排序或管理共享资源。然而，一个规定模型行为的可复用提示可以有多种表示。我们提出 RePrism，一个联合选择服务哪个就绪请求以及使用其提示的哪个合格表示的服务系统。其目标是提高吞吐量并缩短会话完成时间（SCT）。调度器将每对请求-表示的即时价值与基于可见工作流的未来价值估计相结合来排序。资源管理器为 LoRA 适配器和缓存的键值状态分配 GPU 内存，并在内存压力变化时协调其准入与驱逐。我们在到达率为每秒 1.8 个会话的动态负载下将 RePrism 与 S-LoRA 比较，RePrism 实现了 1.37 倍的请求吞吐量，并将 P95 SCT 降低 4.10 倍。在受控负载下，RePrism 相对 S-LoRA 将平均首 token 时间降低 5.26 倍。在受控工作负载上，RePrism 的联合评分比先排序请求再选择其表示的策略高出 2.7% 的请求吞吐量，并降低 12.3% 的平均 SCT。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 智能体服务中请求调度与提示表示选择割裂导致效率低下的问题，核心方法是提出 RePrism 系统联合调度请求与提示表示，并统一管理 LoRA 适配器与 KV 缓存的 GPU 内存。

papers.title: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
papers.abstract: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.

translation.title: PartAgent：通过专家集成与闭环精炼的智能体式3D部件分割
translation.abstract: 将3D物体分割为语义上有意义的部件需要对几何结构和语义上下文进行联合推理。预训练的3D专家提供空间上有依据的区域提议，而2D专家提供用于识别物体部件的语义线索。挑战在于将这些互补能力整合到一个既能产生有意义的部件分割又能逐步精炼它们的框架中。我们提出PartAgent，一个无需训练的智能体式3D部件分割框架，建立在两个互补模块之上：(i) 结构-语义专家集成通过图像到表面的对应关系，将3D专家预测的区域与来自2D专家的多视角语义证据相结合，构建多粒度的组合式部件划分。(ii) 观察驱动的闭环划分精炼观察当前划分及其支持证据，以选择有针对性的检查、证据修复、组合或重新选择动作。它验证提议的更改，并使用更新后的状态和动作结果来指导后续决策。在PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT上，PartAgent达到68.41 mIoU，超过最强竞争方法8.53分。在3DCoMPaT200、PartNeXt、PartNetE和PartObjaverse-Tiny上，PartAgent在每个数据集上均取得最高mIoU，四个数据集平均为69.36，比竞争方法中的最高平均值高出7.28分。
translation.brief: 解决3D部件分割中几何与语义信息融合问题，采用无需训练的智能体框架，集成3D与2D专家并通过闭环观察精炼划分。

papers.title: Understanding the Importance of Massive Activations through Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract: A common occurrence in Large Language Models (LLMs) is the emergence of so-called massive activations. This phenomenon is well known in the literature and has been connected to attention sinks, representational compression, as well as signal propagation. However, the reasons and consequences for their appearance are not yet well understood. In this paper, we explain the role of massive activations in deep learning by showing that they are connected to the region migration phenomenon in delayed robustness. Under the spline theoretic interpretation of deep networks, we show that massive activations push the representations away from the nonlinearity boundaries of the network, decreasing the complexity of its input-output map around data points. Furthermore, we uncover for the first time that this phenomenon is not unique to transformers and actually appears in a number of common architectures performing simple supervised learning tasks. We validate this connection through extensive experiments on a diverse set of architectures including residual MLP, ResNet18, Vision Transformers and GPT and datasets including MNIST, CIFAR10, Imagenette and Shakespeare Text. We consistently observe that massive activations and region migration co-occur with adversarial robustness. Furthermore, we illustrate that this connection holds in the large-scale pretraining of LLMs by showing that the rise of massive activations in LLMs closely tracks the adversarial accuracy of the model under perturbations of the token embeddings.

translation.title: 通过对抗鲁棒性理解大规模激活的重要性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中一个常见现象是所谓大规模激活（massive activations）的出现。这一现象在文献中广为人知，并与注意力汇聚（attention sinks）、表征压缩以及信号传播相关联。然而，其出现的原因和后果尚未被充分理解。在本文中，我们通过展示大规模激活与延迟鲁棒性中的区域迁移现象相关联，解释了大规模激活在深度学习中的作用。在深度网络的样条理论解释下，我们表明大规模激活将表征推离网络的非线性边界，降低了其输入输出映射在数据点附近的复杂度。此外，我们首次揭示这一现象并非Transformer独有，实际上出现在许多执行简单监督学习任务的常见架构中。我们通过在包括残差MLP、ResNet18、Vision Transformers和GPT等多种架构以及MNIST、CIFAR10、Imagenette和Shakespeare Text等数据集上的大量实验验证了这一联系。我们一致观察到大规模激活与区域迁移和对抗鲁棒性共同出现。此外，我们通过展示LLM中大规模激活的兴起与模型在token嵌入扰动下的对抗准确率紧密相关，说明这一联系在LLM的大规模预训练中同样成立。
translation.brief: 研究大规模激活的作用，通过样条理论将其与区域迁移现象和对抗鲁棒性联系起来，并在多种架构和数据集上验证。

papers.title: Recursive Collective Intelligence: Emergence on an Equal-Budget Ladder in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly work as teams of agents, and a team is expected to solve problems beyond the reach of any single member. Most evaluations credit a team for outperforming a single agent, without accounting for the additional computation: a team may consume many times the tokens of one agent, and a plain vote over independent answers already explains most of the reported gain. Two questions therefore remain open: When does interaction itself make a group smarter, and can a group improve its next generation by learning from its own work? We answer both with the equal-budget ladder, which grades a group against independent agents at three levels: outperforming a single agent, a compute-matched majority vote, and compute-matched pass@n. On this ladder we define Recursive Collective Intelligence (RCI) as a group whose own output, without a teacher or external labels, makes its next generation smarter at equal cost. Three findings follow. First, interaction improves collective intelligence when it moves information across agents: forwarding split facts lifts groups above pass@n at three model scales, by about a third at 27B. Second, organization emerges spontaneously: identical 27B agents form hubs and improve accuracy by 18 percentage points; encoding their organization in a prompt enables them to reach level 3 at less than half the token budget in a descriptive comparison. Third, groups recursively improve themselves: Two label-free generations progressively climb the ladder, the second 9B generation surpassing both pass@$n$ and a control trained on base-model turns; on PlanBench, HiddenBench and Hanabi, each generation outperforms its predecessor on unseen problems for four to six generations. A group therefore outperforms its members when it forwards useful information more efficiently than it spends tokens on coordination, and learns to do so from its own work.

translation.title: 递归集体智能：多智能体LLM系统中等预算阶梯上的涌现
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地以智能体团队的形式工作，人们期望团队能解决任何单个成员无法解决的问题。大多数评估只将团队优于单个智能体归功于团队，而未考虑额外的计算开销：团队可能消耗单个智能体数倍的token，而对独立答案的简单投票已经能解释大部分报告的收益。因此两个问题仍然悬而未决：交互本身何时能让群体更聪明？群体能否通过从自身工作中学习来改进下一代？我们用等预算阶梯回答这两个问题，该阶梯在三个层级上对群体与独立智能体进行评级：优于单个智能体、计算匹配的多数投票以及计算匹配的pass@n。在此阶梯上，我们将递归集体智能（RCI）定义为：在无教师或外部标签的情况下，群体自身的输出能以相同成本使其下一代更聪明。由此得出三个发现。第一，当交互在智能体之间传递信息时，交互能提升集体智能：转发拆分的事实使群体在三个模型规模上超越pass@n，在27B规模上约提升三分之一。第二，组织自发涌现：相同的27B智能体形成枢纽并将准确率提升18个百分点；在描述性比较中，将其组织编码进提示词使它们能以不到一半的token预算达到第3层级。第三，群体递归地自我改进：两代无标签生成逐步攀爬阶梯，第二代9B生成同时超越pass@n和在基础模型轮次上训练的对照组；在PlanBench、HiddenBench和Hanabi上，每一代在未见问题上都优于前代，持续四到六代。因此，当群体比在协调上花费token更高效地转发有用信息，并从自身工作中学会这样做时，群体就会优于其成员。
translation.brief: 研究多智能体LLM团队何时真正超越单个智能体，提出等预算阶梯评估框架和递归集体智能概念，发现信息转发与组织涌现是关键。

papers.title: Privacy Disclosure Control Benchmark (PDC-Bench): How Faithfully Do LLMs Keep Privacy Constraints on In-Context Disclosure Granularity?
papers.abstract: In LLM task execution, a constraint on the permitted disclosure granularity of personal attributes is sometimes imposed on the output. For example, if a person's private attribute is their location (San Francisco) and disclosure is permitted only at the country level, an output at the state level (California) violates the constraint. Detecting such violations requires capturing not only direct privacy leakage (San Francisco) but also semantic leakage (California). However, existing benchmarks cannot measure the degree of leakage with respect to a given semantic constraint such as the country-level limit. We therefore formalize disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling over the hierarchy of a knowledge graph. Building on this formulation, we construct PDC-Bench, a benchmark of 16,105 samples covering geography, age, race and ethnicity, and occupation. In our experiments applying PDC-Bench to eleven LLMs, 62% of the constraint violations were semantic leakage. We further found that semantic leakage depends less on the model than on the permitted disclosure granularity and the task's need for the private attribute; reliable auditing must therefore target semantic leakage together with these two factors. Data, prompts, and code are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 隐私披露控制基准（PDC-Bench）：LLM在上下文披露粒度上能多忠实地遵守隐私约束？
translation.abstract: 在LLM任务执行中，有时会对输出施加关于个人属性允许披露粒度的约束。例如，如果某人的隐私属性是其位置（旧金山），而披露仅允许在国家层面，那么州层面的输出（加利福尼亚）就违反了约束。检测此类违规不仅需要捕捉直接隐私泄露（旧金山），还需要捕捉语义泄露（加利福尼亚）。然而，现有基准无法衡量相对于给定语义约束（如国家层面限制）的泄露程度。因此，我们将披露控制形式化为对知识图谱层级中允许上限的约束。基于这一形式化，我们构建了PDC-Bench，一个包含16,105个样本、涵盖地理、年龄、种族与民族以及职业的基准。在将PDC-Bench应用于十一个LLM的实验中，62%的约束违规是语义泄露。我们进一步发现，语义泄露更多取决于允许的披露粒度和任务对隐私属性的需求，而非模型本身；因此可靠的审计必须针对语义泄露以及这两个因素。数据、提示词和代码可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 解决LLM输出中语义层面隐私泄露难以度量的问题，将披露控制形式化为知识图谱层级上限约束并构建PDC-Bench基准。

papers.title: HiCal: Offline Calibration for Hierarchical Scale Encoding in Accurate HiF4 Quantization
papers.abstract: Block floating-point (BFP) quantization is widely adopted for efficient low-bit large language model (LLM) inference, where the choice of block scales plays a critical role in quantization accuracy. HiFloat4 (HiF4) employs a hierarchical scale encoding scheme consisting of a global E6M2 scale and two levels of binary scale extensions. However, its conventional rounding rule and fixed scale extension thresholds may not fully capture the statistical characteristics of the quantized tensors in practice, leading to suboptimal scale representations. In this work, we propose HiCal, an offline calibration approach that improves HiF4 quantization accuracy by refining the encoding decisions across all three scale levels. Specifically, we introduce a calibrated rounding bias for the Level-1 E6M2 scale and optimize the scale-extension thresholds at Levels 2 and 3 based on the empirical distributions of local group magnitudes. The resulting calibration parameters are determined offline and remain fixed during inference, while the hierarchical encoding continues to adapt to individual blocks through their local values. This design eliminates the need for per-block multi-candidate scale search while preserving the original deterministic HiF4 encoding procedure. Experiments across five synthetic and real activation distributions show that the proposed method reduces quantization MSE by 9.91%-23.50% relative to the original HiF4 scheme, including a 13.00% reduction on real Qwen3-8B activations. End-to-end evaluations across six benchmarks further show average-score improvements of 0.91 and 1.25 percentage points on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, respectively, without per-block multi-candidate search during inference.

translation.title: HiCal：面向精确HiF4量化的分层尺度编码离线校准
translation.abstract: 块浮点（BFP）量化被广泛用于高效低比特大语言模型（LLM）推理，其中块尺度的选择对量化精度至关重要。HiFloat4（HiF4）采用由全局E6M2尺度和两级二进制尺度扩展组成的分层尺度编码方案。然而，其传统的舍入规则和固定的尺度扩展阈值可能无法充分捕捉实际中量化张量的统计特性，导致次优的尺度表示。在本工作中，我们提出HiCal，一种通过精炼所有三个尺度层级的编码决策来提升HiF4量化精度的离线校准方法。具体而言，我们为Level-1的E6M2尺度引入校准的舍入偏置，并基于局部组幅值的经验分布优化Level 2和Level 3的尺度扩展阈值。所得校准参数离线确定并在推理期间保持固定，同时分层编码仍通过局部值自适应于各个块。这一设计消除了逐块多候选尺度搜索的需要，同时保留了原始的确定性HiF4编码过程。在五种合成和真实激活分布上的实验表明，所提方法相对于原始HiF4方案将量化MSE降低9.91%-23.50%，包括在真实Qwen3-8B激活上降低13.00%。在六个基准上的端到端评估进一步显示，Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的平均分数分别提升0.91和1.25个百分点，且推理期间无需逐块多候选搜索。
translation.brief: 解决HiF4量化中固定舍入规则和尺度扩展阈值导致的精度损失问题，提出离线校准方法HiCal精炼三个尺度层级的编码决策。

papers.title: ModelLess: A Serverless System for Multi-Tier LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
papers.abstract: LLM inference platforms sell online, asynchronous, batch and rollout products on GPUs provisioned per product, so a service's cards sit idle between bursts while other work waits. We present ModelLess, a serverless system for LLM inference. Users declare model services and the platform owns the instances. An idle service scales to zero: its instances go to sleep with their weights in host memory (release about 1 s, wake about 4 s for GLM-5.2 at TP8, against a cold start of over four minutes). Billing follows the time a service holds GPUs. The GPUs that sleeping instances free are lent to lower tiers. Cluster managers preempt low-priority tasks and treat eviction as all-or-nothing, but an LLM instance's eviction cost depends on which of its weights, execution state, KV cache and in-flight requests survive. ModelLess therefore gives each tier (online, job, flex) eviction semantics that state what it may lose when preempted, and runs a preemption protocol that closes admission before it releases memory, re-enqueues a request durably before it aborts it, and fails closed. Four components (entry, dispatcher, node agent, SGLang plugin) enforce it with sleep/wake, pause/resume of in-flight requests for flex, and a weight-copy path (follow/seal) for RL rollout. Replaying a week of traces from 1,100 H20 cards serving long-tail online models shows that about 38% of GPU-time (417 equivalent GPUs) could be lent under a coarse latency target with one fixed idle threshold. This is an idealized upper bound, and it holds only if recovery takes seconds: with a 240 s cold start under 8% remains even with per-service thresholds. On one node, a single four-hour run per policy shows that pausing yields 22% more borrower tokens per held GPU sample than abort-and-requeue, with the same median online latency. The job tier and follow/seal are not yet evaluated end to end.

translation.title: ModelLess：基于共享GPU的多层LLM推理无服务器系统
translation.abstract: LLM推理平台按产品线独立配置GPU来售卖在线、异步、批处理和rollout服务，导致某服务的GPU在流量低谷时闲置而其他任务却在等待。我们提出ModelLess，一个面向LLM推理的无服务器系统。用户声明模型服务，实例由平台统一管理。空闲服务可缩容到零：实例休眠并将权重保存在主机内存中（GLM-5.2在TP8下释放约1秒、唤醒约4秒，而冷启动超过四分钟）。计费按服务占用GPU的时间计算。休眠实例释放的GPU可出借给低层级任务。集群管理器抢占低优先级任务时采用全有或全无的驱逐方式，但LLM实例的驱逐成本取决于其权重、执行状态、KV cache和在途请求中哪些得以保留。因此ModelLess为每个层级（online、job、flex）定义了驱逐语义，说明被抢占时可能失去什么，并运行一套抢占协议：先关闭准入再释放内存，在中止请求前将其持久化重新入队，并保证失败时安全关闭。四个组件（entry、dispatcher、node agent、SGLang插件）通过休眠/唤醒、flex层在途请求的暂停/恢复，以及面向RL rollout的权重复制路径（follow/seal）来实现该协议。回放一周内1,100张H20卡服务长尾在线模型的轨迹显示，在粗粒度延迟目标和一个固定空闲阈值下，约38%的GPU时间（相当于417张GPU）可以出借。这是理想化的上界，且仅在恢复耗时为秒级时成立：若冷启动为240秒，即使采用按服务阈值，可出借比例也降至8%以下。在单节点上，每种策略各进行一次四小时运行的结果表明，暂停方式比中止并重新入队在每个持有GPU样本上多产生22%的借用方token，同时在线延迟中位数相同。job层级和follow/seal尚未进行端到端评估。
translation.brief: 解决LLM推理平台GPU按产品隔离导致闲置的问题，提出无服务器系统ModelLess，通过休眠/唤醒、分层驱逐语义和抢占协议实现GPU跨层级共享出借。

papers.title: TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.abstract: Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

translation.title: TeamFlowFlowRL：面向多智能体协作的去中心化流策略在线策略优化
translation.abstract: 复杂的协作任务需要多智能体的协调行为。离线生成式策略能从轨迹中学习富有表现力的协作行为，但受限于固定数据集。在线强化学习可通过环境交互改进它们。然而，微调流策略十分困难，因为动作似然难以计算。我们提出TeamFlowRL，一个两阶段框架：先离线预训练多智能体流策略，再在线微调。我们在去中心化流策略的完整去噪轨迹上构建团队策略优化，避免难以求解的动作似然。所得目标函数用共享的团队优势为每个智能体的轨迹比率加权，并对各比率分别裁剪，使局部策略更新与共同团队回报对齐。在七个仿真组的51个配对配置中，TeamFlowRL改进了所有离线初始化，归一化得分平均提升47.3%。在6个双手任务中，其在探索噪声下的平均成功率也比高斯策略微调高33.1%。
translation.brief: 解决流策略因动作似然难计算而难以在线微调的问题，提出在完整去噪轨迹上以共享团队优势加权的两阶段优化框架TeamFlowRL。

papers.title: A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics
papers.abstract: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs to find the right tables and ground a question in the right codes. The benchmark includes expert-annotated questions for different query and aggregation types, including raw value retrieval, summations, proportion calculations, and joins. Alongside standard evaluation measures, we introduce an observation F1 metric that measures how close a query is to the ground truth even when the answers are different. We evaluate a variety of state-of-the-art LLMs and find that they struggle to write SQL that answers the questions correctly.

translation.title: 面向官方统计的Text-to-SQL基准
translation.abstract: 官方统计是政策制定者、企业等各类主体的重要数据集。对官方统计的提供方而言，提升数据的可访问性、治理和披露水平至关重要。基于text-to-SQL方法的问答系统可以改善这一点。然而，现有text-to-SQL基准与这一场景不符。官方统计以开放目录形式发布数千张宽表，其列和取值都是代码，其含义记录在独立的元数据中而非关系模式里。为填补这一空白，我们提出LOCuST，一个text-to-SQL基准，将Statistics Netherlands的两千多张英文和荷兰语表格与一个语义知识图谱配对。该图谱通过标签、定义、层级和单位描述表格、度量和维度代码，是系统找到正确表格并将问题落地到正确代码所需的外部知识。基准包含专家标注的、覆盖不同查询与聚合类型的问题，包括原始值检索、求和、比例计算和连接。除标准评估指标外，我们提出观测F1指标，即使答案不同也能衡量查询与真实答案的接近程度。我们评估了多种最先进的LLM，发现它们难以写出正确回答问题的SQL。
translation.brief: 解决现有text-to-SQL基准不适用于官方统计场景（宽表、代码化列值、外部元数据）的问题，构建结合语义知识图谱的LOCuST基准并提出观测F1指标。

papers.title: Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents
papers.abstract: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.

translation.title: Bathys：推进深度搜索智能体
translation.abstract: 深度搜索是智能体应对复杂开放任务的关键能力，解决此类问题需要迭代式信息收集、查询改写和基于证据的验证，而非单次检索。为此，我们提出Bathys 9B和27B深度搜索智能体，其训练框架涵盖可验证的问题合成、后训练以及上下文压缩下的在线强化学习（RL）。高质量的数据构建保证了搜索深度和可靠性：每条线索都被改写为需要独立检索的间接引用，并保留证据链以验证线索共同决定唯一答案。精选轨迹支撑了监督微调（SFT）、Kahneman-Tversky优化（KTO）和压缩管理组序列策略优化（CM-GSPO）的流水线：SFT为长时程工具使用和查询改写提供稳定基础；KTO利用轨迹上的二元反馈改进基于证据的答案选择；CM-GSPO在记录的rollout上下文上用长度归一化似然比优化执行子轨迹，并重加权子轨迹优势以校正独立平均子轨迹损失引入的额外权重。在带轨迹自验证和条件重试的评估协议下，Bathys 9B和27B在BrowseComp上分别取得66.51%和80.49%。
translation.brief: 解决深度搜索智能体需要迭代检索与证据验证的问题，构建从可验证问题合成到SFT、KTO和CM-GSPO在线RL的完整训练框架。

papers.title: Economic World Model
papers.abstract: Can artificial intelligence reproduce the economic dynamics that emerge as households, firms and governments interact and adapt through markets and institutions? To answer this question, we define an economic world model (EWM) as an agent's internal representation of how an economic system works, enabling counterfactual simulation and decision-making under resource constraints. We then propose a general framework for studying EWMs that links three tasks: simulating agent behaviour, learning economic transitions and systematically evaluating the dynamics. As an initial implementation, we learn household policies from microeconomic data and calibrate a structural economic transition model using macroeconomic data, linking individual decisions to aggregate dynamics. Our micro-to-macro evaluation framework compares simulated individual actions and group distributions with observed microdata and assesses macroeconomic dynamics through forecasting and counterfactual experiments. Results show that simulated and observed household consumption distributions overlap by 94.9%, while EWM forecasts closely track real GDP and several other aggregate levels. In government-borrowing counterfactuals, the EWM reproduces the benchmark life-cycle model's short-run transmission from borrowing to consumption. For ex ante planning, the EWM enables an LLM agent to achieve 10.29% higher simulated GDP under the epidemic shock than direct LLM decisions. This initial EWM is only a starting point. We invite economists and AI researchers to build a stronger EWM together. Economists can contribute richer economic models and knowledge, while AI researchers can develop stronger data-driven methods for simulating agent behaviour and learning economic transitions. Together, we aim not only to reproduce real economic dynamics, but also to discover and test new mechanisms that support better decisions and benefit society.

translation.title: 经济世界模型
translation.abstract: 人工智能能否再现家庭、企业和政府通过市场与制度互动和适应所产生的经济动态？为回答这一问题，我们将经济世界模型（EWM）定义为智能体对经济系统运行方式的内部表征，使其能够在资源约束下进行反事实模拟和决策。我们进而提出研究EWM的通用框架，联结三项任务：模拟智能体行为、学习经济转移以及系统评估动态。作为初步实现，我们从微观数据学习家庭策略，并用宏观数据校准结构化经济转移模型，将个体决策与总体动态联系起来。我们的微观到宏观评估框架将模拟的个体行为和群体分布与观测微观数据对比，并通过预测和反事实实验评估宏观经济动态。结果显示，模拟与观测的家庭消费分布重叠度达94.9%，EWM的预测紧密跟踪真实GDP及其他多个总量水平。在政府借贷反事实中，EWM再现了基准生命周期模型中借贷对消费的短期传导。在事前规划中，EWM使LLM智能体在疫情冲击下比LLM直接决策获得高10.29%的模拟GDP。这一初步EWM仅是起点。我们邀请经济学家和AI研究者共同构建更强的EWM：经济学家可贡献更丰富的经济模型和知识，AI研究者可开发更强的数据驱动方法来模拟智能体行为和学习经济转移。我们共同的目标不仅是再现真实经济动态，还要发现和检验支持更好决策、造福社会的新机制。
translation.brief: 解决AI能否再现经济系统动态的问题，提出经济世界模型（EWM）框架，从微观数据学习家庭策略并结合宏观校准实现模拟、预测与反事实分析。

papers.title: The Elephant-Goldfish Model for software design review: what a fresh reviewer can see
papers.abstract: A design can be easy to understand and still specify the wrong system. Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model asks fresh agents to review a design without the conversation that produced it. We examined how this choice affects detection of omissions, agreement violations and internal defects. We seeded nine defects in each of 47 public software design documents and supplied each with a scripted drafting conversation. A fresh reviewer given the conversation as its own earlier exchange detected 94.8% of omitted-decision instances, compared with 62.4% for the same model given the document alone. It detected 98.3% of violations of conversation-only requirements. On document-visible defects, recall was 87.5% with the conversation and 88.4% without it, equivalent within a prespecified 15-percentage-point margin. Three model judges scored detection and were calibrated on constructed controls. In document-only runs, the plugin's five-stage review took a geometric mean of 9.03 minutes against 1.81 for one reviewer. Its estimated recall was lower under both judging procedures, with a difference distinguishable from zero under one. A later generic-prompt comparison gave a similar result. The experiment separates two objectives for automated design review: testing whether a new reader can reconstruct the design and checking whether the design preserves the decisions that govern implementation.

translation.title: 软件设计评审的“大象-金鱼”模型：新评审者能看到什么
translation.abstract: 一个设计可能易于理解，却规定了错误的系统。Google 的 Elephant-Goldfish 模型让全新的 agent 在不了解产生该设计的讨论过程的情况下评审设计。我们研究了这一选择如何影响对遗漏、约定违反和内部缺陷的检测。我们在 47 份公开软件设计文档中各植入九个缺陷，并为每份文档提供一段脚本化的起草对话。将对话作为自己先前交流提供给全新评审者时，其检测到 94.8% 的遗漏决策实例，而同一模型仅凭文档时为 62.4%。它检测到 98.3% 的仅存在于对话中的需求违反。对于文档可见的缺陷，有对话时召回率为 87.5%，无对话时为 88.4%，在预设的 15 个百分点误差范围内等价。三个模型裁判对检测结果进行评分，并通过构造的对照进行校准。在仅文档的运行中，该插件的五阶段评审几何平均耗时 9.03 分钟，而单个评审者为 1.81 分钟。在两种评判程序下，其估计召回率均较低，且其中一种下差异可区分于零。后续的通用提示对比给出了类似结果。该实验将自动化设计评审的两个目标区分开来：测试新读者能否重构该设计，以及检查设计是否保留了指导实现的决策。
translation.brief: 研究让不了解设计讨论背景的新评审者（agent）评审设计文档能否发现遗漏与缺陷，通过在47份文档中植入缺陷并对比有无起草对话的检测效果来验证。

papers.title: AI-Generated Code Issues: A Taxonomy from Repository Histories, AI Conversations, and Developer Interviews
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate source code, yet the quality issues in such code remain only partially understood. Understanding these issues can help developers adapt quality assurance practices, such as code review and testing, to better detect problems that may be more common in AI-generated than in human-written code. We study how quality issues in AI-generated code manifest in real software development activities through a mixed-method empirical study that draws on evidence from three complementary sources. First, we mine GitHub commits whose messages explicitly attribute a fix to a problem in AI-generated code, and we manually inspect the 914 matched commits to remove false positives and classify the quality issue being corrected. Second, we collect developers' shared conversations with AI tools, identify conversations including source code and textual signals of model mistakes, and manually analyze 299 of them to classify the underlying quality issue. Third, we interview 20 practitioners and researchers who use AI coding tools to enrich and validate the obtained catalog of quality issues. From these analyses, we derive a taxonomy of 87 types of developer-attributed quality issues in AI-generated code, going beyond functional bugs. Our findings contribute an empirically grounded taxonomy and implications for the design and evaluation of AI coding assistants and agents.

translation.title: AI 生成代码的问题：来自仓库历史、AI 对话和开发者访谈的分类体系
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于生成源代码，但此类代码中的质量问题仍只被部分理解。理解这些问题可以帮助开发者调整质量保证实践（如代码评审和测试），以更好地检测那些在 AI 生成代码中可能比人类编写代码中更常见的问题。我们通过一项混合方法实证研究，考察 AI 生成代码的质量问题如何在真实软件开发活动中显现，该研究借鉴了三个互补来源的证据。首先，我们挖掘 GitHub 上提交信息明确将修复归因于 AI 生成代码问题的 commit，人工检查 914 个匹配的 commit 以剔除误报并对所修复的质量问题进行分类。其次，我们收集开发者与 AI 工具共享的对话，识别包含源代码和模型错误文本信号的对话，并人工分析其中 299 个以对底层质量问题进行分类。第三，我们访谈 20 位使用 AI 编码工具的从业者和研究者，以丰富和验证所获得的质量问题目录。基于这些分析，我们构建了一个包含 87 类开发者归因的 AI 生成代码质量问题的分类体系，超越了功能性 bug 的范畴。我们的发现提供了一个有实证依据的分类体系，并对 AI 编码助手和 agent 的设计与评估具有启示意义。
translation.brief: 通过挖掘 GitHub 修复提交、分析开发者与 AI 的对话并访谈从业者，构建了 AI 生成代码中 87 类质量问题的分类体系。

papers.title: CAPTA: Identifying LLMs Behind AI Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents access remote services through tools to complete user tasks, often via API calls. In this setting, a remote service may want to identify the backend LLM of an agent to launch model-specific attacks, including prompt injection or selective delivery of manipulated content. However, the service cannot directly query the backend model and must instead collect observable responses through its interactions with the agent, making identification challenging. In this paper, we present Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart (CAPTA), a model identification approach inspired by CAPTCHA (Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart), which distinguishes humans from automated programs. CAPTA presents multiple-choice questions as verification challenges, using differences in models' selection preferences to identify the backend LLM. It selects questions based on cross-model option-generation diversity and uses LLM-guided search to optimize their option sets. Our evaluation shows that CAPTA achieves 99.0% mean identification accuracy with only 10 questions across 25 LLMs from 10 model families. We further evaluate CAPTA with four widely used agents and seven representative LLMs, achieving 99.7% mean identification accuracy across all 28 agent-LLM combinations with 30 submitted answers.

translation.title: CAPTA：识别 AI Agent 背后的 LLM
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的 agent 通过工具（通常经由 API 调用）访问远程服务以完成用户任务。在这种场景下，远程服务可能希望识别 agent 的后端 LLM，以发起模型特定的攻击，包括提示注入或选择性投递被篡改的内容。然而，服务无法直接查询后端模型，只能通过其与 agent 的交互收集可观察的响应，这使得识别颇具挑战。本文提出 Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart（CAPTA），一种受 CAPTCHA（Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart，用于区分人类与自动化程序）启发的模型识别方法。CAPTA 将选择题作为验证挑战，利用模型选择偏好的差异来识别后端 LLM。它基于跨模型选项生成多样性来选择问题，并使用 LLM 引导的搜索优化其选项集。我们的评估表明，CAPTA 仅用 10 个问题即可在来自 10 个模型家族的 25 个 LLM 上达到 99.0% 的平均识别准确率。我们进一步用四个广泛使用的 agent 和七个代表性 LLM 评估 CAPTA，在全部 28 个 agent-LLM 组合上提交 30 个答案即达到 99.7% 的平均识别准确率。
translation.brief: 提出 CAPTA 方法，通过向 agent 提出利用模型选择偏好差异的选择题挑战，从可观察响应中识别其后端 LLM。

papers.title: Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted to enhance the multimodal reasoning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods share a common limitation of Module-Level Credit Entanglement, in which the vision encoder, projector, and LLM modules are jointly optimized using the same advantage signals even when perceptual correctness and final-answer correctness differ. To address this limitation, we propose Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), a framework that separates perceptual and outcome-based learning signals across model modules. Specifically, MSPO uses responses to perception checklists comprising auxiliary questions about visual information to derive an advantage for training the vision encoder. From these responses, MSPO computes the Confidence-aware Perception Reward (CaPR), using a perception sign obtained by thresholding checklist accuracy to determine reward direction and posterior confidence from a Beta distribution over latent perception accuracy to scale reward magnitude. We then derive the vision advantage through group-relative normalization of CaPR and scale it using main-task success rates. This advantage guides updates to the vision encoder, while the projector and LLM retain outcome-based GRPO updates. Extensive experiments on seven mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MSPO outperforms existing RL-tuned models on average at both the 3B and 7B scales.

translation.title: 我们是否在奖励错误的模块？面向多模态强化学习的模块特定策略优化
translation.abstract: 基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已被广泛用于增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多模态推理能力。然而，现有方法存在一个共同局限——模块级信用纠缠（Module-Level Credit Entanglement），即视觉编码器、投影器和 LLM 模块使用相同的优势信号被联合优化，即使感知正确性与最终答案正确性并不一致。为解决这一局限，我们提出模块特定策略优化（MSPO），一个在各模型模块间分离感知信号与结果信号学习信号的框架。具体而言，MSPO 利用对感知清单（包含关于视觉信息的辅助问题）的响应来推导用于训练视觉编码器的优势。基于这些响应，MSPO 计算置信度感知感知奖励（CaPR），通过对清单准确率设定阈值得到的感知符号确定奖励方向，并利用对潜在感知准确率的 Beta 分布后验置信度来缩放奖励幅度。随后，我们通过对 CaPR 进行组相对归一化推导视觉优势，并用主任务成功率对其进行缩放。该优势指导视觉编码器的更新，而投影器和 LLM 保留基于结果的 GRPO 更新。在七个数学和通用推理基准上的大量实验表明，MSPO 在 3B 和 7B 规模上平均优于现有 RL 调优模型。
translation.brief: 针对 GRPO 中视觉编码器与 LLM 被同一优势信号联合优化的信用纠缠问题，提出 MSPO 框架，用感知清单奖励单独更新视觉编码器，其余模块保留结果导向更新。

papers.title: Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM, Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages
papers.abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. Moreover, reasoning traces can leak confidential records even when final answers withhold them. Our experiments also show that post-training does not consistently improve safety. Our findings demonstrate that system prompts alone cannot ensure confidentiality and highlight the need for multilingual reasoning-aware safety evaluations.

translation.title: 对主权 LLM、其推理过程及其训练阶段的红队测试
translation.abstract: 开放权重大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于涉及敏感信息的应用。我们研究系统提示中的保密指令能否保护此类信息。我们对开放主权 LLM Apertus v1.5 以及其他五个模型家族进行了红队测试，覆盖六种语言和多种推理模式。我们使用合成个人记录来评估直接泄露、纠正诱饵、是/否验证、派生值查询、推理泄露和授权检查。我们还探讨了版权归属、历史歪曲和刻板印象。尽管有保密指令，Apertus 8B 和 70B 在纠正诱饵攻击下分别有 96% 和 95% 的请求泄露信息。验证和派生值查询也会暴露受保护信息，而不必泄露标识符。此外，即使最终答案有所保留，推理轨迹也可能泄露机密记录。我们的实验还表明，后训练并不能持续提升安全性。我们的发现表明，仅靠系统提示无法确保保密性，并凸显了开展多语言、推理感知的安全评估的必要性。
translation.brief: 对 Apertus 等开放权重 LLM 进行多语言红队测试，评估系统提示保密指令能否防止敏感信息通过直接查询、推理轨迹等途径泄露。

papers.title: ASCENT: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Stepwise Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models on Common Clinical Scenarios
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at medical question answering yet are rarely evaluated on the stepwise diagnostic reasoning that defines real clinical workflows, where impressions are revised as information accumulates. We build Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis (ASCENT), a clinician-annotated benchmark and training resource of 3,078 stepwise problems derived from MedQA-USMLE that decomposes each vignette into EMR-aligned steps (Findings, Impression, supporting Rationale), enabling evaluation of intermediate reasoning under incomplete information. Experiments and training with ASCENT revealed insights into how current LLMs handle stepwise diagnostic reasoning. Even strong reasoning models that perform well on MedQA-USMLE leave substantial headroom on ASCENT, and general-purpose frontier models trail further, exposing a persistent gap between fully informed and stepwise diagnosis. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B and 32B on ASCENT yields measurable F1 gains over both pre-trained and HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT-trained baselines, with gains driven primarily by precision. Complementary robustness analyses (counterfactual perturbation, format-vs-content control, judge agreement, and rollout) further show that ASCENT-fine-tuned models rely on the diagnostic content of prior impressions rather than imitating their output format, while error propagation under rollout remains a key challenge for clinical deployment.

translation.title: ASCENT：用于评估和提升大语言模型在常见临床场景中逐步诊断推理能力的基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学问答上表现出色，却很少在定义真实临床工作流的逐步诊断推理上被评估——在这种工作流中，随着信息积累，诊断印象会不断修正。我们构建了 ASCENT（Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis），一个由临床医生标注的基准与训练资源，包含从 MedQA-USMLE 派生的 3,078 个逐步问题，将每个病例分解为与 EMR 对齐的步骤（Findings、Impression 及支持性 Rationale），从而支持在不完整信息下对中间推理进行评估。基于 ASCENT 的实验与训练揭示了当前 LLM 处理逐步诊断推理的若干洞见。即使在 MedQA-USMLE 上表现优异的强推理模型，在 ASCENT 上仍有很大提升空间，通用前沿模型则落后更多，暴露出完全信息诊断与逐步诊断之间的持续差距。在 ASCENT 上微调 Qwen2.5-7B 和 32B 相比预训练基线和 HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT 训练基线均取得可测量的 F1 提升，且提升主要来自精确率。补充的鲁棒性分析（反事实扰动、格式与内容对照、评审一致性以及 rollout）进一步表明，经 ASCENT 微调的模型依赖先前诊断印象的诊断内容而非模仿其输出格式，而 rollout 下的误差传播仍是临床部署的关键挑战。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在不完整信息下逐步诊断推理缺乏评估的问题，构建临床医生标注的逐步临床推理基准 ASCENT 并用于评估与微调。

papers.title: ReQOR: Operator-Discrepancy Subspace Repair for Quantization-Conditioned Backdoors in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoors (QCBs) cause large language models (LLMs) to exhibit malicious behavior after quantization while remaining benign at high precision. Existing defenses often rely on security-guided configuration selection or iterative optimization, but do not identify which quantization-induced changes should be repaired. We isolate module-local quantization effects from upstream drift by evaluating the high-precision and quantized versions of each module on identical states from the quantized inference trajectory, and formulate QCB defense as repairing the resulting same-state operator discrepancies. We propose ReQOR, a training-free defense that identifies the dominant directions of these discrepancies on benign calibration data and restores the full-precision computation along them in closed form, yielding a factorized residual adapter. ReQOR uses neither attack information nor gradient-based optimization and supports both full-span and low-rank repair. Experiments across four LLMs, three PGD-based QCB attacks, three malicious behaviors, and three quantization formats show substantial QCB mitigation while largely preserving benign utility. In additional experiments on a non-PGD outlier-injection attack, existing baselines largely fail, whereas ReQOR remains effective. Further analysis shows that dominant operator-discrepancy directions provide more effective and rank-efficient repair than rank-matched random, low-energy, or raw weight-error directions, while low-rank ReQOR reduces deployment memory overhead.

translation.title: ReQOR：面向大语言模型量化条件后门的算子差异子空间修复
translation.abstract: 量化条件后门（QCB）会使大语言模型（LLM）在量化后表现出恶意行为，而在高精度下保持良性。现有防御通常依赖安全导向的配置选择或迭代优化，但无法识别哪些量化引起的变化应当被修复。我们通过在量化推理轨迹的相同状态上评估每个模块的高精度版本与量化版本，将模块局部的量化效应与上游漂移分离，并将 QCB 防御形式化为修复由此产生的同状态算子差异。我们提出 ReQOR，一种免训练防御方法，它在良性校准数据上识别这些差异的主导方向，并以闭式解恢复沿这些方向的全精度计算，得到一个分解式残差适配器。ReQOR 既不使用攻击信息也不使用基于梯度的优化，同时支持全跨度与低秩修复。在四个 LLM、三种基于 PGD 的 QCB 攻击、三种恶意行为和三种量化格式上的实验表明，ReQOR 能显著缓解 QCB，同时基本保持良性效用。在针对非 PGD 离群值注入攻击的附加实验中，现有基线基本失效，而 ReQOR 仍然有效。进一步分析显示，主导算子差异方向相比秩匹配的随机、低能量或原始权重误差方向能提供更有效且秩效率更高的修复，而低秩 ReQOR 还能降低部署时的内存开销。
translation.brief: 针对量化条件后门（QCB）防御问题，提出免训练的 ReQOR，通过识别并闭式修复同状态算子差异的主导方向来恢复全精度计算。

papers.title: EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See?
papers.abstract: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-40% of runs, against 76%-94% under L, and the strongest agent under G scores below each of them under L. In two models, removing only the line-of-sight test closes 93%-96% of the score gap, and loading state only inside tools recovers 70%-98%, so safeguards on observations and queries leave most of the leak open. In open-ended acquisition, the gain from L concentrates in items that depend on buried resources or mobs. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL

translation.title: EviCraft：Minecraft 智能体能找到它们看不见的东西吗？
translation.abstract: 在 Minecraft 这一具身智能体常用测试平台中，mineBlock 等语义工具直接从模拟器加载的世界状态中选取目标而不做可见性检测，因此智能体从未见过的埋藏矿石只需一次调用即可获得，得分无法反映智能体是否真正进行了搜索。我们将这一缺失的要求形式化为证据闭包（evidence closure）：智能体系统的每一个决策，包括其工具内部的决策，只能通过智能体持有证据的事实来依赖世界。EviCraft 是一个在智能体之下强制执行闭包的运行时与基准，并将准入规则作为实验变量：感知接地模式（G）只接受视线内或由智能体自身行动返回的内容，而加载状态模式（L）复现标准工具栈，同时保持智能体、工具和世界不变。在 Survival 任务上，模式效应超过最强智能体的领先幅度：在 G 下，三个中等规模智能体在 32%-40% 的运行中到达钻石，而在 L 下为 76%-94%；G 下最强智能体的得分低于 L 下每一个智能体。在两个模型中，仅移除视线检测即可弥合 93%-96% 的得分差距，而仅在工具内部加载状态即可恢复 70%-98%，说明仅对观察和查询设置防护仍会留下大部分泄漏。在开放式获取任务中，L 带来的收益集中在依赖埋藏资源或生物的物品上。代码与基准见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对具身智能体基准中语义工具绕过可见性检测导致无法衡量真实搜索能力的问题，提出证据闭包形式化及强制感知接地的 EviCraft 运行时与基准。

papers.title: RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop
papers.abstract: Database agents need more than schema structure: business meanings, stored values and reference queries supply knowledge that becomes relevant at different points in reasoning. We introduce RubikSQL-HB, which exposes these materials through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on the HeavenBase platform. Its knowledge interface remains available as an agent constructs and investigates an answer. Candidate agents interleave knowledge access with SQL construction and execution; a downstream Judge can reuse the same interfaces to investigate disagreements. A two-stage example interface separates discovering a reference question from expanding its SQL. On a 500-question BIRD Mini-Dev evaluation, the full pipeline reaches 75.2% execution accuracy, against 71.2% for first-candidate selection and 70.4% for execution-majority voting, with a correct candidate available on 79.0% of questions. The raw-knowledge condition, which also regenerates candidates without the built workspace, is 3.0 points lower, and adjudication with tools and revision accounts for most of the gain over selection baselines. A recorded execution probe shows how continued investigation resolves a candidate disagreement. Separate archived runs show semantic revision recovering answers absent from their original candidate pools. A versioned development study further illustrates how recurring corrections become reusable execution checks. The system and results connect knowledge-interface design to agent decision quality: queryable knowledge supports the construction of useful alternatives, and evidence-aware adjudication connects those alternatives to a final answer. Keeping knowledge in the loop lets agents acquire relevant observations as their reasoning develops.

translation.title: RubikSQL-HB：知识在环的智能体式 Text-to-SQL
translation.abstract: 数据库智能体需要的不仅是模式结构：业务含义、存储值和参考查询提供了在推理的不同阶段变得相关的知识。我们提出 RubikSQL-HB，它通过基于 HeavenBase 平台构建的可查询、数据库专属知识工作区来暴露这些材料。其知识接口在智能体构建并调查答案的过程中始终可用。候选智能体将知识访问与 SQL 构建和执行交错进行；下游的 Judge 可以复用相同接口来调查分歧。一个两阶段示例接口将发现参考问题与扩展其 SQL 分开。在包含 500 个问题的 BIRD Mini-Dev 评估中，完整流水线达到 75.2% 的执行准确率，而首选候选选择为 71.2%，执行多数投票为 70.4%，且在 79.0% 的问题上存在正确候选。原始知识条件（同样重新生成候选但不使用构建的工作区）低 3.0 个百分点，而带工具与修订的裁决贡献了相对选择基线的大部分增益。一次记录的执行探针展示了持续调查如何解决候选分歧。单独的存档运行显示语义修订能恢复原始候选池中缺失的答案。一项版本化开发研究进一步说明反复出现的修正如何成为可复用的执行检查。系统与结果将知识接口设计与智能体决策质量联系起来：可查询知识支持有用备选方案的构建，而证据感知的裁决将这些备选方案连接到最终答案。让知识保持在环中，使智能体能够随着推理的发展获取相关观察。
translation.brief: 针对 Text-to-SQL 智能体缺乏业务知识支撑的问题，提出 RubikSQL-HB，通过可查询的数据库专属知识工作区将知识访问与 SQL 构建、执行及裁决交织在推理过程中。

papers.title: C3H: Compression-to-Consensus Criteria Hijacking in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are transforming recommender systems into content-aware decision systems. In these systems, multimodal compression and cross-modal fusion are often viewed as robustness-enhancing mechanisms against content manipulation, as compression can filter noisy signals and cross-modal consensus can suppress inconsistent anomalies. We challenge this assumption by showing that the same process can expose a compression-to-consensus (C2C) bias in ranking decisions. Signals that remain salient after compression and receive consistent support across modalities can gain disproportionate influence in candidate comparison, offering an exploitable direction for content manipulation. In this paper, we introduce C3H, a novel inference-time attack that exploits this vulnerability. Rather than relying on noisy perturbations or training-time poisoning, C3H promotes a target item by tailoring its multimodal content to align with the decision criteria implicitly expressed by the recommender. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C3H substantially increases target-item exposure while maintaining overall recommendation utility. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: C3H：多模态大语言模型推荐系统中的压缩到共识准则劫持
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正在将推荐系统转变为内容感知的决策系统。在这类系统中，多模态压缩与跨模态融合常被视为抵御内容操纵的鲁棒性增强机制，因为压缩可以过滤噪声信号，跨模态共识可以抑制不一致的异常。我们挑战这一假设，证明同一过程可能在排序决策中暴露一种压缩到共识（C2C）偏差。在压缩后仍然显著并在多个模态间获得一致支持的信号，可能在候选比较中获得不成比例的影响力，为内容操纵提供了可利用的方向。本文提出 C3H，一种利用该漏洞的新型推理时攻击。C3H 不依赖噪声扰动或训练期投毒，而是通过定制目标物品的多模态内容，使其与推荐器隐式表达的决策准则对齐，从而提升目标物品。大量实验表明，C3H 在保持整体推荐效用的同时显著提高目标物品的曝光度。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多模态推荐系统中压缩与跨模态共识反而可被利用的漏洞，提出推理时攻击 C3H，通过使目标物品内容对齐推荐器隐式决策准则来提升其曝光。

papers.title: Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA
papers.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even across English and Chinese, and is largely preserved through post-training fine-tuning. As a direct test that this signal is structurally meaningful, we use it to guide width pruning in a knowledge-distilled student under a matched parameter budget: the PCA-guided allocation outperforms the uniform-width convention by +2.3 points on Qwen3-8B and +2.5 on Qwen2.5-3B, while lower-dispersion teachers show smaller gaps (+0.9 on Gemma-3-4B, +0.5 on LLaMA-3-8B), and a budget-matched inverted control does worst on all four teachers. Across these four teachers, the size of the gap tracks how unevenly the teacher's intrinsic dimensionality is distributed across layers (a single-number summary we call $\sigma_{99}$), and the advantage persists through downstream supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 基于PCA测量LLM中FFN的逐层内在维度
translation.abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）在每一层都保持前馈网络（FFN）中间宽度一致，这一惯例沿袭自最初的Transformer。然而机制研究表明，不同深度的层做着性质不同的工作，由此引出一个自然的问题：它们的容量需求是否也不均匀？如果是，能否比均匀分配更明智地分配固定的参数预算？为探究这一点，我们对每个FFN下投影的输入应用主成分分析（PCA），并以在固定余弦相似度下重构激活所需的最少主成分数来测量每一层的内在维度。通过扫描涵盖14个家族、参数量从70M到72B的58个开源权重LLM，我们发现一种反复出现的“中间偏重”分布：中间层的内在维度高于边缘层；该分布对校准语料库具有鲁棒性，即使在英文和中文之间也保持一致，并且在后训练微调后基本得以保留。作为该信号具有结构性意义的直接验证，我们用它来指导在匹配参数预算下知识蒸馏学生模型的宽度剪枝：PCA引导的分配在Qwen3-8B上比均匀宽度惯例高出2.3分，在Qwen2.5-3B上高出2.5分，而离散度较低的教师模型差距较小（Gemma-3-4B为+0.9，LLaMA-3-8B为+0.5），且预算匹配的反向对照在所有四个教师模型上表现最差。在这四个教师模型中，差距的大小与教师模型内在维度在各层间分布的不均匀程度（我们称之为$\sigma_{99}$的单数字摘要）相关，且该优势在下游监督微调后依然存在。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 研究LLM各层FFN容量需求是否不均匀，通过PCA测量逐层内在维度并据此指导宽度剪枝的参数分配。

papers.title: Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?
papers.abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

translation.title: 韵律是否被编码在神经音频编解码器Mimi中？
translation.abstract: 神经音频编解码器（NAC）已成为现代语音-语言模型的基础设施，它将连续语音信号离散化为token序列，使大语言模型能够处理和生成音频。大多数研究在解码阶段评估编解码器质量，评估重构语音的自然度。然而，很少有研究调查编码过程中捕获了哪些语音学信息。在本文中，我们研究了NAC Mimi中韵律的潜在关联物，Mimi是Moshi和Sesame等对话式语音代理所使用的编解码器，也用于语音到语音翻译（Hibiki）等下游任务。
translation.brief: 研究神经音频编解码器Mimi在编码阶段是否捕获了韵律信息。

papers.title: Scaling Laws of Ensemble Uncertainty in Language Models
papers.abstract: Many use cases for large language models (LLMs)---from AI safety to exploration and human interaction---can benefit from epistemic uncertainty estimates. We argue that existing Bayesian Deep Learning solutions, which are often restricted to a fixed model family, fail to capture the full epistemic uncertainty at practical LLM scales. This is because the error due to the bounded capacity of the model family remains invisible to disagreement among models supported by the prior. We relate this error to the well-known power-law scaling of LLM loss with model size. We then show that a second power law quantifies the shrinking disagreement within ensembles as model size increases. Its slower decay relative to the capacity law above suggests that ensembles capture a growing share of epistemic uncertainty and become more competitive as an axis for scaling, compared to a single larger model. Finally, a third power law quantifies the loss of ensemble diversity as members share a larger fraction of training before branching, and therefore identifies a further limitation, beyond the capacity error, for LoRA ensembles and optimization-based or second-order methods that approximate uncertainty around a single training solution. At a high level, these findings suggest diverse ensembles can be a promising axis, both for scaling and uncertainty quantification at larger scales.

translation.title: 语言模型集成不确定性的缩放定律
