translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的许多用例——从AI安全到探索和人机交互——都可以从认知不确定性估计中受益。我们认为，现有的贝叶斯深度学习解决方案通常局限于固定的模型家族，无法在实际LLM规模下捕获完整的认知不确定性。这是因为模型家族有限容量导致的误差对于先验所支持的模型之间的分歧是不可见的。我们将该误差与众所周知的LLM损失随模型规模的幂律缩放联系起来。然后我们证明，第二条幂律量化了集成内部分歧随模型规模增大而缩小的现象。相对于上述容量定律，其较慢的衰减表明集成捕获了越来越大的认知不确定性份额，并且与单个更大的模型相比，作为缩放轴变得更具竞争力。最后，第三条幂律量化了当成员在分支前共享更大比例的训练时集成多样性的损失，因此指出了LoRA集成以及围绕单一训练解近似不确定性的基于优化或二阶方法在容量误差之外的又一局限。总体而言，这些发现表明多样化集成可以成为更大规模缩放和不确定性量化的一个有前景的轴。
translation.brief: 研究LLM认知不确定性估计，通过三条幂律刻画集成分歧随模型规模和训练共享程度的变化规律。

papers.title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
papers.abstract: RL for LLMs often separates rollout generation from policy training. Although the two numerical engines share model parameters, they can induce different policies. This creates a challenge beyond correcting a known training-inference mismatch: during learner updates, the execution policy corresponding to the current parameters cannot be directly observed. We view this as optimizing an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor of its evolution. This perspective raises two fundamental questions: how can we estimate the execution policy's response to learner updates, and how much should we trust that estimate when optimizing the actual execution policy? We introduce Execution-Policy Robust Optimization (EPRO) to address these challenges. Starting from the observed rollout-time execution policy, we use training-policy changes to construct a differentiable predictor of the current execution policy, whose score yields Transported Score Centering (TSC). Our robust-improvement analysis reveals how prediction error limits the magnitude of reliably justified updates. For practical implementation, we introduce Policy Shift as an observable proxy for prediction risk and use Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC) to attenuate risky updates. Across four Qwen3 model settings, EPRO achieves the highest average held-out accuracy among the compared methods on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

translation.title: EPRO：通过不完美的执行策略预测器实现鲁棒策略优化
translation.abstract: LLM的强化学习通常将rollout生成与策略训练分离。尽管两个数值引擎共享模型参数，但它们可能诱导出不同的策略。这带来了一个超越纠正已知训练-推理不匹配的挑战：在学习器更新期间，与当前参数对应的执行策略无法被直接观测。我们将此视为通过一个不完美的演化预测器来优化一个未被观测的执行策略。这一视角引出了两个基本问题：我们如何估计执行策略对学习器更新的响应，以及在优化实际执行策略时应多大程度信任该估计？我们引入执行策略鲁棒优化（EPRO）来应对这些挑战。从观测到的rollout时执行策略出发，我们利用训练策略的变化构建当前执行策略的可微预测器，其得分产生Transported Score Centering（TSC）。我们的鲁棒改进分析揭示了预测误差如何限制可靠合理更新的幅度。在实际实现中，我们引入Policy Shift作为预测风险的可观测代理，并使用Shift-Aware Soft Clipping（SSC）来削弱有风险的更新。在四个Qwen3模型设置下，EPRO在七个数学推理基准上取得了对比方法中最高的平均held-out准确率。
translation.brief: 解决RL训练中rollout执行策略与训练策略不一致且当前执行策略不可观测的问题，通过可微预测器估计执行策略并基于预测风险对更新进行鲁棒性约束。

papers.title: Interactive Neural Computers
papers.abstract: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

translation.title: 交互式神经计算机
translation.abstract: 计算机及其接口通常被视为固定的，因此一个人——或越来越多的AI智能体——必须去适应操作系统所呈现的一切。当有人需要不同的工作流程，或需要适合免手操作或残障人士的界面时，这就成了限制。我们探索一种被忽视的替代方案：不是训练一个智能体去操作现有的计算机，而是训练一个生成模型成为计算机，根据过去的屏幕以及用户的鼠标和键盘动作预测下一帧屏幕。将桌面视为交互式世界模型带来了自然视频世界模型基本可以避免的问题。没有用于索引记忆的相机位姿，模型必须记住已离开屏幕的内容，且没有任何几何线索。终端中的算术必须完全正确，而不仅仅是看似合理。小的界面文本还必须在交互式帧率下保持清晰可读。我们的Interactive Neural Computer在结构上类似Neural Turing Machine，通过三个从像素和动作端到端训练的模块开始解决这些问题。一个由潜在下一帧预测（MEMORY-JEPA）监督的惊奇门控槽位记忆，存储屏幕之外的内容。一个探索性查询桥接引入预训练VLM的推理能力，一个残差渲染器只预测帧之间的潜在变化。在长闭环rollout中，我们的模型在64.2%的试验中回忆起被遮挡的文件（随机水平为33.3%），而循环和滑动窗口基线最高为56.0%。它还将终端文本OCR准确率从1.3%提升到50.1%。最后，由于记忆是显式的，可以在测试时移植，从而因果地改变模型的渲染结果。
translation.brief: 训练生成式世界模型直接充当计算机（预测下一帧屏幕），通过惊奇门控槽位记忆、VLM查询桥接和残差渲染器解决屏幕外内容记忆、精确算术和小文本渲染问题。

papers.title: Breaking the Joint Action Space Dependence in Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We study the sample complexity of learning robust coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in finite-horizon, general-sum, distributionally robust Markov games with known rewards and a generative model of the nominal transitions. Each player evaluates a policy by its worst-case return over total-variation (TV) balls centered at the nominal transition distribution of every stage, state, and joint action; this is the standard $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set. Existing generative-model guarantees for this model scale with the number $\prod_iA_i$ of joint actions, where $A_i$ is the number of actions of player~$i$. Since this number grows exponentially with the number of players, these guarantees suffer from the curse of multiagency. We design an algorithm whose sample complexity depends on the action sets only through the largest individual action-set size $A_*:=\max_iA_i$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ transition samples and, with probability at least $1-\delta$, returns a Markov policy that is an $\varepsilon$-robust CCE from every initial state. Here $S$ is the number of states, $H$ is the horizon, and $D:=\max_i\min\{H,1/\rho_i\}$, where $\rho_i$ is the TV radius of player~$i$. Two ingredients make this possible: a plug-in estimate of the robust backup whose mean error does not depend on the number of states, and a single batch of samples per round that serves as bandit feedback for all players at once. The result shows that the dependence on $\prod_iA_i$ can be avoided without modifying the $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set.

translation.title: 打破分布式鲁棒多智能体强化学习中对联合动作空间的依赖
translation.abstract: 我们研究在有限时域、一般和、分布式鲁棒马尔可夫博弈中学习鲁棒粗相关均衡（CCE）的样本复杂度，其中奖励已知且拥有名义转移的生成模型。每个玩家通过其在以每个阶段、状态和联合动作的名义转移分布为中心的全变差（TV）球上的最坏情况回报来评估策略；这是标准的 $(s,a)$-矩形不确定性集。现有针对该模型的生成模型保证的样本复杂度随联合动作数 $\prod_iA_i$ 缩放，其中 $A_i$ 是玩家 $i$ 的动作数。由于该数随玩家数量指数增长，这些保证遭受多智能体诅咒。我们设计了一种算法，其样本复杂度仅通过最大个体动作集大小 $A_*:=\max_iA_i$ 依赖于动作集。该算法使用 $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ 个转移样本，并以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率返回一个从每个初始状态出发都是 $\varepsilon$-鲁棒 CCE 的马尔可夫策略。这里 $S$ 是状态数，$H$ 是时域，$D:=\max_i\min\{H,1/\rho_i\}$，其中 $\rho_i$ 是玩家 $i$ 的 TV 半径。两个要素使之成为可能：一个鲁棒备份的代入估计，其平均误差不依赖于状态数；以及每轮使用单批样本同时作为所有玩家的 bandit 反馈。结果表明，无需修改 $(s,a)$-矩形不确定性集即可避免对 $\prod_iA_i$ 的依赖。
translation.brief: 解决鲁棒CCE学习样本复杂度随联合动作数指数增长的问题，核心方法是通过鲁棒备份的代入估计和单批样本共享的bandit反馈，将复杂度降至仅依赖最大个体动作集大小。

papers.title: DED-Agent: An agentic AI method for autonomous thermal simulation model development and calibration in laser directed energy deposition
papers.abstract: In metal additive manufacturing (AM), process parameters set the local thermal history, which governs defects, microstructure and properties. Laser power, scan speed, hatch spacing, layer thickness, scan strategy and position combine into a design space of 10^4-10^6 conditions, which is beyond what human experts can map by hand with finite element (FE) thermal models: every model must be set up, meshed, solved and calibrated by an expert, and calibrating unknown heat-source parameters alone can take days to weeks. This paper presents DED-Agent, an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) method for autonomous simulation model development and calibration in laser directed energy deposition (L-DED). A supervisor agent coordinates three specialist agents that share a structured simulation specification and call open-source tools. An intent agent turns a plain-language request into a validated specification, a simulation agent builds, runs and checks an FE thermal model through physics-aware step-by-step reasoning, and a calibration agent identifies key heat-source parameters against experimental data (e.g., thermocouple data) using a high-order proper generalized decomposition (HOPGD) surrogate within a trust-region search. On five benchmark builds, from single-track walls to a multi-track band on a cylindrical tube, the agents built executable thermal models without manual intervention, with 4.1-9.1% error for the simple and medium builds. Within three calibration rounds, the error fell to 0.9-2.5%. The surrogate matched full FE to within 0.08-1.55% and shortened calibration by 5-13 times. Agentic AI can thus autonomously establish reliable, accurate simulation models for AM processes and accelerate the search for process parameters that control microstructure.

translation.title: DED-Agent：用于激光定向能量沉积中自主热仿真模型开发与校准的智能体AI方法
translation.abstract: 在金属增材制造（AM）中，工艺参数决定局部热历史，进而决定缺陷、微观组织和性能。激光功率、扫描速度、 hatch 间距、层厚、扫描策略和位置组合成 $10^4$–$10^6$ 个条件的设计空间，超出了人类专家用有限元（FE）热模型手工探索的能力：每个模型都必须由专家建立、网格划分、求解和校准，仅校准未知热源参数就可能需要数天到数周。本文提出 DED-Agent，一种用于激光定向能量沉积（L-DED）中自主仿真模型开发与校准的智能体人工智能（AI）方法。一个监督智能体协调三个共享结构化仿真规范并调用开源工具的专家智能体：意图智能体将自然语言请求转化为经过验证的规范；仿真智能体通过具备物理感知的逐步推理构建、运行和检查 FE 热模型；校准智能体在信赖域搜索中利用高阶广义分解（HOPGD）代理模型，根据实验数据（如热电偶数据）识别关键热源参数。在五个基准构件上，从单道墙到圆柱管上的多道带，智能体无需人工干预即可构建可执行的热模型，简单和中等构件的误差为 4.1–9.1%。在三轮校准内，误差降至 0.9–2.5%。代理模型与完整 FE 的偏差在 0.08–1.55% 以内，并将校准时间缩短 5–13 倍。因此，智能体AI可以自主建立可靠、准确的 AM 工艺仿真模型，并加速搜索控制微观组织的工艺参数。
translation.brief: 解决L-DED热仿真模型人工建模与校准耗时的问题，核心方法是多智能体协作框架，结合HOPGD代理模型与信赖域搜索实现自主建模和热源参数校准。

papers.title: Measurement Artifacts in Trustworthiness Evaluations of Quantized Small Language Models
papers.abstract: Evaluations of quantized language models attribute the change in a benchmark score to quantization. We write the measured change as the true change plus a term contributed by the instrument. Instrument error that is the same at every precision can shrink a paired comparison but cannot create or reverse an effect. Error that interacts with quantization can do both, and it is reported as an effect of quantization. We estimate this interaction for four measurement choices in 8 instruction-tuned models below two billion parameters, at float16, LLM.int8() and NF4, on identical items. Measured against labels from two human annotators, the 4-bit rise in harmful compliance is about half to two-thirds of the rise in non-refusal that a corrected key word detector records. Cloze and lettered multiple-choice scoring disagree about the effect of quantization far more than their noise allows: their estimates correlate at \r{ho} = 0.10, against a ceiling of about 0.77. LLM.int8() answers and generations depend on which items share a batch, and padding alone changes its answers. Rounding activations to 8 bits is enough to produce this dependence. NF4 is batch-invariant. The two largest reported calibration losses are response-bias shifts. We release item-level predictions, option scores and human annotations, and give recommendations for evaluating compressed small models.

translation.title: 量化小语言模型可信度评估中的测量伪影
translation.abstract: 对量化语言模型的评估将基准分数的变化归因于量化。我们将测量到的变化写为真实变化加上由测量工具贡献的项。在每个精度下相同的工具误差会缩小配对比较，但不能制造或逆转效应。与量化相互作用的误差则两者皆可，且会被报告为量化的效应。我们在 8 个二十亿参数以下的指令微调模型上，在 float16、LLM.int8() 和 NF4 精度下，对相同条目估计了四种测量选择的这种交互。以两位人工标注者的标签为基准，4-bit 下有害顺从的上升约为经校正的关键词检测器记录的非拒绝上升的一半到三分之二。完形填空和带字母选项的多选评分对量化效应的判断分歧远超其噪声允许范围：它们的估计相关性仅为 \r{ho} = 0.10，而上限约为 0.77。LLM.int8() 的答案和生成取决于哪些条目共享一个批次，仅填充就会改变其答案。将激活值舍入到 8 位就足以产生这种依赖。NF4 是批次不变的。报告的两个最大校准损失是响应偏差的偏移。我们发布了条目级预测、选项分数和人工标注，并给出评估压缩小模型的建议。
translation.brief: 解决量化模型评估中测量工具与量化交互导致的伪效应问题，核心方法是在相同条目上系统估计四种测量选择与量化的交互作用。

papers.title: Fresh Keys, Stale Secrets: Numeric Leakage across Linked LLM Prompts
papers.abstract: Small businesses repeatedly ask cloud language models about the same confidential prices, unit costs and margins. Numeric prompt disguises for such numbers are evaluated one prompt at a time, but a provider sees a firm's history, in which each fresh secret gives a new, independent view of the same numbers. Since real costs are not public, we measure on synthetic firms with known values how much an honest-but-curious provider recovers when it knows the disguise algorithm, holds sector-level price and margin statistics, and links a firm's queries. In one prompt, per-field scaling, a fixed-axis instantiation of Zhang et al.'s order-preserving substitution and Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt's released sanitizer keep the attacker's margin-hit advantage over a prior-only guess between -0.6 and +4.4 percentage points. After 16 linked queries with fresh secrets, every disguise we test (Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon\geq 0.5$) has a target recovered significantly more often: under the order-preserving substitution, margin recovery rises from 25.0% to 59.4%. The same attacker recovers 29.4 percentage points more margins with fresh maps than with one reused map. Theory explains the contrast: one reused secret bounds all queries by a single full-precision view of the fields shown, whereas fresh scaling keys are identifiable. Except for Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt at $\varepsilon=0.5$, the gains persist when the attacker's prior comes from another population model and when values drift by up to 5% between queries; on our firms, whose prose cues are weak, reading the prose with a language model adds at most 2.5 points. Code and data: this https URL

translation.title: 新密钥，旧秘密：跨关联LLM提示的数值泄露
translation.abstract: 小企业反复向云端语言模型询问相同的机密价格、单位成本和利润率。针对这些数字的数值提示伪装通常一次只评估一个提示，但服务提供商会看到一家企业的历史记录，其中每个新秘密都给出相同数字的一个新的独立视角。由于真实成本不公开，我们在已知数值的合成企业上测量：当一个诚实但好奇的提供商知道伪装算法、掌握行业级价格和利润率统计并关联一家企业的查询时，能恢复多少信息。在单个提示中，逐字段缩放、Zhang 等人的保序替换的固定轴实例化以及 Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt 的发布版净化器，使攻击者相对仅先验猜测的利润率命中优势保持在 -0.6 到 +4.4 个百分点之间。在使用新秘密进行 16 次关联查询后，我们测试的每种伪装（$\varepsilon\geq 0.5$ 的 Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt）都有目标被显著更频繁地恢复：在保序替换下，利润率恢复率从 25.0% 升至 59.4%。同一攻击者用新映射比用单个复用映射多恢复 29.4 个百分点的利润率。理论解释了这种对比：一个复用的秘密将所有查询限制在所示字段的单个全精度视图内，而新的缩放密钥是可识别的。除 $\varepsilon=0.5$ 的 Pr$\varepsilon\varepsilon$mpt 外，当攻击者的先验来自另一个总体模型且数值在查询间漂移最多 5% 时，这些增益仍然存在；对于我们的企业（其文本线索较弱），用语言模型阅读文本最多增加 2.5 个百分点。代码和数据：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决数值提示伪装在多次关联查询下的泄露问题，核心方法是在合成企业数据上模拟知道算法并关联查询历史的攻击者，量化新密钥与复用密钥的泄露差异。

papers.title: MXFP4 for LLM Inference: Complementary Post-Training Quantization Techniques and Their Interactions
papers.abstract: Recent advances in low-precision representation have introduced several microscaling numerical formats for LLM quantization. By sharing a scale factor across groups of 16 or 32 elements, these formats enable aggressive low-precision quantization with minimal accuracy degradation, particularly when combined with modern PTQ algorithms. Their accuracy depends on how the numerical format interacts with rotation, PTQ, and scale selection. We study the composability of PTQ configurations across six LLMs and three microscaling formats: MXFP6, MXFP4, and NVFP4, systematically varying Hadamard rotation granularity, PTQ algorithm, and scale-selection strategy. Our central finding is that effective quantization recipes are format dependent: both MXFP4 and NVFP4 support accurate 4-bit inference, but techniques that benefit one do not necessarily transfer to the other. MXFP4 benefits substantially from rotation and error-correcting PTQ, whereas NVFP4 gains less from rotation, consistent with its finer-grained scales capturing more within-block variation. Building on these findings, we introduce Midmax, a calibration-free scale-selection strategy that mitigates clipping error in power-of-two block scales and improves accuracy across a majority of the evaluated MXFP4 configurations. We show that pairing MXFP6 activations with MXFP4 weights recovers most of the accuracy lost at 4-bit and, on Llama-3.1-8B, matches or exceeds our in-house BF16 baseline. An additional study finds that augmenting MXFP4 with a per-tensor macroscale, a mechanism intrinsic to NVFP4, does not improve average accuracy, suggesting that global rescaling alone does not address the limitations of E8M0 block scales for MXFP4 quantization. Together, these results provide practical guidance for combining numerical formats, rotation, PTQ, and scale selection for accurate low-precision LLM inference.

translation.title: MXFP4 用于 LLM 推理：互补的后训练量化技术及其交互
translation.abstract: 低精度表示的最新进展为 LLM 量化引入了多种微缩放数值格式。通过在 16 或 32 个元素的组之间共享一个缩放因子，这些格式能够实现激进低精度量化且精度损失极小，尤其是与现代 PTQ 算法结合时。其精度取决于数值格式与旋转、PTQ 和缩放选择的交互方式。我们研究了跨六个 LLM 和三种微缩放格式（MXFP6、MXFP4 和 NVFP4）的 PTQ 配置的可组合性，系统地改变 Hadamard 旋转粒度、PTQ 算法和缩放选择策略。我们的核心发现是有效的量化配方依赖于格式：MXFP4 和 NVFP4 都支持精确的 4-bit 推理，但有利于其中一种的技术不一定能迁移到另一种。MXFP4 从旋转和纠错 PTQ 中获益显著，而 NVFP4 从旋转中获益较少，这与它更细粒度的缩放能捕捉更多块内变化相一致。基于这些发现，我们提出 Midmax，一种免校准的缩放选择策略，可缓解 2 的幂块缩放中的截断误差，并在大多数评估的 MXFP4 配置中提高精度。我们表明，将 MXFP6 激活与 MXFP4 权重配对可恢复 4-bit 下损失的大部分精度，并且在 Llama-3.1-8B 上达到或超过我们的内部 BF16 基线。另一项研究发现，为 MXFP4 增加逐张量宏缩放（NVFP4 固有机制）并不能提高平均精度，这表明仅靠全局重缩放无法解决 E8M0 块缩放对 MXFP4 量化的局限。这些结果共同为组合数值格式、旋转、PTQ 和缩放选择以实现精确低精度 LLM 推理提供了实用指导。
translation.brief: 解决MXFP4等微缩放格式下PTQ技术组合选择不明确的问题，核心方法是系统研究格式、旋转、PTQ算法与缩放策略的交互，并提出免校准的Midmax缩放选择策略。

papers.title: Scalable Placement for Disaggregated LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Fleets
papers.abstract: Serving large language models (LLMs) at the edge is increasingly desirable for privacy-sensitive applications and scenarios that require data to remain on local devices. However, edge environments are constrained by limited computational resources and exhibit substantial device heterogeneity, making efficient LLM serving challenging. These limitations become particularly pronounced under bursty demand, where congestion and queue buildup can significantly increase response latency. Replicating the model into multiple pipeline instances can improve serving capacity and reduce congestion. Yet, deciding how devices should be grouped into replicas, assigning replicas to prefill or decode functions, and partitioning model layers across heterogeneous devices jointly creates a large combinatorial optimization problem. We present Spade, a scalable and runtime-efficient placement planner for disaggregated LLM serving with pipeline replication across heterogeneous edge clusters. Spade introduces a dominance-based pruning technique that discards inferior replica candidates and recursively eliminates larger candidates that contain them, dramatically shrinking the search space. It further combines a water-filling approach for layer partitioning with a bounded multidimensional knapsack formulation that optimizes placement under a congestion-aware objective. On a synthetic fleet of 30 devices spanning five hardware classes, Spade finds the optimal placement in 441ms. In contrast, a genetic-search baseline augmented with dynamic-programming partitioning requires approximately two hours and still produces solutions with a 19.7% worse congestion objective. When evaluated on fleets containing ten device types, Spade's pruning strategy eliminates 99.6% of candidate placements while yielding the same surviving candidate set as exhaustive enumeration.

translation.title: 面向异构边缘集群上解耦式 LLM 服务的可扩展放置方法
translation.abstract: 在边缘环境服务大语言模型（LLM）对隐私敏感应用和要求数据留在本地设备的场景日益重要。然而，边缘环境受限于有限的计算资源并呈现显著的设备异构性，使高效 LLM 服务充满挑战。这些限制在突发需求下尤为突出，拥塞和队列积压会显著增加响应延迟。将模型复制为多个流水线实例可以提升服务能力并缓解拥塞。然而，如何将设备分组为副本、如何将副本分配给 prefill 或 decode 功能、以及如何在异构设备上划分模型层，共同构成了一个大规模组合优化问题。我们提出 Spade，一个面向异构边缘集群上带流水线复制的解耦式 LLM 服务的可扩展、运行时高效的放置规划器。Spade 引入基于支配关系的剪枝技术，丢弃劣质副本候选并递归消除包含它们的更大候选，大幅缩小搜索空间。它进一步将注水式层划分方法与有界多维背包形式化相结合，在拥塞感知目标下优化放置。在一个包含五类硬件、30 台设备的合成集群上，Spade 在 441ms 内找到最优放置。相比之下，结合动态规划划分的遗传搜索基线需要约两小时，且得到的解在拥塞目标上仍差 19.7%。在包含十种设备类型的集群上评估时，Spade 的剪枝策略消除了 99.6% 的候选放置，同时得到与穷举枚举相同的存活候选集。
translation.brief: 解决异构边缘集群上解耦式 LLM 服务的副本分组、功能分配与层划分的组合优化问题，核心方法是基于支配关系剪枝、注水式层划分和拥塞感知背包形式化的可扩展放置规划器。

papers.title: Adaptive Electromagnetic Transient-level Digital Twins for Data Centers via In-Context Learning with LLMs
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) workloads has significantly increased data center (DC) power demand. Frequent operational and configurational changes, such as load surges caused by dynamic workload allocation, can induce electromagnetic transients (EMTs) whose accurate prediction is critical for reliable DC operation and maintenance. Although high-fidelity EMT solvers are widely adopted for transient analysis, their computational cost limits large-scale and multi-scenario studies. Digital twins address this computational bottleneck by emulating the behavior of a physical system and enabling fast prediction in place of expensive high-fidelity simulation. However,data-driven digital twins are non-adaptive and fail to generalize once the DC configuration changes. To address this limitation, this paper proposes an adaptive EMT-level digital twin for DCs based on in-context learning (ICL) with large language models (LLMs). We formulate the EMT prediction task as a system identification problem under parametric uncertainty and develop a GPT-2-based framework that adapts to unseen DC configurations at inference time from a small set of EMT trajectory samples, without model retraining. The proposed framework is validated on three representative EMT scenarios and benchmarked against three baseline non-adaptive twins. Results demonstrate superior prediction accuracy, improved adaptability to unseen operating conditions, and substantial computational speedups compared to high-fidelity EMT simulation.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 上下文学习的数据中心自适应电磁暂态级数字孪生
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）工作负载的快速增长显著推高了数据中心（DC）的电力需求。频繁的运行和配置变更，例如动态工作负载分配引起的负载激增，会引发电磁暂态（EMT），其准确预测对数据中心的可靠运行与维护至关重要。尽管高保真 EMT 求解器被广泛用于暂态分析，但其计算成本限制了大规模、多场景研究。数字孪生通过模拟物理系统行为、以快速预测替代昂贵的高保真仿真，解决了这一计算瓶颈。然而，数据驱动的数字孪生不具备自适应性，一旦数据中心配置发生变化便无法泛化。为解决这一局限，本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）上下文学习（ICL）的数据中心自适应 EMT 级数字孪生。我们将 EMT 预测任务形式化为参数不确定性下的系统辨识问题，并开发了基于 GPT-2 的框架，在推理时从少量 EMT 轨迹样本适应未见过的数据中心配置，无需重新训练模型。该框架在三个代表性 EMT 场景上验证，并与三个非自适应孪生基线对比。结果表明其预测精度更优、对未见运行条件的适应性更强，且相比高保真 EMT 仿真获得显著的计算加速。
translation.brief: 解决数据中心配置变化导致数据驱动数字孪生无法泛化的问题，核心方法是将 EMT 预测形式化为系统辨识问题并利用基于 GPT-2 的 LLM 上下文学习在推理时自适应，无需重训练。

papers.title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
papers.abstract: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.

translation.title: 懒惰智能体会违背自身信念作答：基于可验证信念的强化学习教会它们依信念行动
translation.abstract: 在长任务中工作的 AI 智能体常常在证据不足时就仓促给出答案，这种行为被称为懒惰。在我们的评估中，它们经常在其陈述的信念仍列出多个可能答案时就仓促作答。回合末尾的结果奖励只对最终答案打分，因此无法教会智能体何时该作答，因为凭运气的猜测与有证据支撑的答案获得相同奖励。然而在训练期间，模拟器可以在每一步计算出答案的精确后验分布，并判断证据是否已经充分。我们提出基于可验证信念的强化学习（RLVB），当后验仍允许多个答案时奖励智能体继续采取行动，一旦证据充分则奖励其作答。该奖励无需裁判、评论家或奖励模型，也从不读取智能体在每个动作前写下的信念行。我们还引入 Pro Worlds，一个视觉谜题基准，其中智能体通过小窗口观察大世界。我们在三个基准上评估三个视觉语言模型，其中两个在训练中从未见过。RLVB 在全部九个设置中均提升基础模型，平均提升 17.1%。在结果奖励下，GRPO 和 PPO 平均低于基础模型。RLVB 还平均超过使用 LLM 裁判过程奖励的 PPO 9.3%，同时节省 1.6 倍 GPU 小时。训练后的智能体在三个基准上分别有 51%、12% 和 74% 的回合在有充分证据时作答，而基础模型仅为 8%、0.4% 和 36%。因此其准确率提升来自更频繁地在高证据水平下作答。信念行展示了智能体如何达到这一证据水平：它依自身信念行动。在证据不足且其信念行仍列出多个答案的回合中，它仅在 0.1% 到 2.2% 的情况下仓促作答，而基础模型为 3% 到 68%。
translation.brief: 解决长任务中智能体证据不足就仓促作答的懒惰问题，核心方法是提出 RLVB，利用模拟器可计算的答案后验分布作为可验证信念奖励，教会智能体依信念决定何时作答。

papers.title: Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations
papers.abstract: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

translation.title: 在线对话中建设性言论、仇恨言论与赞同的联合检测
translation.abstract: 网络仇恨言论是一个日益严重的问题，对群体和个人都有负面影响，可能导致用户退出在线对话和辩论。随着一些知名社交媒体平台减少审核力度，建设性言论已成为对抗仇恨的替代策略。对建设性言论和仇恨言论的自动检测有助于监测，并加深对其流行程度和网络动态的理解。在本工作中，我们收集并标注了一个包含英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论的大型数据集，标注维度包括仇恨语气、建设性语气以及对父评论的赞同。我们微调了多个多语言 LLM 以在这三个维度上进行分类，并比较了上下文增强与非上下文增强的模型架构。E5-large LLM 在上下文增强（平均 F1 为 82%）和非上下文增强（平均 F1 为 81.6%）分类任务上均表现最佳，展示了多语言 LLM 在跨语言可扩展检测仇恨与建设性言论方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决跨语言的仇恨言论与建设性言论自动检测问题，核心方法是构建英丹双语标注数据集并微调多语言 LLM 进行三维度联合分类。

papers.title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
papers.abstract: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.

translation.title: SOARS：面向智能体搜索的 System One 辅助重排序
translation.abstract: 深度搜索智能体通过迭代检索与推理来满足复杂的信息需求，其中检索证据的相关性影响下游性能。现有重排序器提升了检索效果，但在整个搜索轨迹中反复调用会带来显著的延迟和成本。我们提出 SOARS，一个免训练框架，利用 System One 模型进行快速、校准的相关性估计。在每个搜索步骤中，SOARS 从长文档中选取与查询相关的段落，并在单次调用中对候选进行重排序，同时考虑原始问题和智能体生成的子查询。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WebShaper 上跨六个 LLM 骨干模型的评估中，SOARS 持续提升答案准确率和证据召回率，同时减少搜索调用次数、端到端延迟和推理成本。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，它将 GPT-5.4 Mini 的准确率从 73.9% 提升至 84.7%，同时将搜索调用次数从 23 次降至 14 次，展示了 System One 重排序在实现更高效、更经济的深度搜索方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 解决深度搜索智能体中现有重排序器延迟和成本过高的问题，核心方法是免训练地利用 System One 模型在单次调用中完成相关性估计与候选重排序。

papers.title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
papers.abstract: A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controlled evidence interventions and first-location decoding establish what these shorter readouts retain and what requires further generation.

translation.title: 先读决策再读片段：高效生成式验证
translation.abstract: 开发者检查助手报告时可能只需要一个“某声明无依据”的警报，而生成式验证器却可以继续解码以引用并分类错误。我们研究需要多少输出才能恢复其决策。在一个冻结的 2B 片段验证器中，空错误列表与其第一个对象之间的选择先于所有定位发生。Native8 在该分支处停止生成。其前面的七个语法 token 是固定的，因此 Prefill1 将它们作为输入提供，仅生成不受限制的分支 token，使用相同的原生指令。在 2,015 条 code-agent TEST 响应上，Prefill1 相比完整生成将 eager 常驻服务减少 84.84%，released-reference F1 为 83.43 对 83.41。尽管其逻辑 token 总数与 Native8 相同，仍节省 31.98%。在默认编译执行下，完整工作负载上的额外节省为 6.74–26.73%，决策变化很小。受控证据干预和首位置解码确立了这些更短的读出保留了什么、什么需要进一步生成。
translation.brief: 研究生成式验证器需要多少输出才能恢复其支持性判断，并通过在决策分支处停止生成、用 prefill 提供固定语法 token 来大幅降低服务开销。

papers.title: One Style Fits All? Cultural Values Embedded in Conversational AI via a People-Pleasing Lens
papers.abstract: Conversational AI systems trained on large-scale web corpora inevitably encode the cultural values and interactional norms embedded in their training data, yet our understanding of how deployed LLMs reflect or reinforce culture-specific social expectations remains limited. This study examined how supportive versus challenging chatbot interaction styles shape user experience and continuance intention, and whether people-pleasing tendency (PPT) moderates these effects across cultures. Taiwanese (N = 49) and Korean (N = 52) participants completed a collaborative tourism-planning task. Results showed that: (1) supportive chatbots consistently led to higher continuance intention, satisfaction, and trust; (2) PPT did not moderate these effects; and (3) cultural variation emerged only in perceived threat, where higher PPT was associated with greater baseline threat in the Taiwanese but not the Korean sample. These findings reveal how a general-purpose LLM style may differentially activate culturally situated social scripts, raising implications for culturally inclusive conversational AI design.

translation.title: 一种风格适合所有人吗？从讨好型视角看对话式 AI 中嵌入的文化价值观
translation.abstract: 基于大规模网络语料训练的对话式 AI 系统不可避免地编码了训练数据中嵌入的文化价值观和互动规范，但我们对已部署的 LLM 如何反映或强化特定文化的社会期望的理解仍然有限。本研究考察了支持型与挑战型聊天机器人交互风格如何塑造用户体验和持续使用意愿，以及讨好倾向（PPT）是否在不同文化间调节这些效应。台湾（N = 49）和韩国（N = 52）的参与者完成了一项协作式旅游规划任务。结果显示：(1) 支持型聊天机器人始终带来更高的持续使用意愿、满意度和信任；(2) PPT 未调节这些效应；(3) 文化差异仅出现在感知威胁上，在台湾样本中较高的 PPT 与更高的基线威胁相关，而在韩国样本中则不然。这些发现揭示了一种通用 LLM 风格可能如何差异化地激活文化情境化的社会脚本，对文化包容性对话式 AI 设计具有启示意义。
translation.brief: 通过跨文化用户实验考察支持型与挑战型聊天机器人风格对用户体验的影响及讨好倾向的调节作用。

papers.title: ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks
papers.abstract: The use of AI agents among the general public has been increasing exponentially throughout 2026, though it is often hard for users to determine which configuration is most effective for their personal use. To help provide clarity here we introduce ShellBench, 100 day-to-day tasks based on more than 10 million user requests, each set in a realistic workspace with messy files and competing data sources, and graded for both correctness and safety. We evaluate 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels for a total of 53,100 rollouts, 20% of which are on tasks designated for public release. We find that model choice impacts performance more than harness choice, but the three leading models differ by only 1.1 percentage points. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at about one-sixth of GPT-6 Astra's estimated token cost per attempt, while GPT-6 Astra led at 62.5%. We also found that harness choice had little effect on either performance or safety with all harnesses scoring between 42.9 (Claude Code) and 45.2 (OpenClaw) for pass@1.

translation.title: ShellBench：对 AI 智能体而言，模型还是 Harness 更重要——面向日常任务
translation.abstract: 2026 年全年，AI 智能体在普通大众中的使用呈指数级增长，但用户往往难以确定哪种配置对其个人使用最有效。为帮助厘清这一点，我们推出 ShellBench，包含基于超过 1,000 万条用户请求的 100 项日常任务，每项任务都置于带有杂乱文件和相互竞争数据源的真实工作区中，并同时按正确性和安全性评分。我们在 3 个推理级别上评估了 5 种 agent harness 下的 12 个模型，共 53,100 次 rollout，其中 20% 在指定公开发布的任务上进行。我们发现模型选择对性能的影响大于 harness 选择，但三个领先模型之间仅相差 1.1 个百分点。GPT-6.1 Sol 以约 GPT-6 Astra 每次尝试估计 token 成本的六分之一通过了 61.4% 的尝试，而 GPT-6 Astra 以 62.5% 领先。我们还发现 harness 选择对性能和安全性几乎没有影响，所有 harness 的 pass@1 得分介于 42.9（Claude Code）和 45.2（OpenClaw）之间。
translation.brief: 构建基于真实用户日常任务的基准 ShellBench，系统比较模型选择与 agent harness 选择对性能和安全性的影响。

papers.title: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
papers.abstract: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

translation.title: OmniHarness-RSI：面向全模态理解的模态感知 Harness 进化
translation.abstract: 基于 harness 的递归自我改进（RSI）的最新进展通过进化可执行的 agent 工作流而不更新基础模型参数，改善了视频理解。然而，将这一范式扩展到全模态理解仍然具有挑战性，因为多模态感知与推理的异质且相互依赖的特性创造了一个复杂的进化空间，使有针对性的 harness 优化变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 OmniHarness-RSI，一个用于进化 agent harness 的模态感知框架。具体而言，我们将进化空间分解为三个能力维度：模态路由与协作、模态感知的证据定位以及模态特定的感知。基于该分解，我们构建了一个集成专门感知专家和音视频检索工具的 Factorized-Harness Agent。我们进一步引入模态引导的 harness 进化，通过结构化的模态-能力归因识别缺陷，并通过交互式代码修订和执行反馈精炼相应的 harness 策略。验证引导的选择和留出评估评估数据集内和跨数据集的泛化能力。在 WorldSense、Daily-Omni 和 OmniVideoBench 上的实验分别展示了 8.86、8.13 和 6.23 个百分点的测试准确率提升，持续优于模态无关的 RSI。进化后的 harness 还展示了无需适配的跨数据集迁移，同时减少了 planner 调用和查看的帧数。
translation.brief: 提出模态感知的 harness 递归自我改进框架，将进化空间分解为三个模态能力维度以优化全模态理解的 agent 工作流。

papers.title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs. LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87. In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. In pool mode, FragPack packs variable-length records into smaller shared-budget GPU pages read in place by a fused decode-attention kernel faster than FlashAttention-3 on BF16. Built with LMCache and vLLM, LoomKV makes compressed tiers act as 1.4x larger raw tiers on AgentX: across LMCache's LRU cliff, tier mode delivers 2.7-3.6x raw's goodput and 1.9-3.1x lower mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), shifts the cliff identically under other simulated replacement policies, and cuts repeated-prompt TTFT up to 1.7x via SSD-to-DRAM promotion. When tiers hold the working set, pool mode fits 1.31-1.34x as many GPU tokens, admitting 12 long requests with roughly raw's queue and goodput at 8. On an AI IDE trace where both tiers and the GPU pool are constrained, tier and pool modes raise goodput by 1.24x and 1.59x. Where raw capacity suffices, compression costs at most 2.2% throughput; tier mode is bit-exact with raw tiers, and pool mode matches FlashAttention-3's numerical accuracy.

translation.title: LoomKV：面向 LLM 服务的从 GPU 内存到 SSD 的无损 KV 缓存压缩
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务引擎将键/值（KV）缓存从 GPU 内存卸载到主机 DRAM 和 SSD，以便多轮和 agent 请求可以复用 prompt 前缀。容量随后在两个层面限制服务：外部层级在驱逐前管理前缀复用，而 GPU KV 池限制并发的长请求，且有损压缩会改变 KV 值和输出。LoomKV 在未修改的引擎上为外部层级（tier 模式）和 GPU 池（pool 模式）带来无损 KV 压缩。使用基于 BF16 高字节（符号位和最高七个指数位）的经校准的每头两级 3-bit 编码，LoomKV 在九个模型上以原始大小的 0.71 存储 BF16 KV，FP8 KV 为 0.85–0.87。在 tier 模式下，TileStream 写入精确长度的记录且长度回读不在加载路径上，保持层级存储、驱逐和预取不变，并将取回的记录直接解压到分散的 GPU 页面中。在 pool 模式下，FragPack 将变长记录打包进更小的共享预算 GPU 页面，由融合的 decode-attention kernel 原位读取，在 BF16 上比 FlashAttention-3 更快。基于 LMCache 和 vLLM 构建，LoomKV 使压缩层级在 AgentX 上相当于 1.4 倍大小的原始层级：跨越 LMCache 的 LRU 悬崖，tier 模式提供 2.7–3.6 倍于原始的 goodput 和 1.9–3.1 倍更低的平均首 token 时间（TTFT），在其他模拟替换策略下同样地移动悬崖，并通过 SSD 到 DRAM 的提升将重复 prompt 的 TTFT 降低至多 1.7 倍。当层级容纳工作集时，pool 模式可容纳 1.31–1.34 倍的 GPU token，在 8 个请求时以大致与原始相同的队列和 goodput 准入 12 个长请求。在层级和 GPU 池均受限的 AI IDE 轨迹上，tier 和 pool 模式分别将 goodput 提升 1.24 倍和 1.59 倍。在原始容量充足的地方，压缩最多损失 2.2% 的吞吐量；tier 模式与原始层级位完全一致，pool 模式匹配 FlashAttention-3 的数值精度。
translation.brief: 提出 LoomKV，一种在 GPU 池和外部存储层级均适用的无损 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过 3-bit 编码和专用读写机制在不改变输出的前提下提升 LLM 服务的容量与吞吐。

papers.title: "I Do Intend to Deliver": Will LLMs Run a Marketplace Advance-Fee Scam?
papers.abstract: Online fraud is traditionally limited by the cost of the human labor needed to talk to potential victims. We ask whether hosted large language models will now supply that labor. We prompted ten off-the-shelf models to play the seller in the "free item, just pay delivery" advance-fee scam common on buy-and-sell sites, using a plain system prompt with no jailbreak. Each model played 30 conversations against each of four buyer personas, from credulous to guarded, with the same model playing the buyer (1,200 conversations). We label each conversation by what happened to the buyer's money, and validate the labels against two human coders. 737 conversations (61%) ended with the buyer paying in advance. Eight of the ten models played in almost every conversation, and running both sides cost about 2.5 cents per payment. Only the guarded buyer, who wanted a findable identity, resisted, and the most willing sellers got past it by inventing names and phone numbers. Sellers that recognized the scam still took the money in 133 conversations, usually reasoning about their own honesty rather than the buyer's risk. Several models protected the buyer without refusing, by conceding payment on delivery, so refusal rates alone misstate safety. We release the benchmark, prompts, code and labels.

translation.title: "我确实打算发货"：LLM 会运行市场预付费骗局吗？
translation.abstract: 在线欺诈传统上受限于与潜在受害者交谈所需的人力成本。我们探究托管式大语言模型现在是否会提供这种人力。我们用一段普通的系统提示词（无越狱）让十个现成模型扮演买卖网站上常见的"免费物品，只需支付运费"预付费骗局中的卖家。每个模型针对四种买家角色（从轻信到警惕）各进行30轮对话，买家由同一模型扮演（共1,200轮对话）。我们根据买家资金的去向标注每轮对话，并由两名人工标注员验证标签。737轮对话（61%）以买家预付款告终。十个模型中有八个几乎在每轮对话中都配合行骗，且让模型同时扮演双方的成本约为每次付款2.5美分。只有要求可查证身份的警惕型买家进行了抵抗，而最配合的卖家通过编造姓名和电话号码绕过了这一障碍。识别出骗局的卖家仍在133轮对话中收下了钱，通常是在推理自身的诚实性而非买家的风险。若干模型在不拒绝的情况下保护了买家，方式是同意货到付款，因此仅凭拒绝率会误判安全性。我们发布了基准、提示词、代码和标签。
translation.brief: 研究托管LLM是否会配合执行"免费物品只需付运费"的预付费骗局，方法是用普通系统提示词让十个模型扮演卖家与四种买家角色进行1,200轮对话并按资金去向标注。

papers.title: Attestation is All You Need: Toward a Zero-Trust Architecture for HPC AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents are beginning to automate data analysis, orchestration, and simulation steering in HPC environments, but they introduce a security problem that existing cluster defenses do not address: the hijacked authorized agent. An adversary can subvert an agent through prompt injection, poisoned shared data, compromised tools, or multi-agent coordination, then exfiltrate sensitive data through legitimate encrypted LLM API traffic. We propose behavioral attestation as a runtime defense for this setting. Our system, AEGIS, compiles task-derived behavioral constraints, monitors agent actions with ebpf-based syscall interception, verifies evidence against constraint profiles, correlates behavior across agents, and triggers slurm-level containment. On the real attestation path, AEGIS detects all four implemented attack classes with sub-second median latency at a 1-second interval and low measured verifier overhead. Controlled experiments show full attack-suite coverage, stronger detection than representative baselines, and no observed false positives on the evaluated benign workflows.

translation.title: Attestation is All You Need：面向 HPC AI Agent 的零信任架构
translation.abstract: AI agent 正开始在 HPC 环境中自动化数据分析、编排和仿真控制，但它们引入了现有集群防御无法解决的安全问题：被劫持的合法授权 agent。攻击者可以通过提示注入、投毒的共享数据、被入侵的工具或多 agent 协调来颠覆一个 agent，然后通过合法的加密 LLM API 流量外泄敏感数据。我们提出行为证明（behavioral attestation）作为该场景下的运行时防御。我们的系统 AEGIS 编译源自任务的行为约束，通过基于 ebpf 的系统调用拦截监控 agent 行为，将证据与约束配置进行核验，跨 agent 关联行为，并触发 slurm 级别的遏制。在真实证明路径上，AEGIS 以亚秒级中位延迟（1秒间隔）和较低的验证器开销检测出全部四类已实现的攻击。受控实验显示其对全部攻击套件均有覆盖，检测能力强于代表性基线，且在评估的良性工作流上未观察到误报。
translation.brief: 针对HPC中被劫持的合法AI agent的安全问题，提出AEGIS系统，通过行为约束编译、ebpf系统调用监控和跨agent行为关联实现运行时检测与遏制。

papers.title: SpecEngineeringBench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Autonomous Specification Engineers
papers.abstract: Autonomous specification engineering requires coding agents to translate functional requirements into executable tests and use the results to discover and validate defects. However, existing benchmarks evaluate coding agents on explicitly specified test generation tasks, commonly providing an issue description, a designated test entry point, or files to inspect, leaving the ability to determine what to test and where to investigate insufficiently evaluated. Relying on such clues bypasses the challenge of mapping requirements to implementations and proactively uncovering unknown defects. We propose SpecEngineeringBench, comprising 100 instances from 78 open-source Python repositories across 16 application categories, with multiple recorded defects in each instance. Two independent tasks evaluate complementary capabilities: generating test suites and discovering defects through execution analysis. The evaluation combines test validity, defect detection, and coverage with localization precision and recall. Across seven frontier coding agents, results reveal that test validity and coverage decouple from defect exposure: agents achieve a 91.47% Head Pass Rate and 80.48% Change-focused Coverage alongside a 26.36% Fail-to-Pass Rate, while localization recall drops from 78.11% at the file level to 51.29% at the function level. Autonomous test generation improves file, function, and hunk localization recall by 4.99, 2.77, and 2.69 percentage points over relying solely on existing repository test suites.

translation.title: SpecEngineeringBench：将编码 Agent 评估为自主规格工程师
translation.abstract: 自主规格工程要求编码 agent 将功能需求转化为可执行测试，并利用测试结果发现和验证缺陷。然而，现有基准在明确指定的测试生成任务上评估编码 agent，通常提供 issue 描述、指定的测试入口点或待检查的文件，导致"决定测什么、查哪里"的能力评估不足。依赖此类线索绕过了将需求映射到实现并主动发现未知缺陷的挑战。我们提出 SpecEngineeringBench，包含来自78个开源 Python 仓库、16个应用类别的100个实例，每个实例含多个已记录缺陷。两个独立任务评估互补能力：生成测试套件和通过执行分析发现缺陷。评估结合测试有效性、缺陷检测、覆盖率以及定位的精确率和召回率。对七个前沿编码 agent 的评估显示，测试有效性和覆盖率与缺陷暴露能力脱钩：agent 达到91.47%的 Head Pass Rate 和80.48%的 Change-focused Coverage，但 Fail-to-Pass Rate 仅为26.36%，且定位召回率从文件级的78.11%降至函数级的51.29%。相比仅依赖仓库现有测试套件，自主测试生成将文件、函数和 hunk 定位召回率分别提升4.99、2.77和2.69个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准依赖明确线索、无法评估编码agent自主决定测试对象与定位缺陷能力的问题，构建含100个实例的SpecEngineeringBench，通过测试套件生成与缺陷发现两个任务进行评估。

papers.title: Estimating GPU Roofline Arithmetic Intensity with Off-the-Shelf LLMs and Compiler Artifacts
papers.abstract: GPU developers use profiling to understand computation and data movement, but access to target hardware can delay optimization. We investigate whether off-the-shelf large language models (LLMs) can estimate Roofline arithmetic intensity (the ratio of floating-point operations (FLOPs) to device-memory bytes) without executing the target GPU workload. We evaluate three models (deepseek-v4-flash, gemini-3.7-flash, and gpt-5.6-sol) across 179 combinations of five kernel families, four NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, four parallel runtimes (CUDA, HIP, OpenMP, and OpenCL), and modified code variants, comparing source-only queries, queries with compiler artifacts, and sandboxed agentic analysis. Compiler artifacts raise the share of arithmetic-intensity estimates within a factor of 1.20 of profiled values from 8-14% to 26-32%, while the resulting bandwidth-bound or compute-bound classifications are correct in 78-92% of runs. With compiler artifacts, FLOP estimates meet the 1.20x tolerance in 59-88% of runs, compared with 36-40% for device-memory traffic. Agentic analysis increases the share of arithmetic-intensity estimates within the 1.20x tolerance by 6.5 percentage points for gpt-5.6-sol, at 3.6x the median cost and 2.5x the median latency of compiler-assisted queries; the other models incur higher costs without a statistically clear improvement. These findings suggest LLM estimates could help prioritize optimization when GPU access is constrained, while identifying cache-dependent device-memory traffic as the main obstacle to precise arithmetic-intensity prediction.

translation.title: 用现成 LLM 和编译器产物估计 GPU Roofline 算术强度
translation.abstract: GPU 开发者使用性能剖析来理解计算与数据搬运，但访问目标硬件可能延误优化。我们研究现成大语言模型（LLM）能否在不执行目标 GPU 工作负载的情况下估计 Roofline 算术强度（浮点运算数（FLOPs）与设备内存字节数之比）。我们在179种组合上评估三个模型（deepseek-v4-flash、gemini-3.7-flash 和 gpt-5.6-sol），涵盖五个 kernel 家族、四块 NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU、四种并行运行时（CUDA、HIP、OpenMP 和 OpenCL）以及修改后的代码变体，比较仅源码查询、附带编译器产物的查询和沙箱化 agentic 分析。编译器产物将算术强度估计落在剖析值1.20倍以内的比例从8-14%提升至26-32%，由此得出的带宽受限或计算受限分类在78-92%的运行中正确。使用编译器产物时，FLOP 估计在59-88%的运行中满足1.20倍容差，而设备内存流量仅为36-40%。Agentic 分析使 gpt-5.6-sol 的算术强度估计落在1.20倍容差内的比例提高6.5个百分点，但中位成本是编译器辅助查询的3.6倍、中位延迟的2.5倍；其他模型成本更高且无统计上明确的改进。这些发现表明，在 GPU 访问受限时 LLM 估计可帮助确定优化优先级，同时指出依赖缓存的设备内存流量是实现精确算术强度预测的主要障碍。
translation.brief: 研究现成LLM能否在不执行GPU工作负载的情况下估计Roofline算术强度，方法是比较仅源码查询、附带编译器产物查询和沙箱agentic分析三种方式在多kernel、GPU和运行时组合上的表现。

papers.title: When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

translation.title: 当修复准确性产生误导：用 VLM 自身的失败训练它
translation.abstract: 在视觉语言模型自身的失败上进行微调是修复它的直接方法，但在留出失败样本上的准确率——这一显而易见的成功指标——会产生误导。许多挖掘出的失败并非模型错误：对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 在由 COCO 和 GQA 生成的问题上的100个失败进行人工审计，发现37个存在标签错误。且挖掘出的失败存在措辞规律：仅基于问题的分类器在73.2%的留出失败对上两个答案都能答对。我们用经验证的失败驱动修复（VFR）研究这两个陷阱：类型化的最小对失败挖掘、由三个不查看存储标签即作答的 LLM 评审进行验证、答案优先的纠正目标，以及带重放的 LoRA 微调。VFR 修复了82.8%的留出失败（基线模型：10.0%），在独立标注、无条件对上，它通过空间关系将总体准确率从87.4%提升至92.4%，空间关系准确率从66.7%升至96.8%，即使在措辞指向错误答案的情况下也是如此。然而在否定上，它修复了88.9%的留出失败，但在无条件对上的准确率却从88.7%降至79.7%：它破坏了关于不存在对象的否定，而这类否定在其训练集中很罕见。不经验证时，无条件对上的准确率降至80.8%，低于基线模型的87.4%，原因是开发基准未捕捉到的否定捷径；不做失败筛选时，准确率保持在92.0%（单种子），但修复率降至73.4%。训练还降低了两图关系准确率（74.3%降至49.6%；仅重放数据：48.4%）；多图重放能部分且不均衡地逆转这一下降。对空间问题进行改写可保留大部分增益（87.3%，基线模型为62.0%），但重新措辞使留出失败上的空间修复率从92.9%降至76.8%。在 What'sUp 的独立照片（物体位于其他物体之下）上，描述选择保持完美，而我们的是非对准确率从84.5%降至26.4%。
translation.brief: 针对在VLM自身失败上微调时留出失败准确率被标签错误和措辞捷径误导的问题，提出经验证的失败驱动修复（VFR），结合最小对失败挖掘、LLM评审验证、答案优先纠正目标和带重放的LoRA微调。

papers.title: Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration
papers.abstract: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.

translation.title: 通过 LLM 训练建模双语学习：关键期探索
translation.abstract: 第二语言（L2）习得的关键期理论认为，学习新语言的能力可能取决于先前习得的第一语言（L1）知识被修改的难易程度。本探索性计算研究将神经网络语言模型方法扩展到关键期效应，考察内部表征而非行为。一个小型两层 GPT-2 模型先在英语上训练，然后通过顺序训练或弹性权重巩固（EWC，限制对英语重要的参数变化）在德语（相对较近的 L2）或芬兰语（相对较远的 L2）上训练。在 L2 训练一和两个 epoch 后，将每种语言 20 个保留探针句子的均值池化隐状态与纯英语模型进行比较，使用嵌入层和两个 transformer 层的余弦相似度。英语相似度在 transformer 层保持较高，但在嵌入层变为负值。L2 相似度在 transformer 层上升，德语和芬兰语在第二个 transformer 层的差异大于第一层。EWC 将 Fisher 加权参数漂移降低约 6%，但对 transformer 层相似度的改变小于 0.001。由于每种条件仅进行一次训练，这些发现是初步的。
translation.brief: 该论文用小型 GPT-2 依次训练英语和第二语言并结合 EWC，通过内部表征相似度探索语言学习关键期效应。

papers.title: LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.

translation.title: LEGOSpec：一个可组合、高效的投机草稿设计与训练框架
translation.abstract: 投机解码使用轻量级草稿模型加速大语言模型（LLM）生成。现有方法在不同训练配置下评估完整方案，导致组件效果、交互和组合收益不明确。因此，我们提出 LEGOSpec，一个用于投机草稿设计与训练的可组合框架。LEGOSpec 将草稿模型分解为 Context、Backbone、Proposal 和 Objective 组件，共享统一的训练基础设施。利用 LEGOSpec，我们系统地变换组件并在匹配的训练条件下评估选定组合，以隔离其效果和交互。这些实验揭示三个发现：(1) 不同工作负载偏好不同的 backbone，取决于上下文长度和内存预算，块内依赖建模对长上下文尤为重要。(2) Proposal 设计需在接受率与延迟之间权衡。(3) 训练目标应在局部匹配 token 分布并优化整个块的接受长度。这些发现指导了面向工作负载的配置以及 DFlux——一个均衡的通用草稿，结合了带卷积的 SWA-GQA 混合 backbone、Residual Corrector 和分层监督。在 Qwen 和 Gemma 模型上，DFlux 在常规基准上将接受长度较最强基线提升最高 13.7%，在长上下文工作负载上提升 34.7%。为支持高效训练，LEGOSpec 集成了元数据感知调度和异步执行，训练吞吐量提升最高 79%，离线监督准备较 SpecForge 加速最高 3.11 倍。
translation.brief: 该论文提出可组合的投机草稿设计与训练框架 LEGOSpec，通过组件化分解系统研究各组件效果并构建通用草稿 DFlux。

papers.title: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

translation.title: Leto：以效用为中心的智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖外部记忆在交互间保留和复用信息。现有记忆系统将记忆视为对过去的记录，并以与对话的忠实度来评估。然而，记忆的价值在于它能否改善智能体的响应。记忆系统需要在响应存在之前决定记什么和提供什么，而忠实度检验无法对照响应检验这两个决策。因此忠实的记忆可能无法改善响应。我们转而将记忆视为预测问题，提出 Leto，一个面向 LLM 智能体的记忆系统，关注记忆对未来的效用而非对过去的忠实。由于未来请求未知，Leto 通过记忆索引保留对对话细节的访问，使信息可通过其来源保持可用。当请求到达时，记忆回放利用该索引预测并提供智能体所需但请求未明确说明的上下文。所提供上下文的效用在响应生成前仍不确定，这促使我们设计一个效用循环，利用响应结果来改进未来的记忆选择。我们在三个场景的五个基准上与六个记忆系统对比评估。在个性化场景中，它在 PrefEval 上准确率超出最强对比记忆系统 16.3 个百分点，在 PERMA 上任务完成率高出 3.1 分。在长程任务中，它在 MemoryArena 五个环境的平均成绩上取得最佳总体表现，且增益随链深度增加。在长上下文理解中，它与基于原始历史的检索表现相当，同时提供更少的上下文 token。
translation.brief: 该论文提出以未来效用而非过去忠实度为核心的智能体记忆系统 Leto，通过记忆索引、记忆回放和效用循环优化记忆选择。

papers.title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
papers.abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

translation.title: LLM 评审能发现不安全的临床行为吗？一项故障注入研究
translation.abstract: 随着临床 AI 智能体开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估其行为。但这些评审模型识别临床上危险错误的可靠性如何，尤其是当智能体看起来已成功完成任务时？我们通过在 MedAgentBench 已验证的智能体轨迹中引入受控临床错误来研究这一问题。实验包括 416 条故障轨迹、八个错误类别和六个开源权重 LLM 评审模型。通过将每条故障轨迹与其正确对应轨迹比较，我们衡量评审模型是真正识别错误，还是仅仅将更多行为标记为不安全。结果表明，获取临床证据显著提高评审可靠性。仅展示最终答案时，评审模型无法识别不改变答案的错误，同时将 56% 的正确轨迹标记为不安全。提供完整轨迹信息时，区分不安全行为与正确行为的能力达到 0.75 分，提供实际 EHR 响应使区分能力提高 0.39。令人惊讶的是，包含智能体的推理并不能提升整体表现，反而使对错误报告临床值的检测降低 0.18，而这仍是最难检测的错误。MedGemma 表现不如通用模型，且是唯一漏掉潜在危险药物过量的评审模型。我们还发现该基准原始评分器接受了全部 38 条故意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而将 LLM 评审与基于完整 EHR 记录的规则检查器结合可检测 97% 的注入故障。
translation.brief: 该论文通过向 MedAgentBench 轨迹注入受控临床错误，评估 LLM 评审模型识别不安全临床行为的能力及不同信息条件的影响。

papers.title: PORTA: Systematic Discovery of Vulnerabilities in Identity Brokers
papers.abstract: Identity brokers such as Keycloak, Vault, and Dex translate authentication proofs from an upstream identity provider into sessions for downstream services. Due to their central role in authentication and trust mediation, a single vulnerability in a broker compromises every downstream service behind it. In fact, recent incidents have demonstrated that even widely adopted platforms are not immune to such issues, highlighting the critical need for systematic analysis. To build such an analysis, this work first defines invariants for broker operation. These invariants are not completely covered by existing authentication specifications, primarily because brokers are unique in their duality, i.e., acting simultaneously as a relying party and an identity provider. The invariants capture the properties that identity brokers must uphold throughout their workflows, as all 60 previous CVEs we consider violate at least one invariant. Within these workflows, we further define high-level action categories. Equipped with this information, our automated tool PORTA leverages a large language model (LLM) to generate API invocation sequences corresponding to the high-level action categories, and oracle assertions aligned with the specified invariants. PORTA identifies 33 previously unreported security vulnerabilities in seven popular open-source brokers. We study these novel vulnerabilities and trace them to eight recurring patterns. We responsibly disclosed all discovered vulnerabilities: 29 have been confirmed, 14 patched, and 19 assigned CVE numbers, with 10 CVEs rated as critical.

translation.title: PORTA：身份代理中漏洞的系统化发现
translation.abstract: Keycloak、Vault 和 Dex 等身份代理将来自上游身份提供者的认证证明转换为下游服务的会话。由于其在认证和信任中介中的核心地位，代理中的单个漏洞会危及其后所有下游服务。事实上，近期事件表明即使是广泛采用的平台也无法免于此类问题，凸显了系统化分析的迫切需要。为构建这样的分析，本工作首先定义了代理操作的不变量。这些不变量未被现有认证规范完全覆盖，主要因为代理具有独特的双重性，即同时充当依赖方和身份提供者。这些不变量刻画了身份代理在其工作流中必须维护的属性，我们考察的全部 60 个历史 CVE 均违反至少一个不变量。在这些工作流内，我们进一步定义了高层动作类别。基于这些信息，我们的自动化工具 PORTA 利用大语言模型（LLM）生成与高层动作类别对应的 API 调用序列，以及与指定不变量对齐的 oracle 断言。PORTA 在七个流行的开源代理中识别出 33 个此前未报告的安全漏洞。我们研究这些新漏洞并将其归因于八种反复出现的模式。我们负责任地披露了所有发现的漏洞：29 个已确认，14 个已修复，19 个已分配 CVE 编号，其中 10 个 CVE 被评为严重级别。
translation.brief: 该论文为身份代理定义操作不变量，并构建基于 LLM 的自动化工具 PORTA 系统化发现其安全漏洞。

papers.title: RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace diagnosis. On natural failures from TraceElephant and CatchBench POST, it outperforms these baselines and three open LLMs in localization.

translation.title: RecordRoute：基于定位引导诊断的智能体失败审计
translation.abstract: 审计失败的智能体执行需要识别责任主体、最早的决定性步骤以及错误模式。现有的代表性监督方法要么专注于步骤定位，要么从共享的轨迹表示中预测多个归因目标。这些方法没有利用定位结果来选择用于模式诊断的文本。为解决这一局限，我们提出 RecordRoute，将对比定位与局部诊断相结合。具体而言，它用词级和字符级特征表示每条记录，并通过轨迹内的比较学习对记录进行排序。被选中的记录提供主体和步骤信息，而其文本和元数据驱动模式预测。在受控注入的 Who&When Pro 上，RecordRoute 在全部四项官方指标上优于 StepFinder 和 ASCon。在主体和步骤预测固定的情况下，局部诊断达到 77.47% 的合并联合准确率，而全轨迹诊断为 69.28%。在来自 TraceElephant 和 CatchBench POST 的自然失败数据上，它在定位上优于这些基线以及三个开源 LLM。
translation.brief: 针对智能体失败审计中定位与模式诊断脱节的问题，提出将轨迹内对比定位与基于所选记录的局部诊断相结合的 RecordRoute 方法。

papers.title: SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

translation.title: SALSA：从学习到的分布中采样对抗后缀以评估 LLM 安全性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到越狱攻击，攻击者在看似良性的提示后附加优化后缀以绕过安全对齐。现有的基于优化的 GCG 类攻击可能有效，但推理时代价高昂，且迁移性差。我们提出 SALSA，一个从优化生成的攻击语料中学习越狱后缀分布的生成式框架。训练完成后，该模型支持高效的基于采样的攻击。在开源目标上，它取得了与最先进优化基线相当的攻击成功率，同时将每个提示的生成时间从 3.46 秒降至 0.04 秒。在黑盒迁移中，它对专有系统仍然高度有效，包括在 GPT-3.5-Turbo 上达到 99% 的 ASR，并在难度大得多的 GPT-4o 上达到 45% 的 ASR，在相同采样预算下是最强基线的两倍以上。我们还进一步解释了当学习到的后缀分布接近优化输出的分布时，生成式采样为何能保持高攻击成功率的直觉。总体而言，我们的结果表明，学习对抗后缀分布为持续的 LLM 漏洞发现提供了可扩展且实际高效的基础。
translation.brief: 针对 GCG 类攻击推理开销大且迁移性差的问题，提出从优化攻击语料中学习越狱后缀分布、通过采样高效生成攻击后缀的生成式框架 SALSA。

papers.title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
papers.abstract: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2's quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at this https URL

translation.title: 前沿 LLM 能否通过免工具的权重空间编程修复量化网络？
translation.abstract: 我们向 Claude 系列的四个大语言模型（LLM）提供一个 2 万参数的 CIFAR-10 CNN 的完整权重（以文本形式），并要求它们在不使用工具、数据或无法运行推理的情况下产出一个 4-bit 网络。标准的最近舍入（RTN）4-bit 量化将测试准确率从 81.4% 降至 60.4%。我们设计了四种在输入和任务描述上有所不同的评估协议并分析其响应。在前两种协议中，LLM 被给予浮点网络和 4-bit RTN 网络，并被告知准确率已显著下降。在后两种协议中，它们只收到浮点网络并被要求进行量化，以测试它们是否会自行应用优化方法还是退回到普通 RTN。我们的分析表明，前沿 LLM 可以恢复大部分损失的准确率。在每层仅给出一次回答的情况下，Opus 5.5 通过在每个 3x3 卷积核内平衡舍入误差，将 4-bit 网络的准确率提升至 77.95%，全程免工具地对整数权重进行推理。这比浮点网络低 3.5 个百分点，比从校准数据中学习舍入的 AdaRound 低 2.8 个百分点。在只给出浮点网络时，LLM 能说出误差抵消的修正方法但并不实际应用，而是退回到普通 RTN，最多带有轻微的尺度裁剪，这仍将 Fable 5.2 的量化网络提升至 70.0%。我们详细分析了 LLM 做了什么以及为什么有效。代码和提示可在该 https URL 找到。
translation.brief: 研究前沿 LLM 能否在无工具、无数据条件下通过权重空间编程修复 4-bit 量化 CNN 的精度损失，发现其可通过核内平衡舍入误差恢复大部分精度。

papers.title: Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
papers.abstract: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. We then apply the taxonomy to representative RAN control solutions across slow, medium, fast, and cross-timescale applications to identify which capabilities they implement and how these capabilities are combined in hybrid AI systems. We also review datasets, benchmarks, simulators, digital twins, and experimental platforms according to their support for the decision-making process and reproducible evaluation. The review highlights a gap between the availability of resources for closed-loop experimentation and the standardization of tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols needed for meaningful this http URL, we identify research directions for hybrid AI in AI-native RAN, including capability integration, multi-agent and cross-timescale coordination, constraint handling, and reproducible closed-loop evaluation. A curated list of surveyed works and evaluation resources is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 面向 AI 原生 RAN 控制的混合 AI：一种功能性视角
translation.abstract: AI 原生无线接入网（RAN）控制涉及跨网络实体、协议层和时间尺度的相互关联决策。理解 AI 与传统方法如何共同支持这些决策，需要一个比较其功能角色的共同基础。本综述提出一种与技术无关的 RAN 决策分类法，围绕四种互补能力组织：表示与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制以及决策综合。这些能力由其在控制过程中的角色定义，与实现它们的具体技术无关。通过这一视角，我们考察了代表性的 AI 和基于模型的方法，包括基础模型、世界模型、强化学习和优化。随后，我们将该分类法应用于慢速、中速、快速和跨时间尺度的代表性 RAN 控制方案，以识别它们实现了哪些能力以及这些能力在混合 AI 系统中如何组合。我们还根据对决策过程和可复现评估的支持，审查了数据集、基准、仿真器、数字孪生和实验平台。本综述指出了闭环实验资源的可用性与实现有意义评估所需的任务、指标和评估协议标准化之间的差距。最后，我们确定了 AI 原生 RAN 中混合 AI 的研究方向，包括能力集成、多智能体与跨时间尺度协调、约束处理以及可复现的闭环评估。已调研工作与评估资源的精选列表见该 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 与传统方法在 RAN 控制中缺乏统一比较基础的问题，提出围绕四种功能能力组织的技术无关决策分类法，并据此分析混合 AI 系统与评估资源。

papers.title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.

translation.title: 面向基于 LLM 的推荐系统的不确定性量化现实评估
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统提供了灵活的接口。然而，其输出的排序需要可靠的实例级不确定性监控。在这一场景中，比较不确定性量化（UQ）方法变得困难，因为 LLM 排序器缺乏标准的物品分类头。其得分可能依赖于选项标签、提示、生成过程以及可用的用户和物品证据。现有方法从不同来源获取不确定性，并应用于推荐过程的不同阶段。一些方法评估已输出的排序，而另一些则利用不确定性改变排序本身，使得直接比较困难。本文引入一个固定排序基准，在共享的输出契约下将八种异构 UQ 信号作为记录级监控器进行评估。我们在共享的固定排序协议下，在四个推荐数据集和两个 LLM 骨干上评估这些信号。从结果中我们得出三个主要观察。第一，即使在相同的参考实例上，UQ 方法的排序也会随骨干变化。第二，与排序对齐的 Top10Mass 在多种评估条件下提供了最强的标量 Error@10 检测，反映了与截断点对齐的有效监控，而其在流行度尾部目标上的优势缩小。第三，标量 UQ 信号在识别哪个控制具有更大的截断 NDCG@10 差异方面较弱，而来源特定的信号，包括扰动排序不稳定性和简单的列表级距离，提供了更强的成对控制一致性，反映了它们对两个受控证据来源的敏感性。这些发现促使我们将排序失败检测、跨推荐条件的鲁棒性以及对受控证据变化的响应作为 UQ 的不同属性来评估。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 排序器缺乏标准分类头导致 UQ 方法难以公平比较的问题，提出固定排序基准，在统一协议下评估八种异构不确定性信号作为记录级监控器。

papers.title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
papers.abstract: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

translation.title: Latent Merger：超网络生成 LoRA 的潜空间组合
translation.abstract: 近期工作提出了一些超网络，能够在单次前向传播中将文档转换为低秩参数更新（LoRA），从而将新知识快速注入冻结的 LLM。然而，在流式场景下为每个文档存储单独的 LoRA 适配器可能难以持续。本文以两个代表性系统 Doc-to-LoRA 和 SHINE 为例，研究超网络生成的 LoRA 的组合问题。我们发现超网络生成的 LoRA 在几何结构上与直接微调得到的 LoRA 截然不同：与下一词预测和问答微调的适配器（弥散且在文档间近乎正交）相比，它们表现出更强的谱集中性和更强的跨文档对齐性。基于这一观察，我们提出潜空间 LoRA 合并方法：先组合超网络的中间潜变量，再通过冻结的 LoRA 生成头解码合并后的潜变量。结果表明，潜空间合并技术在保持单一固定秩适配器的同时，始终优于权重空间和因子空间基线。这些结果支持将潜空间组合作为在固定输出秩预算下组合超网络生成 LoRA 的一种有前景的机制。
translation.brief: 解决流式场景下超网络生成的 LoRA 难以合并的问题，提出在超网络潜空间中组合中间潜变量再解码的合并方法。

papers.title: Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement
papers.abstract: Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer's chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena's designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.

translation.title: 值得等待吗？响应时间与流式输出如何影响对生成式 AI 回答的评价与聊天机器人参与度
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式 AI 聊天机器人的回答如今以截然不同的速度到达：推理模型在回复前会深思熟虑，而响应缓存可以立即返回存储的答案。对这些模型进行排名的盲偏好投票被解读为对其文本的评价，如果交付方式有影响，更快的回答理应更受青睐。然而，关于劳动错觉以及文本在屏幕上呈现方式的研究表明，逐步展开呈现的答案会比一次性展示的相同答案获得更高评价。我们通过自然使用中的三个变化来源检验这些观点。首先，法国政府聊天机器人竞技场 compar:IA 通过随机抽取，对重复的提示要么以边生成边流式输出的全新回答作答，要么一次性展示同一模型先前存储的答案。在同一提示下，重放使答案在决定性盲投票中获胜的概率降低了 25.8 个百分点。同一份存储文本在流式输出时赢得 57% 的决定性投票，重放时仅赢得 29%，且投票者认为重放的答案更不完整、更肤浅、更常出错。其次，服务商拥塞使流式回答变慢。在 324,029 段对话中，较慢的回答在投票中未获得可检测的净加分，但首次交互变慢会降低访客提出后续问题的可能性。第三，在日常 ChatGPT 使用的 4,378,514 条 WildChat 回复中，因拥塞而变慢的回复使用户更不愿意继续对话。交付方式确实影响了盲投票，但方向与竞技场设计者的预期相反，而等待则损失了后续提问——当两个答案都很慢时，这种损失无法通过两者之间的比较被察觉。这些结果对 AI 服务如何缓存和流式输出答案、如何预算延迟以及偏好排行榜如何评估模型都有借鉴意义。
translation.brief: 研究响应时间与流式输出对用户评价和参与度的影响，通过三个大规模自然实验发现流式呈现比一次性重放更受青睐、而等待会降低用户继续提问的意愿。

papers.title: Approximate MMS allocations for large number of agents
papers.abstract: We consider allocation of indivisible items to agents with non-negative additive valuations, under the maximin share (MMS) fairness benchmark. We prove that for every $\rho < 1$, there exists some $n_{\rho}$ such that every allocation instance with $n \ge n_{\rho}$ agents has a $\rho$-MMS allocation. This was explicitly stated as a conjecture in a recent paper of the authors, where it was shown to hold if the number of items is at most $(2 - \epsilon)n$ (and $n \ge n_{\rho, \epsilon}$). We build on some techniques from that earlier paper, including the construction of $\textit{ordinal MMS}$ allocations that give $n - O(\log^2 n)$ agents their full MMS. Among the new techniques that we introduce is the definition of $\textit{block-matchings}$ between the MMS partitions of two agents, and a proof that if the number of item types is small, then block-matchings of small width necessarily exist.
