translation.title: 面向大量智能体的近似 MMS 分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究在最大最小份额（MMS）公平性基准下，将不可分物品分配给具有非负可加估值的智能体的问题。我们证明，对于每个 $\rho < 1$，存在某个 $n_{\rho}$，使得每个拥有 $n \ge n_{\rho}$ 个智能体的分配实例都存在 $\rho$-MMS 分配。这一结论在作者近期的一篇论文中被明确表述为猜想，该论文证明了当物品数量至多为 $(2 - \epsilon)n$（且 $n \ge n_{\rho, \epsilon}$）时该结论成立。我们沿用了那篇早期论文的一些技术，包括构造能给 $n - O(\log^2 n)$ 个智能体其完整 MMS 的序数 MMS 分配。我们引入的新技术之一是定义两个智能体的 MMS 划分之间的块匹配（block-matchings），并证明当物品类型数量较少时，必然存在小宽度的块匹配。
translation.brief: 解决智能体数量很大时近似最大最小份额（MMS）公平分配的存在性问题，通过序数 MMS 分配与块匹配技术证明任意固定近似比在足够多智能体下必然可实现。

papers.title: $(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS Allocations
papers.abstract: We study maximin share (MMS) allocations of $m$ indivisible items among $n$ agents with additive valuations. We prove that for both goods and chores, the optimal MMS approximation factor converges to $1$ as $n$ grows. In particular, for every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, sufficiently large $n$, and any $m$, we give polynomial-time algorithms that compute a $(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS allocation for goods and a $(1+\varepsilon)$-MMS allocation for chores. Furthermore, both algorithms can be implemented using a polynomial number of bundle comparisons.

translation.title: $(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS 分配
translation.abstract: 我们研究在具有可加估值的 $n$ 个智能体之间分配 $m$ 个不可分物品的最大最小份额（MMS）分配问题。我们证明，无论是物品（goods）还是负担（chores），最优的 MMS 近似因子都随 $n$ 增大而收敛到 1。特别地，对于每个固定的 $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$、足够大的 $n$ 和任意 $m$，我们给出了多项式时间算法，可计算物品的 $(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS 分配和负担的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-MMS 分配。此外，两种算法都可以仅用多项式数量的捆绑比较来实现。
translation.brief: 解决智能体数量很大时物品与负担的近似 MMS 分配计算问题，给出多项式时间算法证明最优近似因子随智能体数增长收敛到 1。

papers.title: Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.abstract: Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a resource-efficient alternative to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) when fine-tuning LLMs, thanks to the inherent low dimensionality of the loss landscape. It relies on a two-point estimate of the gradient that only accesses the function value and not the gradient, bypassing the resource-heavy backpropagation. Recently, it was accidentally discovered that per-sample clipping can improve the performance of the trained model, while running a differentially private version of zeroth-order optimization \cite{zhang2024dpzero} with a very large privacy parameter $\epsilon$ (corresponding to very little privacy). In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and demonstrate that ($i$) the optimal choice of learning rate $\eta$ is inversely proportional to the clipping threshold $c$, satisfying $\eta c =$ constant; ($ii$) clipping drives the zeroth-order optimization to a different solution with higher test accuracy; and ($iii$) this phenomenon is only observed with per-sample clipped zeroth-order optimization and not other zeroth-order alternatives that also provide robust estimates of the gradient. Further analyses with artificially injected label noise reveals that clipping leads to more robust predictions, which stems from the implicit down weighting of hard-to-fit training examples. Our code is available at this https URL

translation.title: 理解零阶优化中的裁剪
translation.abstract: 零阶优化凭借损失景观固有的低维性，已成为微调 LLM 时替代随机梯度下降（SGD）的资源高效方案。它依赖仅访问函数值而不访问梯度的两点梯度估计，从而绕开了资源密集型的反向传播。最近，Zhang 等人（2024）在以极大隐私参数 $\epsilon$（对应极小隐私保护）运行差分隐私版零阶优化时，意外发现逐样本裁剪可以提升训练后模型的性能。本文系统性地研究了这一现象，并证明：(i) 学习率 $\eta$ 的最优选择与裁剪阈值 $c$ 成反比，满足 $\eta c =$ 常数；(ii) 裁剪使零阶优化收敛到测试准确率更高的不同解；(iii) 该现象仅在逐样本裁剪的零阶优化中出现，而在其他同样能提供鲁棒梯度估计的零阶替代方法中并不存在。通过人工注入标签噪声的进一步分析表明，裁剪带来更鲁棒的预测，其根源在于对难以拟合的训练样本的隐式降权。我们的代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 研究零阶优化中逐样本裁剪为何能提升模型性能，揭示学习率与裁剪阈值的最优反比关系及裁剪对难拟合样本的隐式降权机制。

papers.title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.

translation.title: 基于U统计量的LLM推理
translation.abstract: 自DeepSeek提出以来，组相对策略优化（GRPO）已被广泛用于训练大型推理模型和智能体，催生了大量变体。然而组大小作为这类GRPO算法中的关键超参数，很大程度上仍靠试错选择。利用GRPO策略梯度的U统计量结构，我们将组大小的选择重新表述为一个经典的统计问题——方差比估计。当比率的分母较小时，该问题尤为困难，使得朴素的代入估计量不稳定。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种考虑分母估计不确定性的悲观比率估计量，并刻画了该估计量在三种样本量情形下的统计性质。实证上，在Reasoning Gym的合成任务以及涵盖数学推理和代码生成的真实基准上，使用基于jackknife的悲观规则，我们表明自适应组大小选择降低了所得策略梯度的均方误差，并在适度额外计算成本下优于固定组大小的基线方法。
translation.brief: 解决GRPO组大小超参数靠试错选择的问题，核心方法是利用其策略梯度的U统计量结构将组大小选择转化为方差比估计，并提出悲观比率估计量实现自适应选择。

papers.title: Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators in evaluation and training pipelines, their judgements are often affected by systematic biases that conflict with human preferences. Although prior work has identified various biases and proposed methods for detecting and mitigating them, less attention has been paid to using human preferences to inform bias identification and mitigation. Moreover, these approaches rely heavily on pre-discovered bias lists, overlook bias strength, and depend on costly interventions. In this work, we propose HUB-J, an integrated framework based on human-derived bias factors that detects, quantifies, and mitigates biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems. Our approach leverages human-LLM judgement disagreement cases to automatically discover interpretable bias factors, and utilizes agreement cases to quantify bias strength through controlled input modifications and resulting shifts in model decisions. Finally, building on these quantified biases, we introduce a lightweight, training-free regression-based mitigation strategy that estimates the influence of each bias factor on model judgments and corrects bias-influenced decisions by removing its estimated effect. Empirical results show that HUB-J uncovers both known and novel bias factors, reveals meaningful differences in model susceptibility, and consistently reduces bias-driven decision flips while generalizing across models.

translation.title: 审计裁判：LLM裁判中基于人类的偏差发现、量化与缓解
translation.abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地在评估和训练流程中充当自动评估器，但其判断常受与人类偏好相冲突的系统性偏差影响。虽然已有工作识别了多种偏差并提出了检测与缓解方法，但较少关注利用人类偏好来指导偏差的识别与缓解。此外，这些方法严重依赖预先发现的偏差列表、忽视偏差强度，并依赖代价高昂的干预。本文提出HUB-J，一个基于人类来源偏差因素的集成框架，用于检测、量化和缓解LLM-as-a-Judge系统中的偏差。我们的方法利用人类与LLM判断不一致的案例自动发现可解释的偏差因素，并利用一致的案例通过受控输入修改及由此引起的模型决策变化来量化偏差强度。最后，基于这些量化偏差，我们提出一种轻量、免训练的基于回归的缓解策略，估计每个偏差因素对模型判断的影响，并通过移除其估计效应来纠正受偏差影响的决策。实证结果表明，HUB-J发现了已知和新的偏差因素，揭示了模型易感性上的有意义差异，并在跨模型泛化时持续减少偏差驱动的决策翻转。
translation.brief: 解决LLM裁判系统性偏差依赖预知偏差列表且忽视偏差强度的问题，核心方法是利用人类与LLM判断不一致案例自动发现偏差因素、量化其强度，并用免训练的回归方法校正偏差影响。

papers.title: FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

translation.title: FOL-Proof：通过确定性语义验证LLM文本到逻辑的翻译
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于将自然语言语句翻译为一阶逻辑（FOL）以改进推理。然而LLM容易出错，语义不忠实的FOL公式可能破坏下游推理。我们提出FOL-Proof，一个语义防火墙流水线，用于对照独立推导的语言学解释验证LLM生成的FOL翻译。FOL-Proof通过语义分析工具（如English Resource Grammar和Minimal Recursion Semantics）确定性地获得候选翻译池，然后用SMT求解器检查每个推导读法与LLM生成公式是否逻辑等价。若翻译忠实则接受；否则拒绝，或可选地通过反复调用LLM进行修复。该过程是保守的：搜索不完整、不支持的构造或结论不明确的检查会产生弃权而非错误拒绝。我们在既有基准（ProofWriter、RuleTaker和PrOntoQA）以及新的对抗性基准（LongFaithCheck）上评估了FOL-Proof。实验表明FOL-Proof达到近乎完美的选择性准确率，而直接LLM裁判和往返基线的性能明显更差。
translation.brief: 解决LLM将自然语言翻译为FOL可能语义不忠实的问题，核心方法是用语义分析工具确定性生成候选翻译，再用SMT求解器检查逻辑等价性以验证或修复翻译。

papers.title: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
papers.abstract: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of this http URL on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.

translation.title: Shifter量化：面向原生整数计算的紧凑表示
translation.abstract: 分组量化被用于LLM量化以在低位宽下提升精度，但对权重分组使得标准整数MMA无法跨越完整点积以实现高效GPU推理。我们开发了一种新的量化方法——Shifter量化（SQ），通过追加和移位共享比特来重构原生宽度整数操作数。为进一步提升效率，我们开发了SQ的特殊变体Shifter Integer（SHI）以使用INT4内核。我们表明，以投影误差和KL散度衡量，SQ和SHI格式在质量上优于标准分组量化，并在解码和prefill期间的推理速度上也更优。对于2-bit量化等低精度，SQ2和SHI2在Q2_K检查点上达到该 http URL 的4,096-token prefill吞吐量的2.71-3.77倍，并将WikiText-2 KL降低6.6-7.8%。对于4-bit量化等中等精度，SQ4在测试的模型和提示长度上达到NInfer分组整数基线prefill吞吐量的1.43-2.47倍，KL比NInfer基线低24-40%。对于8-bit量化等高精度，SQ8比vLLM的在线FP8实现27.4%更高的batch-one prefill吞吐量和低72.7%的KL。
translation.brief: 解决分组量化权重导致整数MMA无法高效执行完整点积的问题，核心方法是通过追加和移位共享比特重构原生宽度整数操作数（SQ/SHI格式）以实现高效GPU推理。

papers.title: Who decides the norms in TCS? Analysing the composition of the STOC 2027 committees and of the Simons Institute "AI+TCS" working group
papers.abstract: A working group organised by the Simons Institute released a report last September containing recommendations aiming to increase the usage of LLMs in theoretical computer science (TCS), including introducing them for communication and evaluation. Most of these recommendations were enacted by the STOC 2027 programme committee and the ACM SIGACT executive committee (as the steering committee of STOC). The composition of the Simons Institute working group is analysed along two axes: country of affiliation, and ties with industry (i.e. affiliated with or funded by). The results show an overwhelming representation of researchers from US institutions and private companies, and a large over-representation of researchers with ties to AI/Big Tech companies (in the present or the recent past). The composition of the STOC 2027 and 2026 programme committees is analysed in terms of country of affiliation. The results show a large over-representation in 2027 of researchers from US institutions/companies, and large under-representation of researchers from EU and Asian institutions, as compared to 2026. The composition of the ACM SIGACT extended executive committee is analysed along the same two axes as the Simons Institute working group: country and industrial ties. The results show the same overwhelming representation of researchers from US institutions/companies, and a large representation of researchers with ties to AI/Big Tech companies.

translation.title: 谁在决定TCS的规范？分析STOC 2027委员会与Simons Institute "AI+TCS"工作组的构成
translation.abstract: Simons Institute组织的一个工作组去年九月发布了一份报告，其中包含旨在增加LLM在理论计算机科学（TCS）中使用的建议，包括将其引入交流和评估。这些建议中的大部分已被STOC 2027程序委员会和ACM SIGACT执行委员会（作为STOC的指导委员会）采纳。我们从两个维度分析Simons Institute工作组的构成：所属国家以及与产业界的联系（即隶属于或受资助于）。结果显示来自美国机构和私营公司的研究人员占压倒性多数，且与AI/大型科技公司有联系（现在或近期）的研究人员严重超额代表。我们按所属国家分析STOC 2027和2026程序委员会的构成。结果显示，与2026年相比，2027年来自美国机构/公司的研究人员大幅超额代表，而来自欧盟和亚洲机构的研究人员严重不足。我们按与Simons Institute工作组相同的两个维度（国家和产业联系）分析ACM SIGACT扩大执行委员会的构成。结果显示同样存在来自美国机构/公司研究人员的压倒性代表，以及与AI/大型科技公司有联系的研究人员的大量代表。
translation.brief: 分析推动LLM进入TCS的Simons Institute工作组及STOC 2027委员会的人员构成，核心方法是从所属国家和产业联系两个维度进行代表性统计分析。

papers.title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
papers.abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

translation.title: AIChipBench：面向自动化AI加速器设计的LLM智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 语言模型解码器需要在解码步骤之间传递状态，而在硬件中，错误的状态更新可能使当前token正确却在若干token之后破坏输出，因此设计可能通过输出测试却仍是错误的。AIChipBench探究LLM编程智能体正确构建此类硬件需要什么。智能体以可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码实现量化版Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器，对照一个可执行的整数参考实现，该参考规定了每个解码步骤的输出和存储状态。智能体在固定预算下针对公开测试进行调试；其冻结的设计在保留的token序列、复位、内存停顿和综合上进行评分，第二条赛道要求它们在面积几乎不变的前提下加速一个正确设计。在四个编程智能体的9,136次尝试中，难点在于存储状态。在一项匹配研究中，指向首个状态不匹配的反馈在全部12个智能体-任务组合中都将接受率相对仅输出反馈提高了25.0至46.9个百分点，并将每个被接受设计所需的智能体工时减半。在新序列和新条件下重新评分时，69个被接受的设计中有45个在其测试所要求的32步内失败。超过三分之一的加速正确设计的尝试以失败告终。一个综合评分将Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1排在Astra 6和Opus 5.5之上，且在全部200次随机划分中，两个实例子集都给出这一排序。因此，硬件智能体需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其基准测试也需要远超开发用例的最终测试。
translation.brief: 该论文针对LLM智能体正确实现硬件解码器（尤其是存储状态）的难题，构建了带可执行整数参考和状态暴露调试反馈的RTL设计基准AIChipBench。

papers.title: Improved Downward-Closed Delegation Bounds
papers.abstract: We study delegated choice under a downward-closed feasibility constraint, where the principal and agent values of each item may be arbitrarily correlated but items are independent. We give a deterministic, agent-oblivious menu that guarantees the principal more than $29/70\approx0.41429$ of the expected offline optimum under every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. The menu depends only on the feasible family and the principal's value distributions, and verifies a proposal using only its items and their principal values. The previous best guarantee for downward-closed constraints was $0.1098$. Matroid constraints admit a guarantee of one half, which is tight already in rank one, but downward-closed constraints do not: a five-item knapsack instance bounds every deterministic menu by $500/1011$ of the optimum, and no rule with randomized acceptance, even one that knows the agent's utilities, can guarantee more than $30/61$. An explicit computer-assisted family of instances lowers the bound to $0.48105$ for all such rules. The guarantee is proved by contradiction. If every menu in a fixed family earns at most a $29/70$ fraction of the optimum, then a normalized instance satisfies a finite system of affine inequalities among the survival functions, stop-loss transforms and overshoot means of its clipped optima. An exact rational certificate shows that the system is infeasible. We also give a short analytic proof that a single threshold on the reported total value guarantees $3/10$.

translation.title: 改进的向下封闭委托界
translation.abstract: 我们研究向下封闭可行性约束下的委托选择问题，其中每个物品的委托人和代理人价值可以任意相关，但物品之间相互独立。我们给出一个确定性的、对代理人无感知的菜单，保证在每一种最优响应（包括不利于委托人的平局裁决）下，委托人获得超过$29/70\approx0.41429$的期望离线最优值。该菜单仅依赖于可行族和委托人的价值分布，并且仅使用物品及其委托人价值即可验证一个提案。向下封闭约束的此前最佳保证为0.1098。拟阵约束可保证二分之一，且在秩为一时已是紧的，但向下封闭约束并非如此：一个五物品背包实例将所有确定性菜单限制在最优值的$500/1011$以内，而任何带随机接受机制的规则，即使知道代理人的效用，也无法保证超过$30/61$。一个显式的计算机辅助实例族将所有此类规则的界降至0.48105。该保证通过反证法证明：若某固定族中的每个菜单获得的收益都不超过最优值的$29/70$，则一个归一化实例在其截断最优值的生存函数、止损变换和超出均值之间满足一个有限的仿射不等式组。一个精确的有理数证书表明该不等式组不可行。我们还给出一个简短的解析证明：对报告的总价值设置单一阈值可保证$3/10$。
translation.brief: 该论文研究向下封闭约束下的委托选择问题，通过反证法与精确有理数证书将确定性菜单的保证从0.1098提升至29/70。

papers.title: Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
papers.abstract: Agents built on frontier language models are expensive. At every step, the frontier model re-reads its entire context and executes every subtask regardless of its difficulty. This paper explores the simple thesis that much of this cost can be removed by delegating easy subtasks to a small language model, or SLM, that runs on hardware one already owns. To test it, we build Delegent, a simple and effective agent harness built on Claude Code, in which the frontier model stays in charge of every task but hands focused subtasks, such as investigating code, running tests, and searching a corpus, to SLM subagents. Existing approaches such as cascades and model routers usually choose which model executes the entire task, whereas in Delegent, the frontier model always leads the execution and delegates easy subtasks to the SLM. No router or model is trained, so either model can be swapped freely. With the help of a 27B FP8 SLM, Delegent reduces the frontier cost of long-horizon coding by 67% and of agentic search by 59%, with no loss in task performance, and even a 2B SLM that fits on a laptop reduces the coding cost by 66%. The savings grow with the legwork that the frontier model would otherwise do itself, and a short instruction, which leaves the main coding tasks to the frontier model, accounts for most of the saving and keeps the 2B SLM from losing tasks. translation.title: Delegent：一种在不牺牲性能的前提下降低成本的多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 基于前沿语言模型的智能体成本高昂。在每一步，前沿模型都会重新读取其全部上下文，并且无论子任务难易都亲自执行。本文探索一个简单的论点：通过将简单子任务委托给一个运行在自有硬件上的小语言模型（SLM），可以消除大部分成本。为验证这一点，我们构建了Delegent，一个基于Claude Code的简单而有效的智能体框架，其中前沿模型始终主导每个任务，但将聚焦的子任务（如调查代码、运行测试、搜索语料库）交给SLM子智能体。级联和模型路由器等现有方法通常选择由哪个模型执行整个任务，而在Delegent中，前沿模型始终主导执行，仅将简单子任务委托给SLM。无需训练任何路由器或模型，因此两个模型都可以自由替换。借助一个27B FP8的SLM，Delegent将长程编程的前沿模型成本降低67%，将智能体搜索成本降低59%，且任务性能无损；即使是一个可装进笔记本电脑的2B SLM也能将编程成本降低66%。节省量随前沿模型原本需要亲自完成的杂务量增长，而一条简短的指令——将主要编程任务留给前沿模型——贡献了大部分节省，并防止2B SLM丢失任务。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文针对前沿LLM智能体成本过高的问题，提出Delegent框架，由前沿模型主导执行并将简单子任务委托给本地SLM以降低成本。

papers.title: GREMLIN: Generating Random Environments for Meta-Learning with Interacting Networks
papers.abstract: Can randomly parameterized neural environments supply useful experience for learning a reinforcement learning algorithm? We investigate this question using DiscoRL's rule-discovery framework, replacing human-designed training games with sixteen selected neural environments. Each game combines bounded vector dynamics with a random strategy-based reward and an independent outcome reward. After 224.8 million agent-environment steps, we froze the teacher and trained fresh agents. DQN outscored GREMLIN on most games, both generated and human-designed. GREMLIN nevertheless outperformed the untrained teacher on all 26 games, showing that generated experience can improve a learning rule. It remains unclear whether this approach can yield a competitive rule with longer meta-training.

translation.title: GREMLIN：面向交互网络元学习的随机环境生成
translation.abstract: 随机参数化的神经网络环境能否为学习一个强化学习算法提供有用的经验？我们使用DiscoRL的规则发现框架研究这一问题，用十六个精选的神经网络环境替代人工设计的训练游戏。每个游戏将有界向量动态与基于随机策略的奖励以及一个独立的结果奖励相结合。经过2.248亿个智能体-环境步后，我们冻结教师并训练全新智能体。DQN在大多数游戏（包括生成的和人工设计的）上得分超过GREMLIN。然而，GREMLIN在全部26个游戏上都优于未训练的教师，表明生成的经验可以改进学习规则。这种方法能否通过更长的元训练产生有竞争力的规则仍不清楚。
translation.brief: 该论文探究随机参数化神经网络环境能否替代人工设计游戏用于元学习强化学习算法，采用DiscoRL规则发现框架在生成的神经环境中训练学习规则。

papers.title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.

translation.title: 面向投机解码的草稿校准：通过匹配草稿与目标分布加速LLM服务
translation.abstract: 投机解码通过使用轻量级草稿模型提出草稿token，并允许目标模型并行验证新token以提高推理时计算利用率，从而加速大语言模型（LLM）推理。加速效果依赖于草稿token在目标验证中的接受概率，该概率与目标分布$p$和草稿分布$q$之间的差距$\|p-q\|_1$直接相关。本文研究投机解码的草稿校准以提升其加速效果，即采用事后方法校准草稿分布以缓解分布差距。我们观察到，尽管当前社区开源草稿模型可能正确学习到头部候选token，但与目标模型相比它们通常置信度不足，表明存在一致的分布失配。为减轻这种失配对草稿模型接受率的影响，我们尝试了多种事后校准方法，包括标准的温度缩放和逐token校准。结果表明，对草稿分布应用标准温度缩放可在不同任务上以几乎零额外成本将接受长度提升至多约10%。吞吐量分析进一步验证了这一服务效率的提升。对更一般校准方法的分析揭示了进一步的改进空间。
translation.brief: 该论文针对投机解码中草稿模型与目标模型的分布失配问题，采用温度缩放等事后校准方法校准草稿分布以提升接受率和加速效果。

papers.title: MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate parallel programs, but their correctness and performance depend strongly on the instructions that guide generation. We present \textsc{MetaFORGE}, an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation. \textsc{MetaFORGE} combines correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static-analysis findings, runtime measurements, and rank-level load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward that drives textual-gradient refinement, while an external memory distills and retrieves reward-supported optimization knowledge across runs. Across six MPI tasks and three workload sizes, \textsc{MetaFORGE} improves static-analysis quality, runtime, and load balance relative to zero-shot generation and generally exceeds the evaluated \textsc{TextGrad} iterative baseline. A model-matched refinement ablation shows that the MetaFORGE advantage persists when its refinement model is reduced to \texttt{gpt-4o}. An expanded retrieval ablation across all 18 task--workload configurations shows consistent runtime benefit and broad static-analysis and load-balance benefit from retrieved context. Leakage-controlled held-out and zero-update experiments further provide evidence that optimization knowledge persists in both the transferred skill and external memory under the evaluated protocol.

translation.title: MetaFORGE：面向并行计算自动代码生成中Harness优化的元学习框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以生成并行程序，但其正确性和性能在很大程度上取决于引导生成过程的指令。我们提出MetaFORGE，一个以执行结果为依据的元学习框架，用于迭代优化面向MPI C代码生成的持久化自然语言技能规范。MetaFORGE将正确性测试、编译器诊断、静态分析结果、运行时测量以及rank级负载不均衡画像组合成一个标量奖励，驱动基于文本梯度的精炼，同时由外部记忆在多次运行之间提炼并检索有奖励支撑的优化知识。在六个MPI任务和三种工作负载规模上，MetaFORGE相对于零样本生成提升了静态分析质量、运行时和负载均衡，并总体上优于所评估的TextGrad迭代基线。模型匹配的精炼消融实验表明，即使将精炼模型降级为gpt-4o，MetaFORGE的优势依然存在。覆盖全部18个任务-工作负载配置的扩展检索消融实验显示，检索到的上下文带来一致的运行时收益以及广泛的静态分析和负载均衡收益。泄漏受控的留出实验和零更新实验进一步提供了证据，表明在所评估的协议下，优化知识同时持久存在于迁移的技能和外部记忆中。
translation.brief: 解决LLM生成MPI并行代码质量依赖指令的问题，提出以执行反馈驱动文本梯度精炼和外部记忆检索的元学习框架MetaFORGE。

papers.title: SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

translation.title: SAG-Mem-1.0 技术报告
translation.abstract: 长期对话记忆需要检索散布在多个对话会话中的互补事实，包括与原始问题相似度有限的中间证据。现有方法通常依赖派生的记忆表示或持久化的关系结构，带来构建成本并可能丢失源细节。我们提出SAG-Mem，一个对话记忆框架，它将完整的对话消息保存在不重叠的分块中，并通过查询时的词法扩展发现互补证据。记忆构建无需模型推理，使用词法索引，不依赖基于LLM的抽取、摘要或语义关系构建。在查询时，BM25检索初始候选，证据评估器识别有用的分块，来自所选证据的词法线索引导额外一轮检索。检索到的对话还会被标注相对时间表达式的日历解释，保留原始措辞和时间粒度。我们还引入SAG-Mem-Lite，一种替代配置，用基于嵌入的候选评分替代证据评分，在两个基准上以低于Full Context和所有基于记忆基线的运营成本实现低查询延迟。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上，SAG-Mem分别取得83.08和80.20的总分，均为所评估方法中的最高分。在LongMemEval上，它超过最强对比基线7.20分。SAG-Mem-Lite分别取得77.09和77.20。这些结果支持对话保留与证据引导的检索扩展作为长期对话记忆的有效设计。
translation.brief: 解决长期对话记忆中互补证据检索成本高的问题，提出保留完整对话分块并在查询时通过词法扩展进行证据引导检索的SAG-Mem框架。

papers.title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. The programmatic policy is developed in two stages: during exploration, multiple agents explore in parallel for task skills and ways to compose them, and a distilling agent condenses the successful attempts into a task library and one program. During refinement, this program is improved through randomized layouts for enhanced robustness and execution efficiency. In simulated environments, PyRUA-Dex achieves SOTA on Bench2Dex with a score of 72.9 and reaches 81.0% success on DexJoCo under full randomization, ahead of every trained policy on both benchmarks. In real world experiments on a bimanual platform with two 22-DoF hands, PyRUA-Dex learns to play piano, write calligraphy, and other tasks efficiently: learning a new piece from sheet music takes as little as 30 minutes. These results suggest that PyRUA-Dex is an effective framework for developing dexterous manipulation policies with coding agents in the absence of high quality dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

translation.title: PyRUA-Dex：用编码智能体学习灵巧双手操作的程序化策略
translation.abstract: 灵巧操作的学习受限于高质量演示数据的稀缺：从人类视频重定向不精确，遥操作无法给操作者提供力反馈，基于外骨骼的数据采集难以规模化。我们提出PyRUA-Dex，一个使编码智能体能够通过程序化策略发展灵巧操作能力的框架，无需演示数据。程序化策略分两个阶段开发：在探索阶段，多个智能体并行探索任务技能及其组合方式，一个蒸馏智能体将成功的尝试浓缩为任务库和一个程序。在精炼阶段，通过随机化布局提升该程序的鲁棒性和执行效率。在仿真环境中，PyRUA-Dex在Bench2Dex上以72.9分达到SOTA，并在完全随机化下在DexJoCo上达到81.0%的成功率，在两个基准上均领先所有训练得到的策略。在配备两只22自由度灵巧手的双手平台上的真实世界实验中，PyRUA-Dex高效学会弹钢琴、写书法等任务：从乐谱学习一首新曲子最快只需30分钟。这些结果表明，PyRUA-Dex是在缺乏高质量灵巧操作演示的情况下用编码智能体开发灵巧操作策略的有效框架。
translation.brief: 解决灵巧操作高质量演示数据稀缺的问题，提出让多个编码智能体并行探索并蒸馏出可精炼的程序化策略的PyRUA-Dex框架。

papers.title: CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies
papers.abstract: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

translation.title: CoT-Proxy：面向长程策略蒸馏的跨格式迁移
translation.abstract: 推理模型通过强化学习成为长程智能体，或者以更低成本通过在更强教师模型的轨迹上微调实现，这些轨迹包含教师的思维链及其动作。标准的微调方法同时模仿两者，然而最强的教师是闭源模型，其思维链隐藏在API之后。我们证明可以完全省略思维链，仅从教师的动作中蒸馏长程策略。学生在这些轨迹上训练，其推理块留空，同时在其自身生成的回放缓冲区上施加KL损失，以限制其偏离初始模型。令人惊讶的是，从这些推理块为空的轨迹中学到的策略可以迁移到启用思考的推理中，此时学生以自己的风格推理，同时表现得像教师，我们将这一效应称为跨格式迁移。蒸馏Qwen3.6-27B的动作将Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上的任务成功率从7%提升到18%，将Qwen3-32B从12%提升到25%。我们进一步引入CoT-proxy，即置于空推理块之后的教师推理简短摘要，将Qwen3-4B进一步提升到35%。由于动作和CoT-proxy都不需要隐藏的思维链，该配方无需修改即可应用于闭源教师。从GPT-5.6 Luna的可见输出及其API返回的推理摘要进行蒸馏，将Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上从7%提升到48%，在SWE-bench Verified上从3%提升到28%。
translation.brief: 解决闭源教师思维链不可见导致长程策略蒸馏受限的问题，提出仅用教师动作加CoT-proxy摘要进行跨格式迁移蒸馏的方法。

papers.title: Envy-Free Cake-Cutting for Five Agents
papers.abstract: We study the envy-free cake-cutting problem, in which a divisible resource must be divided among a set of agents with heterogeneous preferences in a way that ensures that no agent envies the piece obtained by another. Remarkably, under some mild continuity assumptions on the agent valuations, it is known that an envy-free division where each agent receives a \emph{connected} piece of the cake is always guaranteed to exist. When the valuations are monotone, prior work has shown that a connected $\varepsilon$-envy-free division can be obtained using $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries for up to four agents, leaving the case of five or more agents open. In this work, we develop a new simpler approach that yields such an efficient algorithm for five agents. Our algorithm uses $\mathcal{O}(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))$ queries and also yields a novel proof of existence for five agents that does not rely on any fixed-point theorems beyond the intermediate value theorem.

translation.title: 五智能体的无嫉妒蛋糕切分
translation.abstract: 我们研究无嫉妒蛋糕切分问题，即可分资源必须在具有异质偏好的智能体集合之间进行划分，并确保没有智能体嫉妒其他智能体获得的份额。值得注意的是，在对智能体估值的一些温和连续性假设下，已知每个智能体获得蛋糕一块连通份额的无嫉妒划分总是保证存在。当估值单调时，先前工作表明对于最多四个智能体，可以使用poly(log(1/ε))次查询获得连通的ε-无嫉妒划分，而五个或更多智能体的情形仍悬而未决。在本工作中，我们开发了一种新的更简单的方法，为五个智能体得到这样的高效算法。我们的算法使用O(log³(1/ε))次查询，并且还给出了五智能体情形的一个新颖的存在性证明，该证明不依赖除介值定理之外的任何不动点定理。
translation.brief: 解决五智能体连通无嫉妒切分的高效算法缺失问题，提出使用O(log³(1/ε))次查询的新算法及不依赖不动点定理的存在性证明。

papers.title: DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning
papers.abstract: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.

translation.title: DiaCap：面向视听对话字幕生成的“谁在何时说话”联合学习
translation.abstract: 我们提出了 DiaCap，一个用于全面对话字幕生成的视听大语言模型，它为视频中的每条话语生成转录文本、时间戳以及说话人的视觉描述。考虑到话语时间与视听说话人分离（diarization）紧密耦合，DiaCap 将这些任务统一在单一模型中，并通过两个互补阶段进行训练。首先，我们在 225K 条精选片段上训练 DiaCap，使用对每条话语进行密集详细标注的合成字幕。其次，我们在 2.9K 条人工校正片段上通过强化学习进一步优化模型，使用直接评估话语时间、说话人分组和说话人绑定的细粒度反馈。在 DiaDemBench（我们为其扩展了话语级时间戳和字幕遮蔽）上，使用现成转录文本的 DiaCap 及其端到端变体 DiaCap-E2E 均取得了强劲结果。具体而言，DiaCap 在视听说话人分离上与 Gemini 4 Argon 表现相当，同时在时间戳准确性上明显优于它（76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME）。它还在多语言和分钟级长度的视频上保持了强劲的说话人分离能力，并能迁移到视听问答任务。
translation.brief: 解决视频中每条话语的转录、时间戳与说话人视觉描述的联合生成问题，方法是将这些任务统一到一个视听 LLM 中，先用大规模合成字幕训练，再用人工校正数据通过强化学习细化。
